tei:div.tei:p: klu 'bum tshe ring gis brtsams/rna/rtsa la/ zugyi/ 3byu/ pa ge // rda~Xris/ spo shesherdor ༈/tsā dzeecirdo/rme7 tsho ciXrngopyekhu rto rdisnyerī ri (shaṃtre— tho / lha7 — —nga tre rijung lha'i tsu— — zlotre girirngo — sauhūṃ
dngul ru rna /klu 'bum tshe ring gis brtsams/kan su'u mi rigs dpe sgrun khang /
dngul 4 rna /klu 'bum tshe ring gis brtsams/kun su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

〈〈dngul gyi rna long〉rga klad kyi gtam/ring nas smon zhing ngang gis sgug mthar skom gdung gi tsha dugs 'joms pa la rtsom rig bsil ma'i char de dus su babs/yun ring rmo slog ma bgyis pa'i tha rgod rengs po brlan gyis bzung /de la dus las ma gzur ba'i 'phru slog byas/ chu lud drangs/ ldum bu bsal/ char rlung dang tsad skam la ma 'dzem pas/ nem 'bol gyi gshin sa zhig bod mi khri phrag gi bsod nams kyi dpal du 'khrungs/ dus rabs snga ma'i lo rabs brgyad bcu par rtsom rig gsar ba'i 'go legs po zhig tshugs shing / rim gyis 'phel rgyas su'ang phyin mod/ shin tu nyams spro ba'i tshad der da dung son ma thub pa 'dra/ da lta 'u cag gi rtsom rig gi zhing sa ru ldum bu dang me tog mnyam skye sog ma dang 'bras bu mnyam sdud/ ra snye ma stong ba'i ’mgo 'phang mtho ba 'di rgyun ldan zhig tu ji ltar mthong /1

〈〈dngul gyi rna long〉rga klad kyi gtam/ring nas smon zhing ngang gis sgug mthar skom gdung gi tsha dugs 'joms pa la rtsom rig bsil ma'i char de dus su babs/yun ring rmo slog ma bgyis pa'i tha rgod rengs po brlan gyis bzung /de la dus las ma gzur ba'i 'phru slog byas/ chu lud drangs/ ldum bu bsal/ char rlung dang tsad skam la ma 'dzem pas/ nem 'bol gyi gshin sa zhig bod mi khri phrag gi bsod nams kyi dpal du 'khrungs/ dus rabs snga ma'i lo rabs brgyad bcu par rtsom rig gsar ba'i 'go legs po zhig tshugs shing / rim gyis 'phel rgyas su'ang phyin mod/ shin tu nyams spro ba'i tshad der da dung son ma thub pa 'dra/ da lta 'u cag gi rtsom rig gi zhing sa ru ldum bu dang me tog mnyam skye sog ma dang 'bras bu mnyam sdud/ ‘‘snye ma stong ba'i ’mgo 'phang mtho ba 'di rgyun ldan zhig tu ji ltar mthong /1

des na nga tshos gzhung lugs kyi rlung khar 'phyar/ sgyu rtsal gyi thang mar brdal/ rdo zegs dang phub ma/ 'bru rdog rnams so sor 'byed rgyu ni kha tsha dgos gtugs su gyur yod pas snang med btang snyoms su bskyur bar mi rigs so/ /dga' 'os pa ni rtsom rig la mos pa'i rjes 'jug pa skor zhig gis rmang brtan po gzhi ru bting / blo 'khor phyogs yid la nges te lam ring bo gom pas 'jal bar lngi ba lding lding mi byed par nan nan bcag bcag gis spo/ snyan ngag dang / lhug rtsom/ de min sgrung gtam sogs kyi phyogs nas brtsams chos legs po re mthong rgyu yod pa des nga tshor re ba yod pa gsal bshad byas yod/ klu 'bum tshe ring ni lo rabs dgu bcu nas rtsom rig gi las la zhugs pa ste snyan ngag dang / sgrung gtam/ lhug rtsom gsum la gang dgar 'jug de las lhug rtsom la cung gzhol che/ lhug rtsom gyis blangs pa'i 'bras bu de snyan ngag dang / sgrung gtam las lhag snyam/ 'on te khos bris pa'i sgrung gtam gyi rtsom rtsal yang tshad nges can zhig la thon yod de/ tshig sbyor bde zhing / rjod byed kyi skad cha phun sum 2

des na nga tshos gzhung lugs kyi rlung khar 'phyar/ sgyu rtsal gyi thang mar brdal/ rdo zegs dang phub ma/ 'bru rdog rnams so sor 'byed rgyu ni kha tsha dgos gtugs su gyur yod pas snang med btang snyoms su bskyur bar mi rigs so/ /dga' 'os pa ni rtsom rig la mos pa'i rjes 'jug pa skor zhig gis rmang brtan po gzhi ru bting / blo 'khor phyogs yid la nges te lam ring bo gom pas 'jal bar lji ba lding lding mi byed par nan nan bcag bcag gis spo/ snyan ngag dang / lhug rtsom/ de min sgrung gtam sogs kyi phyogs nas brtsams chos legs po re mthong rgyu yod pa des nga tshor re ba yod pa gsal bshad byas yod/ klu 'bum tshe ring ni lo rabs dgu bcu nas rtsom rig gi las la zhugs pa ste snyan ngag dang / sgrung gtam/ lhug rtsom gsum la gang dgar 'jug de las lhug rtsom la cung gzhol che/ lhug rtsom gyis blangs pa'i 'bras bu de snyan ngag dang / sgrung gtam las lhag snyam/ 'on te khos bris pa'i sgrung gtam gyi rtsom rtsal yang tshad nges can zhig la thon yod de/ tshig sbyor bde zhing / rjod byed kyi skad cha phun sum 2

tshogs pas yid 'gug gi bro ba cung ldan/ 〈〈bsags 'bras〉〉kye mi sna yis nga tshor‘‘las 'bras rnam smin’byung zhes dbugs dbyung dang dga' ba mi skyes pa phud/ da dung mi zhig yin pa'i cha nas khag mi 'dug ces gdung sems dang rgyus lon par bskul la/bklags tshar rjes 'dang rgyag rgyu zhig ngang gis skye nges/ 〈〈rdo lo ske ring〉stanas dga' sdang chags gsum ldan pa'i sha khrag gdos bcas kyi mi sna zhig dpe gzhi can du bzhengs bskrun byed de mtha' mar re ba stong zad du gyur pa'i mi sna‘‘rdo lo’de ngu dgod spel ma rtsed mtshar gyi tshul du bris pa brgyud mi'i rang gshis 'bur du dod yod/〈〈'dam las skyes pa'i padma〉stanas dngos yod gzhi ru byas te de la las snon cung tsam gyis bsam pa'i snying stobs la re zhing snyeg pa de zhib 'bri byas pa cung bzang / sgrung thung〈〈ru nang gi 'brog pa〉༅sa tshig 'bru nyung ngur brten te bod mi'i rgyud na gnas pa'i byams dang snying rje bris pa brgyud/ ‘‘'khon yod kyang 'khon mi slog ’pa'i khong yangs de la bstod pa byas yod/ 'di dag legs cha'i tshul du mthong la/ de min da dung mu mthud nas 'tshol snyeg dang rang ngos 3

tshogs pas yid 'gug gi bro ba cung ldan/ 〈〈bsags 'bras〉〉kye mi sna yis nga tshor las 'bras rnam smin’byung zhes dbugs dbyung dang dga' ba mi skyes pa phud/ da dung mi zhig yin pa'i cha nas khag mi 'dug ces gdung sems dang rgyus lon par bskul la/bklags tshar rjes 'dang rgyag rgyu zhig ngang gis skye nges/ 〈〈rdo lo ske ring〉stanas dga' sdang chags gsum ldan pa'i sha khrag gdos bcas kyi mi sna zhig dpe gzhi can du bzhengs bskrun byed de mtha' mar re ba stong zad du gyur pa'i mi sna rdo lo’de ngu dgod spel ma rtsed mtshar gyi tshul du bris pa brgyud mi'i rang gshis 'bur du dod yod/〈〈'dam las skyes pa'i padma〉(pes dngos yod gzhi ru byas te de la las snon cung tsam gyis bsam pa'i snying stobs la re zhing snyeg pa de zhib 'bri byas pa cung bzang / sgrung thung〈〈ru nang gi 'brog pa〉stabs tshig 'bru nyung ngur brten te bod mi'i rgyud na gnas pa'i byams dang snying rje bris pa brgyud/ ‘ 'khon yod kyang 'khon mi slog ’pa'i khong yangs de la bstod pa byas yod/ 'di dag legs cha'i tshul du mthong la/ de min da dung mu mthud nas 'tshol snyeg dang rang ngos 3

nas mthor 'degs su gtong dgos shing / tha na snga ma'i sgyu rtsal 'tshol snyeg gi rjes shul khrod bsam blo sgyu rtsal gang rung gi cha na da dung na ma smin cing tshad du ma longs pa spang byar 'os pa'ang ldod srid mod khong gi skyes sbyang gi shes rab dang 'gan 'khri'i 'du shes la dpags tshe de dag yun gyis khyad du bsad de sngar las mdzes pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi zhal thang gsar ba zhig kun gyi gzigs mor 'bul nus pa nga tshor yid ches bdo/ zhes pa'ang bskul ngor snyug thogs pa 'ju skal bzang nas bris shing phul/

nas mthor 'degs su gtong dgos shing / tha na snga ma'i sgyu rtsal 'tshol snyeg gi rjes shul khrod bsam blo sgyu rtsal gang rung gi cha na da dung na ma smin cing tshad du ma longs pa spang byar 'os pa'ang ldod srid mod khong gi skyes sbyang gi shes rab dang 'gan 'khri'i 'du shes la dpags tshe de dag yun gyis khyad du bsad de sngar las mdzes pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi zhal thang gsar ba zhig kun gyi gzigs mor 'bul nus pa nga tshor yid ches bdo/ zhes pa'ang bskul ngor skug thogs pa 'ju skal bzang nas bris shing phul/

tshong ba phag lo/ 1bsags 'bras/ 7rdzong dpon gyis kha lo ba brje spor byas/ 7gsar bu rta mgrin/ lkordo lo ske ring / 7zhor las pa tshe lo 69gsar bu lha rgyal gyi gtam rgyud/ 76'dam las skyes pa'i pad ma/ 91brel ba che ba'i mi 103'u gnyis sdong mgo gcig la babs pa'i bya yin/ 120dngul gyi rna long / 142byams pa/ 157ru nang gi 'brog pa/ 172dgong mo der khos mi lam 'khral 'khrul zhig ma mis/ 177mjug gtam/ 2011

tshong ba phag lo/ 1bsags 'bras/ 7rdzong dpon gyis kha lo ba brje spor byas/ phogasar bu rta mgrin/ lkordo lo ske ring / 7zhor las pa tshe lo 69gsar bu lha rgyal gyi gtam rgyud/ 76'dam las skyes pa'i pad ma/ 91brel ba che ba'i mi 103'u gnyis sdong mgo gcig la babs pa'i bya yin/ 120dngul gyi rna long / 142byams pa/ 157ru nang gi 'brog pa/ 172dgong mo der khos mi lam 'khral 'khrul zhig ma mis/ 177mjug gtam/ 2011

dacal gyi rna long /tshong ba phag lo/phag lo ni rang sde ma zad sde ba yar mar kun la ming yod pa'i tshong pa zhig yin/ kho dus rgyun yul nas 'dug mi bzod par phyi ru tshong rtsag rtsig byed du 'gro bar dga'/ thag ring 'brog phyogs su thengs mang song zhing / 'byog khul gyi ko ba dang / dbyar rtsa dgun 'bu sogs ni kho'i gnyer bya'i tshong gtso bo red/ kho 'brog phyogs su thengs mang por song bas mi mang por 'brel ba btsugs yod la/ de'i khar kho tshong yar bskor mar bskor la'ang mkhas pas da lta phag lo rgyu thog la brgyab 'dug ces kun gyis gleng gin 'dug go thos la kho'i ske na btags pa'i gzi mig dgu ma de tshong spogs kyis nyos pa red zer/ phag los gzi de nam yang srung 'khor bzhin du ske ru btags te gzhan la ngom so byed pas/ sus mthong na rgyu ma mi 'gul ba med la gan la rgyu med na su la yod ces snyam/ grong khyer la 'gro grangs mang zhing / khra khra rig rig gi grong khyer 'tsho bas phag lo'i yid sems bkug pas skyid snang zad med pa zhig skyes su bcug lhag tu kho skye bo gzhan dang bsdur na mo dad shin tu che la/ mor 1

dadul gyi rna long /tshong ba phag lo/phag lo ni rang sde ma zad sde ba yar mar kun la ming yod pa'i tshong pa zhig yin/ kho dus rgyun yul nas 'dug mi bzod par phyi ru tshong rtsag rtsig byed du 'gro bar dga'/ thag ring 'brog phyogs su thengs mang song zhing / 'brog khul gyi ko ba dang / dbyar rtsa dgun 'bu sogs ni kho'i gnyer bya'i tshong gtso bo red/ kho 'brog phyogs su thengs mang por song bas mi mang por 'brel ba btsugs yod la/ de'i khar kho tshong yar bskor mar bskor la'ang mkhas pas da lta phag lo rgyu thog la brgyab 'dug ces kun gyis gleng gin 'dug go thos la kho'i ske na btags pa'i gzi mig dgu ma de tshong spogs kyis nyos pa red zer/ phag los gzi de nam yang srung 'khor bzhin du ske ru btags te gzhan la ngom so byed pas/ sus mthong na rgyu ma mi 'gul ba med la gan la rgyu med na su la yod ces snyam/ grong khyer la 'gro grangs mang zhing / khra khra rig rig gi grong khyer 'tsho bas phag lo'i yid sems bkug pas skyid snang zad med pa zhig skyes su bcug lhag tu kho skye bo gzhan dang bsdur na mo dad shin tu che la/ mor 1

tshong ba phag lo/'grogs rgyur de bas dga'/ mo la phrad tshe kho gtong phod kyang che/ grong khyer gyi bro khang dang chang khang sogs ni phag lo rgyun du 'gro ba'i gnas shig yin/nyin gang mang ring la yar rgyugs mar rgyugs dang rin gong gi phyogs nas rtsod pa yang yang byas mthar de ring phyi dro da gzod kho'i dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu de gzhan la btsong thub song / tshong 'di'i mgo nas khe spogs ci 'dra zhig lon yod pa smra mi dgos te kho'i kha zum thub kyin med pa de las shes thub/tshong 'grig song bas sems lhod la babs shing du ba yang mor rngub/ phag lo'i sems la do dgong za ma gya rnam pa zhig zos rjes snga mor nyal te ngal gso tshim po zhig byed dgos snyam/ 'on kyang mgron khang 'di 'dra chen po zhig gi nang rang gcig pur lus pas/ nam rgyun zang zing la dga' ba'i kho gcig pur 'dug mi lobs pas/ sun snang ngam stong snang zhig kho la rim gyis skyes/ 'di ltar bsdad na snying bo ci yod/ do dgong bro khang zhig gi nang bag g.yeng byed du 'gro snyam/ phag lo khrus gzhong nang lding ste lus po gtsang mar bkrus/ phyi gling pa'i gon pa rtsa chen de lus la gyon/ skra lo lan 'gar shad/ rkang lham 'od yug ger btang / ngo blta nar mo de'i mdun du phar 'gro tshur 'ong dang g.yas blta g.yon blta 'ga' byas rjes gzi mig dgu ma der reg reg byed bzhin sgo la bud/rlangs 'khor chung chung zhig glas te kho thad kur mgron khang dang cung tha~X ring ba'i rmi lam zhes pa'i chang khang gi phyogs su song / tshon mdog sna

tshongasnyeb phag lo/'grogs rgyur de bas dga'/ mo la phrad tshe kho gtong phod kyang che/ grong khyer gyi bro khang dang chang khang sogs ni phag lo rgyun du 'gro ba'i gnas shig yin/nyin gang mang ring la yar rgyugs mar rgyugs dang rin gong gi phyogs nas rtsod pa yang yang byas mthar de ring phyi dro da gzod kho'i dbyar tsu dgun 'bu de gzhan la btsong thub song / tshong 'di'i mgo nas khe spogs ci 'dra zhig lon yod pa smra mi dgos te kho'i kha zum thub kyin med pa de las shes thub/tshong 'grig song bas sems lhod la babs shing du ba yang mor rngub/ phag lo'i sems la do dgong za ma gya nom pa zhig zos rjes snga mor nyal te ngal gso tshim po zhig byed dgos snyam/ 'on kyang mgron khang 'di 'dra chen po zhig gi nang rang gcig pur lus pas/ nam rgyun zang zing la dga' ba'i kho gcig pur 'dug mi lobs pas/ sun snang ngam stong snang zhig kho la rim gyis skyes/ 'di ltar bsdad na snying bo ci yod/ do dgong bro khang zhig gi nang bag g.yeng byed du 'gro snyam/ phag lo khrus gzhong nang lding ste lus po gtsang mar bkrus/ phyi gling pa'i gon pa rtsa chen de lus la gyon/ skra lo lan 'gar shad/ rkang lham 'od yug ger btang / ngo blta nar mo de'i mdun du phar 'gro tshur 'ong dang g.yas blta g.yon blta 'ga' byas rjes gzi mig dgu ma der reg reg byed bzhin sgo la bud/rlangs 'khor chung chung zhig glas te kho thad kar mgron khang dang cung tha/ ring ba'i rmi lam zhes pa'i chang khang gi phyogs su song / tshon mdog sna

dacal gyi rna long /lnga'i glog sgron gyi phreng ba'i lda ldi 'then pa'i sgo dmar po nang 'dzul ma thag mgron po la skug pa'i zhabs zhu sras mo tsho phag lo bslebs pa mthong ba dang gzan la bkram pa'i khyim bya bzhin kho'i phyogs su 'du 'ong / ngo ma phag lor mtshon na phyi'i pho sgo dang gzugs skyelus gang yang mi 'dzom mod/ tsho zhing rgyags pa'i sku lus thung thung steng da lta dar khyab che ba'i phe 'ar khā tan rtags can gyi phyi gling pa'i thog lu cha tshang zhig gyon yod la/ gzi mig dgu ma de brang kha na phar g.yo tshur g.yo byed kyin 'dug pa la bltas pa tsam gyis phag lo ni rgyu 'byor ba che ba'i mi bsod nams can zhig yin pa'i snang ba ster/ khe phan gtso bor 'dzin pa'i da lta'i dus 'dir grong khyer gyi bu mo khag gcig gis skyes pa'i phyi'i pho sgo bzang ngan dang gzugs kyi ring thung / lo'i rgan gzhon la de 'dra do snang mi bya ste rgyu stobs che na tshang ma de la dga' zhing de la dungs/ de gong du'ang bkur nges/ phag lo la yang sras mo tshos g.yas g.yon gnyis nas gral sgrig rsā khyed rang dus ltar phebs par dga' bsu zhu/ nang du phebs/ nang du phebarsā zhes rab tu gus pas/ phag los kyang mgo bar snang du btegs te 'gying nger song /glog 'od rab rib yin pa'i zur bzhugs khang zhig gi nang phag lo bsdad/ cang ma 'gor bar skyes gzugs shin tu phra ba'i zhabs zhu sraṭa mo zhig ldem ldem ngang tshur 'ong ste phag lo la zur mig lan 'ga' 'phen bzhin lu chang drangs/ a jo lags/ tshong gnyer du phebs sam zhes dris pa dang sras mo de 3

dngul gyi rna long /lnga'i glog sgron gyi phreng ba'i lda ldi 'then pa'i sgo dmar po nang 'dzul ma thag mgron po la sgug pa'i zhabs zhu sras mo tsho phag lo bslebs pa mthong ba dang gzan la bkram pa'i khyim bya bzhin kho'i phyogs su 'du 'ong / ngo ma phag lor mtshon na phyi'i pho sgo dang gzugs skyelus gang yang mi 'dzom mod/ tsho zhing rgyags pa'i sku lus thung thung steng da lta dar khyab che ba'i phe 'ar khā tan rtags can gyi phyi gling pa'i thog lwa cha tshang zhig gyon yod la/ gzi mig dgu ma de brang kha na phar g.yo tshur g.yo byed kyin 'dug pa la bltas pa tsam gyis phag lo ni rgyu 'byor ba che ba'i mi bsod nams can zhig yin pa'i snang ba ster/ khe phan gtso bor 'dzin pa'i da lta'i dus 'dir grong khyer gyi bu mo khag gcig gis skyes pa'i phyi'i pho sgo bzang ngan dang gzugs kyi ring thung / lo'i rgan gzhon la de 'dra do snang mi bya ste rgyu stobs che na tshang ma de la dga' zhing de la dungs/ de gong du'ang bkur nges/ phag lo la yang sras mo tshos g.yas g.yon gnyis nas gral sgrig ste khyed rang dus ltar phebs par dga' bsu zhu/ nang du phebs/ nang du phebs zhes rab tu gus pas/ phag los kyang mgo bar snang du btegs te 'gying nger song /glog 'od rab rib yin pa'i zur bzhugs khang zhig gi nang phag lo bsdad/ cang ma 'gor bar skyes gzugs shin tu phra ba'i zhabs zhu srab mo zhig ldem ldem ngang tshur 'ong ste phag lo la zur mig lan 'ga' 'phen bzhin lu chang drangs/ a jo lags/ tshong gnyer du phebs sam zhes dris pa dang sras mo de 3

tshong ba phag lo/la 'byar te tsog un/ tshong chung chung zhig brgyab pa tsam yigazhes ci mi snyam par bshad/ shog mnyam du bzhes phag los sras mo la yang lu chang drangs/ kho gnyis kyis mnyam du lu chang 'thung bzhin phyogs yar mar gyi kha brda mang po byas/ re zhig song ba na phag lo'i snang ba la mgo bo je sdid du 'gro zhing / kha brda yang sngon ltar ma yin par sha sbrid dgos pa'i tshig de dag 'dzem dogs med par bshad/ chang gi zil shugs las phag lo'i khrag rtsa je ngar je ngar du song ba dang bstun snying stobs kyang rim gyis che ru bskyed/ de'i khar sras mo'i phyir mngon pa'i dkar 'jam brla sha dang mo dri khyad par ba des kho'i snang ba 'khrul bar byas/ blta zhin blta kin kho'i logs kyi sras mo 'di sngar bas mdzes shing sdug la yid du 'ong / phag lo'i lag pa yang rang dbang med pa bzhin sras mo'i lus la reg grong khyer gyi zhabs zhu sras mo 'di tsho de'i phyogs la byang po tag tag yin pas phag lo'i 'jab rgol la rgol lan mi sprod pa phud/ da dung grogs su byon pa bzhin sras mo'i brkam chags kyi mig gis phag lo'i ske la dam por 'jus shing 'o byas/ da dung phag lo la a jo da ci ngas khyod mthong ba tsam gyis blor babs byung zhes sogs ngo bstod kyi tshig mang du lab/ skyes pa'i rna la bud med skad zer ba ltar sras mo'i tshig de dag phag lo'i rna lam du dril chung bzhin du snyan par gyur/ phag lo ni nas chang mngar mo zhig 'thung ba bzhin sems pa sngar las skyid par gyur/ yun tsam 'gor ba dang sras mos ci zhig dran pa bzhin lag pa de phag lo'i ske nas 4

dngul gyi rna long /chog shes de rim gyis med par gyur/ a ce lha mo zer na rdzong mkhar 'di ru mi shes pa med la/ kho mo la dpon po dang tshong pa la sogs pa'i ngo shes dang grogs po shin tu mang / nyin nub gnyis kar kho mo 'chol mkhan rgyun mi chad/gang ltar za sa 'thung sa zhig la kho mo 'bod kyin 'du ga skabs rer bde skyid grogs su 'khrid pa red/de ring nyin gung yang a ce lha mo la lha sa nas 'ong ba'i tshong pa ngo shes rnying ba zhig gis dgung zas za khang du za ru shog ces za khang gi ming dang dus chod bcas gsal ba'i mgron brda 'byor/ tshong pa 'di a ce lha mos sngon zhig nas ngo shes la/ phan tshun la 'brel ba shin tu zab/ lha sa'i tshong pa'i khrod du ming nges can yod pa zhig kyang red/ tshong pa 'dis bza' ba dang btung ba longs su spyod thengs rer sgor mo ji ltar spyod pa des a ce lha mo sngar nas ha las su bcug yod/ do dgong 'bod srol la bltas na yang gsol ston rgya chen po zhig bshams rgyu gdon mi za bas bu mo bde skyid la bshad de rang gnyis ka song na shin tu legs snyam/ de nas bde skyid sgo la bos shing a rogs bde skyid gra sgrig gyis dang / do dgong yang ngo shes shig gis 'bod kyin 'dugatshugs kar bltas na 'u gnyis kyis do dgong yid tshim pa zhig bzhes na chogahe sme zhes bgad pa dang / red ga khyed kyis ras lu de 'phud la do dgong gon pa mdza' mo zhig gyon dgorsā zhes bshad pa dang khyim la 'dzul/ bde skyid kyi khyo bo khe nyin gzhi rim la song bas zla gcig ring la phyir yul du log mi 11

bsags 'bras/thub/ da lta kho mor rang dbang 'thob yod pas a ce lha mos 'di star bos na kho mo dga' ba dang bcas mi 'gro ga la srid/ de nas kho mos lan bu gsar du bsles shing gdong la skag cung tsam byugs/ sgam nang nas lha sa'i bod lu blangs te lus la gyon/ gzab 'phyor legs por spras tshar rjes kho mo mace lha mo tshang la 'dzul te ji 'dra red ces phar 'khor tshur 'khor 'ga' byas pa na/a ce lha mos ya mtshar ba'i tshul gyis mig che ru gdangs bzhin sngun blta phyi blta 'ga' byed pa dang a ga ri mor bris pa dang a na ma na red/ do dgong khyed kyis rang rdzong gi gsar bu tsho dbang bo 'chor du 'jug kho thag red/ ngo ma nga khyed la 'grogs rgyur ngo gnongs dgos pa zhig kyang red ces bstod pa gnam la mi shong pa zhig gnang /mun rub la nye dus kho mo gnyis dus chad ltar mgron du 'bod sa'i za khang gi phyogs su chas/ za khang nang mgron du 'bod mkhan gyi tshong pa ngo shes de snga mo nas de gar sgug 'dug kho mo gnyis baspebs pa mthong ba dang kho tsho gsum po yar langs te thal mo rdob kyin lcam mo gnyis lags dus ltar 'byor bar dga' bsu zhu zhes gus pa 'bul bzhin kho tsho dang lhan du 'dug tu bcug sa brda dang bstun te phan tshun ngo sbyor byed pa brgyud a ce lha mo'i ngo shes tshong pa de'i ming la rta bho dang / kho'i logs kyi gsar bu gnyis nang gi gcig ming la phun bkra dang cig shos la rta mgrin zhes 'bod cing / kho tsho gsum po sngon chad tshong brgyab ste phan tshun ngo shes pa yin zer/ kho tsho kha brda 12

dngul gyi rna long /byas te yun tsam 'gor ba na/ zhabs zhu bas zas sna 'dren pa dang / chang sder zhig gi nang chang dkar(pe 4)lnga bzhag ste 'khyer 'ong / tshong pa rta bho yar langs te chang dkar lnga bo'i nang chang ltems mer 'khyil ba re blugs rjes so so der yod kyi mdun la bzhag de mur chang dkar yar bkyags te shog do dgong nga tsho ngo shes rnying pa dang ngo shes gsar ba tshang ma lhan 'dzoms byung ba la tshang mas gtsang bzhes gnong zer ba dang / bde gyid ma gtogs tshang mas chang dkar mgor g.yon te zhabs dag brgyab/ bde gyid kyis mchod gsum 'phangs rjes khyed rnam pa thugs rgyal ma bzhengag ngas ngo ma chang zhig kha la reg gin med ces chang dkar phyir gtod rtsis byas/ tshong pa rta lhas 'di ga la nyan/ nged cag gsar du ngo shes pa yin pas/ las 'brel gyi lhan 'dzoms 'di'i rten 'brel la khyed kyis mchod chang gtsang bzhes mi gnang ngayo zer ba dang / a ce lha mo ston bzhin ltos dang lha mos sngon nas 'thung tshar/ khyed kyis kho mo la slob sbyong byas na 'grig 'dug ces bshad pa na/ lha mos kyang red ya/ deng sang sngon chad dang mi 'dra/ pho mo 'dra mnyam gyi srid jus lag tu bstar ba'i dus 'dir ma bu mo zhig gis chang 'thung na mi 'grig sa ci yod/ bsam blo 'di ltar rnying na dus rabs kyi rjes ga la chod/ 'thung /'thung / kho tsho langs te bsdad na rkang ba yang na nges red ces bden bden tshul du smras pa na/ tshong pa gsum pos kyang red red/ lha mos bshad pa dngos gnas bden 'dug ces mig hrig ger kho mo'i gdong la bltas pas bde skyid 13

bsags 'bras/kyis kyang ngo bzlog mi nus pas btsan gyis jub/ kho tshos bza' zhor 'thung zhor du dus yun ga 'dra 'gor ba mi shes mod/ 'grul ba byings rnams sngon zhig nas yul la log zin/ zhabs zhu ba tsho sgrog tse'i mtha' ru bsdad de ngal gsos 'dug za khang gi sgo rgyag ran 'dug sa tshos kyang rtsis brgyab ste mi 'gro ka med byung /phyi rol gyi mun ha cang gnag la/ rlung bser bu yang lding gin 'dugabaser khar yong ba dang kho tsho'i bzi snang sngar bas je cher gyur/ bde skyid kyis kyang da ci'i kho tsho bzhi bos nan yang yang byas pa la ngo bzlog ma nus par chang dkur mi nyung ba zhig 'thung bas da lta gom pa spos na yang zhing 'khyom/ tshong pa rta snyo la sger gyi 'jeb 'khor zhig yod/ khos 'jab 'khor gyi sgo phyes pa dang gam gyi tshong rogs gnyis la 'u cag gis lcam mo gnyis khyim du bde bar bskyal rjes phyir mgron khang du log na ji 'dra red ces dris pa na/ tshong grogs bun bkra dgod tsam byas rje ‘rta mgrin khyed gnyis kyis bskyal na chog 'dug nga da mgron khang du log 'gro gnyis 'thib ste 'obazhes zer/ rta sgos de yang mi chog rgyu mi 'dug ya lcam mo gnyis nang la bzhugs/ nang la bzhugs/ rta mgrin/ rlangs 'khor khyed kyis bskor dang nga dang lcam mo gnyis rgyab kyi 'dug stegs steng bsdad de kha brda byed dgos zhes zer bzhin kho yo ce lha mo'i logs su bsdad/'jeb 'khor de kho mo gnyis 'dug sa'i ra skor nang du bskor 'ong zhing /14

dngul gyi rna long /mgrin gyi chung ma ni gzugs bongs che zhing rkang lag shin tu sbom/ bde skyid kyis ngu mtshams bzhag ste zhum zhum ngang kha rog ger sgo ru phyin/'on kyang kho mo gang la 'gro'am/ sa cha med dang mi la rgyus med pa'i thag ring gi yul 'di nas kho mo phyogs gang la gtad de 'gro/ rgyu 'bras med pa'i rta mgrin khyod gang na yod/ ngas khyed kyi snying khrag hub gsum 'thung yang snying nad ji ltar dwangs/ skabs 'dir kho mos da gzod yid nas gting brjed du song ba'i khyo bo snying nas dran/ kho la dbang med cing rgyu dkon na yang rang la yid gzhung drang zhing snying nas sha tsha ba yin/ kho mo rang gi byas las la 'gyod pa gting nas skyes shing yid skyo ba'i mchi ma 'khyag bsil ber lhung / da ni ci bya/ phyir khyo bo yod sar 'gro'am/ khyo bos da lta ci zhig byed kyin yod dam/99lo'i mang tshogs sgyu rtsagadeb dang po'i steng bkod/23

dacal sgru rna long /mgrin gyi chung ma ni gzugs bongs che zhing rkang lag shin tu sbom/ bde skyid kyis ngu mtshams bzhag ste zhum zhum ngang kha rog ger sgo ru phyin/'on kyang kho mo gang la 'gro'am/ sa cha med dang mi la rgyus med pa'i thag ring gi yul 'di nas kho mo phyogs gang la gtad de 'gro/ rgyu 'bras med pa'i rta mgrin khyod gang na yod/ ngas khyed kyi snying khrag hub gsum 'thung yang snying nad ji ltar dwangs/ skabs 'dir kho mos da gzod yid nas gting brjed du song ba'i khyo bo snying nas dran/ kho la dbang med cing rgyu dkon na yang rang la yid gzhung drang zhing snying nas sha tsha ba yin/ kho mo rang gi byas las la 'gyod pa gting nas skyes shing yid skyo ba'i mchi ma 'khyag bsil ber lhung / da ni ci bya/ phyir khyo bo yod sar 'gro'am/ khyo bos da lta ci zhig byed kyin yod dam/99lo'i(mang tshogs sku rtsalpodeb dang po'i steng bkod/23

rdzong dpon gyis kha lo ba brje spor byas/rdzong dpon ka ba dang bo a ma'i mngal nas 'jig rten 'dir 'ong ba nas bzung pho yi lus la mo yi khyad chos 'dzoms pa zhig ste/ gdong ba dker zhing phra ba dang / gzugs skyes lus kyang de dang mthu na par za zhing thung la/ tha na skad gdangs kyang phra zhing 'dzer ba mo skad sing sing 'byin pa zhig yin/gal te sman shar zhig yin pa'i dbang du btang na sgeg ldan ma'i gras su brtsi chog chog yin mod/ pho lte thogs shig yin pas thabs ci yod/ da lta pho lo bdun lnga so lngar bud na yang phyi yi lus la 'gyur ba med par lus po sngar bzhin skam zhing rid la thung bar gnas/ yin yang rgyal khab kyi dbang lag tu 'dzin pa'i rdzong dpon yin pas/ bas mtha'i 'brog khul du mtshon na sa cha'i tshod kyi ri dwags zer ba ltar mgo yod brgya'i bkur sa dang lce yod brgya'i zhu sa'i mthon po khri na 'gying ba'i dbang can zhig yin pa sgros ci dgog tshang mas shes gsal ltar deng sang dpon po phal che ba zhig sku lus tsho zhing brjid la/ skad 'drag can tag tag yin mod/ yid phangs pa zhig la 'u cag gi rdzong dpon ka ba tshang la de lta bu'i cha rkyen gcig kyang dkon pas kho rang nyid dpon tshugs ye nas med pa'i skam rid kyi lus po nyam chung de'i steng la yi 2

rdzong dpon gyis kha lo ba brje spor byas/rdzong dpon ka ba dang bo a ma'i mngal nas 'jig rten 'dir 'ong ba nas bzung pho yi lus la mo yi khyad chos 'dzoms pa zhig ste/ gdong ba dgan zhing phra ba dang / gzugs skyes lus kyang de dang mabu na par phra zhing bung la/ tha na skad gdangs kyang phra zhing 'dzer ba mo skad sing sing 'byin pa zhig yin/gal te sman shar zhig yin pa'i dbang du btang na sgeg ldan ma'i gras su baji chog chog yin mod/ pho lte thogs shig yin pas thabs ci yod/ da lta pho lo bdun lnga so lngar bud na yang phyi yi lus la 'gyur ba med par lus po sngar bzhin skam zhing rid la thung bar gnas/ yin yang rgyal khab kyi dbang lag tu 'dzin pa'i rdzong dpon yin pas/ bas mtha'i 'brog khul du mtshon na sa cha'i tshod kyi ri dwags zer ba ltar mgo yod brgya'i bkur sa dang lce yod brgya'i zhu sa'i mthon po khri na 'gying ba'i dbang can zhig yin pa smos ci dgog tshang mas shes gsal ltar deng sang dpon po phal che ba zhig sku lus tsho zhing brjid la/ skad 'drag can tag tag yin mod/ yid phangs pa zhig la 'u cag gi rdzong dpon ka ba tshang la de lta bu'i cha rkyen gcig kyang dkon pas kho rang nyid dpon tshugs ye nas med pa'i skam rid kyi lus po nyam chung de'i steng la yi 2

dacal gyi rna long /mug cing / de'i steng la sems 'khur gyed byed cig che ba tang dang rgyal khab/chung ba mang tshogs kyi skyid sdug la yang byed kyin med/ dpon po tsho gros tshogs dang gsol ston du zhugs thengs rer kha sha dang chang la mi 'bral ba de bzhin du rdzong dpon ka ba yis kyang za skal dang 'thung skal gtan nas chad du 'jug mi srid la/ de'i khar khos 'tsho bcud kyis phyug pa'i zas sna dang tsho sman gang bzang bsten te myur ba myur du lus la sha rgyas te da lta'i yid skyo ba'i rnam pa 'di bsgyur te‘ dpon po gzi brjid can zhig tu 'bad cing re mod/ 'bras bu mngon gsal zhig sngar bzhin ma 'thob/ rdzong 'di'i bzo tshong cu'u yi cu'u krang tsho drag ste 'gro 'dug dka' bas skun gzhi phog par skrag ste tsho bying byed kyi sman sna ci rigs 'thung zhing rngul nag sham sham dang dbugs nyem ltem gyis lus po sbyong brdar sogs byed de tsho myur tu bying ste bskyod pa yang ba zhig tu skom pa chu bzhin 'dod mod/ rdzong dpon ka ba de dang go bzlog ste lus la sha tshil mi rgyas par dngan pa ring du 'then zhing sems sdug gi gting du lhung 'dug grogs po la las kyal ka'i tshul du kho la‘‘ngo ma a ye 'dra mo red/ khrid lta bu'i dpon po zhig gang na yod/ dngos gnas tshugs ka mi 'dug ces bshad skabs/ khos ci mi snyam par‘‘ci skyon/ 'di ni tang dang mi dmangs la sha tsha zhing sems khur byed rkyen nga la sha ma gsog pa red ces dgod pa'i 'dzum mdangs re btsan gyis phyungs mod/ 'dzum mdangs de ngu shor ba las kyang sdug la/ grogs po'i ku re'i tshig de dag gzugs med kyi mda' mo bzhin 25

dngul gyi rna long /mug cing / de'i steng la sems 'khur byed byed cig che ba tang dang rgyal khab/chung ba mang tshogs kyi skyid sdug la yang byed kyin med/ dpon po tsho gros tshogs dang gsol ston du zhugs thengs rer kha sha dang chang la mi 'bral ba de bzhin du rdzong dpon ka ba yis kyang za skal dang 'thung skal gtan nas chad du 'jug mi srid la/ de'i khar khos 'tsho bcud kyis phyug pa'i zas sna dang tsho sman gang bzang bsten te myur ba myur du lus la sha rgyas te da lta'i yid skyo ba'i rnam pa 'di bsgyur te ‘dpon po gzi brjid can zhig tu 'bad cing re mod/ 'bras bu mngon gsal zhig sngar bzhin ma 'thob/ rdzong 'di'i bzo tshong cu'u yi cu'u krang tsho drag ste 'gro 'dug dka' bas skun gzhi phog par skrag ste tsho bying byed kyi sman sna ci rigs 'thung zhing jul nag sham sham dang dbugs ltem ltem gyis lus po sbyong brdar sogs byed de tsho myur tu bying ste bskyod pa yang ba zhig tu skom pa chu bzhin 'dod mod/ rdzong dpon ka ba de dang go bzlog ste lus la sha tshil mi rgyas par dngan pa ring du 'then zhing sems sdug gi gting du lhung 'dug grogs po la las kyal na'i tshul du kho la‘‘ngo ma a ye 'dra mo red/ khyod lta bu'i dpon po zhig gang na yod/ dngos gnas tshugs ka mi 'dug ces bshad skabs/ khos ci mi snyam par ‘ci skyon/ 'di ni tang dang mi dmangs la sha tsha zhing sems khur byed rkyen nga la sha ma gsog pa red ces dgod pa'i 'dzum mdangs re btsan gyis phyungs mod/ 'dzum mdangs de ngu shor ba las kyang sdug la/ grogs po'i ku re'i tshig de dag gzugs med kyi mda' mo bzhin 25

jong dpon gyis kha lo ba brje spor byas/snying khar zug ste gzer slong bzhin pa su yis tshor/rdzong dpon ka ba'i gnas tshul de ltar du sdug na yang / kho la lus dang grib ma bzhin 'grogs pa'i gzugs po ring ba'i kha lo ba de rdzong dpon gyi bka' drin la brten nas za sa 'thung sa zhig tu rgyun par 'gro thub pas bsod nams che ba'i gso phag bzhin kha ru zas zas dang 'thung 'thung thams cad ngo la shar te/ bltas bltas rig rig la lus la sha rgyas shing / pho ba sbrum ma bzhin phyir 'bur byung ba dang / ma ne de rgya nag hwa shang bzhin gnyis brtsegs su babs/ de'i rkyen gyis rdzong dpon ka ba sems kha dkrugs pa'i gnad don gang mang zhig la phrad/ thengs 'ga' zhig la gzhi rim du bskyod thengs rer sngon chad rdzong dpon gyi zhal ngo mjal ma myong ba'i mang tshogs kyis kha lo ba dang rdzong dpon gnyis po nor 'chug byung ba'i dgod bro'i gnas tshul la phrad/de ring yang rdzong dpon ka ba ched spyod 'jeb 'khor du bsdad de rdzong mkhar dang bar thag cung ring ba'i zhang srid gzhung de'i sgo drung du dan ser bsdad pa dang / rdzong dpon snga ma byed de rlangs 'khor las thang la babs shing de 'phral mgo bar snang du dgye ba dang / brang khog phyir ldir ba/ gom pa dal gyis len bzhin 'gying nger song ste dpon po 'khrul med cig gi phyi'i nyams gtod ci thub byed mod/ snga mo nas bsu bar 'ong ba'i 'brog pa mang tshogs kyis snga gzhug rtsod bzhin sku brjid can gyi kha lo ba'i lag par 'jus te‘‘rdzong dpon khyed tshang sku bde bar bslebs sam/ lam bar nas 'o brgyal ma myangs 26

jong dathan gyis kha 'o ba brje spor byas/snying khar zug ste gzer slong bzhin pa su yis tshor/rdzong dpon ka ba'i gnas tshul de ltar du sdug na yang / kho la lus dang grib ma bzhin 'grogs pa'i gzugs po ring ba'i kha lo ba de rdzong dpon gyi bka' drin la brten nas za sa 'thung sa zhig tu rgyun par 'gro thub pas bsod nams che ba'i gso phag bzhin kha ru zas zas dang 'thung 'thung thams cad ngo la shar te/ bltas bltas rig rig la lus la sha rgyas shing / pho ba sbrum ma bzhin phyir 'bur byung ba dang / ma ne de rgya nag hwa shang bzhin gnyis brtsegs su babs/ de'i rkyen gyis rdzong dpon ka ba sems kha dkrugs pa'i gnad don gang mang zhig la phrad/ thengs 'ga' zhig la gzhi rim du bskyod thengs rer sngon chad rdzong dpon gyi zhal ngo mjal ma myong ba'i mang tshogs kyis kha lo ba dang rdzong dpon gnyis po nor 'chug byung ba'i dgod bro'i gnas tshul la phrad/de ring yang rdzong dpon ka ba ched spyod 'jeb zhakhor du bsdad de rdzong mkhar dang bar thag cung ring ba'i zhang srid gzhung de'i sgo drung du dan ser bsdad pa dang / rdzong dpon snga ma byed de rlangs 'khor las thang la babs shing de 'phral mgo bar snang du dgye ba dang / brang khog phyir ldir ba/ gom pa dal gyis len bzhin 'gying nger song ste dpon po 'khrul med cig gi phyi'i nyams gtod ci thub byed mod/ snga mo nas bsu bar 'ong ba'i 'brog pa mang tshogs kyis snga gzhug rtsod bzhin sku brjid can gyi kha lo ba'i lag par 'jus te‘‘rdzong dpon khyed tshang sku bde bar bslebs sam/ lam bar nas 'o brgyal ma myangs 26

dacal kyi rna long /sam zhes mtshams 'dri dang gus gus byas pa las rdzong dpon ngo ma kha lo ba'i tshul du bskyur te kha ya de 'dra ma byas so/ /ngu ma dgod kyi gnas tshul de mthong ba dang rdzong dpon ka ba tshod tshod la ngo tsha zhing de'i mur kha lo ba'i thog la zhe sdang dang / yid smon/ phrag dog sogs 'gran pa bzhin du skyes/ kha lo ba yang dogs ma bde pas myur du gsal bshad bya dgos snyam skabs rdzong dpon lags rna khung nas hun sgra 'byin zhing zhal ngo nag rog ger srid gzhung gi sgo chen du 'dzul gyin 'dug nyin der gzhi rim 'brog pa mang tshogs kyis rdzong dponagyi ngo so len ched sha tshon po spungs shing chang zhim po drangs te gsol ston rgya chen po zhig bshams na yang / rdzong dpon ka ba thugs dgyes po ma byung la/bzhes 'dod kyi yi ga med par gyur/ ‘‘hun/ khyod kha lo ba nga'i gla ba min nam/khyed kyis 'di ltar ngo tshar gtad na nga'i sems nang skyid po cig ga la yin/ rdzong dpon zhe sdang gis 'dug mi bzod par gyur/ kha lo ba'i kha gzhan du ma bskor na rang gi gzi brjid dang mtshan snyan grags la gnod pa chen po bskyal 'ong snyam/ gzhi rim gyi don dag bsgrub tshar te phyir rdzong thog tu log pa dang /rdzong dpon gyis don dag cig la kha g.yar te kha lo ba 'di las khungs gzhan zhig tu brdzangs shing / kha mal du rdzong dpon kho las kyang gzugs thung la sha skam pa dang / mig skog tu lhung ba/ rkang lag shin tu phra ba'i lo na cung mtho ba'i nyam thag cig kha lo bar bzhag go /2001lolamang tshogs sku mnyadeb dang po'i steng bkod/27

dngul gyi rna long /sam zhes mtshams 'dri dang gus gus byas pa las rdzong dpon ngo ma kha lo ba'i tshul du bskyur te kha ya de 'dra ma byas so/ /ngu ma dgod kyi gnas tshul de mthong ba dang rdzong dpon ka ba tshod tshod la ngo tsha zhing de'i mur kha lo ba'i thog la zhe sdang dang / yid smon/ phrag dog sogs 'gran pa bzhin du skyes/ kha lo ba yang dogs ma bde pas myur du gsal bshad bya dgos snyam skabs rdzong dpon lags rna khung nas hun sgra 'byin zhing zhal ngo nag rog ger srid gzhung gi sgo chen du 'dzul gyin 'dug nyin der gzhi rim 'brog pa mang tshogs kyis rdzong dponagyi ngo so len ched sha tshon po spungs shing chang zhim po drangs te gsol ston rgya chen po zhig bshams na yang / rdzong dpon ka ba thugs dgyes po ma byung la/bzhes 'dod kyi yi ga med par gyur/ 4‘hun/ khyod kha lo ba nga'i gla ba min nam/khyed kyis 'di ltar ngo tshar gtad na nga'i sems nang skyid po cig ga la yin/ rdzong dpon zhe sdang gis 'dug mi bzod par gyur/ kha lo ba'i kha gzhan du ma bskor na rang gi gzi brjid dang mtshan snyan grags la gnod pa chen po bskyal 'ong snyam/ gzhi rim gyi don dag bsgrub tshar te phyir rdzong thog tu log pa dang /rdzong dpon gyis don dag cig la kha g.yar te kha lo ba 'di las khungs gzhan zhig tu brdzangs shing / kha mal du rdzong dpon kho las kyang gzugs thung la sha skam pa dang / mig lkog tu lhung ba/ rkang lag shin tu phra ba'i lo na cung mtho ba'i nyam thag cig kha lo bar bzhag go /2001lo'amang tshogs spru mnyadeb dang po'i steng bkod/27

gsar bu rta mgrin/sngon chad rta mgrin gyis 'jig rten na dgon pa'i grwa pa yan gyi skyid cig med snyam zhing dmar lam lam gyi ston pa'i na bza' gyon te rab tu byung na ci ma rung snyam pa na pha ma gnyis pos bu gcig po grwa pa byas na khyim 'di'i shul 'dzin chad 'gro zhes bshol 'debs dang zhu ba yang yang byas na yang / rta mgrin sus kyang ma khogs par kha rog ger dgon par bros te spokhu'i mdun nas rab tu byung / 'on kyang lo na cher son te sha dar khrag dar gyi dus la bslebs pa na/ dgon pa'i phyi rol gyi 'jig rten gyi khra khra rig rig mang du mthong bas/ kho grwa rkyang gi 'tsho ba 'dir yun gyis sun snang skyes shing zhen pa log pas/ lus dgon pa na gnas kyang sems ri 'dabs kyi grong la shor/mjug mthar sdom pa dang dam bca' la sogs kyis sems kyi rta rgod 'chun thabs ma byung bas/ thur mda' mgo nas bshus ma thag mgo g.yug g.yug dang sna phu phu byed pa'i rang dbang thob pa'i bong skya li bzhin phyir rgya lu gyon te grong du brgyugs/ pha ma gnyis kyis rang gi bu phyir skya sar babs pa mthong ba dang chos mgo ma 'khyongs par sde ba'i nang nas ngo tsha nyos song zhes kha nas bu 28

gsar bu rta mgrin/sngon chad rta mgrin gyis 'jig rten na dgon pa'i grwa pa yan gyi skyid cig med snyam zhing dmar lam lam gyi ston pa'i na bza' gyon te rab tu byung na ci ma rung snyam pa na pha ma gnyis pos bu gcig po grwa pa byas na khyim 'di'i shul 'dzin chad 'gro zhes bshol 'debs dang zhu ba yang yang byas na yang / rta mgrin sus kyang ma khogs par kha rog ger dgon par bros te gakhu'i mdun nas rab tu byung / 'on kyang lo na cher son te sha dar khrag dar gyi dus la bslebs pa na/ dgon pa'i phyi rol gyi 'jig rten gyi khra khra rig rig mang du mthong bas/ kho grwa rkyang gi 'tsho ba 'dir yun gyis sun snang skyes shing zhen pa log pas/ lus dgon pa na gnas kyang sems ri 'dabs kyi grong la shor/mjug mthar sdom pa dang dam bca' la sogs kyis sems kyi rta rgod 'chun thabs ma byung bas/ thur mda' mgo nas bshus ma thag mgo g.yug g.yug dang sna phu phu byed pa'i rang dbang thob pa'i bong skya li bzhin phyir rgya pa gyon te grong du brgyugs/ pha ma gnyis kyis rang gi bu phyir skya sar babs pa mthong ba dang chos mgo ma 'khyongs par sde ba'i nang nas ngo tsha nyos song zhes kha nas bu 28

dacal gyi rna long /la sdig dmod dang mi 'ga' ba'i rnam 'gyur re bstan na yang / 'di ni skyes pa sngon gyi las red/ bu 'di ltar skya sar babs na khyim 'dir shul 'dzin yod song zhes sems gting nas dga' ba skyes shing bu'i 'dod thog tu bzhag pa ma zad/ ring min 'jig rten gyi mthun lugs ltar sde ba'i nang gi bu mo zhig khyim 'khor ba skyong ba'i chung mar blangs/ kho grwa pa yin dus mtshan la tshul khrims bzang bor 'bod mod/ mtshan de 'byor dbang ma phyin par phyir skya sar babs pa yin pas/ da lta tshul khrims bzang bo zhes bos na mtshang ming zhig tu 'gro srid pas mi rnams kyis slar yang / grong ming ste rta mgrin zhes bos so/ /dpyid rmo yi las ka mjug rdzogs pa dang sngo skyes pa'i dus la ran skabs/sde ba'i nang gi pho skyes tshang ma 'brog khul du zhor las btsal du 'gro ba yin la/bza' ba bza' rkyang 'ga' res shul gyi las ka tshang ma gzhan la bcol rjes bza' zla gnyis ka zhor las su 'gro ba red/ gal te gsar bu zhig phyi thog tu mi 'gro bar shul du khyim bsrungs te bsdad na kun gyis snying 'phyas gtong sar brtsi nges/ rta mgrin gyis kyang bza' zla khrid de zhor las btsal du 'gro 'dod mod/ pha ma gnyis po lo na mtho bas khyim phyi nang gi las ka lci mo lus pos mi rtsogs snyam ste zhing la chu gtong ba dang ri la zog rdzir 'gro ba sogs kyi las ka rnams chung mar bskyur rjes khres po rgyab la khur cing 'jor chung chung zhig bzung ste 'brog khul du dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu brko ru phyin/rta mgrin 'grul skyel rlangs 'khor du bsdad de 'brog khul du yong ba'i 29

dbyal gyi rna long /la sdig dmod dang mi 'ga' ba'i rnam 'gyur re bstan na yang / 'di ni skyes pa sngon gyi las red/ bu 'di ltar skya sar babs na khyim 'dir shul 'dzin yod song zhes sems gting nas dga' ba skyes shing bu'i 'dod thog tu bzhag pa ma zad/ ring min 'jig rten gyi mthun lugs ltar sde ba'i nang gi bu mo zhig khyim 'khor ba skyong ba'i chung mar blangs/ kho grwa pa yin dus mtshan la tshul khrims bzang bor 'bod mod/ mtshan de 'byor dbang ma phyin par phyir skya sar babs pa yin pas/ da lta tshul khrims bzang bo zhes bos na mtshang ming zhig tu 'gro srid pas mi rnams kyis slar yang / grong ming ste rta mgrin zhes bos so/ /dpyid rmo yi las ka mjug rdzogs pa dang sngo skyes pa'i dus la ran skabs/sde ba'i nang gi pho skyes tshang ma 'brog khul du zhor las btsal du 'gro ba yin la/bza' ba bza' rkyang 'ga' res shul gyi las ka tshang ma gzhan la bcol rjes bza' zla gnyis ka zhor las su 'gro ba red/ gal te gsar bu zhig phyi thog tu mi 'gro bar shul du khyim bsrungs te bsdad na kun gyis snying 'phyas gtong sar brtsi nges/ rta mgrin gyis kyang bza' zla khrid de zhor las btsal du 'gro 'dod mod/ pha ma gnyis po lo na mtho bas khyim phyi nang gi las ka lci mo lus pos mi lcogs snyam ste zhing la chu gtong ba dang ri la zog rdzir 'gro ba sogs kyi las ka rnams chung mar bskyur rjes khres po rgyab la khur cing 'jor chung chung zhig bzung ste 'brog khul du dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu brko ru phyin/rta mgrin 'grul skyel rlangs 'khor du bsdad de 'brog khul du yong ba'i 29

gsar bu rta mgrin/lam bar du sems khur byed sa nyag gcig ni dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu brko sa zhig lag tu chud min de red/ 'on kyang sems khur de ni lhag ma yin te/ 'grul skyel rlangs 'khor de 'brog khul gyi rdzong thog de ru dan ser bsdad ma thag de gar ngang skug byas yod pa'i mi skor zhig 'grul skyes rlangs 'khor gyi sgo kha ru rub 'ongs shing / kho tshos rlangs 'khor nang la gtad de gcig kha gcig gis 'phrog bzhin ‘'bu brko mkhan yod dam/nged tshang gi ru sar 'gro dang 'bu ni 'dod pa yod(sa cha 'di'i mi rnams kyis dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu la 'bu zhes 'bod kyin yod la/ brko mkhan la 'bu brko zhes 'bod) ces 'dri 'ong /phar ma dris gong la tshur 'dri tshul la bltas na sa rin mi dgos par ci dgar brko chog pa 'dra/ rta mgrin gyi bsam thog tu rta brgyugs song bas dga' yal ler gyur cing de 'phral lag pa gnam la 'gyog bzhin‘‘yod/ yod ces mi tshogs kyi gseb nas 'tshang kha rgyag bzhin rlangs 'khor gyi sgo ru thon par brel ba langs/ 'bu brko mkhan zhig yod pa mthong ba na/ rlangasa'akhor gyi sgo kha na langs yod pa'i 'brog pa'i gsar rgod dar ma zhig gis der yod kun gyi sngun 'phrog ste lag pa yas cig rta mgrin la bsridas shing dam por 'jus ma thag tshur shed kyis 'then pa na/ rta mgrin gyis sdun na yod pa'i mi skor zhig phar 'gyel tshur 'gyel du gtong bzhin thang la babag kho'i sems la rang nyid ni ci 'dra'i las can zhig red ang / yar rgyug mar rgyug byas te rtsad gcod ma dgos par dbyar rtswa brko sa zhig lag tu skyid por thob song / ngo ma g.yang rdzi 30

gsar bu rtasnyemagrin/lam bar du sems khur byed sa nyag gcig ni dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu brko sa zhig lag tu chud min de red/ 'on kyang sems khur de ni lhag ma yin te/ 'grul skyel rlangs 'khor de 'brog khul gyi rdzong thog de ru dan ser bsdad ma thag de gar ngang skug byas yod pa'i mi skor zhig 'grul skyel rlangs 'khor gyi sgo kha ru rub 'ongs shing / kho tshos rlangs 'khor nang la gtad de gcig kha gcig gis 'phrog bzhin‘‘'bu brko mkhan yod dam/nged tshang gi ru sar 'gro dang 'bu ni 'dod pa yod(sa cha 'di'i mi rnams kyis dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu la 'bu zhes 'bod kyin yod la/ brko mkhan la 'bu brko zhes 'bod) ces 'dri 'ong /phar ma dris gong la tshur 'dri tshul la bltas na sa rin mi dgos par ci dgar brko chog pa 'dra/ rta mgrin gyi bsam thog tu rta brgyugs song bas dga' yal ler gyur cing de 'phral lag pa gnam la 'gyog bzhin‘ yod/ yod ces mi tshogs kyi gseb nas 'tshang kha rgyag bzhin rlangs 'khor gyi sgo ru thon par brel ba langs/ 'bu brko mkhan zhig yod pa mthong ba na/ rlangasa'akhor gyi sgo kha na langs yod pa'i 'brog pa'i gsar rgod dar ma zhig gis der yod kun gyi sngun 'phrog ste lag pa yas cig rta mgrin la bsrings shing dam por 'jus ma thag tshur shed kyis 'then pa na/ rta mgrin gyis sngun na yod pa'i mi skor zhig phar 'gyel tshur 'gyel du gtong bzhin thang la babag kho'i sems la rang nyid ni ci 'dra'i las can zhig red khang / yar rgyug mar rgyug byas te rtsad gcod ma dgos par dbyar rtswa brko sa zhig lag tu skyid por thob song / ngo ma g.yang rdzi 30

dacal gyi rna long /nyal te bsdad na g.yang zog ngang gis 'khor zer ba cis ma bden snyam/ kho'i sems nas rdog rdog cig thang la lhung song ba'i bde snang can zhig dbang med du skyes/ drang mor bshad na rta mgrin sngon chad dgon pa'i grwa pa yin pa'i cha nas gnas tshul la rgyus ma lon pa ma gtogs/ deng gi dus 'dir khrom ra'i dpal 'byor zer ba'i sgyu 'phrul can 'dis mi rnams kyi dpal 'byor 'du shes je drag tu btang yod la gcig las gcig spyang zhing rnam rig je rgod du btang yod pas/ sus kyang pha rol po'i lag nas sha tshon po zhig lon 'dod pa yin/ lhag tu lo 'di gar dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu rin po che 'di'i gong yang lo rer rtsa chen du 'gyur bzhin yod pa'i rkyen gyis rko mkhan gyis phar la ma dris gong tshur la rtsad gcod mkhan je mang du gyur 'dug 'on kyang sa rin mi dgos par rang dgar bsko sa zhig gang na yod/ rta mgrin gyis gzhan ltar sa rin ster dgos byung ba ma zad sa rin mtho song snyam mod/ 'brog pas bshad na 'u tshang ma bod yin pas kha ngor bltas te dma' mo zhig ma gtogs ma blangs zer/ gang ltar da ni sa rin ni sprad zin la/ 'brog pa'i rtswa sar yang thon song bas mgo bsgur te dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu bsko ba las ci yang med/nyin dang por sko skabs sngon chad brkos ma myong ba'i rkyen gyis rta mgrin gyis lag tu rkang gcig kyang ma chud/ 'on kyang phyis su rko rogs gzhan gyi rko tshul la bltas shing rko thabs bslabs pas rim gyis mgo bo sa khar bud pa'i rin po che 'di rnyed song / de nas bzung khos nangs snga langs dang dgung phyi dro'i grib 31

dadul gyi rna long /nyal te bsdad na g.yang zog ngang gis 'khor zer ba cis ma bden snyam/ kho'i sems nas rdog rdog cig thang la lhung song ba'i bde snang can zhig dbang med du skyes/ drang mor bshad na rta mgrin sngon chad dgon pa'i grwa pa yin pa'i cha nas gnas tshul la rgyus ma lon pa ma gtogs/ deng gi dus 'dir khrom ra'i dpal 'byor zer ba'i sgyu 'phrul can 'dis mi rnams kyi dpal 'byor 'du shes je drag tu btang yod la gcig las gcig spyang zhing rnam rig je rgod du btang yod pas/ sus kyang pha rol po'i lag nas sha tshon po zhig lon 'dod pa yin/ lhag tu lo 'di gar dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu rin po che 'di'i gong yang lo rer rtsa chen du 'gyur bzhin yod pa'i rkyen gyis rko mkhan gyis phar la ma dris gong tshur la rtsad gcod mkhan je mang du gyur 'dug 'on kyang sa rin mi dgos par rang dgar brko sa zhig gang na yod/ rta mgrin gyis gzhan ltar sa rin ster dgos byung ba ma zad sa rin mtho song snyam mod/ 'brog pas bshad na 'u tshang ma bod yin pas kha ngor bltas te dma' mo zhig ma gtogs ma blangs zer/ gang ltar da ni sa rin ni sprad zin la/ 'brog pa'i rtswa sar yang thon song bas mgo bskur te dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu brko ba las ci yang med/nyin dang por rko skabs sngon chad brkos ma myong ba'i rkyen gyis rta mgrin gyis lag tu rkang gcig kyang ma chud/ 'on kyang phyis su rko rogs gzhan gyi rko tshul la bltas shing rko thabs bslabs pas rim gyis mgo bo sa khar bud pa'i rin po che 'di rnyed song / de nas bzung khos nangs snga langs dang dgung phyi dro'i grib 31

gsar bu rta mgrin/so 'gugs bar du rko rogs gzhan ltar sa la gog nur gyis 'gro ba'am pus mo sa la btsugs te rig rig mig gis rtswa gseng nas dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu btsal/rin po che ni dngos gnas rin po che red/ dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu 'di rko sla mod/ rnyed dka' bas dngos gnas blo yid du mi shong ba'i sug mang po zhig myong dgos/ rta mgrin gyis nyin 'ga' la brkos pa na rkang lag thams cad nya be nyob bee shubs zad par gyur la/ mig kyang gdangs drags pas na zug skyes shing / de'i khar sa mi 'phrod pas rdza dug phog ste mgo bo ban ne bon ner btang / kho la sgyid lug cing tshegs snang skyes pas sgor mo btsal te khyim 'khor ba skyong rgyu ni ci 'dra'i dka' mo zhig red ang snyam la rang nyid mar log byung bar 'gyod pa skyes la/ skabs rer phyir yar log byed na bzang snyam/ 'on kyang dran snang 'di ni 'phral gyi rkyen la dmigs pa'i dar cig gi yun tsam yin la/ dran pa rgod pa'i rta mgrin la mtshon na mngon du 'gyur mi srid pa'i dran snang kho na nyid red/ de'i khar sa rin yang mi nyung ba zhig shor bas/ lag stong la phyir pha yul du 'gro srol gang na yod/ rta mgrin gyis de ltar dran pa dang slar yang sdug rus byas te dbyar rna dgun 'bu brkos/ de ltar zla gcig gi ring la brkos pa na rta mgrin gyis sa rin phud sgor stong gnyis lhag gi dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu rnyed byung la/ kho 'brog pa'i ru nang nas phyir rdzong thog la yong /da ni dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu rko ba'i dus 'das zin la/ lag tu sgor mo yang mthug po zhig yod pas rta mgrin gyi sems lhod la babs shing dga' bas 32

dngul gyi rna long /tshim/ zla gcig gi ring la ri nas bsdad de sdug mi nyung ba zhig myangs pas da lta sems rnam par g.yeng ste rdzong mkhar 'di nas yar myul mar myul byas na cis mi chog snyam/ khos mgron khang nas dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu rko skabs kyi lwa rnying rnams phud de yul nas khyer yong ba'i lwa ba gra dag po de gyon zhing / mgo ru 'byar ba'i rtswa dang sa rdul rnams gtsang mar bkrus la/ ngo gdong lan mang du bkrus te lus phung gi mgo nas mjug bar du yid tshim pa'i mchor nyams shig btod pa dang lag tu ko khug chung chung zhig bzung ste sgo ru bud/ lus kyi cha byad yongs su brjes pas rta mgrin ni dus yun thung ngu zhig gi nang mi gzhan zhig tu gyur 'dug mdangs bzang la sha rgyags rus rgyags yin pa'i khar lus kyi gon pa yang bzang bas da ni sus mthong na rta mgrin ni 'bu brko zhig red ces rnar mi 'gro la/ thob go sa can gyi las byed zhig gam yang na rgyu nom pa 'khor ba'i tshong chen rgyag mkhan zhig tu mi 'dod mkhan yod mi srid/mgron khang gi tho 'god byed mkhan bu mo des kyang 'di ni da ci sgo nang nas 'dzul yong skabs lus la rdul gyis gang zhing kha la ser gas khyab la ngo mdog skya skya yin pa'i 'bu rko mkhan de yin nam zhes the tshom dang bcas rta mgrin gyi mgo nas mjug bar du rig rig tu lta bzhin 'dugagasar bu rta mgrin za khang nang 'dzul zhing tshong khang du myul myul mod/ltad mo dga' zhig ma mthong bas/ da ni the'u chi'u spo lo rtsed ba las bzang med snyam/ kho dgon pa na yod dus chos kyi 'don pa'i phyogs nas kun gyi tha 33

gsar bu rta mgrin/ma yin mod/ the'u chi'u spo lo rtsed skabs kho'i do ya med la grwa gzhon yongs kyi yang rtse yin/ de ring yang kho'i lag par za 'phrug langs byung bas yar mar myul mtshams bzhag ste lam 'gram na‘ spro skyid the'u chi'u spo lo rtsed khang zhes pa'i nang du 'dzul/ de'i nang na the'u chi'u stegs bu gcig bshams 'dugartsib na phar bltas tshod kyis lo nyi shu'i nang yin snyam pa'i mo gsar zhig gis bsrungs 'dug snabs lud 'dom gang drud pa'i byis pa zhig gis thu bar 'jus te‘‘yom/ a ma/ nga la sgor mo dgos zhes ngu bshum rgyag gin 'dug mod/ mos the'u chi'u 'phen mkhan zhig nang du bslebs pa mthong ma thag byis pa'i lag la sgor mo bzhag ste‘ da phar la song zhig’ ces byis pa de sgo ru bsdangs pa dang / the'u chi'u 'phen mkhan 'dzum gyis bsus/ 'go brtsams ma thag rta mgrin gyis gtan nas 'phen mi shes khul dang rtsal med tshul bstan pa na/ the'u chi'u bdag mos kyang gsar bu 'dis dngos gnas 'phen shes kyin mi 'dugasnyam ste spo lo re re khung bu'i nang bsdu ci thub byag kho mor spo lo 'phen pa'i rtsal nges can zhig 'dzoms mod/ rta mgrin gyi do yar 'ong ba zhig gtan nas ma red/ yin na yang khos mo la kha glong 'dod shugs drag tu skyes/bu mo 'di'i gzugs skye lus ring rgyu med na yang lus kyi gang la bltas na cha 'grig cing bde mor 'dug pas/ snying rje ba zhig tu snang la/ lhag tu mos gzhan la lta ba'i mig mdangs ni chags pa'i nyams dang bcas pa'i bslu brid kyi kyo ba rnon po zhig ldan pas/ rta mgrin dbang med du 'gram chu ldang la cis 34

dacal gyi rna long /kyang mo dang ngo shes bsgrig dgos snyam/ khos bsam gzas nas rgyal kha pha rol bo la ster bzhin the'u chi'u spo lo rtse/ kho mos rta mgrin gyi 'phen tshul la lta bzhin hab cha sgrog cing 'phya rgod byas/ mos rta mgrin la‘‘deng sang gsar bu'i nang na the'u chi'u 'phen mi shes mkhan su yod/ ngo ma ngo tsha red zer bzhin rta mgrin la dbyu gu 'di ltar 'dzin dgos tshul dang spo lo 'di ltar 'phen dgos zhes bslab pa na/ rta mgrin khong nas dgod rgyu zhig 'ong mod/bsran ci thub byas/ go skabs 'di dang bstun nas khos kyang mo la kha brda'i tshig btsal te phan tshun ngo shes su sgrig 'go brtsams/ mos bshad na kho mo ni rdzong 'di'i las byed cig gi khyim thab yin zhing / khyo bo gzhung don zhig gi ched du phyi ru song ste nyin 'di gar yul na med zer bzhin nang don phun sum tshogs pa'i skog gyur gyi mig mda' zhig 'phangs byung / mig mda' de rang ga ba zhig ga la yin/ de ni ci zhig gi gsang brda yin pa gor ma chag rta mgrin gyis spobs pa che ru bskyed cing da ni go skabs 'grig song snyam/ khos mo la rang ni gser dngul dang g.yu byur gyi tshong rgyag pa'i rnga ba'i tshong ba lta bu zhig min yang / khri tsho bcu yi ma rtsa yod pa'i tshong ba chung chung zhig yin la/ da thengs 'brog khul du dbyar rtswa bsdu nyo byed du 'ong ba yin zhing / tshong 'di bzang na mi 'gyangs par hrin krin grong khyer la btsong du 'gro rgyu yin zhes stong lab mang po brgyab/ khos de ltar lab skabs the'u chi'u bdag mos bden par zlosas pa'i brda la rta mgrin gyi gyon chas thog la yid smon gyi mig gis lta zhing /35

gsar bya rta mgrin/skabs rer brkam chags kyi mig mdangs kyis kho'i lag mgor bskon pa'i ko khug la yang yang lta bzhin 'dug kho gnyis kyis de ltar kha brda byed bzhin yud tsam 'das pa na la lung kha kha nas thon pa'i chu bo gnyis gcig tu 'dres pa bzhin zhe snang ba kun nas mthun par gyur la/ rim gyis phan tshun kha rtsed dang lag rtsed byas la/ rta mgrin gyi snying stobs kyang de dang baḥn nas ldab 'gyur gyis che ru phyin/ skabs shig la khos mo'i ske la 'jus te 'o byed rtsis byed pa na/ mos ci yang ma byung ba bzhin snang dogs spu tsam med par btang snyoms su bskyur/ rta mgrin gyi sems la lta spyod la brtag na mo ni sus kyang zhon chog pa'i rgod ma g.yung mo zhig red snyam/ ri nas bsdad pa'i zla gcig gi ring la khos sems su dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu gcig pu sgom zhing / sha sgrim sgrim la bsdad pas/ sems na yar mar dran rgyu ma byung mod/ da ni lus bag la phab cing rtsa lhod song bas/ de ring kho mo mthong ba dang kho yun ring bo zhig la bud med gzhan zhig la ma thug ma 'grogs pa'i stogs skom gyis ches cher mnar zhing gzir 'ongs/ do dgong rgod ma 'di'i thog la rang nyid cis kyang zhon thabs bya dgos snyam/ khos mo'i lag par 'jus te‘‘'u gnyis la tshe gcig gi bsod nams med kyang zhag gcig gi skal ba yod na chog gam zhes dris pa na/mos kyang dgod tsam byas pa las mi 'dod mi 'thad pa'i rnam 'gyur ci yang ma bstan/ kho gnyis kha brda byas te gting la thon pa'i dus la nye ba na mun yang rub song / kho mos phyi rol la lta tsam byas rjes‘ da ni yul la log ran 36

dadul gyi rna long /song zer/ de nas rta mgrin gyis the'u chi'u brtses pa'i rin pa sprod mgo brtsams/ mos khyon sgor sum cu babs 'dug zer ba na/ rta mgrin gyis ko khug nas thog ser sgor lnga bcu can zhig bton te 'phro ma phyir slog mi dgos par mo la bkol rgyur gnang ba yin zer/ mos byis pa pang ste khang ba'i sgo brgyab pa dang yukha la 'gro rtsis byas pa na/ rta mgrin gyis mo'i sngun bkag ste‘‘khyed kyis nga la kha ngo zhig ster rgyu zer na/ 'u gnyis mnyam tu song nas za ma zhig zos na ci 'dra zhes bshad pa na/ mos ‘ngas khyed kyis sgor mo brlag mi phod zer/ rta mgrin gyis ‘nga la sgor mo brlag rogs yod na/ der skyon med ces bshad/ mjug mthar kho mo yul la nub tsha bskol du 'gro ma dgos par ma bu gnyis ka rta mgrin gyi mgron du song / zas sna 'dzoms po zhig la rol rjes rta mgrin gyis snga mo nas gnyid du yur ba'i byis pa de 'khur grogs byas te mo rang yul la bskyal/ khyim gyi sgo rtsar thon ma thag mos rta mgrin la‘‘khyod dka' las la gtad song / da bde mo byos zer ba na/ rta mgrin gyis mi nyan par khyim nang du 'dzul rtsis byas/ mos rta mgrin gyi mdun nas bkag ste ‘'di ltar byed mi rung / ru ba khyim mtshes kyis shes song na mi bzang zhes 'dod pa bskangs ma byung / 'di ni blo yid las 'gongs pa zhig yin mod/ rta mgrin gyi sems la btsan po byas na bzang mi 'ong snyam la/gtam dpe la yang a ma'i bu dal dgos/ rgod ma'i bu brel dgos zer ba min nam/ da dung nyin ring bas yul la 'gro kha zhig la mo rang rgod ma zhon zhon bya 37

gsar sge rta masgran/thub pa gdon mi za zhes gdeng tshod po yod pa'i ngang khong dgod byed bzhin mgron khang du logarta mgrin phyi nyin yang kho mo yod sar song ste the'u ci'u 'phen bzhin mo la dgod kha slong zhing bzang bzang mang du byas mod/ mos kho'i re ba sngar bzhin bskangs ma byung / khos sems ma pham par nyin bcu lhag la 'bad na yang / ko khug nang gi sgor mo spam 'thug po de je srab je srab tu phyin pa las ci yang ma thob/ de ni mo'i thog la sgor mo bkol bkol bas/ lhag ma na yul la 'gro ba'i rlangs 'khor la 'dug spyad las lus mi 'dug de'i mtshungs su kho mos kyang kho rang tshong ba zhig yin zer ba stong lab tsam yin pa shes 'dug la/ rta mgrin gyi phugs de rig 'dug cing / phugs na don dam du ci tsam yod pa yang gsal bor rig song ba 'dra/ mo'i rnam 'gyur rdzengan du gyur 'dug yul la log grabs byed pa'i snga nyin der rta mgrin gyis mtha' mjug gi re ba nyag phra ba de bcangs te mo'i yod sar song ba na/ mos de na gsar bu zhig dang ha ha ho ho zer bzhin the'u ri'u 'then bzhin 'dug kho nang du 'ong ba mthong na yang ma mthong khul byas te gsar bu de la kha rtsed bzhin kho la kha ya tsam yang ma byas/ kho cung khros te ‘nga sang nyin 'gro rgyu yin pag 'u gnyis kha brda byas na mi chog gam zer ba na/ mos‘‘khyod bud song na de red 'gog mkhan su yodamices glo bur ba'i tshig btsan po zhig smras byung / khos phyir chin lan sdid mo zhig ster rtsis byas mod kha gdangs dbang ma byin par mos slar yang‘‘rdza khra 38

rdo tsha ring /ring gi mi lam khrod kyi dga' ma yin pa smras ci dgos/ ‘‘dri ldan me tog rgyang ring yang / bung ba sprin gyi tshogs bzhin 'khor zer ba ltar/ me tog mtsho rdzong mkhar 'dir bslebs ma thag nam mkha'i lha mo zhig glo bur mi yul du byon pa bzhin mo'i lag tu brtse dung mtshon pa'i yi ge khangs skya 'bab 'bab yin zhing / pho gsar tsho'i 'du long brgyab ste kho mo'i phyogs la brtse dung gi zhags pa bskor 'phen byas/ me tog mtsho 'dod mkhan 'di 'dra'i mang la 'gran rtsod mkhan gyi do ya'i dpung 'di 'dra'i mabug na yang / rdo lo sko ring gi sems na yang za 'phrug chen po zhig langs kyin 'duganyin zhig rgya srang du 'cham skabs/ mdun na 'gro bzhin pa'i rdo lo ske ring dan se bsdad de‘‘ltos dang / baglebs byung / bslebs byung zer/ kho dang lhan du 'gro bzhin pa'i grogs po don 'grub kyis ci yin cha ma 'tshal bar‘‘su zhig bslebs byung zer ba na/ khos ma rangs pa'i ngang‘‘khyed kyi mig zhar song ba yin nam/ nga'i mi lam khrod kyi dga' ma thon byung zer bzhin mig brda zhig bstan byung / don 'grub kyi mig mi rno bas ches cher gdangs te bltas pa na ngo ma mi tshogs kyi klod na me tog mtsho mnyen myug gi sku lus ldem ldem du g.yo bzhin yar la 'ong gin 'dug kho gnyis mar thur la 'gro ba dang me tog mtsho yar la 'ong ba gnyis 'phrad byung zhing / dbung ba dang dpung ba 'phrad pa'i skad cig ma der kho mos rdo lo dang don 'grub gnyis kyi phyogs la 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang bcas mig zhags shig 'phangs song / mig zhags 44

dacal gyi rna tshang /skad cig ma des rdo lo dbang bo 'chor la khad du btang zhing / gom kha dam la btags song / kho mo'i rjes su yang yang blta zhing re zhig de gar bla 'khyams pa bzhin 'greng / yud tsam gyi rjes su kho'i gnyer ris lhug par grol zhing dga' spro'i zer ma 'khyug bzhin skad ngag cung 'dar ba'i ngang logs kyi grogs po la‘‘mthong byung ngam/ mig mda' de rang dgar 'phangs pa min/ de la nang don phun sum tshogs pa 'dus pa the mi tshom/ bu mo zhig gis don med la mig mda' 'phen mi srid zer/ mig mda' des rdo lo la re ba po zhig bstsal byung ba'am snying stobs bskyed pa gang yin mi shes mod/ kho tshod tshod du spobs shugs kyis khengs song / ‘‘nga rdo los me tog mtsho gzhan gyi lag la shor du mi 'jug kho thag yin zer ba na/ don 'grub kyis kho la‘‘sbal ba na khung na yod kyang bsam pa gling dkar stod red ang zhes bshad pa na/ kho ma rangs par gyur na yang de 'phral skad mgo mtho ru btegs te‘‘gangs dkar sems na rta med na/ phu rung nang la srab mi 'dzin’’zhes brang kha lag pas rdung bzhin gdeng tshod po'i ngang nas bshad/rdo lo ni gsar bu mngon chung can zhig min te/ spobs pa mdzo 'dra ba zhig yod pa ma zad/ ‘‘tshig kha thog nas bshad na don thog dang/ rkang rdo thog nas bcag na lce thog can zhig ste don bya ci zhig yin rung sems nas mi 'jog par lag len du bstar mkhan zhig yin/ dgong mo zhig la khos rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung gi tshoms khang du bro tshogs shig yod pa thos byung / deng 45

rdo mo ske ring /rabs kyi pho mo zung 'khrab kyi bro 'di phan tshun 'brel 'dris dang ngo shes bsgrigs byed kyi thabs lam mchog gyur zhig yin pas/ da reb me tog mtsho la thog ma'i ngo shes sgrig pa'i go skabs 'thob la nye/ 'thob dka' ba'i go skabs bzang bo 'di dam 'dzin ma byas na ga la 'grig khos grogs po don 'grub la rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung du 'gro rogs byed yothub zhes dris byung / spyir don 'grub ni mi mang 'du sa dang 'ur zing che sa'i khrom tshogs su 'gro rgyur mi mos la lobs kyang med/ deng rabs zhabs bro 'khrab par shin tu rmongs/'di'i phyogs la dga' ba yang cher med/ 'on kyang rdo lo ni kho'i grogs po'i ya gyal yin la/ lhag tu do dgong ni rnam kun dang mi mtshungs pa'i khyad par can gyi dus skabs shig ste/ rdo lo'i don dag rlabs chen bsgrub pa'i dus la bslebs/ de bas don 'grub sems gting nas bro chogs su zhugs mi 'dod kyang grogs po'i re bas khengs pa'i mig zung dang zhu ba nan cher 'then pa'i tshul de mthong ba na ngo bzlog ma thub pas dgong mo der rdo lo'i rogs su rdzong srid gzhung gi bro tshogs der zhugs dgos byung / bar med du 'khor ba'i tshon khra'i glog sgron gyi 'og na snga mo nas 'ong ba'i gsar bu gsar mo mang bo zhig snyan 'jebs kyi rol mo'i 'gros dang bstun nas gcig gis gcig la 'jus te bro gar yang mor 'cham gyin 'dug 'khrab tshan zhig bzhag ma thag bro 'cham mkhan dag so so'i kha mal gyi 'dug sar phyin/ rdo los me tog mtsho mthong ma thag mi tshogs kyi gseng du 'tshang ste kho mo'i nye sar bcar rol 46

dadrul gyi rna long /dbyangs slar yang grags byung / rdo los de ma thag de gar ngang skug byas pa'i pho gsar gnyis kyi sngun brtsad de gus pa'i nyams ngang bcas lag pa myur du phar la bsrings shing‘‘'u gnyis 'cham na chog gam zhes gdan 'dren zhus pa na/ me tog mtshos kyang 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang bcas yar la langs te kho dang mnyam du bro 'cham/ bro 'cham bzhin du rdo los rang 'gul gyis kha brda'i mgo bslangs te phan tshun ngo sbyor byas te rgyus yod cig byas/ de nas rjes ma'i bro 'cham thengs rer yang rdo los kho mo pho gsar gzhan dag gi lag tu mi gtong bar mu mthud du mnyam du bro 'cham/ bro tshogs mjug rdzogs rjes tshoms khang gi sgo khar bud pa dang rdo lo mi 'dod bzhin du kho mo dang kha 'bral dgos byung / yin yang rdo los blos mi thongs bzhin mo la khyim du bskyal rogs bya zhes zhus pa na/ kho mos‘‘bka' drin che/ nga la 'gro rogs yod pas bskya'añtsa rogs bya mi dgos zhes snyan mo ngag gis smras byung / rdo lo dga' ba yid kyis mi gnon pa zhig skyes bzhin‘‘ya de na bde mo byos/ ngas do nub khyed la rmi lam yag po zhig mis pa'i smon lam 'debs zhes bshad/ sdod shag gi phyogs su log pa'i lam bar du phar ma dris gong la rdo los do dgong ji ltar me tog mtsho dang ngo shes sgrig tshul dang sang nyin ji ltar dus btab tshul sogs tshur don 'grub la lab byung / rdo los bshad rgyur‘‘mos nga la gzhon nu lhod cha can zhig dang 'dris shing lobs sla ba zhig reng ces bshad byung la/ thog ma'i bag chags bzang bo zhig bzhag song zer zhes bshad/ kho'i bshad pa'i tshig 'bru 47

dadul gyi rna long /dbyangs slar yang grags byung / rdo los de ma thag de gar ngang skug byas pa'i pho gsar gnyis kyi sdun brtsad de gus pa'i nyams ngang bcas lag pa myur du phar la bsrings shing‘ 'u gnyis 'cham na chog gam zhes gdan 'dren zhus pa na/ me tog mtshos kyang 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang bcas yar la langs te kho dang mnyam du bro 'cham/ bro 'cham bzhin du rdo los rang 'gul gyis kha brda'i mgo bslangs te phan tshun ngo sbyor byas te rgyus yod cig byas/ de nas rjes ma'i bro 'cham thengs rer yang rdo los kho mo pho gsar gzhan dag gi lag tu mi gtong bar mu mthud du mnyam du bro 'cham/ bro tshogs mjug rdzogs rjes tshoms khang gi sgo khar bud pa dang rdo lo mi 'dod bzhin du kho mo dang kha 'bral dgos byung / yin yang rdo los blos mi thongs bzhin mo la khyim du bskyal rogs bya zhes zhus pa na/ kho mos ‘bka' drin che/ nga la 'gro rogs yod pas bskya'/ rogs bya mi dgos zhes snyan mo ngag gis smras byung / rdo lo dga' ba yid kyis mi gnon pa zhig skyes bzhin‘‘ya de na bde mo byos/ ngas do nub khyed la rmi lam yag po zhig mis pa'i smon lam 'debs zhes bshad/ sdod shag gi phyogs su log pa'i lam bar du phar ma dris gong la rdo los do dgong ji ltar me tog mtsho dang ngo shes sgrig tshul dang sang nyin ji ltar dus btab tshul sogs tshur don 'grub la lab byung / rdo los bshad rgyur‘‘mos nga la gzhon nu lhod cha can zhig dang 'dris shing lobs sla ba zhig reng ces bshad byung la/ thog ma'i bag chags bzang bo zhig bzhag song zer’zhes bshad/ kho'i bshad pa'i tshig 'bru 47

rdo lo zhe ring /re re brtse dung gi gdangs kyis rgyug cing / dga' ba gnon thabs med pa zhig khong nas 'phyur bzhin pa'i rnam 'gyur de las re ba yid bzhin du 'grub par gom pa dang po zhig spos song ba 'dra/ don 'grub kyis kyang kho'i khams dang bsnan te‘‘grogs po ngas kyang me tog mtsho'i dri ngad ldan pa'i brtse dung gi me tog de mi 'gyang bar khyed la 'thob par smon lam 'debs zhes bshad pa na/kho de bas kyang dga' spro 'phel te‘‘grogs po zer ba ni khyod lta bu'i bsam pa rnam dag can yin zer/ byis pa lo brgyad can zhig la oṃms zas zhim po zhig gnang ba bzhin gnam lding sa lding dang rkang bro 'khrab kyin rang gi sdod shag tu 'dzul zhing / sang nyin kho mo dang thug skabs skad cha ji ltar brjod rgyu'i gra sgrig tshags tshags byed 'go brtsams/sang nyin las grol byas ma thag rdo lo za khang nang la'ang mi 'gro bar mi rkyang thug pa cig nyos rjes thad kar sdod shag tu 'ong zhing / chu khol gyis bangs te nub tsha'i tshab byas te 'thung / grod pa rgyags tsam byas rjes kho gzhi nas brel zing gi las la zhugs/ thog mar gong gyi 'dag rdzas des mgo bo lan 'gar baspus pa dang / dkar sngo dmar ser 'dres pa'i kha spu rnams gtsang mar bzhar/ skra lo yang yang shad rjes tshugs ka 'dug byed kyi snum bskus te 'od yug ger btang / mgo bo dang bzhin ras la byi dor blo yid tshim pa zhig byas rjes lus la shom byed mgo brtsams/ sngon chad thang la gyon mi phod par bsri tshags byas te bzhag yod pa'i phyi gling gyon gos rtsa chen de yang 48

rdo lo ske ring /re re brtse dung gi gdangs kyis phyug cing / dga' ba gnon thabs med pa zhig khong nas 'phyur bzhin pa'i rnam 'gyur de las re ba yid bzhin du 'grub par gom pa dang po zhig spos song ba 'dra/ don 'grub kyis kyang kho'i khams dang bstun te‘‘grogs po ngas kyang me tog mtsho'i dri ngad ldan pa'i brtse dung gi me tog de mi 'gyang bar khyed la 'thob par smon lam 'debs zhes bshad pa na/kho de bas kyang dga' spro 'phel te ‘grogs po zer ba ni khyod lta bu'i bsam pa rnam dag can yin zer/ byis pa lo brgyad can zhig la ོmas zas zhim po zhig gnang ba bzhin gnam lding sa lding dang rkang bro 'khrab kyin rang gi sdod shag tu 'dzul zhing / sang nyin kho mo dang thug skabs skad cha ji ltar brjod rgyu'i gra sgrig tshags tshags byed 'go brtsams/sang nyin las grol byas ma thag rdo lo za khang nang la'ang mi 'gro bar mi rkyang thug pa cig nyos rjes thad nar sdod shag tu 'ong zhing / chu khol gyis bangs te nub tsha'i tshab byas te 'thung / grod pa rgyags tsam byas rjes kho gzhi nas brel zing gi las la zhugs/ thog mar gong chen gyi 'dag rdzas des mgo bo lan 'gar bkrus pa dang / dkar sngo dmar ser 'dres pa'i kha spu rnams gtsang mar bzhar/ skra lo yang yang shad rjes tshugs ka 'dug byed kyi snum bskus te 'od yug ger btang / mgo bo dang bzhin ras la byi dor blo yid tshim pa zhig byas rjes lus la shom byed mgo brtsams/ sngon chad thang la gyon mi phod par bsri tshags byas te bzhag yod pa'i phyi gling gyon gos rtsa chen de yang 48

dacal gyi rna long /lus la gyon/ de'i 'og gi dkar gtsang gi tshi len gsar ba'i gong kha ru gong sdom khra khra zhig dpyangs su bcug gzab mchor yongs su spras rjes kho gos sgam gyi ngo blta nar mo 'di'i mdun du langs/ ngo ma‘‘mi 'dre dang gos lha zer ba cis ma bden/ de sngon rgas nyams che ba'i gsar bu bgres po 'di dus tshod gcig dang phyed ka'i ring gi gzi dang nyams btod rjes phyi yi nyams la bshad dka' ba'i 'gyur ldog cig byung 'dug lo gzhon zhig gi nyams de slar sos byung la grung sha dod po zhig 'dug pas lang tsho'i gzi mdangs mngon par shar byung / 'on kyang rdo lo ske ring gis lus la mnyam 'jog nan mo dang dang dod byas pa las phyi yi nam zla la mnyam ma bzhag pa'am yid nas gting brjed du song ba 'dra/ de min na mtho sgang gi yul gru 'dir dgun snga mo nas zug ste btsag ngar shin tu che dus 'dir lus la ras lu thar rkyang zhig gyon rgyu ji ltar dran byung ngam/ phyi gling gi gyon gos lus steng la shin tu 'phrod cing mdza' na yang phyi rol gyi nam zla la dngos gnas 'grig med/ grogs po don 'grub kyis kho la blta bzhin sems 'khur dang bcas‘‘da lta btsag che bas khyod do dgong cham pa phog na ci bya zer ba na/ kho dgod bzhin du‘‘sems dros na lus 'khyag kyang skyon ci la yod ces ci mi snyam par bshad/ de nas khos mkhrig ma'i chu tshod 'khor lo la yang yang bltas/ do nub dus tshod bdun dang phyed ka'i steng me tog mtsho dang mjal rgyu'i dus chad byas yod/ da so ma dus tshos drug dang skar ma lnga bcu tsam yin pas kho mo la thug pa'i bar la da 49

dacal gyi rna long /lus la gyon/ de'i 'og gi dkar gtsang gi tshi len gsar ba'i gong kha ru gong sdom khra khra zhig dpyangs su bcug gzab mchor yongs su spras rjes kho gos sgam gyi ngo blta nar mo 'di'i mdun du langs/ ngo ma mi 'dre dang gos lha zer ba cis ma bden/ de sngon rgas nyams che ba'i gsar bu bgres po 'di dus tshod gcig dang phyed ku'i ring gi gzi dang nyams btod rjes phyi yi nyams la bshad dka' ba'i 'gyur ldog cig byung 'dug lo gzhon zhig gi nyams de slar sos byung la grung sha dod po zhig 'dug pas lang tsho'i gzi mdangs mngon par shar byung / 'on kyang rdo lo ske ring gis lus la mnyam 'jog nan mo dang dang dod byas pa las phyi yi nam zla la mnyam ma bzhag pa'am yid nas gting brjed du song ba 'dra/ de min na mtho sgang gi yul gru 'dir dgun snga mo nas zug ste btsag ngar shin tu che dus 'dir lus la ras wa thar rkyang zhig gyon rgyu ji ltar dran byung ngam/ phyi gling gi gyon gos lus steng la shin tu 'phrod cing mdza' na yang phyi rol gyi nam zla la dngos gnas 'grig med/ grogs po don 'grub kyis kho la blta bzhin sems 'khur dang bcas‘‘da lta btsag che bas khyod do dgong cham pa phog na ci bya zer ba na/ kho dgod bzhin du sems dros na lus 'khyag kyang skyon ci la yod ces ci mi snyam par bshad/ de nas khos mkhrig ma'i chu tshod 'khor lo la yang yang bltas/ do nub dus tshod bdun dang phyed ga'i steng me tog mtsho dang mjal rgyu'i dus chad byas yod/ da so ma dus tshos drug dang skar ma lnga bcu tsam yin pas kho mo la thug pa'i bar la da 49

rdo pho ske ring /dung skar ma bzhi bcu tsam 'dug dus chod kyi mda' rtags ni 'gul tsam las 'gro rgyu med par ji 'dra'i dal ba la ang / rdo lo sems gting nas brel ba chen po langs/ khang ba'i gnas gcig tu 'dug bzod med par phar 'gro tshur 'gro byas/ phar bltas tshod kyis bskal ba chen po zhig la ngang sgug byas pa 'dra/ khos btsan gyis sgug sgug pa'i mthar skar ma sum cu gzhi nas rdzogs song / ngo blta'i mdun du bcar te rang gi byad gzugs la yang bskyar zhib blta zhig byas pa dang skar ma 'gas dus btab kyi sngon la brel myur gyis phyin no/ /phyi nyin don 'grub grod pa bshal ba'i sman zhig nyo ched las khungs zhol gyi sgo bsten khang du song ba na/ rdo lo ske ring nad pa'i mal khri'i thog na sman chu gtong gin 'dug tshul de mthong ba dang kho dgod rgyu zhig gting nas langs byung / kho la ci zhig byung ba phal che ba shes yod na'ang ma shes khul du ha las pa'i ngang‘‘rdo lo khyod la ci nyes zer ba na/ kho dogs mi bde ba'i ngang dgod tsam byas rjes‘‘mdang shin tu 'khyag pas kho mo dang kha bshad byed mgo brtsams ma thag grang sha zos byung mod/ bsran te dus chod gnyis ring la kha brda byas pa yin/ phyir khyim du log pa na snabs chu mi chogs shing tsha rgyas te zhag gang bor gnyid ma yong / yin yang 'di 'dra tsam zhig nga la ci skyon/mdang nga la yong 'bab ha cang che zhes dga' dga' lhang lhang gis bshad/de'i mur mdang nub kho mo dang kha brda byed pa brgyud brtse dung gi sa bon 50

rdo tsā ring /dung skar ma bzhi bcu tsam 'dug dus chod kyi mda' rtags ni 'gul tsam las 'gro rgyu med par ji 'dra'i dal ba la ang / rdo lo thems gting nas brel ba chen po langs/ khang ba'i gnas gcig tu 'dug bzod med par phar 'gro tshur 'gro byas/ phar bltas tshod kyis bskal ba chen po zhig la ngang sgug byas pa 'dra/ khos btsan gyis sgug sgug pa'i mthar skar ma sum cu gzhi nas rdzogs song / ngo blta'i mdun du bcar te rang gi byad gzugs la yang bskyar zhib //lta /zhig byas pa dang skar ma 'gas dus btab kyi sngon la brel myur gyis phyin phyi nyin don 'grub grod pa bshal ba'i sman zhig nyo ched las khungs zhol gyi sgo bsten khang du song ba na/ rdo lo ske ring nad pa'i mal khri'i thog na sman chu gtong gin 'dug tshul de mthong ba dang kho dgod rgyu zhig gting nas langs byung / kho la ci zhig byung ba phal che ba shes yod na'ang ma shes khul du ha las pa'i ngang‘‘rdo lo khyod la ci nyes zer ba na/ kho dogs mi bde ba'i ngang dgod tsam byas rjes‘‘mdang shin tu 'khyag pas kho mo dang kha bshad byed mgo brtsams ma thag grang sha zos byung mod/ bsran te dus chod gnyis ring la kha brda byas pa yin/ phyir khyim du log pa na snabs chu mi chogs shing tsha rgyas te zhag gang bor gnyid ma yong / yin yang 'di 'dra tsam zhig nga la ci skyon/mdang nga la yong 'bab ha cang che zhes dga' dga' lhang lhang gis bshad/de'i mur mdang nub kho mo dang kha brda byed pa brgyud brtse dung gi sa bon 50

dacal gyi rna long /'debs par re ba sngar las che tshul sogs ma dris tshur la spros bshad byung la/bshad kyin bshad kyin kho sems 'gul chen po byung ste lus rang dbang med par 'phag ste tha na sman chu gtong bzhin pa'ang brjed 'dug la/ cham nad phog pa'i lus kyi mi bde ba de snang ba na ci yang mi 'dug don 'grub kyis kho la‘‘brtse dung gtso che ba smos ma dgos mod/ lus la bdag gces bzang bo ma byas na ga la 'grig do dgong snga mo nas mal sa dron mo byas te ngal gsos na 'grig’ ces kha ta byas pa na/ khos ‘min/ do dgong yang nga kho mo la thug rgyu byas yod zer ba na/ don 'grub kyis‘‘nyi ma brje na mi chog gam zhes dris par/ khos nan tan ngang‘‘de ltar na kho mo la brtsi 'jog ma byas pa yin pas ga la 'grig do dgong nga kho mo la cis kyang thug dgos/ lcags tsha thog nas brdung na mi bzang ngam zer/ don 'grub kyis ku re'i tshul du ‘ngo ma brtse dung ni stobs dang ldan zhes bshad/ kho'i brtse dung la bzung ba'i blta tshul dang spyod stangs de mthong ba'i mod la don 'grub kyis 'jar man gyi rtsom pa po lha tsu'i〈〈the ke phu'i bu mo〉dkus pa'i nang‘‘brtse zhing 'khreng ba'i mi de gdon 'dre dang lha'i pho nya las kyang mthu stobs che la yod tshad bsgrub phod ces pa'i gsung 'di yid la dran zhing / rdo lo ske ring gis me tog mtsho'i brtse dung gi slad du srog 'jog pa'ang dngos gnas khag mi 'dug snyam/de nas bzung rdo lo ske ring dang me tog mtsho gnyis dgun gyi btsag la mi 'jom par dgong thug byed rgyu je mang du btang zhing / rdzong gi mkhar zhol gyi 51

dadul kyi rna long /'debs par re ba sngar las che tshul sogs ma dris tshur la spros bshad byung la/bshad kyin bshad kyin kho sems 'gul chen po byung ste lus rang dbang med par 'phag ste tha na sman chu gtong bzhin pa'ang brjed 'dug la/ cham nad sog pa'i lus kyi mi bde ba de snang ba na ci yang mi 'dug don 'grub kyis kho la‘ brtse dung gtso che ba smos ma dgos mod/ lus la bdag gces bzang bo ma byas na ga la 'grig do dgong snga mo nas mal sa dron mo byas te ngal gsos na 'grig’ ces kha ta byas pa na/ khos ‘min/ do dgong yang nga kho mo la thug rgyu byas yod zer ba na/ don 'grub kyis nyi ma brje na mi chog gam zhes dris par/ khos nan tan ngang‘‘de ltar na kho mo la brtsi 'jog ma byas pa yin pas ga la 'grig do dgong nga kho mo la cis kyang thug dgos/ lcags tsha thog nas brdung na mi bzang ngam zer/ don 'grub kyis ku re'i tshul du ‘ngo ma brtse dung ni stobs dang ldan zhes bshad/ kho'i brtse dung la bzung ba'i blta tshul dang spyod stangs de mthong ba'i mod la don 'grub kyis 'jar man gyi rtsom pa po nye tsu'i〈〈the ke phu'i bu mo〉zhas pa'i nang ‘brtse zhing 'khring ba'i mi de gdon 'dre dang lha'i po nya las kyang mthu stobs che la yod tshad bsgrub phod ces pa'i gsung 'di yid la dran zhing / rdo lo ske ring gis me tog mtsho'i brtse dung gi slad du srog 'jog pa'ang dngos gnas khag mi 'dug snyam/de nas bzung rdo lo ske ring dang me tog mtsho gnyis dgun gyi btsag la mi 'dzem par dgong thug byed rgyu je mang du btang zhing / rdzong gi mkhar zhol gyi 51

rdo mo ske ringasnye/lung khug de ni kho dang kho mo gnyis ka'i dus btab lhan 'dzom gyi gnas mchog yin la/ dben 'jags kyi gnas de ru gzhon nu pho mo 'di gnyis kyis sngo bsangs ma'i mthong na 'dzum pa'i dung zla dang rgyu skar rnams ltad mor bkug ste chu bo shang shang gi glu la nyan bzhin snying gtam dron mo shub bur bzlo ba dang / dgun gyi grang ngar mtha' ru bskrad/ brtse dung gi rgya la tshud pa'i ri dwags pho mo 'di gnyis kyi snang ba zhig la drod 'khol 'bar ba'i me phung zhig kho gnyis kyi bar na 'ur 'ur drag tu mched pa 'dra/ lhag du rdo lo ske ring gis kho mo'i dkar gsal zla ba'i bzhin ras dang / chu mig dwangs mo 'dzum zhing smra brjod nus pa'i khra chung zung mthong thengs rer yid kyi mkhar gyang rmang nas bshig ste kha brda'i go rim 'chol zhing re zhig ci zhig smra dgos pa'ang mi shes par gyur/ me tog mtsho'i mgrin pa gser gyi 'khor lo nas 'jo ba'i don ldan tshig gi phreng ba sbrang char bzhin du rdo lo ske ring gi snying gar sim byung / 'di ni spyir btang phal ba'i smra sgo'i tshig cig ga la yin/ nyan gyin nyan gyin snyan mo mgur dang bya khu lo'i glu sogs kyang dman sar 'god pa'i brjod par dka' ba'i ngag gi 'gyur khugs red/ kho mo la yun thung tsam la 'grogs pa'ang rdo lo la mtshon na 'jig rten khams kyi bde skyid nyag gcig red la/ 'di lta'i mdzangs ma'i yon tan gyis phyug cing 'jo sgeg dpal gyis brgyan pa'i sman chung zhig la tshe 'dir thug 'phrad byung ba ni gnam sa gnyis kyis mtshams sbyar ba yin zhing / las bsod can gyi rtags su shar ba min nam/ rdo lo ske ring gi 52

dadul gyi rna 'ong /mig lam na me tog mtsho ni sngar bas yid du 'ong zhing khyad du 'phags par mthong /'di ltar nyin 'ga'i ring gi ngo thug dang brtse dung gi mngar bcud nyams su myong ba'i drin gyis rdo lo ske ring gi gdong na sngar med kyi 'dzum mdangs 'khrug cing / kha gdangs na skad cha mang ba dang / mig zung yang sngar las chung du phyin pa'i snang ba 'gog med du ster/ skabs rer srang lam du 'gro thengs rer khos dbang med du skad 'tsher 'tsher gyis 'jig rten glu chung ngag nas shor 'gro/ las khungs nang gi grogs po tshos kho dang kho mo gnyis kha rog ger dus btab ste thug gin yod pa'i gnas tshul zur tsam go byung bas/ tshang ma'i sems na ched reb rang las khungs kyi mi rkyang gcig po 'di'i gnad don yang thag gcod thub la nye 'dug snyam ste/ kho la‘ rdo lo/ gnyen ston gyi skal nam zhig la gnang ngam zhes dris pa na/ rdo lo yid myos te kha zim mi thub par gyur la/ kha shags shags kyis‘ gnyen ston gyi skal bza' rgyur da dung snga zhes lan btab/ ‘‘rdo lo dang me tog mtsho gnyis dga' rogs sgrig gyin 'dug ces skya ga'i tshang la rdo 'phangs pa bzhin rdzong mkhar chung chung 'di 'ur ser btang la/ tshang ma'i kha na gleng zhing nyan na 'dod pa'i gsar 'gyur chung chung zhig tu gyur/ mang che ba zhig yid ma ches shing rna ru ma song ste‘ me tog mtsho ni rdo lo lta bu la 'grogs mi srid ces zer la/ kho dang kho mo gnyis rgya srang du dpung ba mnyam gshib dang gom pa mnyam len gyis gleng mol byed 53
