rdo lo ske ring /bzhin 'gro ba dngos su mthong yang / 'ga' res da dung kho gnyis kyi rjes su cer bzhin the tshom gyi dri ba 'don pa red/ pho sgo nga bzang dang nus pa nga che rlom pa'i pho gsar mig ser can 'ga' re phrag dog gis rgyud 'khrigs shing /zhe sdang dang yid smon gyis yid sems bsregs te bsam btsugs te rdo lo ske ring mig la mi 'gro bar mtho 'tshams shing co 'dri byed pa dang / klan ka 'tshol 'ong ba dang / tha na rdo lo dang lam thug byung na dpung pas brgyab ste tsham tshom med par khu tshur gzhus 'ong / 'on kyang brtse dung ni rlabs po che yin pas/ bgegs bar chad ci rigs la gdong thug rgyag dgos la/ sdug lan chags mang po zhig myong los dgos/ grogs po don 'grub kyis kho'i kha la sngo thig babs shing mig lcibs dmar spangs byung ba dag pho gsar mig sar can tshos bzhag pa'i lag rjes yin pa shes song bag sems kyis ma bzod par kho la 'jig rten gyi mdzes ma ni me tog cig dang 'dra ste de'i ze'u 'bru la rol 'dod mkhan gyi bung ba ni gang mang mang yod pas/ khyod kyis gzab gzab dang sems chung byas na legs zer ba na/ khos ‘hun/ gsus pa na na rnyang du song / ngas kho tshor ltad mo ngo mtshar zhig 'jog nges yin/ me tog mtsho'i brtse dung gi me tog bung ba nga min par su la dbang zhes bshad pa'i mod la/ kho'i ske rtsa rnams 'bur 'ong ba dang / ngo mdangs dmar nag tu log cing / sna khung nas dbugs sgra shugs kyis 'don/ tshul der bltas na kho pho gsar mig ser can dag gi steng la zhe sdang bzod med cig skyes pa dang / la rgya dang khog 54

dacal gyi rna tsāng /dpung yang gting nas langs bzhin pa rtogs thub la/ mi 'gyangs myur du me tog mtsho dang khyim gcig tu sdod rgyu byung na ci ca rung yang snyam pa 'dra/ kho gnyis dga' rogs bsgrigs te zla ngo gnyis lhag so nga na yang nam rgyun kha brda'i nang don ni rang rang gi bya ba'i skor dang / 'dun mos/ slob ma'i skabs kyi 'tsho ba phyir dran sogs las ma 'das/ rdo lo ske ring ni ma 'ongs khyim gzhi ji ltar bsgrigs pa'i don la sems 'khur che zhing brel ba langs pa dang / 'di'i phyogs kyi kha brda yang byed 'dod che mod/ skabs 'di dag tu me tog mtshos ma go khul dang ma shes pa'i zol gyis 'phral mar tshig mgo gzhan la bskor 'gro/ rdo lo ske ring gi sems la mos 'di ltar bgyid pa ni rgyu mtshan med pa ma red snyam/ dga' rogs bsgrigs yun thung na ga la 'grig ma mtha' yang lo gcig ring la nyams tshod len dgos/ rang gis 'di ltar 'tshub cha slong ba ni dngos gnas yon tshad dma' ba'i glen rtags ston pa las ci/ rdo lo ske ring gi sems su 'grig ma song zhes gnong 'gyod tshad med cig skyes shing phyis su khyim gzhi bsgrigs pa'i skor gyi tshig sne tsam yang gleng ma phod la/ kho mo'i khams dang bstun ci thub kyis rna byang du song ba'i kha brda rnying ba dag yang dang bskyar du gleng zhing / de ni ro myong gi bro ba ldan zhing don gyis phyug pa ltar byas/ kho gnyis mtshan mor thug rgyu mtshams ma chad la/ gzhan gyis bltas na yang snang ba dar gyi mdud pa dang / mi 'gyur rdo rje'i tshad la slebs 'dra'i snang ba zhig bcos min du ster mod/ kho mo rdo lo ske ring gi mi rkyang khang ba'i 55

rdo lo ske ring /nang skor rgyag tu thengs gcig ma yong la/ tha na grogs po tshos kho la skul ma byas te kho mo mgron du bos te grogs po dag la ngo sbyor byed du mngags na yang / kho mos nam yang bya ba brel ba che zhing khom pa yod dus shig la blta ru yong zer ba las/ mi rkyang 'di'i khang ba'i sgo khar gom gang yang ma btud/don ngo ma'i dga' rogs yin na rang gi snying mabun gyi khang ba'i nang la los yong / 'ga' res le dbar stong gi sa nas lam bar gyi dka' tshegs la ma 'dzem par rang gi dga' rogs la skor rgyag tu 'ong thub na/ khyod rdzong mkhar gcig gi yid bzhin du mi thon pa'i don ci yin/ grogs po don 'grub kyis kho la‘‘mo khyed kyi khang ba'i nang la mi yong bar gnad don zhig mi 'dug gam zhes rnam rtog dang dogs pa slong ba na/ brtse dung gi dbang du tshud pa'i rdo los‘‘ga la yod ces bshad de mo la bden kha byin te kho la blta ru yong ma thub par khag med tshul lab/gza' nyi ma zhig la grogs po don 'grub kyis rdo lo ske ring la‘‘mdzes ma yon tan can de 'dra zhig khyod la thob pa ni nyid kyi skyid dang bsod nams yin pa bshad ci dgos/ grogs po nga yi rgyan zhig kyang min nam/ de ring ngas khyed la ched du rten 'brel zhu ba la sha chang gi mgron bya zer bzhin sngon nas nyos yong ba'i tshon po sha dang zhim po chang dang btung ba'i rigs rnams rdo lo 'dug sa'i 'bol khri'i than gyi mdun cog thog la bsgrigs/ yang kho la‘‘nga la re ba cig yod pa ni de ring ngal gso ba'i nyin yin pas/ me tog mtsho la yang 56

dngul gyi rna bong /khom pa los yod/ khyod kyi dga' ma 'dir bos 'ong ste mnyam gcig tu glu len gar rtsed byed7zer na/ kho dga' thag chod de bshad rgyur‘‘grogs pos nga 'di ltar sems su bzung ste ngo so bstod na/ ngas re ba stong zad du gtong srol gang na yod/ nga da lta nyid du 'gro la kho mo rem mar 'khrid 'ongang zer bzhin kho mo tshang la kha par gtong du phyin/ don 'grub kyis bsam par de ring kho mo la khom pa med mi srid pas kha ngor bltas te los yong snyam/ yin yang dus tshod ring bo zhig 'das mod/ rdo lo thon rgyu ma byung / don 'grub sdod ma tshugs par yang yang sgo ru bltas pa na/ yun ring bo zhig gi rjes su rdo lo gcig pu da gzod ngo thur du bsnar te slebs byung / kho'i bzhin mdangs yongs su shor 'dug grogs po'i re ba stong zad du btang bas kho ngo gnongs te kha mur mur gyis ci zhig shod rtsis byas mod/ kho'i gdong gi rnam 'gyur las mos sngar mus bzhin don dag gzhan la kha g.yar te 'dir yong ma 'dod pa gsal bor tshor thub/ de bas don 'grub kyis kyang rgyu mtshan gting 'dri dang phugs 'dri mi byed par kho la sems gso chedaphamo yong ma thub pa don dag cig yod las che/'u grogs po gnyis kyis skyid po byas na da gzod bag yangs yin pas 'di'i yan gyi skyid cig gang na yod zer bzhin kho la rten 'brel gyi chang drangs/khos kyang re re bzhin mgo ru g.yon te hub 'thung byas/ 'on kyang kho'i ngo na 'dzum zhig mthong rgyu mi 'dug la/ kha brda yang nyung tsam las mi byed/ grogs po don 'grub kyis khrom pa 'di skyid la bskur ched ku re mtshar gtam gleng 57

rdo mo ske ring /zhing / glu dang glu dbyangs ngag la drangs na yang rdo los mu tshugs kyis 'dzum tsam btod pa dang / de min mgo skur te chang rngam 'thung byed kyin 'dugacang ma 'gor bar kho ra bzi ste mgo bo brang khar bsnar te 'bol khri'i thog tu gnyid du yur song / don 'grub kyis kho skyon te mal khri'i thog bde mor nyal du bcug dang po dga' skyid rab tu rgyas par re ba che ba'i lhan 'dzoms 'de grogs po cig sems pham ste snga mor gnyid du yur ba'i rkyen gyis zhe smreng ba'i mkha' dbugs stug po zhig mi rkyang gi khang ba hril bor khyab cing / shul du lus pa'i grogs po la yang mu mthud du chang 'dod kyi yi ga 'gag cing / rdo lo'i mdangs nyams pa'i gdong la blta tsam byas rjes dngan pa 'then bzhin rang sar logade'i rjes su don 'grub rdzong mus skong 'then byas pa ltar gzhi rim bya ba'i tsho chung zhig tu zhugs shing zla gcig lhag gi ring la rdzong mkhar dang bar la nyin phyed kyi lam thag yod cing / kha par yang mi 'gro ba'i lung kyog tu chags pa'i zhang srid gzhung du 'dug dgos byung / yin yang dus yun 'di'i ring la don 'grub kyi dran yul du bar med kyis 'khor ba ni kho'i grogs po rdo lo ske ring yin la/ sems khur byed sa yang rdo lo dang kho'i snying gi mdza' mor 'bod pa'i me tog mtsho gnyis kyi 'brel ba je bzang tu 'gro bzhin yod med de red/ gzhi rim nas don dag mtha' dag las thabs dang bsgrub thabs byas te tshugs ka tsam bstan chog la/ de'i khar gzhi rim na spro skyid gtong sa gzhan 58

rdo tsha ring /zhing / glu dang glu dbyangs ngag la drangs na yang rdo los sku tshugs kyis 'dzum tsam btod pa dang / de min mgo sgrur te chang rngam 'thung byed kyin 'dugacang ma 'gor bar kho ra bzi ste mgo bo brang khar bsnar te 'bol khri'i thog tu gnyid du yur song / don 'grub kyis kho skyon te mal khri'i thog bde mor nyal du bcug dang po dga' skyid rab tu rgyas par re ba che ba'i lhan 'dzoms 'di grogs po cig sems pham ste snga mor gnyid du yur ba'i rkyen gyis zhe spreng ba'i mkha' dbugs snag po zhig mi rkyang gi khang ba hril bor khyab cing / shul du lus pa'i grogs po la yang mu mthud du chang 'dod kyi yi ga 'gag cing / rdo lo'i mdangs nyams pa'i gdong la blta tsam byas rjes dngan pa 'then bzhin rang sar logade'i rjes su don 'grub rdzong us skong 'then byas pa ltar gzhi rim bya ba'i tsho chung zhig tu zhugs shing zla gcig lhag gi ring la rdzong mkhar dang bar la nyin gyed kyi lam thag yod cing / kha par yang mi 'gro ba'i lung kyog tu chags pa'i zhang srid gzhung du 'dug dgos byung / yin yang dus yun 'di'i ring la don 'grub kyi dran yul du bar med kyis 'khor ba ni kho'i grogs po rdo lo ske ring yin la/ sems khur byed sa yang rdo lo dang kho'i snying gi mdza' mor 'bod pa'i me tog mtsho gnyis kyi 'brel ba je bzang tu 'gro bzhin yod med de red/ gzhi rim nas don dag mtha' dag las thabs dang bsgrub thabs byas te tshugs ka tsam bstan chog la/ de'i khar gzhi rim na spro skyid gtong sa gzhan 58

dadul gyi rna bong /med/ yod pa nyag gcig ni deng sang shin tu dar ba'i mā cang rtsed rgyu de red/gru bzhi sho yi mkhar gyang rdung na nyi ma re re ni skad cig skad cig nyid du 'das/ skabs la la'i mtshan mor chang gi grogs po yod pas skyid po byas rkyang red/ ci yin 'di yin med par zla gcig tshang song / don 'grub gzhi rim nas rdzong mkhar du thon ma thag thad nar rdo lo ske ring la 'phrad du song / 'on kyang las khungs nang na kho mi 'dug las khungs 'go khrid kyis bshad na rdo lo na ste nyin bzhi yi gnang ba zhus song zer/ don 'grub kyis ci zhig gi nad byung ngam snyam bzhin rdo lo'i nyal khang du yong ba na/ rdo lo mal khri'i thog na rang sham byas te nyal 'dug don 'grub kho'i 'khris su bcar te bzhin mdangs la bltas pa na/ a tsi kho la sma ra dang ag tshom ring bo skyes shing /mig 'bras chung chung gnyis dong du lhung ba dang / ma ne yang je ring du song ba'i tshor snang ster/ phar bltas tshod kyis nad ljid mo zhig phog pa 'dra/ don 'grub kyis kho la sman khang la mi bsten par 'di ltar 'dug ga la rung / yar longs la sman khang du 'gro zer ba na/ khos gdong nas ngu ma dgod kyi mdangs shig phyungs te‘‘nga'i nad 'di sman khang gi sman pa la bkod pa ci yod zer/ grogs pos 'dang ma phog par‘ 'o na nad ya mtshar 'di ji ltar byung ba yin zer ba na/ khos mgo bo g.yug g.yug byed bzhin ‘da bshad srol med ces bshad bzhin mgo bo rum la bcug bal bo se'u ma zos kyang / /kha dog nyid las bro ba shes/ /khos grogs po'i dris pa'i tshig la lan ma btab 59

dacal gyi rna tshang /med/ yod pa nyag gcig ni deng sang shin tu dar ba'i mā cang rtsed rgyu de red/gru bzhi sho yi mkhar gyang rdung na nyi ma re re ni skad cig skad cig nyid du 'das/ skabs la la'i mtshan mor chang gi grogs po yod pas skyid po byas rkyang red/ ci yin 'di yin med par zla gcig tshang song / don 'grub gzhi rim nas rdzong mkhar du thon ma thag thad kar rdo lo ske ring la 'phrad du song / 'on kyang las khungs nang na kho mi 'dug las khungs 'go khrid kyis bshad na rdo lo na ste nyin bzhi yi gnang ba zhus song zer/ don 'grub kyis ci zhig gi nad byung ngam snyam bzhin rdo lo'i nyal khang du yong ba na/ rdo lo mal khri'i thog na rang sham byas te nyal 'dug don 'grub kho'i 'khris su bcar te bzhin mdangs la bltas pa na/ ma tsi kho la sma ra dang ag tshom ring bo skyes shing /mig 'bras chung chung gnyis dong du kung ba dang / ma ne yang je ring du song ba'i tshor snang ster/ phar bltas tshod kyis nad ljid mo zhig phog pa 'dra/ don 'grub kyis kho la‘ sman khang la mi bsten par 'di ltar 'dug ga la rung / yar longs la sman khang du 'gro zer ba na/ khos gdong nas ngu ma dgod kyi mdangs shig phyungs te‘‘nga'i nad 'di sman khang gi sman pa la bkod pa ci yod zer/ grogs pos 'dang ma phog par‘‘'o na nad ya mtshar 'di ji ltar byung ba yin zer ba na/ khos mgo bo g.yug g.yug byed bzhin‘‘da bshad srol med ces bshad bzhin mgo bo rum la bcug bal bo se'u ma zos kyang / /kha dog nyid las bro ba shes/ /khos grogs po'i dris pa'i tshig la lan ma btab 59

rdo mo ring /kyang / kho nyam thag pa'i gnas 'di 'dra zhig tu lhung ba la bltas na gnas tshul mi legs pa zhig byung zin par gdon mi za la/ kho dang me tog mtsho gnyis kyi 'brel ba tshad ji lta bu zhig tu lhung ba yang phal che ba blo la shar song /yin yang don 'grub kyis sems kha ma nyan par yang nas yang du gnas tshul 'di'i 'byung rkyen dris pa na khos gzhi nas bzod par dka' zhing theg par mi nus pa'i lus sems mnar gcod kyi brgyud rim de gleng byung /dbyin ji'i gli phen kon gyis mi ni brtse dung gi dbang gis blo rmongs 'gro zhes gsungs pa ni cis ma bden/ me tog mtsho la rgyus yod pa'i ngo shes 'ga' res de snga rdo lo la me tog mtsho ni kha yag pa kho na las bsam pa mi drang ba dang nyen kha che tshul sogs kyi sems bsam pa'i kha ta byas myong na yang / rdo lo ske ring kho me tog mtsho la mtha' gcig rtse gcig tu dungs shing zhen chags pas tshig de dag rna ru ga la 'gro/ kho mo ni ra ri dri mas stongs pa'i bla med mchog gyur zhig tu bsgom la/ brtse dung gi baspu brid kyis kho'i yid sems kun nas rmongs su bcug grogs po don 'grub gzhi rim du song shul gyi nyin 'ga' la bsnad mar kho mos kho la khom pa med ces dus chad dang len ma byas/'gyur ldog glo bur ba 'dis kho sems ma bde la ma babs shing dogs gzhi yang yang bsladag nyin zhig rdo lo gzhung sgrub khang du thems pham ste sdod skabs/me tog mtshos kha phar tshur btang 'ong ste bshad rgyur ‘do nub khyed la khom pa yod na/ sngon gyi gnas de ru thug dgos zhes bshad byung / rdo lo ni mi byas 60

dngul gyi rna 'ong /'brug sgra thos pa bzhin yid sems dga' spro dpag med kyis myos te skad cig nyid la mig lam gyi yod tshad 'ja' tshon bzhin du rnam par bkra zhing yid 'ong lham me bar gyur/ 'di ni me tog mtshos rang 'gul gyis tshur la btang yong ba'i kha par yin pas/ sems khong du rba rlabs 'khrigs/ kho la slar yang gson shugs dang spobs pas khengs song / dgong mor rdo lo ske ring gis rang gis rang la nya ra blo yid chim pa zhig byas rjes kho mo la thug tu phyin/ mthon po a sngon gyi dbyings na cha rdzogs min pa'i zla ba tshes ris shig sprin gyi phag tu bzhud la nye zhing / de'i mtha' na bskor ba'i skar ma'i tshogs kyis 'dzum dmul ler ci zhig bshu bur bzlo/ rdo los re ba'i mig zung gis mkha' ru blta zhing / gom stabs myur mo lung khug de ru bsgyur/ mo snga mo nas de ru thon zhing kho la sgug 'dug mo mthong ma thag rdo lo ske ring 'tshub cha zhig langs shing re zhig ci zhig bshad dgos pa'ang mi shes par khu sim mer lus/ yud tsam 'gor rjes thog mar kho mos kha grags byung / mos mgo bo smad de rdog sde la blta bzhin ha cang gcom bskyungs kyi tshul du skad dma' mos‘‘rdo lo/ nga la bshad rgyu zhig yod mod/ khyod kyis dang len phod dam zhes dris pa dang / rdo los snying drag tu lding zhing skad ngag cung 'dar bzhin du‘ ci red/ shod dang zer ba na/ ‘‘'u gnyis rang rang sar song na ji 'dra zhes bshad byung /rdo lo rang gi rna la yid ma ches par‘‘khyod kyis ci zer zhes dris par/ kho mos slar yang ‘'u gnyis gyes bral byas na bzang zhes smras pa na/ rdo lo ske ring gi 61

dacal gyi rna 'ong /'brug sgra thos pa bzhin yid sems dga' spro dpag med kyis myos te skad cig nyid la mig lam gyi yod tshad 'ja' tshon bzhin du rnam par bkra zhing yid 'ong lham me bar gyur/ 'di ni me tog mtshos rang 'gul gyis tshur la btang yong ba'i kha par yin pas/ sems khong du rba rlabs 'khrigs/ kho la slar yang gson shugs dang spobs pas khengs song / dgong mor rdo lo ske ring gis rang gis rang la nya ra blo yid rim pa zhig byas rjes kho mo la thug tu phyin/ mthon po a sngon gyi dbyings na cha rdzogs min pa'i zla ba tshes ris shig sprin gyi phag tu bzhud la nye zhing / de'i mtha' na bskor ba'i skar ma'i tshogs kyis 'dzum dmul ler ci zhig bshu bur bzlo/ rdo los re ba'i mig thung gis mkha' ru blta zhing / gom stabs myur mo lung khug de ru bsgyur/ mo snga mo nas de ru thon zhing kho la sug 'dug mo mthong ma thag rdo lo ske ring 'tshub cha zhig langs shing re zhig ci zhig bshad dgos pa'ang mi shes par khu sim mer lus/ yud tsam 'gor rjes thog mar kho mos kha grags byung / mos mgo bo smad de rdog sne la blta bzhin ha cang gcom bskyungs kyi tshul du skad dma' mos‘‘rdo lo/ nga la bshad rgyu zhig yod mod/ khyod kyis dang len phod dam zhes dris pa dang / rdo los snying drag tu lding zhing skad ngag cung 'dar bzhin du ‘ci red/ shod dang zer ba na/ ‘‘'u gnyis rang rang sar song na ji 'dra zhes bshad byung /rdo lo rang gi rna la yid ma ches par khyod kyis ci zer zhes dris par/ kho mos slar yang‘‘'u gnyis gyes bral byas na bzang zhes smras pa na/ rdo lo ske ring gi 61

rdo mo ske ring /mgo la glo bur du dbyu gus bsnun pa bzhin klad pa'i nang nag 'thom mer gyur la yom snar mi brtan chen tsam min na thang la 'gyel song / me tog mtshos‘ ngas kyang don dngos 'di khyed kyis dang len byed dka' ba shes mod/'on kyang don 'di snga mo nas thag gcod byas na mi bzang ngam/ khyod la snying nas bzod gsol zhu zer/ sems cung lhod la babs song ba'i rdo los stobs shugs zad pa bzhin khyod nga la gyes bral bya don ci yin zhes dris pa na/ me tog mtshos de snga kho la ma gleng ba ma gtogs mo rang la slob grwar 'grim skabs nas bzung dga' rogs shig yod tshul dang / bya bar zhugs rjes kyang phan tshun yi ge dang kha pa ra gyi lam nas 'brel ba byed kyin yod tshul/ gnyis ka 'brog phyogs kyi yin zhing khyim pha ma gnyis kyis kyang don 'di shes yod la bu mo'i kha thog tu bzhag yod tshul sogs rab dang rim pa zhig lab byung bas rdo lo la re ba med tshul dang sngon bsags kyi las 'brel de med tshul bstan/ rdo lo ske ring gis kho mo'i skad char nyan rjes rang gis re ba bcangasapa'i bu mo 'dis da reg bar du rang la 'grogs pa ni gnas skabs kyi kha brda byed rogs dang / yid kyi skyo snang sel rogs tsam du brtsisapa las mo'i sems ngo na rang nyid gtan nas med pa shes/ 'dang brgyab kyin brgyab kyin rang nyid rtsis med dang rtse spyad du bzung song sems bzhin zhe sdang gis ma bzod par‘‘'brug mo hor na yod kyang / bsam pa gling na yod/ khyod kyis nga rang spre'u rtsed rtsed byas pa red ces bshad pa na/ kho mos myur du‘ min/ khyod kyang 62

rdo mo ring /mgo la glo bur du dbyu gus bsnun pa bzhin klad pa'i nang nag 'thom mer gyur la yom snar mi brtan tsam min na thang la 'gyel song / me tog mtshos‘‘ngas kyang don dngos 'di khyed kyis dang len byed dka' ba shes mod/'on kyang don 'di snga mo nas thag gcod byas na mi bzang ngam/ khyod la snying nas bzod gsol zhu zer/ sems cung lhod la babs song ba'i rdo los stobs shugs zad pa bzhin‘‘khyod nga la gyes bral bya don ci yin zhes dris pa na/ me tog mtshos de snga kho la ma gleng ba ma gtogs mo rang la slob grwar 'grim skabs nas bzung dga' rogs shig yod tshul dang / bya bar zhugs rjes kyang phan tshun yi ge dang kha pa ra gyi lam nas 'brel ba byed kyin yod tshul/ gnyis ka 'brog phyogs kyi yin zhing khyim pha ma gnyis kyis kyang don 'di shes yod la bu mo'i kha thog tu bzhag yod tshul sogs rab dang rim pa zhig lab byung bas rdo lo la re ba med tshul dang sngon bsags kyi las 'brel de med tshul bstan/ rdo lo ske ring gis kho mo'i skad char nyan rjes rang gis re ba bcangaspopa'i bu mo 'dis da reg bar du rang la 'grogs pa ni gnas skabs kyi kha brda byed rogs dang / yid kyi skyo snang sel rogs tsam du brtsisapa las mo'i sems ngo na rang nyid gtan nas med pa shes/ 'dang brgyab kyin brgyab kyin rang nyid rtsis med dang rtse spyad du bzung song sems bzhin zhe sdang gis ma bzod par‘6'brug mo hor na yod kyang / bsam pa gling na yod/ khyod kyis nga rang spro/ ༵da rtsed byas pa red ces bshad pa na/ kho mos myur du‘ min/ khyod kyang

dngul gyi rna long /bshad rgyu gtam rgyu med pa'i mi dga' zhig yin pas/ grogs po zhig la brtsis pa yin/ yang cig bshad na ngas khyod la gnyen sgrig ces ga la bshad myong zer/ rdo lo'i re ba stong zad du gyur pas da 'di nas kho mor phar lab tshur lab byas na snying bo ci yang mi 'dug snyam ste‘ da nas bzung rta 'do ba'i rgyugs lam so sor byed/ khyed 'u gnyis bsam pa kha kha red/ bde mo byos zhes mtha' mjug gi bde mo 'jog mgo brtsams pa na/ mos brtse dung med kyang mdza' gcugs yod na los chog ces ngag 'jam pos bshad pa na/rdo los de 'phral‘‘bka' drin che/ nga la khyed lta bu'i bu mo zhig gi mdza' gcugs mi dgos zhes bshad tshar ma thag phyir mig tsam yang mi blta bar phyir rang gi sdod shag tu log rdo lo ske ring gis gong gi skad cha de dag bshad de mtshams 'dir bslebs rjes dngan pa zhig 'then bzhin ‘'dre mo des da ngo tshar gtad song / nga mal sar lhung du bcug pa 'di red ces bshad/ grogs pos kho la‘ me tog mtsho ni bzhin bzang rgyud 'khyog cig yin pas blo gtad rgyu gang na yod/ rang bzhin gya gyu che ba 'di 'dra chung mar blangs rung skyid med kho thag yin zer ba dang yang‘‘'jig rten na kho mo min pa bu mo med pa ga la yin/ stag sha ra zhig yin tshe sems che dgos/ ya chung nang na rta rgyugs sa dang ma chung nang na mda' 'phen sa zhig yod dgos/ rgya'i gtam dpe la yang ljon shing gcig gi thog nas shi mi rung zer bas/ khyod sems chung don med ces rdo lo la gang nus kyis sems gso byas/63

rdo mo ske ring /me tog mtshos tshur bde mo bzhag pa nas rdo lo ske ring gi rdzong mkhar 'di'i bu mo gcig la yang kha glong ma thub/ mig deb dbang tsam la dgun tshar te dpyid kyi sngo skyes pa'i dus la slebs byung / nyin zhig gi dgong mor grogs po don 'grub ni rdo lo ske ring gis bos pa'i mgron du phyin/ sgo chen kha ru thon pa na rdo lo'i khang shag gi nang nas ‘ho ho ya zhes gzhon nu ma gcig gnyis kyi dgod sgra grags 'ong / ‘ yogi mi rkyang gi khang ba nang na bu mo yod pa 'di ci zhes don 'grub mtshar snang dang bcas nang du 'dzul ba na khang ba'i nang na rdo lo las gzhan mtha' sham phrug can gyi bod lugs ras lu gyon pa'i gsar mo gnyis 'dug kho mo gnyis kyi sha mdangs dang / skra'i lan bu bslas tshul/gon pa cha lugs bcas gang thad nas bltas na pha yul rong gi bu mo yin pa shes thub/ gcig skub stegs su bsdad de rdo lo la kha brda byed kyin 'dug la/cig shos kyis rang mi 'dug par lcags thab tu mong ba sdug pa dang nga'adren chang 'dren sogs kyi las nar brel bzhin 'dug rdo lo'i bshad pa ltar na kho mo gnyis dang 'u cag ni lung khog gcig gi yin zhing / sa 'dir dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu brko ru 'ong ba yin la/ kho tsho ngo shes te nyin bcu lhag 'das song zer/ rdo lo dang mnyam du kha brda byed mkhan gyi bu mo'i de'i ming la lcags mo mtsho 'bod la/ khyim bdag ma nang bzhin las ker brel ba der lha go zhes 'bod/ skabs shig la rdo los don 'grub la mchu brda zhig byas te lha go ston bzhin‘‘mo ni ji 'dra red ces skad gdangs dma' mos dris byung / don 64

dngul gyi rna mong /'grub kyis‘ lag las ker mkhas pa'i tshegs yang la mo sgo yang bzang bas/bzang mo 'di lta bu zla phogs len mkhan min yang / khyim chung mar blangs na gnyom med par ha cang mdza' zhes ku re dang bcas bshad pa na/ rdo los yid chim pa'i brda la mgo bo nang la ldem ldem byas/ rdo los bshad rgyur kho mo gnyis mthong ba dang rang ni gro nas sran gsum gyi dri zhim 'thul ba'i pha yul gyi zhing khar bslebs pa 'dra zer/ de nas kho tshos chang la rol bzhin du glu len gar rtse byas/ glu dang rtsed rigs kyis yid ma tshim pas bu mo gnyis kyi re ba ltar la gzhas 'then rgyu byas/ don 'grub la gzhas la rmongs pas rdo los ma bskul dang blangs kyis yar la langs shing / 'gram pa lag pas skyor bzhin 'khor gyin 'khor gyin ‘ya la re zhes rtse mgo dngul dkar 'khor lo blangs song / la gnas de bu mo gnyis kyi gang rung zhig la blangs pa yin mod/ lcags mo mtsho dgod bzhin du lha go'i rgyab la lag pas rgyag bzhin ‘lan pa khyod kyis rdzogs na 'grig ces skul ba na/ lha gos kyang brdzi bag tsam byas pa las phyir bshol mang du mi bgyis par ga ler yar la yangs pa dang / cung 'tsher snang dang bcas mgo bo dang gar smad cing 'gram pa lag pas skyor bzhin la gzhas lan pa rdzogs so/ /de'i rjes su rdo lo dang lha go gnyis kyis mtshams mi 'jog par mthun pa'i skor gyi la gzhas 'ba' zhig 'then bzhin/ tshig gi 'bru la gzhigs na kho gnyis ni 'jig rten gyi zhe snang ba mthun pa'i rogs lo zhig la 'gyur la nye/ gsar bu gsar mo 'di gnyis kyi snyan mo la gzhas lcags kyu des 65

rdo mo ske ring /nyan mkhan don 'grub kyi yid sems rab tu 'phrog cing / nyan gyin nyan gyin kho rang ri chu lung gsum 'dzoms pa'i pha yul gyi zhing bar la thon pa 'dra zhing /lcang sdong gi bsil grib sdum po'i gram pa ru skor dang skor byas te la gzhas 'then pa'i‘‘drug pa'i lab tse la rol ba'i snang ba yang bcos min du ster/rdo los la gzhas len zhor du lha go'i gdong la mig gis zum mer bltas shing /lha gos kyang gdong la dmar mdangs rgyas bzhin rdo lo'i phyogs la mig zhags lan mang 'phen gyin 'dug nam gung yol song / don 'grub ra bzi la nye byung bas gnyid bcag thebs na sang nyin gyi bya bar gnod dogs te sngon ma byas te khri sadu loganyin 'ga'i rjes su don 'grub kyis gzhan gyi kha nas go tshul la/ phayul gyi bu mo lha go zer ba de rdo lo ske ring gi sdod khang du zhag 'dug byed kyin 'dug la/ mi 'gyangs par khoganyis khyim thab bsgrig rgyu red zer/ don 'grub yid ma ches par 'dri ru song ba na rdo los skad cha de bden tshul gleng / don 'grub ha las pa'i ngang‘‘khyod bzang na ngan na las byed cig yin pag las ka ba zhig btsal don ci yin zhes dris par/ khos‘ngas kyang sngon chad rang dang 'dra ba'i las byed cig chung mar len 'dod mod/ da 'dang brgyab na gcig red/ 'di na yang las byed pa'i nang na las ka ba chung mar blangs pa gang mang mang 'dug de dag gis kha sos thub na ngas ci ma mi sos zer/khos mu mthud du bshad rgyur‘‘nged gnyis sa mtha' 'di nas 'phrad dgos byung 66

gsar bu lha rgyal gyi gtam rgyud/gsar bu lha rgyal zer na rdzong mkhar 'dir mi shes mkhan nyung nyung las med/ de ni‘ ngan pa ming can zhes ngan byas te grags pa min la/ bzang byas te kun la grags pa de bas kyang min/ 'o na gsar bu lha rgyal zhes ming grags che ba de ci yin zhe na/ de ni kho'i phyi'i pho sgo dang gzugs skyes lus kyi sku drin las ma 'das/ ngo ma gnam rgan mas kho la lta bas chog mi shes pa'i byad bzhin dang skyes gzugs shig gnang yod pas/ sus mthong na smon pa mi 'chor ba mi srid/ kho gang du song na der yod kyi so gzhon rnams dbang med du zil gyis gnon cing / mo gsar rnams kyi yid dbang bkug pas/ pho yag zer ba gan min na su yin zhes tshang masamig gis cer re bltaspote gom pa mdun du spro rgyu'ang brjed 'gro/ 'bring rim slob grwa nas mthar phyin te 'brog khul gyi rdzong mkhar 'dir yong ma thag pho yag lha rgyal gyis snying 'jags kyi sa cha chung chung 'dir grags 'gul po zhig bzos song / las sgrub kyi skabs 76

gsar bu lha rgyal gyi gtam rgyud/gsar bu lha rgyal zer na rdzong mkhar 'dir mi shes mkhan nyung nyung las med/ de ni ngan pa ming can zhes ngan byas te grags pa min la/ bzang byas te kun la grags pa de bas kyang min/ 'o na gsar bu lha rgyal zhes ming grags che ba de ci yin zhe na/ de ni kho'i phyi'i po sgo dang gzugs skyes lus kyi sku drin las ma 'das/ ngo ma gnam rgan mas kho la lta bas chog mi shes pa'i byad bzhin dang skyes gzugs shig gnang yod pas/ sus mthong na smon pa mi 'chor ba mi srid/ kho gang du song na der yod kyi po gzhon rnams dbang med du zil gyis gnon cing / mo gsar rnams kyi yid dbang bkug pas/ po yag zer ba gan min na su yin zhes tshang ma mig gis cer re blta te gom pa mdun du spo rgyu'ang brjed 'gro/ 'bring rim slob grwa nas mthar phyin te 'brog khul gyi rdzong mkhar 'dir yong ma thag pho yag lha rgyal gyis snying 'jags kyi sa cha chung chung 'dir grags 'gul chen po zhig bzos song / las sgrub kyi skabs 76

dngul sgru rna tsāng /su las khungs nang gi mo gsar tshos nam rgyun gleng bzhin pa ni pho yag lha rgyal red/ bu mo 'ga' res don dag gzhan la kha g.yar te kho la ched du blta ru 'ong ba dang / 'ga' res kho la kha par nas gtam sna tshogs 'dri ba red/go thos la gsar bu lha rgyal la rkyen byas te dga' rogs sgrig bzhin pa'i sgang gi na chung bu mo skor zhig gis rgyu mtshan ci yang med par rang gi mdza' bo la bde mo bzhag pa dang / yang bu mo skor zhig gis kho brtsad de don med 'khon 'dzing byung song skad/ gsar bu lha rgyal gyi rkyen gyis rdzong mkhar 'di'i pho gzhon skor zhig langa'ang zhe ldang khong nas 'bar du bcug la/ na chung ma mi nyung ba zhig la mtshan mor mi lam rdzogs med cig mis su bcug de bas kho la las sgrub skabs su nangs zas nyo mkhan dang gza' nyi mar gon pa 'khrud du pong mkhan gang mang mang yod pa de kun gyi mthong thos su gyur 'dug kho'i lag tu brtse dung mtshon pa'i yi ge ni kha ba bzhin lhab lhub tu 'bab pa'ang dzun ga la yin/ 'on kyang gsar bu lha rgyal gyis rang nyid da dung lo na gzhon zhing bya bar zhugs ma thag yin pa dang khyim sgrig na snga song bsabrel dgos don mi 'dug snyam ste rang nyid 'dod mkhan dang btsal yong mkhan gyi bu mo dag re re bzhin gnas skabs tsam gyi‘‘me tog gi mchod rdzas su brtsis pa las yun ring brten pa'i‘‘sku rten du ma blangs/ bu mo tsho ni ma bos sprang ma 'khor 'khor byed pas lha rgyal gyi snang ba yang bar snang du 'khyer zhing mgo bo je skrad du song ba dang bsnan nga rgyal dang khengs rlom zhig gis kho rang sprin 77

dbyal gyi rna yong /su las khungs nang gi mo gsar tshos nam rgyun gleng bzhin pa ni pho yag lha rgyal red/ bu mo 'ga' res don dag gzhan la kha g.yar te kho la ched du blta ru 'ong ba dang / 'ga' res kho la kha par nas gtam sna tshogs 'dri ba red/go thos la gsar bu lha rgyal la rkyen byas te dga' rogs sgrig bzhin pa'i sgang gi na chung bu mo skor zhig gis rgyu mtshan ci yang med par rang gi mdza' bo la bde mo bzhag pa dang / yang bu mo skor zhig gis kho brtsad de don med 'khon 'dzing byung song skad/ gsar bu lha rgyal gyi rkyen gyis rdzong mkhar 'di'i pho gzhon skor zhig langa'ang zhe sdang khong nas 'bar du bcug la/ na chung ma mi nyung ba zhig la mtshan mor rmi lam rdzogs med cig mis su bcug de bas kho la las sgrub skabs su nangs zas nyo mkhan dang gza' nyi mar gon pa 'khrud du yong mkhan gang mang mang yod pa de kun gyi mthong thos su gyur 'dug kho'i lag tu brtse dung mtshon pa'i yi ge ni kha ba bzhin lhab lhub tu 'bab pa'ang dzun ga la yin/ 'on kyang gsar bu lha rgyal gyis rang nyid da dung lo na gzhon zhing bya bar zhugs ma thag yin pa dang khyim sgrig na snga song bsabrel dgos don mi 'dug snyam ste rang nyid 'dod mkhan dang btsal yong mkhan gyi bu mo dag re re bzhin gnas skabs tsam gyi‘‘me tog gi mchod rdzas su brtsis pa las yun ring brten pa'i‘‘sku rten du ma blangs/ bu mo tsho ni ma bos sbrang ma 'khor 'khor byed pas lha rgyal gyi snang ba yang bar snang du 'khyer zhing mgo bo je skrang du song ba dang bsnan nga rgyal dang khengs rlom zhig gis kho rang sprin 77

gsar sge lha rgyal dzigatam rgyud/dkar gyi 'dab ma'i steng la bskyod pa'i snang ba zhig bcos min du skyes/ lha rgyal gyi sems la gal te gling 'brug mo 'jig rten 'dir bzhugs rgyu na kho'i lag nas 'chor sa ga la yod snyam/ kho'i snang ba mtho bas bza' tshang bdams pa'i cha rkyen de bzhin mtho/ khos rdzong mkhar 'di'i bu mo gang yag gang bzang bdams te 'grogs na yang 'dod thog la khel ba zhig ma byung / phal cher kho dang cha mthun pa'i bu mo zhig sa 'di na med pa 'dra bas/ kho'i phyi'i skyi pags kho nar chags pa'i bu mo rnams ni lha rgyal gyis lus thog gi gon pa brje brje ltar byed pa las ci la'ang baji gi med/lha rgyal ni bu mo gang mang zhig la 'grogs na yang kho'i sems kyi go gnas 'dzin thub mkhan nyung shas yin la/ kho la bag chags zab mo bzhag cing 'grogs yun ring bor brtsi chog pa ni khul thog na yod pa'i bu mo lha mtsho red/lha mtsho ni rdzong thog 'dir bya ba bsgrub tu yong skabs lha rgyal ngo shes/ lha mtsho yang dang thog kho'i yag pho sgos sems bkug pa yin mod/ bro tshogs kyi steng nas mnyam du bro 'cham bzhin kha brda byed pa brgyud kho gnyis bar la bun mong gi cha ha cang mang bo zhig gnas pa ma zad/ gnyis dzi'i dga' kha mos phyogs gcig tu mthun pa shes pas/ gzhon nu pho mo 'di gnyis kyi brtse sems kyi chu bo yur bu gcig tu 'bab par gyur/ lha mtshos rdzong 'di nas don dag bsgrub tshar te phyir khul thog tu 'gro khar phan tshun 'bral mi phod par gyur/ lha mtsho la khag med de mo'i mig nang na lha rgyal ni skyon kun zad dang yon tan kun 78

gsar bu lha rgyal yigatam rgyud/dkar gyi 'dab ma'i steng la bskyod pa'i snang ba zhig bcos min du skyes/ lha rgyal gyi sems la gal te gling 'brug mo 'jig rten 'dir bzhugs rgyu na kho'i lag nas 'chor sa ga la yod snyam/ kho'i snang ba mtho bas bza' tshang bdams pa'i cha rkyen de bzhin mtho/ khos rdzong mkhar 'di'i bu mo gang yag gang bzang bdams te 'grogs na yang 'dod thog la khel ba zhig ma byung / phal cher kho dang cha mthun pa'i bu mo zhig sa 'di na med pa 'dra bas/ kho'i phyi'i skyi pags kho nar chags pa'i bu mo rnams ni lha rgyal gyis lus thog gi gon pa brje brje ltar byed pa las ci la'ang brtsi gi med/lha rgyal ni bu mo gang mang zhig la 'grogs na yang kho'i sems kyi go gnas 'dzin thub mkhan nyung shas yin la/ kho la bag chags zab mo bzhag cing 'grogs yun ring bor brtsi chog pa ni khul thog na yod pa'i bu mo lha mtsho red/lha mtsho ni rdzong thog 'dir bya ba bsgrub tu yong skabs lha rgyal ngo shes/ lha mtsho yang dang thog kho'i yag pho sgos sems bkug pa yin mod/ bro tshogs kyi steng nas mnyam du bro 'cham bzhin kha brda byed pa brgyud kho gnyis bar la thun mong gi cha ha cang mang bo zhig gnas pa ma zad/ gnyis ku'i dga' kha mos phyogs gcig tu mthun pa shes pas/ gzhon nu pho mo 'di gnyis kyi brtse sems kyi chu bo yur bu gcig tu 'bab par gyur/ lha mtshos rdzong 'di nas don dag bsgrub tshar te phyir khul thog tu 'gro khar phan tshun 'bral mi phod par gyur/ lha mtsho la khag med de mo'i mig nang na lha rgyal ni skyon kun zad dang yon tan kun 78

dadul gyi rna mong /rdzogs kyi skyebo khyad par ba zhig yin la/ 'di ni rang gi ring mo zhig nas re zhing skug pa'i‘‘mi lam khrod kyi mdza' bo’ 'khrul med du mthong bas/ rang nyid song shul du kho'i sems pa bu mo gzhan gyis 'phrog 'gro snyam ste sems gtan nas ma bde/ gyes khar lha mtshos mgo bo rlangs 'khor gyi dra ma'i phyir bsrings te nga ma brjed ang / ngas khyed la kha par gtong / yi ge bskur/ nga khyod la blta ru yong’zhes yang yang smrag de'i rjes su lha mtsho ni mo rang gi bshad pa nang bzhin yi ge mang bo zhig ma bskur na yang / kha par btang ba ni grangs kyis mi zin/ rlangs 'khor gyi nyin lam gcig yod pa'i sa de ru lha rgyal la blta ru song ba'ang thengs gcig dang gnyis min/ yin na yang lha rgyal khul thog tu lha mtsho la skor gcig ma gtogs ma brgyab la de yang bya ba'i zhor du yin/ gang lhar lha mtshos yod tshad lha rgyal la 'bul rtsis yod pa 'dra ste/ mos lha rgyal la mo rang rdzong thog 'di ru kho la blta ru yong khar rang gi sngon gyi mdza' grogs des zhu ba ji ltar 'then yang 'dang rgyag med par de dang kha bral tshul dang da nas bzung lha rgyal ma gtogs mi 'grogs tshul sogs bshad de lha rgyal gyis phyin chad kho mo la khrel med bya mi nyan pa de shugs su bstan/ lha rgyal gyis kyang lha mtsho la‘‘da phyin chad ngas kyang khyod ma gtogs bu mo gzhan zhig mi btsal’zhes khas blangs/ de nas bzung kho gnyas brtse dung gi spang thang du mnyam du rtse la/ bde skyid kyi mkha' dbyings su yang mnyam du 'phur/ srang lam nas dpung ba mnyam gshib ngang ha ha dang ho ho zer bzhin song / de'i 79

dacal gyi rna tshang /rdzogs kyi skyebo khyad par ba zhig yin la/ 'di ni rang gi ring mo zhig nas re zhing skug pa'i‘‘mi lam khrod kyi mdza' bomi 'khrul med du mthong bas/ rang nyid song shul du kho'i sems pa bu mo gzhan gyis 'phrog 'gro snyam ste sems gtan nas ma bde/ gyes khar lha mtshos mgo bo rlangs 'khor gyi dra ma'i phyir bsrings te‘‘nga ma brjed ang / ngas khyed la kha par gtong / yi ge bskur/ nga khyod la blta ru yong zhes yang yang smrag de'i rjes su lha mtsho ni mo rang gi bshad pa nang bzhin yi ge mang bo zhig ma bskur na yang / kha par btang ba ni grangs kyis mi zin/ rlangs 'khor gyi nyin lam gcig yod pa'i sa de ru lha rgyal la blta ru song ba'ang thengs gcig dang gnyis min/ yin na yang lha rgyal khul thog tu lha mtsho la skor gcig ma gtogs ma brgyab la de yang bya ba'i zhor du yin/ gang lhar lha mtshos yod tshad lha rgyal la 'bul rtsis yod pa 'dra ste/ mos lha rgyal la mo rang rdzong thog 'di ru kho la blta ru yong khar rang gi sngon gyi mdza' grogs des zhu ba ji ltar 'then yang 'dang rgyag med par de dang kha bral tshul dang da nas bzung lha rgyal ma gtogs mi 'grogs tshul sogs bshad de lha rgyal gyis phyin chad kho mo la khrel med bya mi nyan pa de shugs su bstan/ lha rgyal gyis kyang lha mtsho la‘‘da phyin chad ngas kyang khyod ma gtogs bu mo gzhan zhig mi btsal’zhes khas blangs/ de nas bzung kho gtis brtse dung gi spang thang du mnyam du rtse la/ bde skyid kyi mkha' dbyings su yang mnyam du 'phur/ srang lam nas dpung ba mnyam gshib ngang ha ha dang ho ho zer bzhin song / de'i 79

gsar bu lha rgyal gyi gtam da/skabs su bu mo mig ser can 'gas phrag dog gi zur mig lha mtsho'i gdong la gtad mod/ gzhon nu mang po zhig gi sems de mur bde la babs/ cha 'grig cha mthun gyi pho mo 'di gnyis kyis brtse dung gi ro mngar myong bzhin dus 'da' bar byed la/ gnyen sgrig yi ge mi 'gyangs par len la nye/ 'on kyang lha rgyal ni sngon chad bu mo gang mang mang la 'grogs te rtse rgyur lobs song ba'i sems pa ri shor zhig yin pas bu mo gcig rkyang rkyang bsrung ste 'dug ga la thub/ de'i khar gzhan gyis rang gi rang dbang la tshod 'dzin dang the jus byed rgyu mang drags na mi dga' bas/ lha mtshos rtsib nas bsrung bsrung la bsdad de sgo ru'ang de 'dra 'gro ru mi 'jug pa 'dir sun snang skyes/ 'grogs kyin 'grogs kyin sngon chad mnyam ma bzhag pa ma gtogs lha mtsho'i lus steng na skyon cha dang zhan cha/ da dung mi 'dang sa mi nyung ba gnas pa de dag rim gyis lhang la bud song / mo'i gshis ka yang blon 'bab pa zhig mi 'dug pas sngon chad kyi thun mong gi cha zer ba de yang nyung nas nyung du 'gro bzhin 'dug da lta skad cha ci zhig bshad na phan tshun tho mi thug la skabs rer kha rtsod kyang byung yong / lha rgyal gyis bltas kyin bltas kyin lha mtsho mig nang du ma song / bu mo 'di 'dra zhig la 'grogs na don snying mi 'dug ste/ mo 'di rang gi gtan gyi 'dun mar blangs na nyan pa zhig ma red snyag de nas bzung lha rgyal gyis lha mtshor rna la gzan pa'i tshig jub sazhing / sems la gnod pa'i dma' 'bebs dang 'phya dmod byas/ mo'i steng la tsham tshom med par zhe sdang bkol/80

dacal gyi rna tsāng /skabs rer chang 'bung ste ra bzi khul gyis mo sgo ru bda' mod/ lha mtsho ni bathod bsran thub pa zhig yin pas lha rgyal gyi bca' srolu las sros mtha' dag btang snyoms su bskyur ba ma zad/ da dung lha rgyal la sngar bas kyang sha tsha tsha dang snying nye nye byas/ tsub reg che ba'i thabs lam de dag go ma chod par gyur ba na/ lha rgyal gyis blo dang bkod pa gzhan zhig 'then dgos snyam/ bsam blo mang du btang mthar lha rgyal gyi yid la blo bkod gzhan zhig shar byung / de ni 'jam po'i thabs bkod cig ste/ thabs 'di lag len du btab na mo dang 'brel ba gcod thub snyam/ lha mtsho khul thog tu song ste phyir kha par btang yong na khos khom pa med tshul lab ste mi nyan pa dang / yang na mos btang ba'i kha par yin pa shes na gtan nas mi nyan pa dang / las grogs gzhan la lha rgyal mi 'dug zer ba'am sa gzhan la bya ba bsgrub tu bud song zhes rdzun bshad du bcug kho mo rdzong thog tu blta ru yong na lha rgyal mo la g.yol ba dang bzha' ste mo la rig tu ma bcug lha mtshos dang thog sems ma shi bar bsdad mod/ re ba stong zad dang ngal ba 'bras med du gyur par brten kho gnyis kyi 'brel thag de mi gcod kamed byung / lha mtsho dang 'brel ba bcad rjes kho'i phrag steng nas khur bo ljid mo zhig dbogs pa bzhin sems lhod la babs/ slar yang tshod 'dzin dang the gtogs med pa'i rang dbang chen po zhig 'thob pas bu mo mang po gang 'dod du rtses/lha rgyal bya bar zhugs te lo drug lhag 'gor ba na sa cha ga sa gang du slob 81

dadul gyi rna bong /skabs rer chang 'thung ste ra bzi khul gyis mo sgo ru bda' mod/ lha mtsho ni bzod bsran thub pa zhig yin pas lha rgyal gyi bca' srolu las sros mtha' dag btang snyoms su bskyur ba ma zad/ da dung lha rgyal la sngar bas kyang sha tsha tsha dang snying nye nye byas/ tsub reg che ba'i thabs lam de dag go ma chod par gyur ba na/ lha rgyal gyis blo dang bkod pa gzhan zhig 'then dgos snyam/ bsam blo mang du btang mthar lha rgyal gyi yid la blo bkod gzhan zhig shar byung / de ni 'jam po'i thabs bkod cig ste/ thabs 'di lag len du btab na mo dang 'brel ba gcod thub snyam/ lha mtsho khul thog tu song ste phyir kha par btang yong na khos khom pa med tshul lab ste mi nyan pa dang / yang na mos btang ba'i kha par yin pa shes na gtan nas mi nyan pa dang / las grogs gzhan la lha rgyal mi 'dug zer ba'am sa gzhan la bya ba bsgrub tu bud song zhes rdzun bshad du bcug kho mo rdzong thog tu blta ru yong na lha rgyal mo la g.yol ba dang bzha' ste mo la rig tu ma bcug lha mtshos dang thog sems ma shi bar bsdad mod/ re ba stong zad dang ngal ba 'bras med du gyur par brten kho gnyis kyi 'brel thag de mi gcod named byung / lha mtsho dang 'brel ba bcad rjes kho'i phrag steng nas khur bo sdid mo zhig dbogs pa bzhin sems lhod la babs/ slar yang tshod 'dzin dang the gtogs med pa'i rang dbang chen po zhig 'thob pas bu mo mang po gang 'dod du rtses/lha rgyal bya bar zhugs te lo drug lhag 'gor ba na sa cha ga sa gang du slob 81

gsar bu lha rgyal kyi gtam rgyad/rtags len pa'i tsha rlabs shig 'phyur bzhin 'dug sa cha 'di'i las khungs dang sde khag dag na yang slob rtags mthon po zhig len pa'i ched du sbrag thog gi slob grwar 'grim pa'am las gnas dang bral te slob grwar 'grim pa sogs byas te thabs brgya jus stong gis slob rtags mthon po zhig len par brel bzhin 'dug lha rgyal yang phyi'i pho sgo bzang ba tsam las 'bring rim ched gnyer gyi yon tshad ma gtogs med pas kho rang dgar 'dug khom gang na yod/khos kyang gzhan ltar mi dar ma'i slob gso bskyed bsring byed sa'i slob grwa zhig la rgyugs sprad pa ma zad/ rgyugs kyang sla mo'i ngang 'phrod song /spyir slob grwar 'grims pa ni slob gso myangasate rig gnas chu tshad mtho ru 'degs rgyu de yin mod/ deng sang zla phogs len pa'i las byed pa tsho yang bskyar slob grwar 'gro ba ni slob rtags len pa tsam du zad/ grong khyeranas rtsed 'jor g.yeng rgyu ni kho tsho'i dmigs yul gtso bo red/ mi dar ma'i slob gso bskyed bsring byed sa'i slob grwa dag gis kyang yong sgo gtso bor 'jog pa las/slob sgrub spus tshad ces pa ni don stong ming gi lhag mar gyur yod/ lhag tu lha rgyal 'grims sa'i slob grwa 'di la kun gyis‘‘rgan gso ra ba btags par gzhigs na slob sgrub spus tshad ga 'dra zhig yin pa shes yong la 'grig lam ga 'dra zhig yin pa yang rtogs thub/ 'di ru yong ba'i slob grwa pa phal cher zhig zla phogs len mkhan yin pas gon rgyu dang bza' rgyu sogs bag med longs spyod bya tshul la bltas na kho tsho slob ma zhig la gtan nas mi mtshungs/ slob 82

dbyal gyi rna mong /grwa'i sgrig lam lhod pas rtsed 'jor blo bag chim pa zhig rol chog slob grwa 'di nas mig gdangs te btsal yang mgo skur te dpe cha klog mkhan ni gcig dang gnyis tsam las mthong dka' mod/ chang 'thung ste glu len gar rtsed dang mā cang dang sho rgyag mkhan ni ga sa gang nas mthong thub/ bu mo skor zhig ni las khungs su yod skabs spam brdzu byas te spyod pa tshul mthun yin mdog ston mod/slob grwa 'dir yong ma thag bsam blor bcings 'grol thob pa nang bzhin/rang sems rta rgod kyi thur mda' bshus yag byas rjes phyi phyogs sgo 'byed kyi dpa' mo'i mtshan snyan len bzhin 'dug kho mo tshos pho mo 'dra mnyam yin zhes slob grogs dang slob grogs ma yin pa'i pho rnams dang lhan du chang bag med du 'thung la/ chang gis bzi rjes pho gzhon gnyis kyis g.yas g.yon nas skyor te 'gro ba dang kha nas gtam sna tshogs re bshad de rtags dang ltad mo sna tshogs shin ston/ lha rgyal ni ma gzhi nas rig gnas sbyong rgyur dga' bo med pas slob grwa 'di kho la mtshon na ha cang 'tsham 'dug drang mor bshad na khra khra rig rig gi grong khyer 'di nas slob sbyong la sems 'khor rgyur dka' mo red/khos nam rgyun slob khrid la nyan khul dang las bya 'bri thabs kyis nyi ma 'phud/sems shugs gtso bo de chang ji ltar 'bung rgyu dang bu mo dag la ji ltar 'grogs rgyu'i thog la bkol/ bu mo rnams kyang lha rgyal gyi mdun du spam rdzu byed thabs bral zhing kho'i kha len tshig brtsi byed nges te/ lha rgyal gyis chang 'thung zer na kho mo tshos sgog ser 'thung nges yin la/ glu longs shig zer na de ma 83

gsar bu lha rgyal migatam rgyad/thag yar langs te skad ngag ci dgar ngoms/ lha rgyal ni kho mo cho'i sems khong gi gling ge sar lta bu'i pho yag yin pas kho dang 'grogs thub pa ni rang gi rgyan zhig tu rloms/ chang 'thung ste tshad nges can zhig la thon skabs chang bzi ma tshos chags pa'i sgeg nyams ston pa'i kho nas ma tshim par snying stobs che ru bskyed de lha rgyal la gtam sna tshogs spa kho mo tshos skabs rer mig chu sham sham dang sdug chen po yod khul gyis ngu shum byed la/ skabs rer glo bur du hab cha brgyab ste rang gshis rtswa skya bzhin yang ba rjen par ngoms/ kha nang du bzhag na sna nang nas shor du mi 'jug pa ni lha rgyal nyid yin pas/ khos kyang bu mo dag gi khams dang bstun te sems gso re byed de rang gi lag nas 'chor du ma bcug 'on kyang gzhon nu ma 'ga' res zhag gcig gi nyal rogs tsam gyis ma chog par da dung lha rgyal la re ba lhag ma yang 'don srid/bza' tshang yod pa zhig gis kho la‘‘gal te khyod 'thad na ngas da lta myur du gnyen 'thor byed de khyod dang lhan du 'dug ces khas blangs/ bu mo 'ga' res lha rgyal la‘‘'u gnyis mnyam 'dug byed thub na nga ni gang du khrid kyang khyod kyi phyir bzhin 'brang zhes re ba bton/ rma lho nas 'ong ba'i bu mo yid du 'ong ba des lha rgyal la‘‘khyod sa cha de 'dra zhig tu bsdad de ci bya/ lang tsho chud zos su gtong ba kho na nyid yin pas ngas spopha bu mo 'di'i spopha ni dbang dang go gnas yod pa'i dpon po blo bkod can zhig yin par grags〉la bshad de khyod nga tsho'i khul thog tu las spor bya zhes nan tan ngang bshad mod/ lha rgyal 84

dadul gyi rna long /ni snang ba mtho bas mo'i ci bshad thams cad rna rgyab kyi lhags pa bzhin gyur/de yang dge chos kyis‘‘skabs rer lha mor 'grogs kyang zhen pa log zer ba cis ma bden/ pho gzhon tsho 'gram chu ldang sa'i rma lho'i yid 'ong ma 'di la nyin 'ga' la 'grogs rjes lha rgyal ni bu mo 'di la 'grogs 'dod kyi sems de med par gyur/ kha yang spyod yang gi bu mo tshos lha rgyal gyi sems 'gug ga thub/blo gtod sa zhig dang sems shor sa zhig ni gcig kyang med pas/ rtsed spyad bzhin sun reg bar du rtse rjes mtha' mar rgyab tu bskur ba las 'os ma mchis/lha rgyal ni 'di lta'i chang dang bud med la dga' mkhan gyi rkyal stong don dang mthun pa zhig yin mod/ bzi dwangs te dran pa sad thengs rer chang gis gnod de lus dang mgo na ba ma zad/ sems khong hril bor stong shur du gyur pa dang / zhe smreng rgyu zhig kyang byung / skabs 'di dag tu khos lha mtshos rang la chang 'thung du mi 'jug pa ni sha tsha ba'i rtags yin pa shes/ 'dir chang ma 'thung zer mkhan su zhig yod/ lha rgyal gyis sngon chad lha mtshos chang 'thung na lus phung la gnod tshul sogs bshad pa de dran pas sems skyo rgyu byung / kho mos da lta ci zhig byed kyin yod dam/ 'brel thag bcad pa nas mo'i phyogs kyi skad cha ci yang ma go 'on kyang lha rgyal gyis lha mtsho dran pa'i skabs yod pa bden na yang / cang ma 'gor bar brjed 'gro ste/ dmar la zhen pa ni spopho spyad ki dang / mo la dga' ba ni lha rgyal gyi rang gshis yin pas/ bu mo gzhan dang 'grogs te chang 'thung na lha mtsho'i gzugs brnyan de kho'i dran ngos nas 85

lha rgyal gyis grong khyer gyi slob grwa 'di nas mgo g.yog thabs kyis nyi ma bskyal te lo gnyis ji ltar 'gor ba'ang ma shes/ lo gnyis kyi ring la ci zhig sbyangs song zhes dris na/ slob mthar phyin pa phal mo che zhig la bshad rgyu med/lha rgyal la yang de bzhin du ston rgyu dang bshad rgyu ci yang med de/ klad med mgo stong du lus pa kho rang yin la/ gal te kho la ngoms rgyu zhig yod zer na de ni chang 'thung ba'i chu tshad ha las pa zhig la thon pa dang / bu mor 'grogs pa'i rtsal ni kun gyi rtse la son pa de yin/ de ring ni mthar phyin te slob grwa nas phyir 'bud pa'i nyi ma red/ lha rgyal gyi mthar phyin dpang yig blangs pa dang khug ma khur te slob grwa'i sgo ru bud pa na sgo chen gyi phyi nang na slob grogs tsho po mo re cha byed de lhan du 'gro bzhin 'dug du mo zhig gi 'grogs ya med pa ni lha rgyal gcig pu red/ stos dang de ring sgo ru 'bud skabs kyang kho rang bskyal mkhan gcig kyang mi 'dug rang nyid rtse spyad bzhin du dor ba'i bu mo tshos da lta lha rgyal rig na snying rlung stod la 'tshang 'ong bas kho rang bskul mkhan gang na yod/ lha rgyal gyis bu mo tshos rang gi dga' rogs rnams las don khang ngam rlangs 'khor sa tshigs su skyel ma byed tshul de mthong ba dang / khor rkyang du 'gro ba'i rang gis rang la snying rje ba zhig byung / de mur sngon chad lha mtshos khul thog nas rang la zhe 'khring ba'i skyes ma byed tshul de mig lam du shar/ kho mo da lta 'gyur ldog byung med dam/ gar 'ong mi shes pa'i 'gyod gdung zhig 86

dadul gyi rna mong /dge rgan nas gzhung sgrub dge rgan du log reg bar du a khu 'jigs med slob dpon du bsten myong zhing phan tshun la rgyus mnga' che/ phu bos bshad na khos da lta gzhung la go ba cung tsam zhig rnyed pa dang / bod yig gi rmang gzhi brtan po zhig chags pa ni dge bshes khong gi bka' drin yin zer/phyi nyin/ nga gzhis khyim gcig nas logs su bud pa'i phu bo tshang la 'tshams 'drir phyin/ nged phu nu gnyis kyis kyang phan tshun la khams bde re dris rjes/ a khu 'jigs med gleng gzhir byas pa yin/ phu bos yid pham pa'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas dge bshes tshang gi khyim gyi 'byor ba zhan la/ nye du rtsa lag gcig kyang med pas kho la 'das chos legs po zhig sgrub ma thub/ yul 'di'i grwa pa la la zhig chos bsgrub tu gdan drangs na yang shi bo tshang ha cang dbul pa yin pag 'bul ba chung snyam nas yong mkhan nyung / deng sang gi dkor gzan de zhes zhe sdang chen po langs bzhin 'dugango ma a khu 'jigs med tshang ni dud khyim lnga bcu lhag 'dus pa'i nga tsho'i sde ba'i nang 'byor ba ches zhan pa'i khyim tshang du bgrang chog chog yin/ nga bya bar zhugs te lo ngo dgu lhag 'das na yang / kho tshang gi cha rkyen la sngar bzhin 'gyur ba cher byung mi 'dug sgor mo'i yong khungs med pas dkar po 'o ma 'jo ba'i bzhon ma zhig yod pa lta ci/ rong ba'i dud khyim gzhan ltar phag cig kyang gso mi thub/ mtha' na skabs rer ja tshwa khu nyo spyad kyang med par khyim mtshes g.yas g.yon la g.yor bskyi byed dgos par thug yod/ kho tshang gi 'tsho 95

'dam mas sgros ba' bad ma/der brten nas mi bzod pa'i snying je zhig spokhu 'jigs thed kyi rgyud la 'khrungs shing / yid sems mi bde ba'i skyo snang chen pos kun nas dpis 'ong bas kho mu mthud du gzhung la 'jug thabs med par gyur/ 'di ltar ma rig ma shes pa'i zol du bsdad na ga la 'grig ci nas kyang dud khyim 'di'irang la sgor rdog 'ga'i kha snon byed dgos snyam/ khos de ltar bsam pa'i mod la dgon pa'i a khu tsho dang 'dra bar 'don chos spyod la brten te sgor mo btsal 'dod skyes/ yin na yang / spokhu 'jigs med kyis sems kyi dran pa 'di dag lag len la bstar mi phod de/ gal srid dpe cha ba zhig gis yon gyi don du chos btonan nyes pa tshabs chen bsags pa yin la/ ston pa'i gsungan chos 'di zang zing la brje na nyes rtsang gi rgyu ru 'gro ba yin zhes bstan yod pas/dge bshes kyi ming blangaspopa zhig gis 'jigarten mi rtag pa'i rgyu nor gyi dbang du song ste nyi tshe ba'i bde ba lhur blangs na tsan dan sol bar bsgyur ba'i blun po'i rtags su zad la/ tshe gang bor chos sgor zhugs pa yang thal bar btang zin/ spokhu 'jigs med kyis sems su de ltar dran pa'i mod la/ ston pa'i gsung dang mdzad pa dag gzugs can bzhin yid ngor shar/ khorsā skemi.oṃgicung min na dam tshig nyams te mi zad nyes snang gi g.yang du lhang sosazhes 'jigs snang skyeg 'jig rten pa'i ṣazas tsam gyi don du semasaram par g.yeng ba ni 'grig ma song zhes nongs 'gyod mi zad pa zhig spyang skyes te/ rang nyid dug gsum gyis bslad song zheglemakha' 'gro chosposkyod snying la sgom bzhin 100

dacal gyi rna long /lhang bshags byas shing / slar yang sems gnad du phab nas dpe klog gi khrod du zhugs/ dngos gnas ngo mtshar ba zhig ni oṃkhu 'jigs med kyis dpe cha'i kha phyes pa tsam gyis zang zing bya bzhag kun dang ring du gyes te 'od kyis brgyangs pa'i snang ba'i khams chen po zhig tu 'gro ba'i tshor ba bde mos lus sems sim la/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub la reg pa'i bde dga' zad med cig dpe cha'i khrod nas rnyed/ mtho nas mtho ru 'phags pa'i bde ba chen po'i go 'phang bsnyegs pa'i rtogs sad cig gis skabs rer rang ni 'jig rten pa gzhan rnams dang mi 'dra bar khyad du 'phags pa'i rlom sems dang nga rgyal zhig kyang ngang gis skyes pa dang zang zing gi rgyu nor mtha' dag ci yang mi brin par don gyis stongs shing / rgyu nom pa'i don la shi 'tham ro 'tham byed pa'i grwa pa tshos ci yang shes kyin mi 'dug ces snying rje zhig rgyud la skyes/gong gi skad cha 'di dag ni bdag gis rang bzo dang rtog bzo byas pa zhig ga la yin/ 'di ni ngas phu bos bshad pa ji ma ji bzhin du yi ger phab pa de yin/ phu bos bshad rgyur/ dge bshes tshang gis dpe cha khrid mtshams bzhag ste rnam g.yeng gi go skabs su kho'i sems nang gi dran 'char dang kun rtog sna tshogag blo'i rtogs sad sogs gling snyong zer/phu bos nga la dge bshes tshang gis tshe gang bor dpe cha kho nar gzigs te sto gos gyong la sbyar zhing / shul du dpe cha sna tshogs las khyim der mkho ba'i 101

brel ba che ba'i mi/rdzong dpon 'brug byams kyis mdang nam phyed yol rag bar du chang 'thung ba'i rkyen gyis da nangs gnyid las sad dus mgo nas gzer langs kyin 'dug de'i khar kho la gnyid kyis 'dang med pas mal las langs 'dod ye nas med mod/ snga dror gzhung sgrub khang du song ste don dag mang bo kho sku dngos kyis ma bskusas na mi nyan pas/ khos sbal ba'i mig 'bras bzhin skradas pa'i mig lcibs 'phur 'phur byed bzhin mal las btsan gyis langs dgos byung /rdzong dpon du bskos pa nas bzung / 'brug byams la sems lhod la 'bab pa'i khom skabs de 'dra mi 'dug dus rgyun tshar rgyu med pa'i gros tshogs sna tshogs dang / slob sbyong sna tshogs/ 'grul bsu sna tshogs kyis kho la sgug skug tu bsdad yod la/ kho'i lus po de ga sa gang du thon dgos/ bas mtha'i rdzong mkhar 'di na nam rgyun ci zhig gi ched du yar rgyug mar rgyug byed 103

zel ba che ba'i mi/de brel 'tshub che mdog gi mi mang bo zhig mchis mod/ rdzong dpon 'brug byams lta bu'i brel ba che ba su zhig yod/ mi rnams kyi mig gis rig rig tu 'dug pa ni kho tsho'i rdzong dpon de nam yang brel brel 'tshub 'tshub kyis bskyod pa'i lus gzugs de red/ sa 'di ni mi grangs khri bzhi mi lon pa'i rdzong chung chung zhig yin yang / rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung gi rdzong gtso yin pag kho ni mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi skyid sdug phrag tu 'khur ba'i dpon po dbang can zhig yin pa smos ma dgos/ khos dbang cha yod do cog spar ba 'acing 'ching byed chog la/ khos kha grags tshe mnga' 'og gi mi su zhig yin rung ya ya yin yin zer ba las mi dgos zhes bzlog thub mkhan gcig tsam med la/ don dag gal chen ci zhig yod na khos thag gis gcod pa dang / gnad don chen po ci zhig byung na khos dngos su bkod 'doms byed dgos par ma zad/ tha na don dag cha nge chung nge la yang kho'i kha dang lag pa spebs dgos/ 'on kyang 'brug byams kho rang nyid ma gtogs rang gi khog gi sdug bsngal sus shes thub/mi tshang mas kho yar la bzhag ste gnya' skur sgur dang skyidapa zha zha yis bkur ba las 'di ltar brel ba che na sku tshegs myangs bzhin pa tshor gyin mi 'dugabrel zing gi bya ba'i khrod bag lhod de dbugs 'byin jub byed khom yang med pas skabs la lar kho rdzong dpon gyi bya ba 'di la sun snang skyes 'ongaka lus 'di rang dbang med par ngal dub kyis nya be nyob ber btang tshe sos dal ler nyi ma bskyal ba'i spyir btang gi lasabyed tsho la yid smon zhig kyang skye mod/104

dajul gyi rna 'ong /sdug bsngal 'di ni dal cig gi yun tsam yin te/ brel zing gi bya ba'i 'go brtsams pa dang / rdzong dpon gyi go gnas dang dbang shugs kyis kho la nga rgyal dang gzi bajid cig 'khyer yong / ngo ma spyir btang gi las byed cig la ci zhig mchig zla phogs gcig pur brten zhing de kho na srung srung la 'dug pa las ci zhig mchis/ da dung 'go khrid kyi gdong gi rnam 'gyur la blta dgos shing de'i khams dang bstun ci thub byed dgos/ dbang dang go sa med pa'i las byed tsho dngos gnas snying rje ba zhig red/ rdzong dpon 'brug byams kho yang bran g.yog nas dmag dpon du gyur ba zhig ste go sa'i skas rkang steng re rer 'gos te brgyud yong ba zhig yin pa sa/ la sa gyed spyir btang ba'i sdug bsngal de kho la shin tu gsal/ kho zhang thog gi las byed cig yin dus dus rgyun hru'u ci dang zhang krang gnyis kyi kha la nyan nyan du 'dug dgos/ nam yang yar rgyug mar rgyug byed mkhan kho rang red/ zhang gi 'go ba gnyis kyis kho rang bong bu bzhin du g.yog tu bkol ba ma zad/ bka' bkyon dang btsan gtam btang 'ong na dngos gnas mi bzod mod/ sdug tshang ma khog tu mid pa las thabs gzhan ci/ der brten/ kho'i sems la las byed spyir btang ba zhig byas na snying bo med tshul rtogs la/ go sa yar 'phags shig ma byas na thar lam zhig med pa shes/ da lta'i gnas bab la yid tshim ste bsdad na re ba dang mdun lam gang na yod/ 'brug byams kyis go sa zhig cis kyang 'thob dgos snyam ste/ dpon po la 'dug rgyu'i chod sems brtan bo bcangs/ 'on spyang 105

dajul gyi rna long /sdug bsngal 'di ni dal cig gi yun tsam yin te/ brel zing gi bya ba'i 'go brtsams pa dang / rdzong dpon gyi go gnas dang dbang shugs kyis kho la nga rgyal dang gzi bajid cig 'khyer yong / ngo ma spyir btang gi las byed cig la ci zhig mchig zla pogs gcig pur brten zhing de kho na srung srung la 'dug pa las ci zhig mchis/ da dung 'go khrid kyi gdong gi rnar 'gyur la blta dgos shing de'i khams dang bstun ci thub byed dgos/ dbang dang go sa med pa'i las byed tsho dngos gnas snying rje ba zhig red/ rdzong dpon 'brug byams kho yang bran g.yog nas dmag dpon du gyur ba zhig ste go sa'i skas rkang steng re rer 'gos te brgyud yong ba zhig yin pa sa/ la sa byed spyir btang ba'i sdug bsngal de kho la shin tu gsal/ kho zhang thog gi las byed cig yin dus dus rgyun hru'u ci dang zhang krang gnyis kyi kha la nyan nyan du 'dug dgos/ nam yang yar rgyug mar rgyug byed mkhan kho rang red/ zhang gi 'go ba gnyis kyis kho rang bong bu bzhin du g.yog tu bkol ba ma zad/ bka' bkyon dang btsan gtam btang 'ong na dngos gnas mi bzod mod/ sdug tshang ma khog tu mid pa las thabs gzhan ci/ der brten/ kho'i sems la las byed spyir btang ba zhig byas na snying bo med tshul rtogs la/ go sa yar 'phags shig ma byas na thar lam zhig med pa shes/ da lta'i gnas bab la yid zim ste bsdad na re ba dang mdun lam gang na yod/ 'brug byams kyis go sa zhig cis kyang 'thob dgos snyam ste/ dpon po la 'dug rgyu'i chod sems brtan bo bcangs/ 'on kyang 105

brel ba che ba'i mi/dpon por 'gyur rgyu ni sla mo zhig ga la yin/ gtam dpe la thob go sa don du gnyer ba de/ /'bu bse spur gyang la 'go ba 'dra/ / zer bas de 'dra'i skyid bo gson po zhig ga la yin/ khos gzhan gyi sa nas nyams myong blangs/ rang gi sa nas bkod pa 'then/ de nas khos gzhan gyi mgo g.yug sar rang gi rnga ma g.yug bya ba'i dgos mkho dbang gis/ ma 'ongs pa'i mdun lam gyi ched du kho ḍaru ngo gnyis byas/ khyi yi mjug ma g.yug g.yug byas/ spre'u zlos gar 'khrab 'khrib byag 'brug byams kyis rgyu shugs gtong dgos sar rgyu shugs btang /mi shugs mkho sar mi shugs bkol/ khos sdug mi nyung ba zhig myangag thabs sna tshogs shig 'then pag gnam rgan mas thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/gong dpon po'i thugs la babs/dang po zhang krang gzhon par bzhag de nas zhang krang ngo mar bskog zhang krang gi go gnasakyis yid ma tshim pas khos mu mthud du 'bad pa byas/ de'i rjes su kho rang rdzong dpon gzhon pa la bskos/rdzong dpon gzhon pa'i go gnas su 'phar ba des kho'i re ba che ru rgyas shing /snying stobs che ru bskyed/ ham sems je cher gyur/ de nas khokhul thog la rgyugs/ zhing chen la rgyugag rgyu shugs dang mi shugasaphangs med du bkol/rgyab rten rnams kyi rgyab skyor dang kho rang yar rgyugs mar rgyugs byasapa'i mtha' ma ga kho'i mi tshe 'di'i dmigs 'ben chen po ste rdzong dpon gyi bzhugs khri mthon po 'di kho la dbang song / rdzong gtso'i go sa lag la 'thob dus 'brug byams lags dgung lo lnga bcur nye bas las 'khyur la nye/ mi tshe 106

zel ba tshe ba' mi/dpon por 'gyur rgyu ni sla mo zhig ga la yin/ gtam dpe la thob go sa don du gnyer ba de/ /'bu bse spur gyang la 'go ba 'dra/ / zer bas de 'dra'i skyid po gson po zhig ga la yin/ khos gzhan gyi sa nas nyams myong blangs/ rang gi sa nas bkod pa 'then/ de nas khos gzhan gyi mgo g.yug sar rang gi rnga ma g.yug bya ba'i dgos mkho dbang gis/ ma 'ongs pa'i mdun lam gyi ched du kho ḍaru ngo gnyis byas/ khyi yi mjug ma g.yug g.yug byas/ spre'u zlos gar 'khrab 'khrib byag 'brug byams kyis rgyu shugs gtong dgos sar rgyu shugs btang /mi shugs mkho sar mi shugs bkol/ khos sdug mi nyung ba zhig zungag thabs sna tshogs shig 'then pag gnam rgan mas thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/gong dpon po'i bugs la babs/dang po zhang krang gzhon par bzhag de nas zhang krang ngo mar bskog zhang krang gi go gnasakyis yid ma tshim pas khos mu mthud du 'bad pa byas/ de'i rjes su kho rang rdzong dpon gzhon pa la bskos/rdzong dpon gzhon pa'i go gnas su 'phar ba des kho'i re ba che ru rgyas shing /snying stobs che ru bskyed/ ham sems je cher gyur/ de nas khokhul thog la rgyugs/ zhing chen la rgyugag rgyu shugs dang mi shugasaphangs med du bkol/rgyab rten rnams kyi rgyab skyor dang kho rang yar rgyugs mar rgyugs byasapa'i mtha' ma ga kho'i mi tshe 'di'i dmigs 'ben chen po ste rdzong dpon gyi bzhugs khri mthon po 'di kho la dbang song / rdzong gtso'i go sa lag la 'thob dus 'brug byams lags dgung lo lnga bcur nye bas las 'khyur la nye/ mi tshe 106

dngul gyi rna yong /thung thung gi rin thang la gzhal na don snying de 'dra med mod/ 'brug byams kho phangs med 'gyod med yin/ rdzong dpon 'brug byams gzhung sgrub khang du thon pa na zhabs phyi ba 'phrin gtong mkhan myur du kho'i mdun drung du bcar te kho la ja blugs/ khos ja hub 'ga' 'thung rjes cog tse ngos la cer ba na/ rdzong dpon 'brug lags kyis gzigs rogs zhu zhes pa'i yig cha skor zhig brtsegs 'dug pa mthong / kho gong nas btang ba'i 'di dag la blta rgyur mgo na zhing sun snang skyes/ ngo ma deng gi yig cha 'di dag gi nang don phal cher gcig mtshungs yin te khyad cung zad tsam ma gtogs med pa ste 'go brjod kyang ci zhig gi 'brel yod dang 'brel yod kyi skor ram yang na brda sbyor gyi brda sbyor zhes pa las ma 'das/ khos thod par gnyer mdud rgyag bzhin mig nyul tsam byas rjes re re'i steng la bltas zin zhes pa'i yig 'bru gnyis dang rang ming dang / zla tshes sogs shar ser bris/ khos mchan rtags brgyab pa'i yig cha de dag cog tse'i gi zur sde zhig tu ded rjes bzhugs khri rgyab bsnyes ma'i steng nas ltag gar dgye dgye zhig byas pa na/ drung yig nang du yong nas rdzong dpon lagag tshogs 'du'i khang nang tshang mas khyod la skug 'dugaces bshad pa na a gi ngas brjed 'dugaces glo bur du dran pa sos pa ltar myur du 'dug stegs nas yar la langag chang 'thung rgyu mang na 'di yin/ khos rang gis rang la le bda' byas/ de ring snga dror srid gtsang 'dzugs sgrun dang dag spel skor gyi skul slong tshogs 'du zhig 'tshogs dgos te/ kha'o rim pa 107

dacal gyi rna spong /thung thung gi rin thang la gzhal na don snying de 'dra med mod/ 'brug byams kho phangs med 'gyod med yin/ rdzong dpon 'brug byams gzhung sgrub khang du thon pa na zhabs phyi ba 'phrin gtong mkhan myur du kho'i mdun drung du bcar te kho la ja blugs/ khos ja hub 'ga' 'thung rjes cog tse ngos la cer ba na/ rdzong dpon 'brug lags kyis gzigs rogs zhu zhes pa'i yig cha skor zhig brtsegs 'dug pa mthong / kho gong nas btang ba'i 'di dag la blta rgyur mgo na zhing sun snang skyes/ ngo ma deng gi yig cha 'di dag gi nang don phal cher gcig mtshungs yin te khyad cung zad tsam ma gtogs med pa ste 'go brjod kyang ci zhig gi 'brel yod dang 'brel yod kyi skor ram yang na brda sbyor gyi brda sbyor7zhes pa las ma 'das/ khos thod par gnyer mdud rgyag bzhin mig nyul tsam byas rjes re re'i steng la bltas zin7zhes pa'i yig 'bru gnyis dang rang ming dang / zla tshes sogs shar ser bris/ khos mchan rtags brgyab pa'i yig cha de dag cog tse'i gi zur sne zhig tu ded rjes bzhugs khri rgyab bsnyes ma'i steng nas ltag gar dgye dgye zhig byas pa na/ drung yig nang du yong nas rdzong dpon lagag tshogs 'du'i khang nang tshang mas khyod la sgug 'dutshices bshad pa na a gi ngas brjed 'dugaces glo bur du dran pa sos pa ltar myur du 'dug stegs nas yar la langag chang 'thung rgyu mang na 'di yin/ khos rang gis rang la le bda' byas/ de ring snga dror srid gtsang 'dzugs sgrun dang dag spel skor gyi skul slong tshogs 'du zhig 'tshogs dgos te/ kha'o rim pa 107

thel ba tshe ba'i mi/yan gyi la byed ma lus par tshogs 'dur zhugasadagos/ khos gom pa myur spos byas te srid gzhung tshogs 'du'i khang gi phyogs su song /rdzong dpon 'brug byams tshogs 'du'i khang nang du thon pa na chogs zhugs mi sna tshang ma dal cag ger gyur/ khos gdong nas gzabanan gyi mdangs shig mngon zhing / khog stod ltag gar dgye ba dang gom pa dal gyis len bzhin kru'u zhi stegs bu'i steng la bud/ gros chogs 'go 'dzin pas tshogs 'du'i nang don mar bsgrags la/ thog mar rdzong dpon 'brug lags kyis gsung bshad gal chen gnang rgyu red ces bshad pa na/ tshang mas cab cab ces thal mo deb ste dga' bsu byas/ rdzong dpon 'brug byams kyis de mur drung yig gis snga mo nas gra sgrig gang legs byas yod pa'i gsung bshad kyi rtsom yig de khug ma nas bton te lag la blangag glo lu tsam byas rjegagasung bshad gnang 'go brtsamag khos bshad rgyur tang krung dbyang gis rul sungs la ngo rgol byas te srid gtsang 'dzugs bsgrun dar spel gtong dgos pa'i skor gyi yig cha rab dang rim pa 'grem spel byed kyin yod pag nga tsho yig cha'i dgongs don de kha bshad tsam gyis mi chog par nan tan ngang lag len du bstar dgog rang steng nas 'go brtsams te rul sungs la 'thab rtsod byed dgos/ gzhung dngul bed spyad de bag med longs spyod la rol bar gtan 'gog byed dgos la/ lhag tu nga tsho 'go khrid dag gis mig dpe gzhan ston gyi nus pa thon pa dang / bsam blo'i go rtogs dzemathor btang ste mi dmangs mang 108

them ba tshe ba'i mi/yan gyi lagabyed ma lus par tshogs 'dur nugasadagos/ khos gom pa myur spos byas te srid gzhung tshogs 'du'i khang gi phyogs su song /rdzong dpon 'brug byams tshogs 'du'i khang nang du thon pa na tshogs zhugs mi sna tshang ma dal cag ger gyur/ khos gdong nas gzabanan gyi mdangs shig mngon zhing / khog stod ltag gar dgye ba dang gom pa dal gyis len bzhin spu'u zhi stegs bu'i steng la bud/ gros tshogs 'go 'dzin pas tshogs 'du'i nang don mar bsgrags la/ thog mar rdzong dpon 'brug lags kyis gsung bshad gal chen gnang rgyu red ces bshad pa na/ tshang mas cab cab ces thal mo deb ste dga' bsu byas/ rdzong dpon 'brug byams kyis de mur drung yig gis snga mo nas gra sgrig gang legs byas yod pa'i gsung bshad kyi rtsom yig de khug ma nas bton te lag la blangag glo lu tsam byas rjespogasung bshad gnang 'go brtsamag khos bshad rgyuradzitang krung dbyang gis rul sungs la ngo rgol byas te srid gtsang 'dzugs bsgrun dar spel gtong dgos pa'i skor gyi yig cha rab dang rim pa 'grem spel gyed kyin yod pag nga tsho.āoṃyig cha'i dgongs don de kha bshad tsam gyis mi chog par nan tan ngang lag len du bstar dgog rang steng nas 'go brtsams te rul sungs la 'thab rtsod byed dgos/ gzhung dngul sged spyad de bag med longs spyod la rol bar gtan 'gog byed dgos la/ lhag tu nga tsho 'go khrid dag gis mig dpe gzhan ston gyi nus pa thon pa dang / bsam blo'i go rtogs ṣpemathor btang ste mi dmangs mang 108

daṅgal gyi rna long /tshogs sems nas mi 'dor bar tang dang mi dmangs la blo dkar dgos pa ma zad/ ga dus yin rung dngul lo dang mdzes ma'i bslu brid las thar dgo.āoṃzhes gsungs pa na/ thal mo deb sgra de 'ur 'ur chil chil ngang tshogs ra yongs su khyab / thal mo deb sgra des rdzong dpon gyi kha lce la ngar byin pas khos mu mthud du tshang mar tang gi rtsa don brtsi srung byas te tang dang mi dmangs kyi blang bya ltar bya ba'i spyod stangs legs bsgyur bya dgos tshul bstan/ rdzong dpon kho bris lag nas mi 'khyongs ba zhig yin na yang gtam bshad kha ru mi thogs pa zhig yin/ khos dus tshod gcig gi ring la gsung bshad gnang rjes gzhi nas mtshams bzhag kho'i rjes na da dung rdzong gi 'go ba gzhan dag gtam bshad byed rgyur gra sgrig byas 'dug ro/ sa mkhrig ma'i dus tshod la bltas pa na/ kho tshogs ra 'di nas 'gro ran pa mthong / da stegs bu'i lteng bsdad de gzhan gyi gsung bshad la nyan khom gang na yod/ don dag gal chen ma bsgrub par bsgyur yod pas/ khos 'go 'dzin pa'i rna rtsar gtad de shab shub 'ga' byas rjes tshogs ra'i phyi la bud de/ brel brel 'tshub 'tshub ngang don dag gzhan zhig sgrub tu phyin/ de ring phyi dror khul thog gi 'go ba skor zhig rdzong 'di ru bya bar gzigs skor du phebs rgyu red/rdzong dpon 'brug byams kyis kha sang phyi dro nas rdzong srid gzhung gzhung las khang gi spu'u rin la snga mo nas gra sgrig bzang bo byed dgos tshul nan bshad byas yod mod/ gra sgrig byas pa ci 'dra yin nam/ kho rang gi gzhung las 109

dadul gyi rna mong /tshogs sems nas mi 'dor bar tang dang mi dmangs la blo dkar dgos pa ma zad/ ga dus yin rung dngul lo dang mdzes ma'i bslu brid las thar dgo zhes gsungs pa na/ thal mo deb sgra de 'ur 'ur chil chil ngang tshogs ra yongs su khyab / thal mo deb sgra des rdzong dpon gyi kha lce la ngar byin pas khos mu mthud du tshang mar tang gi rtsa don brtsi srung byas te tang dang mi dmangs kyi blang bya ltar bya ba'i spyod stangs legs bsgyur bya dgos tshul bstan/ rdzong dpon kho bris lag nas mi 'khyongs ba zhig yin na yang gtam bshad kha ru mi thogs pa zhig yin/ khos dus tshod gcig gi ring la gsung bshad gnang rjes gzhi nas mtshams bzhag kho'i rjes na da dung rdzong gi 'go ba gzhan dag gtam bshad byed rgyur gra sgrig byas 'dug tho/ sa mkhrig ma'i dus tshod la bltas pa na/ kho tshogs ra 'di nas 'gro ran pa mthong / da stegs bu'i steng bsdad de gzhan gyi gsung bshad la nyan khom gang na yod/ don dag gal chen ma bsgrub par bsgyur yod pas/ khos 'go 'dzin pa'i rna rtsar gtad de shab shub 'ga' byas rjes tshogs ra'i phyi la bud de/ brel brel 'tshub 'tshub ngang don dag gzhan zhig sgrub tu phyin/ de ring phyi dror khul thog gi 'go ba skor zhig rdzong 'di ru bya bar gzigs skor du phebs rgyu red/rdzong dpon 'brug byams kyis kha sang phyi dro nas rdzong srid gzhung gzhung las khang gi kru'u rin la snga mo nas gra sgrig bzang bo byed dgos tshul nan bshad byas yod mod/ gra sgrig byas pa ci 'dra yin nam/ kho rang gi gzhung las 109

zel ba tshe ba'i /khang du'ang ma song bar thad kur kru'u rin sar song / khos kru'u rin la gra sgrig byas tshul ji 'dra yin zhes dris pa na/ kru'u rin gyis lan btab pa de kho'i thugs la ma babs pa ma zad/ khong khro langs su bcug kru'u rin gyis rdzong dpon gyi zhal ngo nag rog ger gyur ba mthong ba dang da ma bzang snyam ste 'phral mar 'u cag gi rtsis tho'i steng na sgor mo de 'dra mang bo mi 'dugaces gsal bshad byas pa na/ rdzong dpon ni me thog tu snum blugs pa bzhin mig 'bras tshur 'bur bzhin ci zer/ sgor mo med ki des na nga'i khug ma'i nang nas 'don dgos pa yin nam zhes skad shugs chen pos bshadapa na/ kru'u rin mgo smad de skad dma' mos de zer ba ga la yisazer/ rdzong dpon gyis sgor mo med na glad pa 'gul mi shes sam/ khyod kru'u rin ji ltar byas pa yin/ chang de 'dra khul gyi 'go brnams kyi mdun la 'jog srol zhig yod dam/khyod rang gis stog rdzong dpon gyis gyin sgra zhig rgyung rjes kha phyir 'khor te bud song / shul na ci byed gang byed med par 'u thug pa'i na gzhonasnrung yig des lag pa gur gur byed bzhin gzhung drang gi gdong la the tsham dang yid gnyis kyis khengag khos rang gis gra sgrig byas pa'i chang de dag ches gong can du sems yod mod/ ma bsam sa nas rdzong dpon gyisabaku' baspyon gnang song / rjes lus sa char mtshon na chang de 'dra gong rim 'go khrid la drangs na mi 'os pa zhig khos gtan nas ma 'dod/ da 'di'i yan gyi chang zhig nyo dgos tshe tshad las 'da' ba min nam/ bya ba'i nyams myong dkon pa'i drung yig gis 110

dacal gyi rnalong /'dang brgyab kyang 'dang ma phog 'on kyang rdzong dpon gyi sems la kru'u rin gyi gra sgrig de 'dra zhig gis khul dpon rnams la sde len bzang bo bya thabs med la/ gong rim 'go khrid kyi ngo so ji ltar len snyam/ mun un/ cung min na rdzong dpon ngas kho tsho'i mdun nas mig la bstan song / stag gi yan na sgang zer bas/ rdzong dpon yin rung khul dpon gyi mdun na rang nyid ci yang min pas/ sde len dga' zhig ma byas na ga la 'grig yang cig bshad na kru'u rin 'di yang gsar du bzhag ma thag yin pas/ nyams myong de 'dra med pa khag mi 'dug rdzong dpon gyis da cir kha nang nas shor ba'i tshig cung btsan 'dug snyam mod/ 'di ltar bka' bkyon re btang na phyis su phan thogs che snyam/rdzong dpon 'brug byams rang gi gzhung las khang du thon pa na/ 'brog pa gnyis gsum gyis sgo 'gram gyi 'bol khri'i steng la tsog ste kho yong bar sgug 'duga'abrog pa tshos kho mthong ba dang 'phral mar yar la langs te rdzong dpon btsal du yong don gleng ba na/ rdzong dpon kho da ci'i kru'u rin gyis bslangs ba'i khong khro de da dung zhi mi 'dug pas khos sun snang dang bca4don dag yod na/ kha gsal mdor bsdus shig shod/ nga brel ba che ba khyod tshos mi mthong nga zhes bshad bzhin thod par gnyer mdud khu tshur lta bu zhig brgyab/ phar bltas tshod kyis nyan 'dod med pa 'dra/ 'on kyang 'brog pa tshos rdzong dpon btsal 'ong ba ni rtswa sa'i skor gyi don dag gal chen zhig gi don du yin la/ de 111

dacal gyi rnatshang /'dang brgyab kyang 'dang ma phog 'on kyang rdzong dpon gyi sems la kru'u rin gyi gra sgrig de 'dra zhig gis khul dpon rnams la sne len bzang bo bya thabs med la/ gong rim 'go khrid kyi ngo so ji ltar len snyam/ un un/ cung min na rdzong dpon ngas kho tsho'i mdun nas mig la bstan song / stag gi yan na sgang zer bas/ rdzong dpon yin rung khul dpon gyi mdun na rang nyid ci yang min pas/ sde len dga' zhig ma byas na ga la 'grig yang cig bshad na kru'u rin 'di yang gsar du bzhag ma thag yin pas/ nyams myong de 'dra med pa khag mi 'dug rdzong dpon gyis da cir kha nang nas shor ba'i tshig cung btsan trī/ga/ snyam mod/ 'di ltar bka' bkyon re btang na phyis su phan thogs che rdzong dpon 'brug byams rang gi gzhung las khang du thon pa na/ 'brog pa gnyis gsum gyis sgo 'gram gyi 'bol khri'i steng la tsog ste kho yong bar sgug 'duga'abrog pa tshos kho mthong ba dang 'phral mar yar la langs te rdzong dpon btsal du yong don gleng ba na/ rdzong dpon kho da ci'i kru'u rin gyis bsladas ba'i khong khro de da dung zhi mi 'dug pas khos sun snang dang bca4don dag yod na/ kha gsal mdor bsdus shig shod/ nga brel ba che ba khyod tshos mi mthong nga4zhes bshad bzhin thod par gnyer mdud khu tshur lta bu zhig brgyab/ phar bltas tshod kyis nyan 'dod med pa 'dra/ 'on kyang 'brog pa tshos rdzong dpon btsal 'ong ba ni rtswa sa'i skor gyi don dag gal zhig gi don du yin la/ de 111

zel ba tshe ba' mi/ring mi bshad na nam zhig la bshad snyam/ de'i nang gi 'brog pa cung rgan pa des kha gdangs te bshad grabs byas pa na/ kha par si lu lu zhesagrags byung /rdzong dpon gyis de mur lag brda zhig byas te 'brog pa de'i bshad mtshams bcad/ khos kha par blangs te we zhes rna la gtad pa na/ pha rol po su yin pa shes pas de ma thag gdong gi gnyer mdud lhug lhug grol byung / rgyun u lha lags yin nam/ bde mo yin nam/ bya bar brel ba che'am nga zer ram nga brel rgyu ci zhig mchis/ don dag nya nyog bsgrub rgyu las mi 'dug skemide khyed kyi tsha mo yin nam/ nga la sngon zhig nas mi bshad pa ci yin/ tshede 'dra zer ga la dgos/ khyed kyi don dag yin na nga'i don dag red/ khyod sems bde mo byas chog ngas kho mo las khungs dga' zhig tu bkod sgrig bya/ phardzong dpon gyis 'dzum lhug lhug dang skad 'jam pos de skad bshad/ rdzong dpon lags kyis bod skad mi brjod par rgya skad rkyang bas kha brda byed kyin 'dug pas/ de na yod pa'i 'brog pa tshos phan tshun ngo la rig rig blta ba las ci yang go med/deng sang bod kyi las byed tshor rgya skad lobs yod pas/ phan tshun bar du rgya skad ma gtogs mi bshad/ 'brog pa gsum po rdzong dpon gyis kha par thang la 'jog par re ba che zhing sems nas brel ba zhig ngang gis langs mod/ bsran tshugs te mi skug ka med byung / yun ring tsam 'gor rjes rdzong dpon gyis dgod sgra lhang lhang dang bcas dzide byos/ bde mo/ bde rshazhes bshad de kha par gyi kha brgyab/ 'brog pa gsum pos rdzong dpon gyis bshad mtshams bzhag 112

zel ba che ba'i mi/ring mi bshad na nam zhig la bshad snyam/ de'i nang gi 'brog pa cung rgan pa des kha gdangs te bshad grabs byas pa na/ kha par si lu lu zhesagrags byung /rdzong dpon gyis de mur lag brda zhig byas te 'brog pa de'i bshad mtshams bcad/ khos kha par blangs te we zhes rna la gtad pa na/ pha rol po su yin pa shes pas de ma thag gdong gi gnyer mdud lhug lhug grol byung / rgyun mu lha lags yin nam/ bde mo yin nam/ bya bar brel ba che'am nga zer ram nga brel rgyu ci zhig mchis/ don dag nya nyog bsgrub rgyu las mi 'dug yocide khyed kyi tsha mo yin nam/ nga la sngon zhig nas mi bshad pa ci yin/ yode 'dra zer ga la dgos/ khyed kyi don dag yin na nga'i don dag red/ khyod sems bde mo byas chog ngas kho mo las khungs dga' zhig tu bkod sgrig bya/ mardzong dpon gyis 'dzum lhug lhug dang skad 'jam pos de skad bshad/ rdzong dpon lags kyis bod skad mi brjod par rgya skad rkyang bas kha brda byed kyin 'dug pas/ de na yod pa'i 'brog pa tshos phan tshun ngo la rig rig blta ba las ci yang go med/deng sang bod kyi las byed tshor rgya skad lobs yod pas/ phan tshun bar du rgya skad ma gtogs mi bshad/ 'brog pa gsum bo rdzong dpon gyis kha par thang la 'jog par re ba che zhing sems nas brel ba zhig ngang gis langs mod/ bsran tshugs te mi skug ka med byung / yun ring tsam 'gor rjes rdzong dpon gyis dgod sgra lhang lhang dang bca 4de byos/ bde mo/ bde mordzozhes bshad de kha par gyi kha brgyab/ 'brog pa gsum pos rdzong dpon gyis bshad mtshams bzhag 112

dacal gyi rna tshang /pa mthong ba dang yar la langs te rdzong dpon gyi mkhris su bcar te kho btsal dgos don bshad/ rdzong dpon 'brug byams kyis kyang ha cang blo gtad de nyan khul gyis rna ba blags te nyan tsam byas/ khos dar tsam la nyan pa dang bzhin nas ci mi snyam pa'i rnam 'gyur zhig mngon te ma gzhi 'di 'dra zhig yin nam/ don dag cha nge chung nge 'di mo 'di nga btsal te ci bya/ gtso gnyer rdzong dpon 'tshol du sotha zhes phyi ru mngags rtsis byas/ 'brog pa tshos 'go ba gzhan pa gcig kyang gzhung sgrub khang du mi 'dug pas khyod mi btsal ka med byub zhes re ba'i mig gis tsu la cer ba na/ rdzong dpon gyis red/ red/don dag chung chung 'di'i rigs bsgrub rgyu sla mo red/ khyod tsho phyir song dang /nga tshos mi 'gyang bar thag gcod bya/ nga la da dung don dag gzhan pa bsgrub rgyu yogaces bshad de 'brog pa de tsho phyir 'gro ru bcug 'brog pa 'di tsho 'brog dmangs u yon lhan khang gi 'go ba dag yin zhing / kho tsho rtswa sa'i don du thengs mang bor rdzong thog tu yar zhu byed du song mod/ 'go ba tshos bya bar brel ba che zhes thag gcod ma byag de ring yang re ba bcangs te yong mod/'bras bu sngar bzhin gcig 'dra red/ kho tsho rdzong dpon gyi rnam 'gyur dang /skad cha bshad stangs la sems gting nas pham/ rdzong dpon la mtshon na de ring yar zhu byas pa'i don dag 'di chung chung las ma 'das na yang mi rabs nas mi rabs bar rtswa sar brten te 'tsho ba rol ba'i 'brog pa rnams la don dag chung chung zhig ga la yin/ mang tshogs kyi skyid sdug zhu sa dpon po yin 113

dadul gyi rna bong /pa mthong ba dang yar la langs te rdzong dpon gyi mkhris su bcar te kho btsal dgos don bshad/ rdzong dpon 'brug byams kyis kyang ha cang blo gtad de nyan khul gyis rna ba blags te nyan tsam byas/ khos dar tsam la nyan pa dang bzhin nas ci mi snyam pa'i rnam 'gyur zhig mngon te ma gzhi 'di 'dra zhig yin nam/ don dag cha nge chung nge 'di mo 'di nga btsal te ci bya/ gtso gnyer rdzong dpon 'tshol du sob zhes phyi ru mngags rtsis byas/ 'brog pa tshos 'go ba gzhan pa gcig kyang gzhung sgrub khang du mi 'dug pas khyod mi btsal ka med byub zhes re ba'i mig gis ngo la cer ba na/ rdzong dpon gyis red/ red/don dag chung chung 'di'i rigs bsgrub rgyu sla mo red/ khyod tsho phyir song dang /nga tshos mi 'gyang bar thag gcod bya/ nga la da dung don dag gzhan pa bsgrub rgyu yobaces bshad de 'brog pa de tsho phyir 'gro ru bcug 'brog pa 'di tsho 'brog dmangs u yon lhan khang gi 'go ba dag yin zhing / kho tsho rtswa sa'i don du thengs mang bor rdzong thog tu yar zhu byed du song mod/ 'go ba tshos bya bar brel ba che zhes thag gcod ma byag de ring yang re ba bcangs te yong mod/'bras bu sngar bzhin gcig 'dra red/ kho tsho rdzong dpon gyi rnam 'gyur dang /skad cha bshad stangs la sems gting nas pham/ rdzong dpon la mtshon na de ring yar zhu byas pa'i don dag 'di chung chung las ma 'das na yang mi rabs nas mi rabs bar rtswa sar brten te 'tsho ba rol ba'i 'brog pa rnams la don dag chung chung zhig ga la yin/ mang tshogs kyi skyid sdug zhu sa dpon po yin 113
