thel ba che ba'i mi/zer yang / dpon po 'di rigs kyis mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi skyid sdug sgems su len nam/ 'brog pa gsum po re thag chad pas dngan pa ring du 'then bzhin gom pa ljid tig ger srid gzhung gi sgo du bud/'byog pa tsho bskyal rjes rdzong dpon 'brug byams ci zhig las thar ba ltar sems khams je skyid la song / khos ja phor kha ru gtad de hub gang 'thung la khad la sgo thag thag ces rdung byung / yang don dag cig yod dam/khos 'thad la mi 'thad ngang nang la shogazer ba na/ nang du 'ong mkhan ni rdzong mkhar 'di na ming grags che ba'i smad rgya nag gi sbyin bdag gzugs thung de red/ go thos la sbyin bdaka 'dis rdzong 'di'i dpon po mang bo zhigawo shes la 'brel ba shin tu bzang bas/ 'dzugs bsgrun gyi rnamagrangs chen po zhig yod na kho'i lag tu 'thob pa las gzhan pa'i sbyin bdag rnamaglel re ba spu tsam med ces zer/ rdzong dpon dang kho gnyis lag 'jusadam po byas tephayun ring la ma mjal/ yun ring la ma mjal zhes phan tshun mtshams 'dri gnang /sbyin bdag gis gus lugs dang bcas rdzong dpon la tha mag rkang gcig bzhes su gsol ba da0 nye char rdzong dpon lagasabrel ba che'am/ mdang nga khyod btsal du yong mod/ khyod la thug ma thub/ ngo ma khyed cag 'go khrid tsho brel ba che ba la zhes bshad pa na/ rdzong dpon gyi4nged cag dpon po tshobrel ba ji 'dra che yang yong rgyu ci zhig yod/ der bltas na khyed cag sbyin bdag tsho mi bzang ngam/ nga tsho'i lo du ma'i zla phogs bsnan na khyod tsho'i bzo baspun rnam 114

thel ba che ba'i mi/zer yang / dpon po 'di rigs kyis mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi skyid sdug sems su len nam/ 'brog pa gsum po re thag chad pas dngan pa ring du 'then bzhin gom pa lngid tig ger srid gzhung gi sgo chen du bud/'brog pa tsho bskyal rjes rdzong dpon 'brug byams ci zhig las thar ba ltar sems khams je skyid la song / khos ja phor kha ru gtad de hub gang 'thung la khad la sgo thag thag ces rdung byung / yang don dag cig yod dam/khos 'thad la mi 'thad ngang nang la shogazer ba na/ nang du 'ong mkhan ni rdzong mkhar 'di na ming grags che ba'i smad rgya nag gi sbyin bdag gzugs thung de red/ go thos la sbyin bdaka 'dis rdzong 'di'i dpon po mang bo zhigayo shes la 'brel ba shin tu bzang bas/ 'dzugs bsgrun gyi rnamagrangs chen po zhig yod na kho'i lag tu 'thob pa las gzhan pa'i sbyin bdag rnam la re ba spu tsam med ces zer/ rdzong dpon dang kho gnyis lag 'jusadam po byas te yun ring la ma mjal/ yun ring la ma mja zhes phan tshun mtshams 'dri gnang /sbyin bdag gis gus lugs dang bcas rdzong dpon la tha mag rkang gcig bzhes su gsol ba dab nye char rdzong dpon lagasabrel ba che'am/ mdang nga khyod btsal du yong mod/ khyod la thug ma thub/ ngo ma khyed cag 'go khrid tsho brel ba che ba 0 zhes bshad pa na/ rdzong dpon gyi4nged cag dpon po tshobrel ba ji 'dra che yang yong rgyu ci zhig yod/ der bltas na khyed cag sbyin bdag tsho mi bzang ngam/ nga tsho'i lo du ma'i zla phogs bsnan na khyod tsho'i bzo bskrun rnam 114

dajul gyi rna mong /grangs gcig gi yong sgo la mi do'izhes ku re dang bden gtam 'dres ma'i tshul du smras pa na/ gnyis ka ha ha zhes bgad byung / kho gnyis gzhung las khang nas kha brda yun tsam byas pa na/ las grol gyi mtshams la thon 'dug rdzong dpon yar la langs te 'gro nga tsho'i srid gzhung gi za khang nang la 'gro za ma bzang rgyu med kyang bza' khul zhig bya zhes bshad pa na/ sbyin bdag gis min/ min/ngas snga mo zhig nas za khang gzhan zhig la bshad yag byas yod/ de ring khyod kyang srid gzhung gi za khang nang la mi 'gro bar bya/ nga dang lhan du 'gro zhes gdan 'dren zhus pa na/ rdzong dpon gyis brdzu bag ston tsam byas mod/ za sa 'thung sa zhig la 'gro ba ni ches rgyun ldan las ma 'das pas/ sbyin bdag gi nangs 'khor du bsdad de bud song /za khang de'i nang na zhabs phyi ma tshos zas sna 'khyag bsil gyi rigs dang tsha drod kyi rigs rnams drangs dang 'dren bzhin 'dug cog tse'i thog na chang gong can zhig phyi thum gyi shog sgam blangs te bzhag 'dug rdzong dpon lags la gsal ba ni sbyin bdag 'dis mgron du 'bod thengs rer sgor mo mi nyung ba zhig gis 'gro song gtong nges/ ltos dang / de ring yang nyung mthar sgor mo stong gcig la nye ba'i zas thun zhig kho'i longs spyod du phul 'dug yang gcig bshad na sbyin bdag dang rdzong dpon gnyis go phar chod tshur chod yin pas badzu byed dgos don ci yod/ de nas sbyin bdag dang / sbyin bdag gi kha lo ba kho tshos kha brda byed zhor du bza' btung gi dpal la rol 'go brtsams/115

dacal gyi rna mong /grangs gcig gi yong sgo la mi do'izhes ku re dang bden gtam 'dres ma'i tshul du smras pa na/ gnyis ka ha ha zhes bgad byung / kho gnyis gzhung las khang nas kha brda yun tsam byas pa na/ las grol gyi mtshams la thon 'dug rdzong dpon yar la langs te 'gro nga tsho'i srid gzhung gi za khang nang la 'gro za ma bzang rgyu med kyang bza' khul zhig bya zhes bshad pa na/ sbyin bdag gis min/ min/ngas snga mo zhig nas za khang gzhan zhig la bshad yag byas yod/ de ring khyod kyang srid gzhung gi za khang nang la mi 'gro bar bya/ nga dang lhan du 'gro zhes gdan 'dren zhus pa na/ rdzong dpon gyis brdzu bag ston tsam byas mod/ za sa 'thung sa zhig la 'gro ba ni ches rgyun ldan las ma 'das pas/ sbyin bdag gi rlangs 'khor du bsdad de bud song /za khang de'i nang na zhabs byi ma tshos zas sna 'khyag bsil gyi rigs dang tsha drod kyi rigs rnams drangs dang 'dren bzhin 'dug cog tse'i thog na chang gong can zhig phyi bum gyi shog sgam blangs te bzhag 'dug rdzong dpon lags la gsal ba ni sbyin bdag 'dis mgron du 'bod thengs rer sgor mo mi nyung ba zhig gis 'gro song gtong nges/ ltos dang / de ring yang nyung mthar sgor mo stong gcig la nye ba'i zas thun zhig kho'i longs spyod du phul 'dug yang gcig bshad na sbyin bdag dang rdzong dpon gnyis go phar chod tshur chod yin pas badzu byed dgos don ci yod/ de nas sbyin bdag dang / sbyin bdag gi kha lo ba kho tshos kha brda byed zhor du bza' btung gi dpal la rol 'go brtsams/115

zel ba ba'i mi/za ma nyung tsam zos pa na sbyin bdag yar bzhengs te rdzong dpon la chang bkyags mod/ rdzong dpon gyi phyi dror khul thog gi 'go ba skor zhig bsleb rgyu yin pas/ 'thung rgyu mang na mi bzang zhes dkon mchog gsum gyi skal ma gtogs ma 'thung / dus tshod gcig lhag la za ma zos rjes rdzong dpon gyis mkhrig ma'i dus tshod la cig bltas te thugs rgyal ma bzhengs/ nga la da dung gra sgrig byed rgyu yod pas khyed tshos dal mor bzhes/ nga sngon na 'gro rgyu bya zhes gyes phyag zhus rjesabrel brel 'tshub 'tshub ngang za khanganas bud/ rdzong dpon gyis gra sgrig byed rgyu yod zer ba ni dzun yin te/ gra sgrig sngon nas tshags tshagayobyas yod pas/ khos gung gnyid rgyag rgyur kha g.yar ba red/(sku ngal chab los yin/ rdzong 'di'i dpon po tsho nyin gung gnyid lcog byed rgyur goms yod)kho mal khang nang 'ong ste gon pa bud de mal khri'i thog la 'bud grabs byed skabag mi zhig gis kho'i mal khang gi sgo brdung byung / khos mi 'dod sun snang dang bcas su yin/ nang la shogaces skad 'drag gis bshad pa na sgo phyes te nang du 'dzul 'ong mkhan ni sun rgyu med pa'i las sa ra rgan po mu tshugasacan de red/ rgad po de mthong ba dang rdzong dpon 'brug byams mgo na byung / rgad po'i kha ma grags kyang kho btsal 'ong don ci yin mi shes pa ci/ kho'i slob mthar phyin pa'i bu der bya ba bgo ba'i don de min nam/ las 'khyur rgad po des nam yang kho deng ma gsar brje'i bya bar zhugs te bya ba ci zhig las tshul sogs ma ṇi bgrang bgrang byas te gshis gyong dang bu tshugs 116

zel gletshe ba'i mi/za ma nyung tsam zos pa na sbyin bdag yar bzhengs te rdzong dpon la chang bkyags mod/ rdzong dpon gyis phyi dror khul thog gi 'go ba skor zhig bsleb rgyu yin pas/ 'thung rgyu mang na mi bzangami zhes dkon mchog gsum gyi skal ma gtogs ma 'thung / dus tshod gcig lhag la za ma zos rjes rdzong dpon gyis mkhrig ma'i dus tshod la cig bltas te thugs rgyal ma bzhengs/ nga la da dung gra sgrig byed rgyu yod pas khyed tshos dal mor bzhes/ nga sngon na 'gro rgyu bya7zhes gyes phyag zhus rjesasbel brel 'tshub 'tshub ngang za khanganas bud/ rdzong dpon gyis gra sgrig byed rgyu yod zer ba ni dzun yin te/ gra sgrig sngon nas tshags tshagasabyas yod pas/ khos gung gnyid rgyag rgyur kha g.yar ba red/(sku ngal tsheb los yin/ rdzong 'di'i dpon po tsho nyin gung gnyid rtsog byed rgyur goms yod)kho mal khang nang 'ong ste gon pa sud de mal khri'i thog la 'bud grabs byed skabs/ mi zhig gis kho'i mal khang gi sgo brdung byung / khos mi 'dod sun snang dang bcas su yin/ nang la shogaces skad 'drag gis bshad pa na sgo phyes te nang du 'dzul 'ong mkhan ni sun rgyu med pa'i las 'khyur rgan po sku tshugasacan de red/ rgad po de mthong ba dang rdzong dpon 'grug byams mgo na byung / rgad po'i kha ma grags kyang kho btsal 'ong don ci yin mi shes pa ci/ kho'i slob mthar phyin pa'i bu der bya ba bgo ba'i don de min nam/ las 'khyur rgad po des nam yang kho deng ma gsar brje'i bya bar zhugs te bya ba ci zhig las tshul sogs ma ṇi bgrang bgrang byas te gshis gyong dang sku tshugs 116

dacal gyi rna mang /btsangs nas gnas lugs bshad 'ong / rgad pos 'dang rgyag med par nga'i bu la nam zhig la bya ba bgo rtsis yin zhes btsan 'dri lta bu zhig byas/ rdzong dpon gyis rgad po'i rnam 'gyur mthong ba dang sems gting nas mi dga' na yang mi 'gyangs par thag gcod byagluzhes lan btab pa na/ rgad pos phyir khyod tshos dus rgyun du mi 'gyangs bar thag gcod bya zer te lo gnyis 'gor song zer/ rdzong dpon gyis da lta las khungs tshang ma'i mi sna'i sgrig gzhi(rkint+ra 61)tshad bkag las 'das pas nga tshos gang du bkod sgrig bya'amakhazhes ldog 'dri zhig bton pa na/ rgad pos ma mchu 'dar bzhin nga'i bu dang lo gcig la mnyam du mthar phyin pa rnams la bya ba bgo thub na/ nga'i bu la ci la bgo rgyu ma byung / khyod tshos kha ngo yo da no tshang mar bgo bub na/ nga rgad po ltag sgo 'jul sa med pa zhig la bgo ma dgos pa zungared ces sdog lan btab byung /god pos bshad kyin bshad kyin zhe sdang po zhig gis khog stod dbang med du 'dar/ skabs 'dir rdzong dpon ni rgad po gshis phyong 'di'i mdun du ldab 'gyur gyis je gnyom du gyur/ de'i mur de ga la yin/ nga tsho brel ba che bas zhes tshig mjug ma rdzogs gong / rgad po des phe/ brel ba na khyod tsho brel ba tshe na ston rgyu ci zhig yod/ khyod tsho brel ba che ba'i grub 'bras gang na yogacesazur za'i tshig mda' 'phangs pas/ rdzong dpon gyi gnad la phog cing / kha grags rgyu ma byung / las 'khyur rgan pas rdzong dpon kha rog ger 'dug pa mthong ba dngadzinga'i bu la bya ba bgo min khyod tshos stos shigaces 117

dajul gyi rna mong /btsangs nas gnas lugs bshad 'ong / rgad pos 'dang rgyag med par nga'i bu la nam zhig la bya ba bgo rtsis yin zhes btsan 'dri lta bu zhig byas/ rdzong dpon gyis rgad po'i rnam 'gyur mthong ba dang sems gting nas mi dga' na yang mi 'gyangs par thag gcod bya zhes lan btab pa na/ rgad pos phyir khyod tshos dus rgyun du mi 'gyangs bar thag gcod bya zer te lo gnyis 'gor song zer/ rdzong dpon gyis da lta las khungs tshang ma'i mi sna'i sgrig gzhi(mthazam)tshad bkag las 'das pas nga tshos gang du bkod sgrig bya'amakhazhes ldog 'dri zhig bton pa na/ rgad pos ma mchu 'dar bzhin nga'i bu dang lo gcig la mnyam du mthar phyin pa rnams la bya ba bgo thub na/ nga'i bu la ci la bgo rgyu ma byung / khyod tshos kha ngo yo da no tshang mar bgo thub na/ nga rgad po ltag sgo 'jul sa med pa zhig la bgo ma dgos pa yored ces sdog lan btab byung /god pos bshad kyin bshad kyin zhe sdang chen po zhig gis khog stod dbang med du 'dar/ skabs 'dir rdzong dpon ni rgad po gshis gyong 'di'i mdun du ldab 'gyur gyis je gnyom du gyur/ de'i mur de ga la yin/ nga tsho brel ba che bsazhes tshig mjug ma rdzogs gong / rgad po des phe/ brel ba na khyod tsho brel ba che na ston rgyu ci zhig yod/ khyod tsho brel ba che ba'i grub 'bras gang na yogacesazur za'i tshig mda' 'phangs pas/ rdzong dpon gyi gnad la phog cing / kha grags rgyu ma byung / las 'khyur rgan pas rdzong dpon kha rog ger 'dug pa mthong ba dang nga'i bu la bya ba bgo min khyod tshos stos shigataces 117

zel ba tshe ba'i mi/bshe bshe gtang ba dang lag pa rgyab lag byas te bud song / rdzong dpon 'brug byams da ni gnyid rtsog rgyag rgyu gang na yod/ zhe sdang dang ngo tsha bcas gyis kho 'dug mi bzod par gyur/ kho da rag bar du 'di 'dra'i skad cha btsan po bshad thub mkhan zhig la 'phrad ma myong / gal te las 'khyur rgad po zhig min rgyu na dpon po zhig gi mdun nas 'di ltar bshad phod dam/ rdzong dpon kho rgad po de song shul du dbugs kyi rkyal ba zhig tu gyur te kha nas pha ro ma ro zhes gang byung du sdig dmod byas/brel ba che ba'i rdzong dpon 'brug byams kyis phyi dror khul gyi 'go khrid tsho bslebs pa dang gros tshogs bkus te bya ba yar zhu byas/ de nas khul dpon tsho la 'grogs te gzigs skor du phebag brel ba che ba'i bya ba de bsgrub tshar ba dang khul dpon tsho rdzong srid gnung gi za khang du bsus te kho tsho'i za rogs 'thung rogs byas/ bza' btung la rol rjes da ni mtshan mo'i ngal gso ba'i dus la ran 'dug 'on kyang rjong dpon 'brug byams la ngal gso khom gang na yod/ da dung khul dpon tsho la mā carpārtsed rogs byed dgos/ khul gyi 'go ba rnams 'dug sa'i mgron khang nas tsā cang rtsed de mjug bku skabs/nam phyed yol 'dug nyin gcig gi bya ba debrel zing gi khrod nas 'gyub song /kho mal du log 'ur 'ur zing zing gi phyi rol nas rang gi mal khang du thon pa na/ khang ba'i nang stong shur shur red/ chung ma jib na med pa'i kho'i sems pa yang de bzhin du stong ba stong rkyang yin pag gnyid ji ltar khugag nyal 118

zel ba tshe ba'i mi/bshe bshe gtang ba dang lag pa rgyab lag byas te bud song / rdzong dpon 'brug byams da ni gnyid rtsog rgyag rgyu gang na yod/ zhe sdang dang ngo tsha bcas gyis kho 'dug mi bzod par gyur/ kho da rag bar du 'di 'dra'i skad cha btsan po bshad thub mkhan zhig la 'phrad ma myong / gal te las 'khyur rgad po zhig min rgyu na dpon po zhig gi mdun nas 'di ltar bshad phod dam/ rdzong dpon kho rgad po de song shul du dbugs kyi rkyal ba zhig tu gyur te kha nas‘pha ro ma ro zhes gang byung du sdig dmod byas/brel ba che ba'i rdzong dpon 'brug byams kyis phyi dror khul gyi 'go khrid tsho bslebs pa dang gros tshogs bsdus te bya ba yar zhu byas/ de nas khul dpon tsho la 'grogs te gzigs skor du phebag brel ba che ba'i bya ba de bsgrub tshar ba dang khul dpon tsho rdzong srid gzhung gi za khang du bsus te kho tsho'i za rogs 'thung rogs byas/ bza' btung la rol rjes da ni mtshan mo'i ngal gso ba'i dus la ran 'dug 'on kyang rjong dpon 'brug byams la ngal gso khom gang na yod/ da dung khul dpon tsho 4mā cabartsed rogs byed dgos/ khul gyi 'go ba rnams 'dug sa'i mgron khang nas mā cang rtsed de mjug bku skabs/nam phyed yol 'dug nyin gcig gi bya ba nabrel zing gi khrod nas 'grub song /kho mal du log 'ur 'ur zing zing gi phyi rol nas rang gi mal khang du thon pa na/ khang ba'i nang stong shur shur red/ chung ma rtsib na med pa'i kho'i sems pa yang de bzhin du stong ba stong rkyang yin pag gnyid ji ltar khugag nyal 118

dngul gyi rna long /rogs shig cis kyang mkho/ de nas kho sku dngos kyis go sa yar 'then byas pa'i cus ga ge mo'i cus krang mo de la kha par btang ba na/ kha par skud sne'i pha rol gyi 'grogs bzang gis kyang kho la sgrug 'dug rdzong dpon 'brug byams kyi gdong nas nyin mor mthong dka' ba'i 'dzum mdangs dpog dka' ba zhig mngon/ ngo ma brel ba che ba la/ rdzong dpon 'brug byams slar yang brelazeng che ba'i don dag gzhan zhig sgrub par chas so/ /2006lo87mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉deb dang po'i steng bkod/

dacal gyi rna long /rogs shig cis kyang mkho/ de nas kho sku dngos kyis go sa yar 'then byas pa'i cus ga ge mo'i cus krang mo de la kha par btang ba na/ kha par skud sne'i pha rol gyi 'grogs bzang gis kyang kho la sgrug 'dug rdzong dpon 'brug byams kyi gdong nas nyin mor mthong dka' ba'i 'dzum mdangs dpog dka' ba zhig mngon/ ngo ma brel ba che ba la/ rdzong dpon 'brug byams slar yang brelashrang che ba'i don dag gzhan zhig sgrub par chas so/ /2006lo'i〈mang tshogs sku rtsalpodeb dang po' steng bkod/

'u gnyis sdong mgo gcig la babs pa'i bya yin/smag rum gyi yol ba sa gzhir 'then te 'ong dus/ kho mor yang mtshan mo baspebs byung zhes sems khur zhig skyes yong / nyin dkar las ka rtsag rtsig las te sems kyi stong cha kha skong re gyed thub mod/ mun rub dang mo'i sems pa slar yang chu med lung stong du 'gyur zhing / skug pa lang long 'jibs mal du ji ltar nyal na yang gnyid kyi bde ba lus steng nas yal 'gro/ zhag gang bor kher hreng gi gdung yus khrod yar mar la 'dang brgyab ste nam ji ltar gsal ba'ang mi shes/ tshe gcig gi skya yar brtsi ba'i khyo bas lde ba gzhan gyi bu mo zhig khrid de thag ring gi gnas la mthun 'jug byed du song ba nas rdzomo'i snying khong chu bzhin grang song / kho mo re thag chad/ khos 'di ltar byed don ci/khos 'di ltar byed 'ong ba mos ye nas bsam ma rtsong / kho gnyisponi zhe mi 'gyur gor mo rdo dang tshig mi 'gyur rdo rje'i ri mo ru bkod jes da gzod tshe grogs sgrig ste khyo shug gi 'tsho ba rol ba yin/ de dus yul pha ma ma 'thad par 120

'u gnyis sdong mgo gcig la babs pa'i bya yin/smag rum gyi yol ba sa gzhir 'then te 'ong dus/ kho mor yang mtshan mo baspebs byung zhes sems khur zhig skyes yong / nyin dkar las ka rtsag rtsig las te sems kyi stong cha kha skong re byed thub mod/ mun rub dang mo'i sems pa slar yang chu med lung stong du 'gyur zhing / skug pa lang long 'thibs mal du ji ltar nyal na yang gnyid kyi bde ba lus steng nas yal 'gro/ zhag gang bor kher hreng gi gdung yus khrod yar mar la 'dang brgyab ste nam ji ltar gsal ba'ang mi shes/ tshe gcig gi skya yar brtsi ba'i khyo bas sde ba gzhan gyi bu mo zhig khrid de thag ring gi gnas la mthun 'jug byed du song ba nas khomo'i snying khong chu bzhin grang song / kho mo re thag chad/ khos 'di ltar byed don ci/khos 'di ltar byed 'ong ba mos ye nas bsam ma phyong / kho gnyi ni zhe mi 'gyur gor mo rdo dang tshig mi 'gyur rdo rje'i ri mo ru bkod rjes da gzod tshe grogs sgrig ste khyo shug gi 'tsho ba rol ba yin/ de dus yul pha ma ma 'thad par 120

dadul gyi rna mong /kho gnyis kha khar gtong 'dod mod/ kha mthun zhe mthun gyi kho gnyis kha rog ger sa gzhan la bros byol byed de bsdad/ phyi nas lo gcig dang gnyis 'gor ba na/ pha mas kyang bzang na ngan na rang gi sha las chad pa'i bu phrug yin pas sdug la gtod par sems kyis ma bzod cing snying rje ste mo'i bsam thog tu bzhag pa ma zad/ kho gnyis phyir rang yul du bos/ phyir rang yul du thon dus mos rang la mngal chags pa tshor/ mo rang dga' spro dpag med skyes/ sbrum mar gyur ba 'dis kho mor bde skyid kyi 'od snang bstsal zhing ma 'ongs bar re rten zhig gnang / mos rang gi khog gi phru gu 'di kho gnyis kyi brtse dung zhun mar chags pa'i nying khu dang zhe snang ba'i dar skud yun nas yun du brgyus pa'i dan rtags gson po zhig tu sgom/ ring min kho mo tshang gis zhe mthun gyi kho rang mag par blangs/(kho mo la spun gsum yod de/ a ce gnas la song zin la/ phu bo dang nu bo gnyis ka grwa ba yin zhing / da lta gnyis ka rgya gar na yod/de bas kho mo ni pha ma'i rtsib nas 'dug mkhan te shul 'dzin gyi bu mo gcig pu yin〉kho mo tshang la khyim tshang gzhan ltar phyi rdig nang zog ces ston rin dang ngom rin zhig med na yang da nas bzung rang la sems bstan sa dang / skad cha bshad sa/ glo snying gtod sa/ sha mchin pas blan sa zhig yod gyur bas/ kho mo'i yid rab tu chim zhing chog shes kyi bde bas khengs/ mi yod na rgyu los 'khor/ bza' ba gnyis mnyam du phyi ru dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu dang snyi ba rko ru song thengs rer yong 'bab kyang mi chog rgyu med la/ khyim mi tshos kha ru za rgyu 121

dacal gyi rna tshang /kho gnyis kha khar gtong 'dod mod/ kha mthun zhe mthun gyi kho gnyis kha rog ger sa gzhan la bros byol byed de bsdad/ phyi nas lo gcig dang gnyis 'gor ba na/ pha mas kyang bzang na ngan na rang gi sha las chad pa'i bu phrug yin pas sdug la gtod par sems kyis ma bzod cing snying rje ste mo'i bsam thog tu bzhag pa ma zad/ kho gnyis phyir rang yul du bos/ phyir rang yul du thon dus mos rang la mngal chags pa tshor/ mo rang dga' spro dpag med skyes/ sbrum mar gyur ba 'dis kho mor bde skyid kyi 'od snang bstsal zhing ma 'ongs bar re rten zhig gnang / mos rang gi khog gi phru gu 'di kho gnyis kyi brtse dung zhun mar chags pa'i nying khu dang zhe snang ba'i dar skud yun nas yun du brgyus pa'i dan rtags gson po zhig tu sgom/ ring min kho mo tshang gis zhe mthun gyi kho rang mag par blangs/(kho mo la spun gsum yod de/ a ce gnas la song zin la/ phu bo dang nu bo gnyis ka grwa ba yin zhing / da lta gnyis ka rgya gar na yod/de bas kho mo ni pha ma'i rtsib nas 'dug mkhan te shul 'dzin gyi bu mo gcig pu yin〉kho mo tshang la khyim tshang gzhan ltar phyi rdig nang zog ces ston rin dang ngom rin zhig med na yang da nas bzung rang la sems bstan sa dang / skad cha bshad sa/ glo snying gtod sa/ sha mchin pas blan sa zhig yod gyur bas/ kho mo'i yid rab tu chim zhing chog shes kyi bde bas khengs/ mi yod na rgyu los 'khor/ bza' ba gnyis mnyam du phyi ru dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu dang snyi ba rko ru song thengs rer yong 'bab kyang mi chog rgyu med la/ khyim mi tshos kha ru za rgyu 121

'u gnyis sdong mgogacig la babs ba'i zu man/zhim po dang rgyab la gon pa 'jam po re len thub/ 'di'i yan gyi skyid cig gang na yod/ da 'dis ma chog pa ci zhig mchis/ khyo shug gi 'tsho bas kho mo la 'jig rten gyi skyid snang dang zhim mngar 'dzad med du drangs bas/ mos rtag tu rang gi khyo ga la ma yum lta bu'i byams brtse dang mdza' grogs lta bu'i sems pa lhag medadu gnang / kho ni mo'i tshe srog gi phyed nar gyur pas yod tshad kho dang khyim 'di'i slad du 'bul ba'i bsam pa bcangs/ da lta'i bde skyid 'di yun du gnas shing rtag pa'i ched du dgong mor mchod me'i zhal phye dus mos rgyun du phyag 'tshal zhor bgegs dang bar chad mi yong ba'i skyabs 'jug snying nas zhus/ 'on kyang bu phrug skyes te lo gsum 'gor ba na/ khos kho mo bskyur te gzhan la 'grogs/ mo ma bu gnyis shul du bskyur te bud song / gnam rgan mar mig yod dam/ ngas tshe sngon mar mi 'grig pa ci zhig bgyis yod/ 'di ni ngas gzhan la chad pa'i bu lon yin nam/ mos khyo shug gnyis 'dzoms kyi 'o ja mngar mo hub gsum 'thung dbang ma byin par rlangs par gyur te yal song /khos rgyab 'gal byed pa ji 'dra'i brtse med dang sems med cig red ang /khog gi snying 'di tshal ba tshal bur gshags la/ gzugs med kyi rdo zhig gis mo rang mnan te dbugs rgyun gcod la khad byas/ ngu 'dod kyang mig chu med/za ma'i bro ba yal la/ mig mdun gyi yod tshad thal shul gyi the ro red/ kho mo sems ma shi bar kho'i steng la da dung re ba bzung mod/ kho kha phyir 'khor med song / mal sa 'khyag po 'di kho mo gcig pus srung dgos 'dug dgung khar 122

'u gagyis sdong margog ga la babs ba'isnyesdo man/zhim po dang rgyab la gon pa 'jam po re len thub/ 'di'i yan gyi skyid cig gang na yod/ da 'dis ma chog pa ci zhig mchis/ khyo shug gi 'tsho bas kho mo la 'jig rten gyi skyid snang dang zhim mngar 'dzad med du drangs bas/ mos rtag tu rang gi khyo ga la ma yum lta bu'i byams brtse dang mdza' grogs lta bu'i sems pa lhag medatpa gnang / kho ni mo'i tshe srog gi gyed kar gyur pas yod tshad kho dang khyim 'di'i slad du 'bul ba'i bsam pa bcangs/ da lta'i bde skyid 'di yun du gnas shing rtag pa'i ched du dgong mor mchod me'i zhal phye dus mos rgyun du phyag 'tshal zhor bgegs dang bar chad mi yong ba'i skyabs 'jug snying nas zhus/ 'on kyang bu phrug skyes te lo gsum 'gor ba na/ khos kho mo basmyur te gzhan la 'grogs/ mo ma bu gnyis shul du bamyur te bud song / gnam rgan mar mig yod dam/ ngas tshe sngon mar mi 'grig pa ci zhig bgyis yod/ 'di ni ngas gzhan la chad pa'i bu lon yin nam/ mos khyo shug gnyis 'dzoms kyi 'o ja mngar mo hub gsum 'thung dbang ma byin par rlangs par gyur te yal song /khos rgyab 'gal byed pa ji 'dra'i brtse thed dang mas thed cig red ang /khog gi snying 'di tshal ba tshal bur gshags la/ gzugs med kyi rdo zhig gis mo rang mnan te dbugs rgyun gcod la khad byas/ ngu 'dod kyang mig chu med/za ma'i bro ba yal la/ mig mdun gyi yod thal shul gyi the ro red/ kho mo sems ma shi bar kho'i steng la da dung re ba bzung mod/ kho kha phyir 'khor thed song / mal sa 'khug po 'di kho mo gcig pus srung dgos 'dug dgung khar 122

dacal gyi rna 'ong /bya gnyis re gnyis re byas te tshang du log skabs/ kho mo dbang med du yid smon skyes shing zhe spreng rgyu byung / 'dab chags bya yin yang ji 'dra'i skyid pa la/bza' ba gnyis tshang dron po zhig tu 'dus rkyang gyed chog lhag par du lo gsum la son pa'i bu chung gis mo'i thu ba nas 'jus te‘‘a pha gang la bud thal/ spopha yul la mi yong don ci red ces ngu skabs/ kho mo'i snying khar gri yis shugs kyis bsnun pa ltar bzod med kyi zug ju ldang la/ ya chung khog par smug sprin dkri log rgyag bu chung 'di la a pha los dgos/ pha med pa'i bu phrug gshog chad kyi bya min nam/ khyod kyis nga la 'dang ma brgyab na chog mod/ bu mi bsam mam/ rang gi sha las chad pa 'di la snying mi brtse'am/ 'di bskur bar sems kyis bzod dam/ kho ni kha grags shes mi shes dang yar la langs te 'gro shes mi shes tsam red ga kho mo khyo ga'i steng la zhe sdang po langs mod/kho'i bca' grokhi las srol 'dis kho mo'i sems pham par byas shing / rang gi sha las chad pa'i bu yang sgyur phod pa yin na de ni mi ma yin par rdo dang lcags las spub pa'i sems med kyi gzugaspopo zhig min nam/ kho mos de ltar dran pa na chod tshod la skrag rgyu dang ha las rgyu zhig byung / rang gi yod phul myong ba'i mi 'dis kho mor yid mug dang re ba zad par byas/ 'jig rten gyi 'tsho bar yi ga 'chus paraspyag da lta kho mo la sems rten zhig yod pa ni jib kyi bu chung 'di gcig pu red/ bu 'di'i don du kho mo da dung mu mthud du gson dgos la/ hur rus byed dgog yin na yang / khyo bo med pa'i mo hreng du gyur 123

dngul gyi rna 'ong /bya gnyis re gnyis re byas te tshang du log skabs/ kho mo dbang med du yid smon skyes shing zhe spreng rgyu byung / 'dab chags bya yin yang ji 'dra'i skyid pa la/bza' ba gnyis tshang dron po zhig tu 'dus rkyang gyed chog lhag par du lo gsum la son pa'i bu chung gis mo'i thu ba nas 'jus te a pha gang la bud thal/ casapha yul la mi yong don ci red ces ngu skabs/ kho mo'i snying khar gri yis shugs kyis bsdun pa ltar bzod med kyi zug ju ldang la/ ya chung khog par smug sprin dkri log rgyag bu chung 'di la a pha los dgos/ pha med pa'i bu phrug gshog chad kyi bya min nam/ khyod kyis nga la 'dang ma brgyab na chog mod/ bu mi bsam mam/ rang gi sha las chad pa 'di la snying mi brtse'am/ 'di bskyur bar sems kyis bzod dam/ kho ni kha grags shes mi shes dang yar la langs te 'gro shes mi shes tsam red ga kho mo khyo ga'i steng la zhe sdang chen po langs mod/kho'i bca' srolu las srol 'dis kho mo'i sems pham par byas shing / rang gi sha las chad pa'i bu yang skyur phod pa yin na de ni mi ma yin par rdo dang lcags las grub pa'i sems med kyi gzugasapo zhig min nam/ kho mos de ltar dran pa na chod chod la skrag rgyu dang ha las rgyu zhig byung / rang gi yod tshad phul myong ba'i mi 'dis kho mor yid mug dang re ba zad par byas/ 'jig rten gyi 'tsho bar yi ga 'chus paraphyag da lta kho mo la sems rten zhig yod pa ni rtsib kyi bu chung 'di gcig pu red/ bu 'di'i don du kho mo da dung mu mthud du gson dgos la/ hur rus byed dgog yin na yang / khyo bo med pa'i mo treng du gyur 123

'u gagyis sdong margo ga ga la babs ba'i byu min/rjes kho mo mi gzhan la kha grags 'dod med par gyur la/ skyes pa gzhan dang 'grogs 'dod skyes ma byung / ngo ma da reg bar du rang la pho gzhan zhig la thug tu 'ang ma bcug gsar bu 'ga' res mo'i mag par 'dug ces tshur nan tan ngang bshad mod/ 'di dag gis mo'i shi zin pa'i sems gson du 'jug ma thub la/ rnam shes la g.yo 'gul phran tsam dang sems 'di skul ma thub/ kho mo la dga' dga' dungs dungs byed mkhan de tsho cha 'jog blo gtad med pa sgyu ma mkhan zhig tu snang bas/ phar btsan gtam dang zur za btab ste kho tsho'i re ba stong zad du btang / pho gzhon tsho'i mig lam na kho mo ni mi gshis tsub cing rgyang la/ sgul mi thub pa rdo dang zhu mi nus pa 'khyag dar gyi gong bu zhig tu mthong mod/ mo lo nyer lngar bud ma thag gi kho mos da so ma 'jig rten snang ba skyong ba'i bro ba myangs pa yin tsa na/ pho mo mabun 'jug dang dga' mgu'i dpal la rol mi 'dod pa ga la yin/ lus lang tsho'i 'dab ma rab tu rgyas pa'i sgang la don med du 'dab lo thor zhing rnyid 'gro bar kho mor phangs sems cis mi skye kho mo la sngar bzhin stag shar gzhon skyes shig gi char chu dang nyi 'od mkho la/ yun ring bor than skam du lus pa'i kho mo'i lus kyi zhing sa ru char ba shag shag 'jo dgos la/ rmo sgrog dang chu lud dor de nem zhing 'bol ba'i gshin sa ru bsgyur dgog kho mo ni smin legs kyi sil tog dpyangs pa'i sdong bo zhig yin pas su zhig steng la 'gos te 'thog par re la/kho mo ni sngo ldem mer chu rdzing zhig yin pas su zhig de'i nang sding bar ci 'dras 1tshi

'u gnyis sdong mgo gcig la bangs ba'i bya min/rjes kho mo mi gzhan la kha grags 'dod med par gyur la/ skyes pa gzhan dang 'grogs 'dod skyes ma byung / ngo ma da reg bar du rang la pho gzhan zhig la thug tu 'ang ma bcug gsar bu 'ga' res mo'i mag par 'dug ces tshur nan tan ngang bshad mod/ 'di dag gis mo'i shi zin pa'i sems gson du 'jug ma thub la/ rnam shes la g.yo 'gul phran tsam dang sems 'di skul ma thub/ kho mo la dga' dga' dungs dungs byed mkhan de tsho cha 'jog blo gtad med pa sgyu ma mkhan zhig tu snang bas/ phar btsan gtam dang zur za btab ste kho tsho'i re ba stong zad du btang / pho gzhon tsho'i mig lam na kho mo ni mi gshes tsub cing gyong la/ sgul mi thub pa rdo dang zhu mi nus pa 'khyag dar gyi gong bu zhig tu mthong mod/ mo lo nyer lngar bud ma thag gi kho mos da so ma 'jig rten snang ba skyong ba'i bro ba myangs pa yin tsa na/ pho mo mthun 'jug dang dga' mgu'i dpal la rol mi 'dod pa ga la yin/ lus lang tsho'i 'dab ma rab tu rgyas pa'i sgang la don med du 'dab lo thor zhing srid 'gro bar kho mor phangs sems cis mi skye sa mo la sngar bzhin stag shar gzhon skyes shig gi char chu dang nyi 'od mkho la/ yun ring bor than skam du lus pa'i kho mo'i lus kyi zhing sa ru char ba shag shag 'jo dgos la/ rmo slog dang chu lud dor de nem zhing 'bol ba'i gshin sa ru bsgyur dgog kho mo ni smin legs kyi sil tog dpyangs pa'i sdong bo zhig yin pas su zhig steng la 'gos te 'thog par re la/kho mo ni sngo ldem mer chu rdzing zhig yin pas su zhig de'i nang lding bar ci 'dras 1yo

dadul gyi rna mong /'dod/ 'on kyang kho mo char chu dkon pa'i than skam du lus te yun ring 'gor/kho mo bkres skom gyis mnar ba'i rdza mtha'i yu mo zhig ste nam yang kher 'gro dang kher nyal byas/ mi rnams kyi mig nang na rdo bzhin gyong la brtan brling yin pa'i kho mo/ don dam du sems snyi mo zha nye dang sa/shis 'jam pa dar gos la 'gran pa su yis rloms/ mo lo nyi shu nang gi lus po 'di bza' btung kho nas gso mi thub pa kho mos shes yod la/ lus kyi bkrag mdangs 'di yang za ma kho nar brten na yal 'gro ba kho mo cir mi gsal/ kho mor sems kyi rma kha gso ba'i sman zhig mkho la/ kho mo slar yang gson thub par stobs shugs shig 465 dgos/dgong mor rtsib na nyal grogs med pa'i kho mo lung stong du gyar ba ltar stong shur shur du gyud tshe/ sngon chad bza' ba gnyis po dga' mgu'i dpa la la rol ba'i rnam pa de dran te gnyid mi khugs/ skabs rer gzugs med kyi me phung zhig sha gseng nas 'bar zhing me de'i lce zhags ring du brkyangs te lus kun sreg par brtsam dus/ de 'phral nyid du 'jam sha 'di su zhig gis reg reg dang 'khyud sbyor byed de lus yongs rlon nem nem du gtong bar ha cang 'dod pas/ mkhar steng nas pho rgod gang zhig gla bzhin lding 'ong ste mo'i mal khang gi sgo rdung rgyu byung na ci ma rung snyam/ 'on kyang kho mo'i 'dod pa yid bzhin skong mkhan ma byung la/ mo'i gsang ba'i sgo mo 'byed mkhan gcig kyang ma byung / mo nam yang bkres skom zhig gis mnar na yang sdug bsngal de'i khrod 125

dacal gyi rna mong /'dod/ 'on kyang kho mo char chu dkon pa'i than skam du lus te yun ring 'gor/kho mo bkros skom gyis mnar ba'i rdza mtha'i yu mo zhig ste nam yang kher 'gro dang kher nyal byas/ mi rnams kyi mig nang na rdo bzhin gyong la brtan barming yin pa'i kho mo/ don dam du sems snyi mo zha nye dang sa/shis 'jam pa dar gos la 'gran pa su yis rlosas/ mo lo nyi shu nang gi lus po 'di bza' btung kho nas gso mi thub pa kho mos shes yod la/ lus kyi bkrag mdangs 'di yang za ma kho nar brten na yal 'gro ba kho mo cir mi gsal/ kho mor sems kyi rma kha gso ba'i sman zhig mkho la/ kho mo slar yang gson thub par stobs shugs shig spyol dgos/dgong mor rtsib na nyal grogs med pa'i kho mo lung stong du gyar ba ltar stong shur shur du gyud tshe/ sngon chad bza' ba gnyis po dga' mgu'i dpa la la rol ba'i rnam pa de dran te gnyid mi khugs/ skabs rer gzugs med kyi me phung zhig sha gseng nas 'bar zhing me de'i lce zhags ring du brkyangs te lus kun sreg par brtsam dus/ de 'phral nyid du 'jam sha 'di su zhig gis reg reg dang 'khyud sbyor byed de lus yongs rlon nem nem du gtong bar ha cang 'dod pas/ mkhar steng nas pho rgod gang zhig gla bzhin lding 'ong ste mo'i mal khang gi sgo rdung rgyu byung na ci ma rung snyam/ 'on kyang kho mo'i 'dod pa yid bzhin skong mkhan ma byung la/ mo'i gsang ba'i sgo mo 'byed mkhan gcig kyang ma byung / mo nam yang bkres skom zhig gis mnar na yang sdug bsngal de'i khrod 125

'u gnyis sdong margo gcig pha babasasnyeba'i bya man/nyin zhag re re u tshugs kyis phar la bskyal/zhing sa kho nar brten pa'i kho mo tshang la sgor mo'i yong khungs gzhan zhig med pas/ kho mo rang yul bsrung ste 'dug khom gang na yod/ snyi ba brko ran la bslebs 'dug mos spoce'i bu mo(lo bcu gsum la son pa〉chung chung de khrid de/ pha yul dang bar thag ring ba'i 'brog pa'i sa cha 'di ru snyi ba rko ru yong /na ning kho mo dang mo'i khyo ga ma ce'i bu mo gsum bcas sa 'di ru dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu rko skabs las 'khyur ngal gso ba zhig ngo shes te shag po bsgrigs la/de tshang la rjong mkhar du khang stong zhig yod pa de kho tshor g.yar myong / do tshigs kyang kho mo gnyis shag po tshang gtad de song ba na/ shag po tshang gis rang gi nye du khyim du 'byor ba ltar sne len gang bzang byag na ning 'dug sa'i khang ba de g.yar byung la/ da dung zho dang 'o ma sogs kyang skabs skabs su bskyal yong / kho mo 'dug sa'i khang ba 'di'i mtshes shag tu gsar bu zhig bsdad 'dug gon pa gra dag dang sha mdangs yag par bltas na kho ni rdzong mkhar 'di'i las khungasashig na bya ba sgrub bzhin yod pa shes bub/ kho sdom rkyal zhig yin 'dug ste nangs dus ma gtogs dgong mor mun rub bar du rgya sgor za brgyab brgyab la 'dug mun yongasposu rub rjes gsar bu 'di da gzod mal khang du mog la/ nyal khar nam yang rdung len zhig blangs te dus ring bo zhig 'gor bar byed/ kho'i skad snyan la ngag bde bas rdung len gyi dbyangs rta re re sbag spren khrod bzhur ba'i chu bsil ma bzhin yin sems kyi 126

'u gnyis sdong mgo gcig la babs ba'i bya min/nyin zhag re re mu tshugs kyis phar la bskyal/zhing sa kho nar brten pa'i kho mo tshang la sgor mo'i yong khungs gzhan zhig med pas/ kho mo rang yul bsrung ste 'dug khom gang na yod/ snyi ba brko ran la baspebs 'dug mos gce'i bu mo(lo bcu gsum la son pa〉chung chung de khrid de/ pha yul dang bar thag ring ba'i 'brog pa'i sa cha 'di ru snyi ba rko ru yong /na ning kho mo dang mo'i khyo ga ma ce'i bu mo gsum bcas sa 'di ru dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu rko skabs las 'khyur ngal gso ba zhig ngo shes te shag po bsgrigs la/de tshang la rjong mkhar du khang stong zhig yod pa de kho tshor g.yar myong / do tshigs kyang kho mo gnyis shag po tshang gtad de song ba na/ shag po tshang gis rang gi nye du khyim du 'byor ba ltar sde len gang bzang byag na ning 'dug sa'i khang ba de g.yar byung la/ da dung zho dang 'o ma sogs kyang skabs skabs su bskyal yong / kho mo 'dug sa'i khang ba 'di'i mtshes shag tu gsar bu zhig bsdad 'dug gon pa gra dag dang sha mdangs yag par bltas na kho ni rdzong mkhar 'di'i las khung shig na bya ba sgrub bzhin yod pa shes thub/ kho sdom rkyal zhig yin 'dug ste nangs dus ma gtogs dgong mor mun rub bar du rgya sgor zu brgyab brgyab la 'dug mun yong su rub rjes gsar bu 'di da gzod mal khang du phog la/ nyal khar nam yang rdung len zhig blangs te dus ring bo zhig 'gor bar byed/ kho'i skad snyan la ngag bde bas rdung len gyi dbyangs rta re re snag sprin khrod bzhur ba'i rdza chu bsil ma bzhin yid sems kyi 126

dngul gyi rna long /zhing sar dal gyis 'bab la/ nyan pa por zhe smreng ba zhig gam smra mi shes pa'i chor ba de ster/ kho'i rdung len la nyan dus sems khams bag yangs su sim 'gro bas/ gnyid kyi zhing khams su ga dus la 'grims pa'ang mi shes/ na ning 'di ru sdod dus mo pho gsar 'di dang lam 'phrad re byung na yang phan tshun la kha ya byed ma myong / 'on te kha skad la brtag na kho 'brog pa'i sa cha 'di'i mi min pa shes thub/ do tshigs kyang na ning bzhin red/ kho mo nangs dus yar la langs te ri la 'gro skabs ma gtogs khyim mtshes tshang gis mun yongs su rub bar du rgya sgor zwa rgan zhig dpyangs 'dug nyal khar rdung len zhig len rgyu de kho'i goms gshis lta bu zhig tu gyur 'dug 'on kyang do tshigs kho mos nyan phyogs shig gis kho'i rdung len gyi dbyangs rta re re skyo snang gis khengs pa zhig red/ khor yang mo rang dang 'dra bar sems na sdug cig yod dam/ yang na ci zhig shor te pham nyes byung ba yin/ snying rje dang gdung sems shig kho mor skyes la/ sems la sna tshogs shar/ skabs rer rang 'gul ngang gsar bu 'di'i nye sar bcar te snying nye ba'i kha brda zhig byed na bsam/ kho mos sems kyi gsang ba brjod sa dang / sdug yus bgrang sa/ snying nye ba'i bshad grogs de ma rnyed par dus ring bo 'gor/ dga' 'os pa la de ring dgong khar kho mo dang rang gi tsha mo gnyis ri 'go nas phyir bslebs te nub tsha bskol skabs/ gsar bu 'di yang rang gi mal khang du log byung / nyin 'di ni ldom rkyal kho snga mor sdod shag tu log par brtsi chog khos lcags thab nang me 'bud pa los yin/ skabs 127

dacal gyi rna mong /zhing sar dal gyis 'bab la/ nyan pa por zhe smreng ba zhig gam smra mi shes pa'i tshor ba de ster/ kho'i rdung len la nyan dus sems khams bag yangs su sim 'gro bas/ gnyid kyi zhing khams su ga dus la 'grims pa'ang mi shes/ na ning 'di ru sdod dus mo pho gsar 'di dang lam 'phrad re byung na yang phan tshun la kha ya byed ma myong / 'on te kha skad la brtag na kho 'brog pa'i sa cha 'di'i mi min pa shes thub/ do tshigs kyang na ning bzhin red/ kho mo nangs dus yar la langs te ri la 'gro skabs ma gtogs khyim mtshes tshang gis mun yongs su rub bar du rgya sgor zwa rgan zhig dpyangs 'dug nyal khar rdung len zhig len rgyu de kho'i goms gshis lta bu zhig tu gyur 'dug 'on kyang do tshigs kho mos nyan phyogs shig gis kho'i rdung len gyi dbyangs rta re re skyo snang gis khengs pa zhig red/ khor yang mo rang dang 'dra bar sems na sdug cig yod dam/ yang na ci zhig shor te pham nyes byung ba yin/ snying rje dang gdung sems shig kho mor skyes la/ sems la sna tshogs shar/ skabs rer rang 'gul ngang gsar bu 'di'i nye sar bcar te snying nye ba'i kha brda zhig byed na bsam/ kho mos sems kyi gsang ba brjod sa dang / sdug yus bgrang sa/ snying nye ba'i bshad grogs de ma rnyed par dus ring bo 'gor/ dga' 'os pa la de ring dgong khar kho mo dang rang gi tsha mo gnyis ri 'go nas phyir bslebs te nub tsha bskol skabs/ gsar bu 'di yang rang gi mal khang du log byung / nyin 'di ni ldom rkyal kho snga mor sdod shag tu log par baji chog khos lcags thab nang me 'bud pa los yin/ skabs 127

'u gagyis sdong mgogabyug ma babs ba'i bya min/shig la gsar bu 'di sgo ru thon zhing mo'i sar 'bar zhun g.yor du bslebs byung / 'bar zhun g.yor skabs khor 'tsher snang gi mdangs la mngon chung zhig shar 'dug da dung dogs dogs dang 'tshab be 'tshub ber ngang kho mo gnyis la khom dus ru nang du shog ces kha yag kyang 'then byung / kho'i dogs mi bde ba'i tshigs ka de dgod bro ba zhig red/ kho dang bar thag je nyer gtong ched mos kho la 'di na 'o ma yod la khyod kyis khyer song zhes bshad mod/khos min min zhes brdzi bag byed bzhin phyir brel 'tshub kyis log sngon chad gsar bu 'di la mnyam 'jog de 'dra ma byed mod/ de ring jib nas zhib blta byas pa na kho'i byad bzhin gsal bor rig ngo gdong dkur zhing gor ga sna ba'i gzengs mtho zhing drang shad du gnas/ mig chargyu med na yang de las rgyud bzang dang gzhung drang gi mdangs shig mngon/ so rnams dkar zhing tshags dam pa ste kho ni stag shar dung gi so sgo can zhig red/ kho'i gzugs stobs mi che mod/ kho'i lus steng na yang stag sha ra'i khyad chos 'dzoms shing yon tan tshang ba ma zad/ lus yongs su bde thang dang gson shugs rgyas 'dug lhag par du kho'i skad cha bshad stangs dang gdong gi rnam 'gyur las mi dra sa drang se dang glen rtags mngon pa 'dis kho mo la rgyus yod dang snying nye ba zhig ster/kho mo ni kha bde rtse bde yi smra mkhas pa dang phar bltas na migazung las rig pa rno zhing grung bo mngon pa'i pho gsar gyi rigs la sems de 'dra mi 'khor/de las ldog ste smra ba nyung zhing glen pa lta bu'i pho gsar gyi rigs la dung pa 128

'u gnyis sdong mgogacig la babs ba'i bya min/shig la gsar bu 'di sgo ru thon zhing mo'i sar 'bar zhun g.yor du bslebs byung / 'bar zhun g.yor skabs khor 'tsher snang gi mdangs la mngon chung zhig shar 'dug da dung dogs dogs dang 'tshab be 'tshub ber ngang kho mo gnyis la khom dus ru nang du shog ces kha yag kyang 'then byung / kho'i dogs mi bde ba'i tshigs ka de dgod bro ba zhig red/ kho dang bar thag je nyer gtong ched mos kho la 'di na 'o ma yod la khyod kyis khyer song zhes bshad mod/khos min min zhes brdzi bag byed bzhin phyir brel 'tshub kyis log sngon chad gsar bu 'di la mnyam 'jog de 'dra ma byed mod/ de ring rtsib nas zhib blta byas pa na kho'i byad bzhin gsal bor rig ngo gdong dkur zhing gor ga sna ba'i gzengs mtho zhing drang shad du gnas/ mig chargyu med na yang de las rgyud bzang dang gzhung drang gi mdangs shig mngon/ so rnams dkar zhing tshags dam pa ste kho ni stag shar dung gi so sgo can zhig red/ kho'i gzugs stobs mi che mod/ kho'i lus steng na yang stag sha ra'i khyad chos 'dzoms shing yon tan tshang ba ma zad/ lus yongs su bde thang dang gson shugs rgyas 'dug lhag par du kho'i skad cha bshad stangs dang gdong gi rnam 'gyur las mi dra sa drang se dang glen rtags mngon pa 'dis kho mo la rgyus yod dang snying nye ba zhig ster/kho mo ni kha bde rtse bde yi smra mkhas pa dang phar bltas na migazung las rig pa rno zhing grung bo mngon pa'i pho gsar gyi rigs la sems de 'dra mi 'khor/de las ldog ste smra ba nyung zhing glen pa lta bu'i pho gsar gyi rigs la dung pa 123

dacam gyi rna mong /'phel/ ci la zhe na rig pa rgod po tshos mi la yid rton dku' ba'i dogs pa za ru 'jug la/ glen rtags 'dres pa de dag gis ma mtha' yang mi brtan tshugs dang blo khel chog pa'i yid ches shig ster ba red/ 'di ni mos pho gzhon tsho la bzung ba'i lta tshul dang dran stangs tsam ste/ 'grin min bshad dka' mod/ mi tshe'i lam bu nas mngar skyur kha gsum myong rol byed pa'i kho mor nyams myong ngam myong tshor de 'dra zhig rgyud la chags su bcug yod/ ngo mtshar ba zhig ni/khyim mtshes gsar bu 'di mthong ba dang ro 'i yid kyi sgrug pa dwangs 'gro zhing/sems 'di yang bde mo'i 'bab stegs shig tu lhod kyis 'bab 'go brtsams/de mur kho'i byad bzhin de gson nyams dang bcas mig lam du yang yang rgyu byung bas/ kho mo'i snying dmar po ri bong gi mchong lding du rtsen zhing / rnam shes nyid gshog thogs bya yi 'phur lding du gyur/ kho mo rang dbang med par stong bsam gyi dbyings su 'phur/ mkha' dbyings de na nyi ma'i drod rgyun dang zla ba'i bsil 'jam mchis la/ chu 'dzin gyi char chu mod/ kho mo gnyid ma khugs/'on kyang do nub gnyid ma 'ong ba ni sngon chad dang mi 'dra ste/ stong bsam gyi bde bas yid sems gso ba'i rkyen yin/ stos dang / do nub dgung gi zla ba yang yar ngo zla ba zhig ste dkar gsal cha rdzogs la nye ba dang / mtha' 'khor du skar tshogs kyis 'dzum chung dmul/ pha yul na yod dus mkha' dbyings kyi zla ba de nam yang spren nag gis bsgribs te mthong lam du mi mngon/ skabs rer sprin gseb nas mngon yang de yang nya gang med par mar ngor 'grib pa 129

dngul gyi rna mong /'phel/ ci la zhe na rig pa rgod po tshos mi la yid rton dku' ba'i dogs pa za ru 'jug la/ glen rtags 'dres pa de dag gis ma mtha' yang mi brtan tshugs dang blo khel chog pa'i yid ches shig ster ba red/ 'di ni mos pho gzhon tsho la bzung ba'i lta tshul dang dran stangs tsam ste/ 'grin min bshad dka' mod/ mi tshe'i lam bu nas mngar skyur kha gsum myong rol byed pa'i kho mor nyams myong ngam myong tshor de 'dra zhig rgyud la chags su bcug yod/ ngo mtshar ba zhig ni/khyim mtshes gsar bu 'di mthong ba dang ro 'i yid kyi sgrug pa dwangs 'gro zhing/sems 'di yang bde mo'i 'bab stegs shig tu lhod kyis 'bab 'go brtsams/de mur kho'i byad bzhin de gson nyams dang bcas mig lam du yang yang rgyu byung bas/ kho mo'i snying dmar po ri bong gi mchong lding du rtsen zhing / rnam shes nyid gshog thogs bya yi 'phur lding du gyur/ kho mo rang dbang med par stong bsam gyi dbyings su 'phur/ mkha' dbyings de na nyi ma'i drod rgyun dang zla ba'i bsil 'jam mchis la/ chu 'dzin gyi char chu mod/ kho mo gnyid ma khugs/'on kyang do nub gnyid ma 'ong ba ni sngon chad dang mi 'dra ste/ stong bsam gyi bde bas yid sems gso ba'i rkyen yin/ stos dang / do nub dgung gi zla ba yang yar ngo zla ba zhig ste dkar gsal cha rdzogs la nye ba dang / mtha' 'khor du skar tshogs kyis 'dzum chung dmul/ pha yul na yod dus mkha' dbyings kyi zla ba de nam yang sprin nag gis bsgribs te mthong lam du mi mngon/ skabs rer sprin gseb nas mngon yang de yang nya gang med par mar ngor 'grib pa 129

'u gnyis sdong margo ga ga la babs ba' bya na/zhig red/ do nub zla ba kha gang la nye bas kho mor sgrug mi bzod pa'ibrel ba zhig bslangs la/ yid sems su rlabs kyi 'du 'god 'khrigs/ 'on kyang kho dang kho mo gnyis bar gyang gcig gis sa sor bcad yod/ las 'brel yod na gnam sa gnyis su bkur yang gzhi gcig tu 'dzom bub la/ las dang bsod nams med na gom pa 'ga'i mtshams na yod kyang phan tshun bug pa'i skal ba med zer/ gtam 'di bden nam/ kho mo sems khur dang dngangs 'tshab cig gis ded yong / skabs 'dir mo'i re ba nyag gcig ni mtshes shag gi gsar rgo da bar gyang brtol te nang du 'dzul 'ong rgyu de yin/ gal te kho la dngos gnas gyang brtol ba'i blo dang spobs pa ldan na mos kho la lhag bsam rnam dag gis ram 'degs byed kho thag yin/ kho mos dran rtog gi klong du nyul ba'i mtshams bzhag ste mtshes shag gi grags 'gul la rna ba blagaspote nyan/ sgo 'byed pa dang gtan pa'i sgra de skabs skabs su mo'i rna ru kung yong ga sgra 'di tsam gyis kyang kho mo'i sems bde la 'bab par 'jug thub lte/ 'dis kho da dung nyal med pa gsal bshad byed yod pa min nag do nub kho yang kho mo ltar gnyid rgyu med na ji 'dra'i bzang / rdung len grags byung / snying 'jags kyi mtshan mo 'di la/ skyo snang gi dbyangs rtar brgyus pa'i tshig 'bru rnams mu tig gi do shal chad pa ltar kho mo'i yid sems su 'thor/ nang don phun sum tshogs la 'gyur khugs rdzogs pa gang bar gyang gis ma khogs par bzhur 'ong bas/ mo sngar bas 'dug mi bzod par gyur/ nyan gyin nyan gyin rdung len 130

'u gnyis sdong mgo gcig la babs ba'i bya min/zhig red/ do nub zla ba kha gang la nye bas kho mor skug mi bzod pa'ibrel ba zhig bslangs la/ yid sems su rlabs kyi 'du 'god 'khrigs/ 'on kyang kho dang kho mo gnyis bar gyang gcig gis sa sor bcad yod/ las 'brel yod na gnam sa gnyis su bkur yang gzhi gcig tu 'dzom thub la/ las dang bsod nams med na gom pa 'ga'i mtshams na yod kyang phan tshun thug pa'i skal ba med zer/ gtam 'di bden nam/ kho mo sems khur dang dngangs 'tshab cig gis ded yong / skabs 'der mo'i re ba nyag gcig ni mtshes shag gi gsar rgo da bar gyang brtol te nang du 'dzul 'ong rgyu de yin/ gal te kho la dngos gnas gyang brtol ba'i blo dang spobs pa ldan na mos kho la lhag bsam rnam dag gis ram 'degs byed kho thag yin/ kho mos dran rtog gi klod du nyul ba'i mtshams bzhag ste mtshes shag gi grags 'gul la rna ba blagasate nyan/ sgo 'byed pa dang gtan pa'i sgra de skabs skabs su mo'i rna ru lhung yong ga sgra 'di tsam gyis kyang kho mo'i sems bde la 'bab par 'jug thub ste/ 'dis kho da dung nyal med pa gsal bshad byed yod pa min nag do nub kho yang kho mo ltar gnyid rgyu med na ji 'dra'i bzang / rdung len grags byung / snying 'jags kyi mtshan mo 'di la/ skyo snang gi dbyangs rtar brgyus pa'i tshig 'bru rnams mu tig gi do shal chad pa ltar kho mo'i yid sems su 'thor/ nang don phun sum tshogs la 'gyur khugs rdzogs pa gang bar gyang gis ma khogs par bzhur 'ong bas/ mo sngar bas 'dug mi bzod par gyur/ nyan gyin nyan gyin rdung len 130

dacal gyithamang /'di kho mo la blangs pa 'dra la/ rdung len mkhan kho rang nyid kyi skyo ba bsangs pa'i slad du blangs pa'ang 'dra/ kho mo skyo shas dang dung sems gnyis 'gran pa bzhin 'phel/ kho mo skabs rer sgo ru 'ong ste yud tsam la nyan/ skabs rer phyir khang ba'i nang du 'dzul/ 'gro 'dug rang dbang dang bral ba'i kho mo yu mo zhig dang gnyis su ma mchis/ do nub kho gnyis ri'i nyin srib gnyis su lus pa'i ri dwags gnyis te/ ri'i nyin gyi sha pho gan 'di ru lding 'ong ste rwa rtsed byed na/ yu mo ngas gces slong ba'i tshul du sha pho de'i gsus 'og tu mgo bo gtug la mchu to bsrings nges/ rdung len dkrol mtshams bzhag song / mos sngar mus bzhin rna ba gtad de nyan yod/ mtshes shag tu g.yo 'gul phran tsam byung na yang kho mos gsal bor thos thub/ mo sa yang bskyar glog sgron ma gzim la de'i khar dra yol yang 'then med/ phyi nas bltas na nang gi yod tshad gsal gyi ler mthong / 'di ltar byed don ni mos kho la sgug pa'i yin la/ kho mo khos sgo rdung bar re bas sgrug yod/ skabs shig la mtshes shag gi sgo 'byed byung la/ yud tsam gyi rjes su gom pa ga ler spo zhing 'jab bus yong ba'i sgra zhig mo'i phyogs su rgyu yong / skegi dngos gnas sgo rdung byung / kho mo'i snying gi 'phar lding je drag tu gyur/ sgo brdung mkhan su zhig yin pa dpog thub na yang / mos su yin zhes dris/ phyinas skad mgo dma' la ngag cung 'dar ba zhig gis ‘nga yin zhes lan btab byung / kho mo mal las langs/ gon pa gyon rjes sgo byes te bltas pa na/ kho sgo khar 'greng 'dug gsar bu mngon chung 131

dadul gyirnamong /'di kho mo la blangs pa 'dra la/ rdung len mkhan kho rang nyid kyi skyo ba bsangs pa'i slad du blangs pa'ang 'dra/ kho mo skyo shas dang dung sems gnyis 'gran pa bzhin 'phel/ kho mo skabs rer sgo ru 'ong ste yud tsam la nyan/ skabs rer phyir khang ba'i nang du 'dzul/ 'gro 'dug rang dbang dang bral ba'i kho mo yu mo zhig dang gnyis su ma mchis/ do nub kho gnyis ri'i nyin srib gnyis su lus pa'i ri dwags gnyis te/ ri'i nyin gyi sha pho gan 'di ru lding 'ong ste rwa rtsed byed na/ yu mo ngas gces slong ba'i tshul du sha pho de'i gsus 'og tu mgo bo gtug la mchu to bsrings nges/ rdung len dkrol mtshams bzhag song / mos sngar mus bzhin rna ba gtad de nyan yod/ mtshes shag tu g.yo 'gul phran tsam byung na yang kho mos gsal bor thos thub/ mo sa yang bskyar glog sgron ma gzim la de'i khar dra yol yang 'then med/ phyi nas bltas na nang gi yod tshad gsal gyi ler mthong / 'di ltar byed don ni mos kho la sgug pa'i ched yin la/ kho mo khos sgo rdung bar re bas sgug yod/ skabs shig la mtshes shag gi sgo 'byed byung la/ yud tsam gyi rjes su gom pa ga ler spo zhing 'jab bus yong ba'i sgra zhig mo'i phyogs su rgyu yong / gagi dngos gnas sgo rdung byung / kho mo'i snying gi 'phar lding je drag tu gyur/ sgo brdung mkhan su zhig yin pa dpog thub na yang / mos su yin zhes dris/ phyinas skad mgo dma' la ngag cung 'dar ba zhig gis ‘nga yin zhes lan btab byung / kho mo mal las langs/ gon pa gyon rjes sgo phyes te bltas pa na/ kho sgo khar 'greng 'dug gsar bu mngon chung 131

'u gnyis rdong mgogacig la babs ba'i bya man/'dis sgo rdung thub par mo cung tsam mtshar snang skyes na yang / kho mo sems 'gul thebs/ kho mo sgo khar 'ong ba na kho ni rku byed du 'ong ba ltar ba rtab por gyur/ tshul de mthong ba na dgod rgyu zhig langs mod/ kho mos mgo bo dud de 'dzum bag phyir bsdug ‘‘khyed nga btsal don ci yin zhes dris par/khos ‘ngas khyod dang mnyam du kha brda byed 'dod zer/ skad gdangs dma' la ngag sngar bzhin 'dar/ zla 'od 'og na khyim mtshes kyi kho rang sngar bas snying rje bor snang la/ 'dod thog tu ma bzhag na blos mi chod pa zhig reg so'i gdong gi rnam 'gyur las yid 'thad dang re ba zhig mngon pa los yin/gsar bu 'di snying stobs che ru bskyed de mo'i nye sar btug lag pas kho mor 'jus/ kho'i lag pa ji 'dra'i drod la 'jam/ drod rgyun zhig mo'i lus yongs su bzhur/ 'di ni mos da rag bar du 'jus ma myong ba'i sha drod tsheba'i lag pa ste gtong mi 'dod pa zhig red mang / lag pa 'dis shugs kyis 'jus pas kho mo rgyab rten dang blo khel zhig rnyed lta'i bde ba zhig gis sim par byas/khos mo'i mal sa ston bzhin ‘'di nas kha brda byed na chog gam zhes dri pa na/ ‘‘'di nas kha brda byed na nga'i tsha mo gnyid las bslad 'gro zhes mo'i skad gdangs ha cang gnyom/ ‘ de na nga'i de ru 'gro/ khos mo'i lag nas 'then/ mos mi 'gro zhes spam rdzu tsam bgyis mod/ sems snga monas kho'i phyogs su gtad yod pas/ khos tshur 'then pa na gom kha yang rang dbang med par kho'i rjes su bsgyur/ kho gnyis kho'i khang ba'i nang thon/ 'di ni khang ba 132

'u gagyis sdong margogacig la babs ba' bya man/'dis sgo rdung thub par mo cung tsam mtshar snang skyes na yang / kho mo sems 'gul thebs/ kho mo sgo khar 'ong ba na kho ni rku byed du 'ong ba ltaratab rtab por gyur/ tshul de mthong ba na dgod rgyu zhig langs mod/ kho mos mgo bo dud de 'dzum bag phyir bsdug ‘‘khyed nga btsal don ci yin zhes dris par/khos ‘ngas khyod dang mnyam du kha brda byed 'dod zer/ skad gdangs dma' la ngag sngar bzhin 'dar/ zla 'od 'og na khyim mtshes kyi kho rang sngar bas snying rje bor snang la/ 'dod thog tu ma bzhag na blos mi chod pa zhig reg mo'i gdong gi rnam 'gyur las yid 'thad dang re ba zhig mngon pa los yin/gsar bu 'di snying stobs che ru bskyed de mo'i nye sar btug lag pas kho mor 'jus/ kho'i lag pa ji 'dra'i drod la 'jam/ drod rgyun zhig mo'i lus yongs su bzhur/ 'di ni mos da rag bar du 'jus ma myong ba'i sha drod chaba'i lag pa ste gtong mi 'dod pa zhig red ang / lag pa 'dis shugs kyis 'jus pas kho mo rgyab rten dang blo khel zhig lhad lta'i bde ba zhig gis sim par byas/khos mo'i mal sa ston bzhin‘‘'di nas kha brda byed na chog gam’ zhes drigapa na/ ‘‘'di nas kha brda byed na nga'i tsha mo gnyid las bslad 'gro zhes mo'i skad gdangs ha cang gnyom/ ‘‘de na nga'i de ru 'gro/ khos mo'i lag nas 'then/ mos mi 'gro zhes spam rdzu tsam bgyis mod/ sems snga monas kho'i phyogs su gtad yod pas/ khos tshur 'then pa na gom kha yang rang dbang med par kho'i rjes su bsgyur/ kho gnyis kho'i khang ba'i nang thon/ 'di ni khang ba 132

dajul gyi rna mong /gyan gcig ste nang gi bkod pa yang de bzhin du stabs bde dang sla bcos su snang / snod ca lag de 'dra med mod/ dpe cha shin tu mang / dpe sgrom chen mo de dpe chas gang 'dug la/ ja cog dang sngas cog nyal khri'i steng gang sa gang du'ang dpe cha dang shog dkar spungs 'dug de sngon rang gis kho ni nyin gang bor ldom ste khyim du log mi shes pa'i mgo stong zhig red bsam mod/ do dgong dpe cha ba zhig yin pa gzhi nas shes/ deng sang na gzhon phal che ba rgyan 'dzugs rgyu dang 'ur 'ur zing zing la mos pa las dpe klog la dga' ba ci tsam yod/ ro/ dpe cha ba yin 'dug pas mo dad gus zhig kyang skyes byung / kho mos dang thog rig skabs gsar bu 'di gzhan dang mi mtshungs par khyad du 'phags pa zhig tu shar ba yang / rgasar bu kho'i rgyud la yon tan gyis phyug cing zhi dul dang khengs sgyung shig yin pa'i rkyen gyis red snyam/ mo ni slob grwar 'grim ma myong ba'i ming don mtshungs pa'i yig rmongs pa zhig yin mod/ rig gnas pa la sems khong nas yid smon dang brtsi mthong che/ kho gnyis yud tsam la kha brda byas/ gnam la dpyangs pa'i glog 'od dkar zhing gsal/ glog 'od kyis mo'i lus kyi mdzes pa yongs su bkyags 'dug kho dang kho mo gnyis kyi mig zhags phan tshun 'phrad/ mig dang mig gis ci zhig 'bod 'gugs byas la mgron du 'bod/ kho ni rngon pa zhig mo ni rnyi la shor ba'i ri dwags shigakho'i mig lam na lta na sdug pa'i kho mo rim gyis mer gyis 'khril ba'i mtsho ljang khu zhig tu shar/ ma gzhi skabs 'dir kho ni tsha gdung gis nyam nyes pa'i lam 133

dacal gyi rna tshang /gyan gcig ste nang gi bkod pa yang de bzhin du stabs bde dang sla bcos su snang / snod ca lag de 'dra med mod/ dpe cha shin tu mang / dpe sgrom chen mo de dpe chas gang 'dug la/ ja cog dang sngas cog nyal khri'i steng gang sa gang du'ang dpe cha dang shog dkar spungs 'dug de sngon rang gis kho ni nyin gang bor ldom ste khyim du log mi shes pa'i mgo stong zhig red bsam mod/ do dgong dpe cha ba zhig yin pa gzhi nas shes/ deng sang na gzhon phal che ba rgyan 'dzugs rgyu dang 'ur 'ur zing zing la mos pa las dpe klog la dga' ba ci tsam yod/ ro/ dpe cha ba yin 'dug pas mo dad gus zhig kyang skyes byung / kho mos dang thog rig skabs gsar bu 'di gzhan dang mi mtshungs par khyad du 'phags pa zhig tu shar ba yang / gsar bu kho'i rgyud la yon tan gyis phyug cing zhi dul dang khengs sgyung shig yin pa'i rkyen gyis red snyam/ mo ni slob grwar 'grim ma myong ba'i ming don mtshungs pa'i yig smyongs pa zhig yin mod/ rig gnas pa la sems khong nas yid smon dang brtsi mthong che/ kho gnyis yud tsam la kha brda byas/ gnam la dpyangs pa'i glog 'od dkar zhing gsal/ glog 'od kyis mo'i lus kyi mdzes pa yongs su bkyags 'dug kho dang kho mo gnyis kyi mig zhags phan tshun 'phrad/ mig dang mig gis ci zhig 'bod 'gugs byas la mgron du 'bod/ kho ni rngon pa zhig mo ni rnyi la shor ba'i ri dwags shigakho'i mig lam na lta na sdug pa'i kho mo rim gyis mer gyis 'khril ba'i mtsho ljang khu zhig tu shar/ ma gzhi skabs 'dir kho ni tsha gdung gis nyam nyes pa'i lam 133

'u gnyis sdong mgo gcig la babs ba'i bya min/'gro ba zhig gomatsho 'dir zhugs mkhan med na grags med skem 'gro la/lam 'gro ba de yang tsha bas srog nyen la thug 'grokho mtsho nang lding rtsis byed pa na/mtsho kha'i sbal ba 'drogs te cal ser chu nang du mchong la/ nya mo 'ga' yang 'drogs te chu'i nang na 'khrug 'khyug tsam byas/ mtsho mo g.yo skyom byas byung /tsha gdung gis mnar ba'i kho lus yongs jul chu 'dzag ste rlon rnam dang 'byar bag tu gyur/khos dbugs hal hal byagade mur bsam dbang dran dbang ma byin par mtsho ru lding / chu'i zegs ma mkha' ru 'thor/ nyi 'od kyi ngogs na zegs ma rnams mu tig bzhin 'od krig ger 'tsher/ zing cha des mtsho ngogs kyi sngon rtse'i bya rnams 'ur ser spur sto dkar nya mo mang bo ci dgar 'khyugakhos mtsho rdzing de nas chur zhugs kyi rtse dgar mngon par rol ba na/ srid na med pa'i bde ba zhig gis dbang bo yong su sigade nas dbugs yang mor len bzhin mtsho khar bslebs/gan rgyal du nyal te nyi 'od de rang lus la phog par byas/skabs 'dir mtsho mo slar yang zhi zhing sgod la/mtsho kha'i spyod shing dag shag shag rlung gis bskyod/kho dang zhag gcig la 'grogs rjes mo'i yid sems skya mor chab chus bran pas snum shig shig tu gyur la/lus la bkrag mdangs rgyas 'go brtsams/de ni skom pas gdung ba'i yu mo zhig chu la 'phrad pa ltar sug bzhi la bde myur ldan par gyur/ 'on kyang mdang khabardasnyed pa na kho ni bza' tshang yod pa'i skyes pa ste/ bu zhig gi mapha yin pa shes song / mos kho la re ba lhag ma zhig tshi

'u gagyis sdong margo gartsag la babs ba'i bya na/'gro ba zhig gomatsho 'dir zhugs mkhan med na grags med skem 'gro la/lam 'gro ba de yang tsha bas srog nyen la thug 'grokho mtsho nang lding rtsis byed pa na/mtsho kha'i sbal ba 'drogs te cal ser chu nang du mchong la/ nya mo 'ga' yang 'drogs te chu'i nang na 'khyug 'khrug tsam byas/ mtsho mo g.yo skyom byas byung /tsha gdung gis mnar ba'i kho lus yongs rngul chu 'dzag ste rlon dem dang 'byar bag tu gyur/khos dbugs hal hal byagade mur bsam dbang dran dbang ma byin par mtsho ru sding / chu'i zegs ma mkha' ru 'thor/ nyi 'od kyi ngogs na zegs ma rnams mu tig bzhin 'od krig ger 'tsher/ zing cha des mtsho ngogs kyi sngon rtse'i bya rnams 'ur ser spur sto dkar nya mo mang bo ci dgar 'khyugakhos mtsho rdzing de nas chur zhugs kyi rtse dgar mngon par rol ba na/ srid na thed pa'i bde ba zhig gis dbang bo yonga.oṃsu sgrigade nas dbugs yang mor len bzhin mtsho khar bslebs/gan rgyal du nyal te nyi 'od de rang lus la phog par byas/skabs 'dir mtsho mo slar yang zhi zhing lhod la/mtsho kha'i ljon shing dag shag shag rlung gis bskyod/kho dang zhag gcig la 'grogs rjes mo'i yid sems skya mor chab chus bran pas snum shig shig tu gyur la/lus la bkrag mdangs rgyas 'go brtsams/de ni skom pas gdung ba'i yu mo zhig chu la 'phrad pa ltar sug bzhi la bde myur ldan par gyur/ 'on kyang mdang khabardakhyed pa na kho ni bza' tshang yod pa'i skyes sdu ste/ bu zhig gi spopha yin pa shes song / mos kho la re ba lhag ma zhig

dacal gyi mamong /bzung med mod/ sngas gcig dang gdan gcig byas spyong ba'i kho tshang bcas pa'i bya zhig ste rang gi jib nas nam 'phur cha med yin nges na/ mo la yid phangs pa'i khar snying la zug rngu zhig kyang ldang byung / tshe gang bor rtswa chu mnyam rol byed rgyu mi lam tsam yin yang / kho mos rang gi zhag gcig gi nyal rogs 'di tshe gang gi tshe grogs su 'gyur bar ci 'dras 'dod/ kho mo slar yang sems khur dang skyo snang gis btums/ de lta na yang khas len dgos pa ni kho ni mo'i sems phug tu 'dzul zin la/ mo'i 'jig rten du med du mi rung ba zhig tu gyur 'dug ri la 'gro ba'i lam bar dang ri mgo nas mgo skur te snyi ba brko ba'i dus gang yin yang / mo'i mig lam du kho yang yang shar la/ sems 'di rang dbang med par kho'i phyogs su shor 'gro/ de bzhin du kho yang zhag gcig la 'grogs rjes rang gi nyal rogs de zhon rta brje brje byed mkhan min pa 'dra sme mdang khos mo'i lag par yang yang reg cing lag pa'i ser ga dang lag mthil sra mor gyur bde mthong rjes/ mig las mi bzod pa'i gdung sems dang sha tsha ba'i mdangs shig bcos min du mngon/ mos rang gi 'das song dang skyo gdung rnams gleng skabs/kho rang mo'i phyogs su 'khor te rna ba gtad de nyan zhing / nyan gyin nyan gyin mig mthar mchi zhags kyang 'khor bzhin 'dug spogi 'di ni brtse dung zer ba de yin nam/ kho dang nged gnyis bgegs kyi chu bo mnyam brgal dang sdug gi khur bo mnyam 'khur/ lo dang zla ba'i nyams tshod blangs pa zhig la ye nas brtsi mi chog mod/ nged gnyis kyi yid 135

dbyal gyi mayong /bzung med mod/ sngas gcig dang gdan gcig byas myong ba'i kho tshang bcas pa'i bya zhig ste rang gi jib nas nam 'phur cha med yin nges na/ mo la yid phangs pa'i khar snying la zug ju zhig kyang ldang byung / tshe gang bor rtswa chu mnyam rol byed rgyu mi lam tsam yin yang / kho mos rang gi zhag gcig gi nyal rogs 'di tshe gang gi tshe grogs su 'gyur bar ci 'dras 'dod/ kho mo slar yang sems khur dang skyo snang gis btums/ de lta na yang khas len dgos pa ni kho ni mo'i sems phug tu 'dzul zin la/ mo'i 'jig rten du med du mi rung ba zhig tu gyur 'dug ri la 'gro ba'i lam bar dang ri mgo nas mgo skur te snyi ba brko ba'i dus gang yin yang / mo'i mig lam du kho yang yang shar la/ sems 'di rang dbang med par kho'i phyogs su shor 'gro/ de bzhin du kho yang zhag gcig la 'grogs rjes rang gi nyal rogs de zhon rta brje brje byed mkhan min pa 'dra sge mdang khos mo'i lag par yang yang reg cing lag pa'i ser ga dang lag mthil sra mor gyur bde mthong rjes/ mig las mi bzod pa'i gdung sems dang sha tsha ba'i mdangs shig bcos min du mngon/ mos rang gi 'das song dang skyo gdung rnams gleng skabs/kho rang mo'i phyogs su 'khor te rna ba gtad de nyan zhing / nyan gyin nyan gyin mig mthar mchi zhags kyang 'khor bzhin 'dug gi 'di ni brtse dung zer ba de yin nam/ kho dang nged gnyis bgegs kyi chu bo mnyam brgal dang sdug gi khur bo mnyam 'khur/ lo dang zla ba'i nyams tshod blangs pa zhig la ye nas brtsi mi chog mod/ nged gnyis kyi yid 135

'u gnyis sdong margo gartsag la babs ba' bya man/sems chu dang 'o ma bzhin 'dres kyin gda'/ nged gnyis kyi rnam shes bsang rtsi dang dud zhags bzhin 'dres bzhin 'dug nged gnyis 'bral mi rung la/'bral thabs kyang ga la yod/ gal te 'di po mo'i brtse dung yin tshe ngas yod tshad blos gtong dgos kyang phangs med 'gyod med yin/ kho mos de ltar bsam la de ltar bgyi dgos par rang sems naspodam bca' yang bcag kho mo la phrad pa nas kho yang phyi nas de 'dra mi ldom par snga mor sdod shag tu log la/ mo dang mo'i tsha mo gnyis tshur mgron du'ang 'bod/ kho tsho mnyam du ku re rtses shing kha brda byas/ mnyam rtsed dang mnyam rol gyis mo'i lus kyi ngal dub sel bar byas 9shu/ kho la spro skyid rdzogs med cig bskyal yong / kho bza' tshang yod pa zhig yin yang mo 'di kho nas kho la sngon chad ma myangs pa'i mi yul gyi drod 'khol dang 'tsho ba'i zhim mngar zhig myong du bcug spro skyid dang zhim mngar 'di kho'i chung ma'i rtsib na mi 'dug kho'i snang ngo na kho dang chung ma gnyis lhas ra gcig gi lug lta bu ste/ de ni rdzi bos la lung mi gcig so so nas ded yong ba ste/ rtswa ram dkar mnyam za byed kyang / kha'i 'ba' sgra sgrog tshul mi gcig la/ mgo'i ra rtsed byed stangs kha kha red/ thag ring nas yong ba'i rgyu med 'khos chung gi bu mo 'dir bal 'jam po yi ngang rgyud ldan la/ dkar 'o ma lta bu'i sems de ldan/ 'jig rten gyi lugs dang mi kha dang bskun na nged gnyis 'di ltar 'grogs shing brtse ba ni ma rung tha shal zhig yin mod/ lhad med dag gtsang dang ra ri dri mas ma gos pa'i zla ba de mkha' ru 'phags na/136

'u gnyis sdong margo gcig la babs ba'i bya min/sems chu dang 'o ma bzhin 'dres kyin gda'/ nged gnyis kyi rnam shes bsang rtsi dang dud zhags bzhin 'dres bzhin 'dug nged gnyis 'bral mi rung la/'bral thabs kyang ga la yod/ gal te 'di pho mo'i brtse dung yin tshe ngas yod tshad blos gtong dgos kyang phangs med 'gyod med yin/ kho mos de ltar bsam la de ltar bgyi dgos par rang sems nasadam bca' yang bcag kho mo la phrad pa nas kho yang phyi nas de 'dra mi ldom par snga mor sdod shag tu log la/ mo dang mo'i tsha mo gnyis tshur mgron du'ang 'bod/ kho tsho mnyam du ku re rtses shing kha brda byas/ mnyam rtsed dang mnyam rol gyis mo'i lus kyi ngal dub sel bar byas 9// kho la spro skyid rdzogs med cig bskyal yong / kho bza' tshang yod pa zhig yin yang mo 'di kho nas kho la sngon chad ma myangs pa'i mi lus gyi drod 'khol dang 'tsho ba'i zhim mngar zhig myong du bcug spro skyid dang zhim mngar 'di kho'i chung ma'i rtsib na mi 'dug kho'i snang ngo na kho dang chung ma gnyis lhas ra gcig gi lug lta bu ste/ de ni rdzi bos la lung mi gcig so so nas ded yong ba ste/ rtswa ram dkar mnyam za byed kyang / kha'i 'ba' sgra sgrog tshul mi gcig la/ mgo'i ra rtsed byed stangs kha kha red/ thag ring nas yong ba'i rgyu med 'khos chung gi bu mo 'dir bal 'jam po yi ngang rgyud ldan la/ dkar 'o ma lta bu'i sems de ldan/ 'jig rten gyi lugs dang mi kha dang bstun na nged gnyis 'di ltar 'grogs shing brtse ba ni ma rung tha shal zhig yin mod/ lhad med dag gtsang dang ra ri dri mas ma gos pa'i zla ba de mkha' ru 'phags na/136

dacal mirna mong /sprin nag gis bsgrib dgos don ga la yod/ gza' yis gzung don ci la yod/red de/ kho ni mtho go gnas dang phogs thob pa/ nang shes rgya 'dzoms pa'i shes ldan pa zhig mo ni ka ngo yig ngo mi chod pa'i zhing ba'i bu mo zhig 'di ni kho gnyis kyi khyad par yin yang / mthar thug gi khyad par yin nam/ nged gnyis la mchog dman med la/ nged gnyis bar du mtho dma' yi khyad par med/ bdag dang kho mo gnyis phreng thag gcig la brgyus pa'i byi ru dmar chung gnyis yin tsa na/ las 'brel 'di su zhig gis bshig phod/ khos skabs rer 'di ltar dran 'ong ste mi kha yi rlung nag la g.yol ched/ kho dang kho mo gnyis thag ring thag ring zhig la 'phur te rang la dbang ba'i tshang zhig bzos te/rgum bu mnyam 'thu yi 'tsho ba rol na bzang snyam/ khos rang gi 'dod blo de kho mo la gleng ba na/ kho mo yid rab tu mgu ba'i brda la mig kong nas zer ma 'khrug mod/ zer ma de skad cig 'a/ yal zhing smin dkyil la mun pa zhig 'thibs/ mos mgo bo dud de ci yang mi ཿ/ mo'i mig lam na bya gnyis rgyang ring du 'phur ba'i shul na/ bya gzhan zhig tshang du kher greng du lus shing / spu long ma rgyas pa'i bye'u zhig pha med par grang bas 'dar sig rgyag pa mthong /mo yang tshang du bamyur ba'i bya yin te/ drod yal ba'i bya tshang dang pha med pa'i bye'u chung gi sdug bsngal los shes/kho mo kho la gtan du 'grogs te tshe yi pha mthar dpung ba mnyam gshib kyis song 'dod/ mo rang kho'i mtho dang go sar chags pa min la/ kho'i rgyu la 137

dngul mirna long /sprin nag gis bsgrib dgos don ga la yod/ gza' yis gzung don ci la yod/red de/ kho ni mtho go gnas dang phogs thob pa/ nang shes rgya 'dzoms pa'i shes ldan pa zhig mo ni ka ngo yig ngo mi chod pa'i zhing ba'i bu mo zhig 'di ni kho gnyis kyi khyad par yin yang / mthar thug gi khyad par yin nam/ nged gnyis la mchog dman med la/ nged gnyis bar du mtho dma' yi khyad par med/ bdag dang kho mo gnyis phreng thag gcig la brgyus pa'i byi ru dmar chung gnyis yin tsa na/ las 'brel 'di su zhig gis bshig phod/ khos skabs rer 'di ltar dran 'ong ste mi kha yi rlung nag la g.yol ched/ kho dang kho mo gnyis thag ring thag ring zhig la 'phur te rang la dbang ba'i tshang zhig bzos te/rgum bu mnyam 'thu yi 'tsho ba rol na bzang snyam/ khos rang gi 'dod blo de kho mo la gleng ba na/ kho mo yid rab tu mgu ba'i brda la mig kong nas zer ma 'khrug mod/ zer ma de skad cig 0/ yal zhing smin dkyil la mun pa zhig 'thibs/ mos mgo bo dud de ci yang mi sga mo'i mig lam na bya gnyis rgyang ring du 'phur ba'i shul na/ bya gzhan zhig tshang du kher treng du lus shing / spu long ma rgyas pa'i bye'u zhig pha med par grang bas 'dar sig rgyag pa mthong /mo yang tshang du bskyur ba'i bya yin te/ drod yal ba'i bya tshang dang pha med pa'i bye'u chung gi sdug bsngal los shes/kho mo kho la gtan du 'grogs te tshe yi pha mthar dpung ba mnyam gshib kyis song 'dod/ mo rang kho'i mtho dang go sar chags pa min la/ kho'i rgyu la 137

'u gnyis sdong maspogadzig la babs pa'i pya na/zhen pa de bas kyang min/ kho dang 'grogs te rma shor ba'i sems khams 'di gso bzhin/ zas kham gang yod na mnyam za dang las khem gang yodan mnyam las byed pa'i khyo shug gi 'tsho ba tsam rol 'dod pa de yin/ 'di ni mtho rgyu med pa'i re ba yin mod/ re ba 'di tsam yang mos mngon 'gyur bub bag kho ni bza' tshang yod pa zhig ste kho gnyis lhan du 'dug dgos na bzang tshang kha khar gtong dgos/ rang gi skyid de gzhan gyi sdug du 'bab/ mo.oṃ'adi ltar bsam skabs khyo bral mo greng gi sdug bsngal de mig gis mngon sum bzhin mthong 'ong zhing / pha med bu phrug cig gi ngu 'bod rna bas thos bzang tshang gi bar du lding bar mo nga mi mdza' la/ khyim bza' tshang la gakrigs shing 'phen rgyu ngas ci la spobs/ kho mos rang steng la dpe blangag gzhan steng la 'dang mang du brgyab mthar kho mo kho la cis kyang 'bral dgos snyam/ thengs shig la kho mos‘‘'u gnyis las shig gis sdong mgo gcig la babs pa'i bya gnyis te/mnyam 'gur mnyam rtsen byed de gsung snyan mo dbyings su bsgrags mod/ tshang gcig la 'du ba'i las 'u gnyis la med ces go rgyu can zhig bshad mod/khos‘ nga'i 'asur gi 'asur grogs khyod yin la/ nga'i rgyam bu 'bu rogs khyod yin/ bya gzhan la 'grogs 'dod ngar med la/ tshang de la log 'dod ngar 2da ces brtan brling dang blo thag bcad de smras byung / kho ni khathog tshig thog dang tshig thog don thog la 'bebs mkhan zhig yin par kho mor yid ches mnga' mod/ 'on kyang kho gnyis 'grogs tshe skyo gar dang sdug bsngal gyi gzhi ru 138

'u gnyis sdong mgogacig la babs pa'i rgya na/zhen pa de bas kyang min/ kho dang 'grogs te rma shor ba'i sems khams 'di gso bzhin/ zas kham gang yod na mnyam za dang las khem gang yodan mnyam las byed pa'i khyo shug gi 'tsho ba tsam rol 'dod pa de yin/ 'di ni mtho rgyu med pa'i re ba yin mod/ re ba 'di tsam yang mos mngon 'gyur thub bag kho ni bza' tshang yod pa zhig ste kho gnyis lhan du 'dug dgos na bzang tshang kha khar gtong dgos/ rang gi skyid de gzhan gyi sdug du 'bab/ mo 'di ltar bsam skabs khyo bral mo treng gi sdug bsngal de mig gis mngon sum bzhin mthong 'ong zhing / pha med bu phrug cig gi ngu 'bod rna bas thos bzang tshang gi bar du lding bar mo nga mi mdza' la/ khyim bza' tshang la gakrigs shing 'phen rgyu ngas ci la spobs/ kho mos rang steng la dpe blangag gzhan steng la 'dang mang du brgyab mthar kho mo kho la cis kyang 'bral dgos snyam/ thengs shig la kho mos‘‘'u gnyis las shig gis sdong mgo gcig la babs pa'i bya gnyis te/mnyam 'phur mnyam rtsen byed de gsung snyan mo dbyings su bsgrags mod/ tshang gcig la 'du ba'i las 'u gnyis la med ces go rgyu can zhig bshad mod/khos‘ nga'i 'bur gi 'gur grogs khyod yin la/ nga'i rgum bu 'thu rogs khyod yin/ bya gzhan la 'grogs 'dod ngar med la/ tshang de la log 'dod ngar med ces brtan brling dang blo thag bcad de smras byung / kho ni khathog tshig thog dang tshig thog don thog la 'bebs mkhan zhig yin par kho mor yid ches mnga' mod/ 'on kyang kho gnyis 'grogs tshe skyo gar dang sdug bsngal gyi gzhi ru 138

dngul gyi rnamong /'gro ba las 'os med/ kho mo gtam mi kha dang skad cha ldom po la skrag rgyu med mod/ skra lan bu thogs pa 'dra 'dra yin pa'i cha nas ma bu mo zhig la 'dang rgyag dgos la/ 'jig rten gyi spom yin pa'i cha nas bu phrug cig la 'dang rgyag dgos/ mo sems kyi gting rim nas kho la dungs shing zhe nas 'khreng mod/tshe grogs su 'gyur ba'i smon lam mi 'dug pas kho mos lkog tu mchi ma dku bzhin ngu bshum brgyab/rnyi ba rko mtshams 'jog par da dung nyin bcu lhag mchis ma da/ kho mo kho dang gyes te phyir rang ge yul du log par sems thag bcad/ kha rog ger khur bo dang nyal gdan sogs sdud gsog brgyab/ sang nyin gye bral gyi nyin mo yin (5 nga mos kho la gsang ste tshig sne tsam yang ma phud/ gyes bral zhu rtsis kyang meg dgong mo der kho rang gnyid du yur ba dngaka kho mo skyo gdung gis yid sems 'thag par byas/ mchi ma mi tshogs pa ra chu bzhin bzhur/ kho mo rang gi las dbang bsam ste ngus la / 'jig rten mi rtag pa dang rmi lam gyi rang bzhin 'di la yid chad dang nges 'byung skyeg sang nyin nam langs dus mos kho bskyur te lam la chas dgos/ kho mos rang gi snying gi dum bu 'di bskyur te 'gro dgos/ kho mos 'thob chog pa gzhan la bzhag ste bzhud dgog sa mo kho dang 'bral 'dod med la/ kho gcig bur bskyur bar sems kyis mi bzod mod/ da 'di ltar bgyi ba las thabs ci/ rmi lam khral khrul dang mchi ma'i rab rib khrod skya mda' rim gyis btangaka kho mo rkang 'jab lag 'jab dang sems 139

dacal gyi rnatshang /'gro ba las 'os med/ kho mo gtam mi kha dang skad cha ldom po la skrag rgyu med mod/ skra lan bu thogs pa 'dra 'dra yin pa'i cha nas ma bu mo zhig la 'dang rgyag dgos la/ 'jig rten gyi spom yin pa'i cha nas bu phrug cig la 'dang rgyag dgos/ mo sems kyi gting rim nas kho la dungs shing zhe nas 'khring mod/tshe grogs su 'gyur ba'i smon lam mi 'dug pas kho mos lkog tu mchi ma dku bzhin ngu bshum brgyab/rnyi ba sko mtshams 'jog par da dung nyin bcu lhag mchis ma da/ kho mo kho dang gyes te phyir rang ge yul du log par sems thag bcad/ kha rog ger khur bo dang nyal gdan sogs sdud gsog brgyab/ sang nyin gyetha zal gyi nyin mo yin rdzuri nga mos kho la gsang ste tshig sne tsam yang ma phud/ gyes bral zhu rtsis kyang meg dgong mo der kho rang gnyid du yur ba dngaka kho mo skyo gdung gis yid sems 'thag par byas/ mchi ba mi tshogs pa ra chu bzhin bzhur/ kho mo rang gi las dbang bsam ste ngus la / 'jig rten mi rtag pa dang mi lam gyi rang bzhin 'di la yid chad dang nges 'byung skyeg sang nyin nam langs dus mos kho bsur te lam la chas dgos/ kho mos rang gi snying gi dum bu 'di bsgyur te 'gro dgos/ kho mos 'thob chog pa gzhan la bzhag ste bzhud dgog kho mo kho dang 'bral 'dod med la/ kho gcig bur basmyur bar sems kyis mi bzod mod/ da 'di ltar bgyi ba las thabs ci/ rmi lam khral khrul dang mchi ma'i rab rib khrod skya mda' rim gyis btangaka kho mo rkang 'jab lag 'jab dang sems 139

'u gnyis sdong mgogargyag la babs ba'i rgya min/chung nem chung ngang mal las langs/ gon pa rnams gyon yag byas rjes kho'i gdong la bltas/ khos da dung mi lam gyi bde ba nyams su myong gin 'dugasdur ba yang mor 'then zhing mchu sgros kyi zum na zhim mngar 'khyil 'dug mo'i sems su skyur sha langs/ kho mo yud tsam la nyal khri'i 'gram du langag phyis su kho dang 'phrad thub bam/ snying mgor ci zhig gis sbar 'brad byed pa ltar sngar med kyi na zug skyes la/ mig zung mchi mas bsgribs/ mos 'dar bzhin pa'i mchu sgros phar bsrings te kho'i thod par 'o zhig byas/ de nas sdid tig ger gom kha phyi ru bsgyur/ sgo phyes te mtha' mjug gi phyir mig de 'phangs rjes ga ler sgo ru bud/kho mo dang tsha mo gnyis lam la chas pa'i nangs mo 'dir char bzem zim 'bab kyin 'dug la/ phyogs bzhi'i sgang rgyud tshang ma thog zin khrod na had 'dug kho mo sge'u khung gi rtsa ru bsdad de phyi rol du bltag de ring rang gi skyes sa 'tshar sa'i pha yul la 'gro ba yin yang / mo'i yid sems kyi spang thang kha ba dang thig pas mnan 'dug kho mos de ring snying tshal bar gshags pa'i bral gdung dang na zug lag pas skyon bzhin 'gro gin yod/ snying nye lagag khyod kyis nga rang khyod dang 'bral bar brtse med dang glo bur zhig red ma 'dod dang / de ring yang nga'i ya chung gangs dkur gyi sems la sdug gi ri rab brtsegs shing / glo dang mazin pa'i bar na sdug gi rgya mtsho 'khyil yod ya/bdag gis da ring mi chod pa zhig btsan gyis gcod kyin yod la/ mi bzod pa 1nya)

dngul gyi rna long /lo 'di dag la sde ba'i nang gi pho mo rnams 'brog phyogs su song ste dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu rko ba dang zhor las sogs gnyer te yong 'bab cung bzang stabs/ gsar bu rnams phyir yul du log pa dang phan tshun khog dpung la rgya brtsad de sbag sbag 'khor lo nyo ba dang / bu mo tshos kyang gcig gis gcig la 'gran res byas te sram nyo ba'am rgyan cha nyos te dus chen gyi skabs su lus la spras te gzhan la ngoms/ zhing sde'i bu mo la mtshon na 'brog gi gzhon nu ma dang 'dra bar g.yu dang byu ru 'dogs pa'i 'byor ba med na yang / gser gyi rna tog cig 'dogs rgyu ni kho mo tsho'i mems su nyar ba'i re smon zhig yin la/mtshan mo'i rmi lam du shar ba'i mtshar sdug gi ri mo zhig yin no/ /su zhig gis rna tog nyos te btags na tshang ma thab ku'i khar rub ste rna tog de'i sdid tshad dang che chung / bzo rtsal gleng bar byed/ mig sngar sde ba'i nang na mace dpa' mo'i gser gyi rna tog las che ba zhig mi 'dug sde mi rnams ma ṇi khang du 142

dacal gyi rnasnye'ong /dang / dkyil mdzub/ srin mdzub bcas la gser gyi mdzub dkris re bskon 'dug la/ tha na gyen du badzes pa'i kha'i mdun so dag kyang gser gyis shan te ser kag ser snang / yid phangs pa zhig la kho rang 'brog phrug gzhan dang 'dra ba'i gzugs stobs med pa'i khar cung skur to yin la/ mig gnyis kyang cha ga babs med par zur gsum phag gi mig dang mtshungs/ de'i khar ngo gdong nag la ngo zheng che bas dom dred cig la kun nas mtshungs/ kho lta bu la rgyan chas spras pa ni yag tu mi 'gro bar btsog gi snon ma red/ mar los rdo rje 'tshos rang la zhib blta byed pa mthong ba dang / gzhon nu ma 'dis rang nyid blor 'bab 'dug snyam ste sems su mi dran dgu dran byed cing 'dod mthun gyi skad cha mang po 'dzem bag med par smras/ dbyar rtswa bsko sar bslebs pa dang /cha/ra los rdo rje 'tsho la gtad de‘‘khyod kyi lag nas sa rin len srog ji ltar chod/ sa rin phyogs la khyod kyis sems khur byed mi dgos/ rogs re byed dgos tshe nga la shod ces bshad rjes rta la lcag gis brad de rang tshang gi ru nang du bzhud/do tshigs ci zhig yin nam/ na ning lta bu zhig brko rgyu mi 'dug rdo rje 'tsho dang pha yul gcig nas 'ong ba'i rko rogs bcas kyis brkos te nyin bcu lhag song yang dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu grangs ka mang po zhig lag tu ma son/ kho tsho nyin rer ri mgo nas phyir ngal gso sa'i gur nang du log skabs/ tshang ma'i lag tu rkang thur 'ga' re las med pas re re'i gdong la ngal dub dang1 ṭwāṃ 7

dacapha gyi rna 'ong /zad kyi mdangs shig phyungs/ 'di ltar song na sa rin byin pa'i 'phro ma na ci zhig yod dam/ tshang mas shugs ring 'then zhing sems khur byas/ red ya/gser gyi rna tog ji ltar nyo/ rdo rje 'tsho pha yul nas 'ong khar re ba rdog rdog cig bzung ste yong ba yin mod/ da gnas tshul la bltas na re ba mngon du 'gyur rgyu khag po 'dug bsam thog la mi 'gro ba'i khar mar lo brdzi med de mo'i rjes su sha 'ded shu 'ded byas te mi gtong / kho mo mar lo rang gi mtha' khar sbrang ma 'khor 'khor byed par skyug log mod/ 'di ni kho tshang gi rtswa sa yin pas ngo gnag gnag byed ma phod/ mi rnams dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu brkos te khom med brel ba che skabs rkyal stong 'di gcig pu nyin rgyun rta la zhon te yar mar la myug te ha cang khom song ba'i snang ba ster/ kho dus dus su rdo rje 'tsho btsal te 'ong zhing / yong thengs rer mar dang rtsam pa/ zho sogs bsnams te 'ong / rdo rje 'tshos ma blangs par phyir 'khyer du bcug na/ mar los ci mi snyam par‘‘da 'u cag ngo shes red/ cha med ma bya/ nged cag 'brog par mtshon na 'di dag cang ma red ces bshad cing bzhag ste 'gro/ de bas rdo rje 'tshos kyang khyod kyis gzhan la sha mi tsha bar nga gcig pur sha tsha ba ya mtshan red/ khyod gtong phod che na ngas bza' thub dgos/ rdo rje 'tshos de ltar snyam pa dang mar los 'khyer yong ba dag der yod kyi rko rogs tshang mar bgos/ nyin zhig gi dgong khar rdo rje 'tsho dang mo'i rko rogs tsho ri 'go nas phyir 'dug sar log pa na/ mar lo rta zhig la zhon te lam skug byed de 'dug148
