dadul gyi rna yong /khos rdo rje 'tsho mthong ba dang rum nas chang dam bu zhig bton te mgo la g.yon rjes mo'i mdun nas bkag byung / rko rogs rnams sngun la cung tsam song ba dang / mar los dmar por gyur pa'i mig zung chung chung de btsum ma khad du rdo rje 'tsho'i gdong la gtad bzhin‘ khyod kyis da rag bar du nga'i re ba ma bskangs/ do dgong nga'i re ba skong ngam/ khyod kyis rum kha phyes dang bzang mang zhes bshad/ skad cha des rdo rje 'tsho la 'tshig pa za ru bcug mod/ phyir ngag 'jam pos ‘a gi 'di ltar byed ga la rung / gur nang na yang nga gcig bu min/ khyod ma yong zhes zhu ba byas/ mar los de mur ‘re ba skong na mi skong na de dgong yin/ nga yong na rum kha 'byed rgyu ma brjed ces bshad pa dang rta la phyir dkyus te bud song / rdo rje 'tshos mar lo'i rjes su blta bzhin skrag snang dang sems khral 'gran pa bzhin skyes pas/ yud tsam la de gar had de lus/ 'on kyang 'dug sar log pa dang lam bar nas 'phrad pa'i don de su la yang ma gleng / nub 'tshal 'thung tshar rjes tshang ma rang rang sar song ste ngal gsos byung / rko rags gsang bdag dang phag sgron gnyis nyin gang bor dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu btsal te thang chad drags pas mgo bo sngas la bzhag ma thag gnyid du yur/ yin na yang bu mo rdo rjo 'tsho la gnyid rgyu gang na yod/ de ring lam bar nas mar los kho mo la btsan gtam 'dres ma zhig bshad de kho'i re ba skong dgos zer/ mos mar lo'i gdong gi rnam 'gyur de dran byung bas rang dbang med par nag li blangs de sngas 'gram du bzhag nam phyed la nye 149

dacal gyi rna tshang /yang bskyar thug du ma bcug 'on kyang chang gi bzi shugs dang chags sred 'phel ba'i mar los rang dgar ga la bskyur/ kho rdo rje 'tsho yi gam la btud de‘‘do dgong kher bor nga khyod kyi rtsib nas nyal du chugs dang / ngas khyod la khis gi 'jug na pha ma'i sha zhes bshad byung la/ da dung kho'i 'dod pa dang bstun na sa rin mi len pa ma zad/ gser gyi rna long zhig kyang nyo ba'i khas blangs/ mar lo ni mi bltas mdog med pa cig yin mod/ bu mo tsho 'gug thabs dang mgo bskor thabs shes pa ma zad/ bu mo tsho ci zhig la dga' ba dang ci zhig la zhen chags che ba khos gsal bor rtogs 'dug bu mo rdo rje 'tsho yang gser gyi rna tog 'dogs par dga' zhing re ba che mod/ de ni gzhan gyis snying rje'i tshul du gnang ba'am rang lus nor la brje ste thob 'dod pa min par rang gi lag zung la brten te 'thob rgyu de min nam/ mar los bshad pa'i skad cha la nyan pa dang rang la dma' 'bebs dang brnyas bcos tshad med bzos pa ltar zhe sdang dang zhe mer ba zhig byung / nga'i rang lus gtsang ma 'di zhi lu gtor ma 'dra bo khyod kyis brlag rgyu zer na nga mi min/ kho mo zhe sdang dang la rgya langs na yang tshig sgo gsal mos‘‘nga zhi mo rgyu med dbul bo zhig yin kyang /nga dma' 'bebs dang dman sar 'god chog pa zhig min la/ khyod kyis dran pa ltar ri nyal thang nyal byed ni zhig de bas kyang min kho mo'i skad gdangs la zhe sdang dang skyo snang 'dres shing / rno ngar gyi tshig mda' re re don dang ldan/'on kyang nyam chung bu mo zhig gi ngag las thon pa'i skad cha des 'dod chags 151

dadul gyi rna mong /yang bskyar thug du ma bcug 'on kyang chang gi bzi shugs dang chags sred 'phel ba'i mar los rang dgar ga la bskyur/ kho rdo rje 'tsho yi gam la btud de‘‘do dgong kher bor nga khyod kyi rtsib nas nyal du chugs dang / ngas khyod la khis gi 'jug na pha ma'i sha zhes bshad byung la/ da dung kho'i 'dod pa dang bstun na sa rin mi len pa ma zad/ gser gyi rna long zhig kyang nyo ba'i khas blangs/ mar lo ni mi bltas mdog med pa cig yin mod/ bu mo tsho 'gug thabs dang mgo bskor thabs shes pa ma zad/ bu mo tsho ci zhig la dga' ba dang ci zhig la zhen chags che ba khos gsal bor rtogs 'dug bu mo rdo rje 'tsho yang gser gyi rna tog 'dogs par dga' zhing re ba che mod/ de ni gzhan gyis snying rje'i tshul du gnang ba'am rang lus nor la brje ste thob 'dong pa min par rang gi lag zung la brten te 'thob rgyu de min nam/ mar los bshad pa'i skad cha la nyan pa dang rang la dma' 'bebs dang brnyas bcos tshad med bzos pa ltar zhe sdang dang zhe mer ba zhig byung / nga'i rang lus gtsang ma 'di zhi lu gtor ma 'dra bo khyod kyis brlag rgyu zer na nga mi min/ kho mo zhe sdang dang la rgya langs na yang tshig sgo gsal mos ‘nga zhi mo rgyu med dbul bo zhig yin kyang /nga dma' 'bebs dang dman sar 'god chog pa zhig min la/ khyod kyis dran pa ltar ri nyal thang nyal byed ni zhig de bas kyang min kho mo'i skad gdangs la zhe sdang dang skyo snang 'dres shing / rno ngar gyi tshig mda' re re don dang ldan/'on kyang nyam chung bu mo zhig gi ngag las thon pa'i skad cha des 'dod chags 151

dngul gyi rna mong /kyis myos pa'i gcan gzan gtum po de'i sder mo bskum par byed thub bam/thabs zad pa'i gsar bu mar lo bsam dbang dran dbang med parardo rje 'tsho'i steng la lding / mo 'og tu mnan te btsan g.yem bgyi grabs byas pa na/rdo rje 'tshos de ring srog shor dgos kyang nga kha rog mi 'dug kho thag yin zhes skad cor rgyag bzhin 'phag ra byas/ zhe sdang gi dbang gis yin nag gar 'ong mi shes pa'i stobs shugs shig gis mo ni rnyi thag gtor ba'i gla bzhin de'i 'og nas bde blag du thar/ de 'phral nag li lag tu blangs/ zed ser yar la langs te ‘da khyod kyis nga la cig thug na yur dum pa zhes skad shugs chen pos bshad/ skabs 'dir mar lo ni thang na sbal ba bzhin kha bub tu 'gyel 'dug kho yar langs te bltas pa na rdo rje 'tshosakag li dam por 'ching zhing /kho la gtad pa'i mig de che ru gdangs la de las dbal gyi zer ma 'khrigs kyin 'dug mgo gzing nger 'dug pas bltas na 'jigs su rung / nam rgyun ngang rgyud dul ba g.yang mo lug dang 'dra ba'i bu mo 'di da lta stag mo zhig tu gyur ba mar lo la mtshon na glo bur ba zhig red/ da rtsib la btud tshe mos lag 'gul bar the mi tshom/ gur nang gi 'ur sgra dang g.yo 'gul gyi sgra sogs kyis gsang bdag dang phag sgron gnyis kyang gnyid lasabasladas song / kho gnyis yar la langs te bltas pa na don dag ci zhig byung ba tshor byung bas/ gnyis nas rang rang gi kug li lag la blangs tephango tsha rgyu med no khyod phyir 'gro thub bam zhes mar lor gtad pa na/ mar lo dbang med du phyir bkyed byed 152

dacal gyi rna tshang /kyis myos pa'i gcan gzan gtum po de'i sder mo bskum par byed bub bam/thabs zad pa'i gsar bu mar lo bsam dbang dran dbang med pararo rje 'tsho'i steng la lding / mo 'og tu mnan te btsan g.yem bgyi grabs byas pa na/rdo rje 'tshos de ring srog shor dgos kyang nga kha rog mi 'dug kho thag yin zhes skad cor rgyag bzhin 'phag ra byas/ zhe sdang gi dbang gis yin nag gar 'ong mi shes pa'i stobs shugs shig gis mo ni gyi thag gtor ba'i gla bzhin de'i 'og nas bde blag du thar/ de 'phral kag li lag tu blangs/ zed ser yar la langs te‘‘da khyod kyis nga la cig thug na yum dum pa zhes skad shugs pos bshad/ skabs 'dir mar lo ni thang na sbal ba bzhin kha bub tu 'gyel 'dug kho yar langs te bltas pa na rdo rje 'tshospokag li dam por 'ching zhing /kho la gtad pa'i mig de che ru gdangs la de lasarno dbal gyi zer ma 'khrigs kyin 'dug mgo skyazing nger 'dug pas bltas na 'jigs su rung / nam rgyun ngang rgyud dul ba g.yang mo lug dang 'dra ba'i bu mo 'di da lta stag mo zhig tu gyur ba mar lo la mtshon na glo bur ba zhig red/ da jib la btud tshe mos lag 'gul bar the mi chom/ gur nang gi 'ur sgra dang g.yo 'gul gyi sgra sogs kyis gsang bdag dang phag sgron gnyis kyang gnyid lasabasladas song / kho gnyis yar la langs te bltas pa na don dag ci zhig byung ba tshor byung bas/ gnyis kas rang rang gi kag li lag la blangs tephango tsha rgyu med no khyod phyir 'gro thub bam zhes mar lor gtad pa na/ mar lo dbang thed du phyir bkyed byed 152

dadul gyi rna mong /dgos byung / skrag snang dang ngo tsha zhig gis da lta kho'i bzi yang je dwangs su song zin/ ngo ma mar lo de ring ma gtogs kha yag dang rgyu yis 'gug mi thub pa'i bu mo zhig la ma 'phrad/ ji 'dra'i bu mo brtan tshugs dang btsan po zhig red ang / khos yang bskyar rdo rje 'tsho yi gdong la blta mi spobs par gyur/ re ba stong zad du gyur ba'i kho phrag sha lhod/ ngo gdong skya log ger gur las bud/rta'i rmig sgra rim gyis thag ring du yal/ shul du bu mo gsum po phan tshun la 'tham ste dga' bas dgod sgra 'byin la skabs der skyo snang zhig skyes te ngu skad phyungs/ snying 'jags mtshan mo'i mkha' dbyings su kho mo tsho'i gnyom la dwangs pa'i sgra dbyangs gzhe gcig tu 'dres te 'tho ra gyin 'dugade'i rjes su gsar bu mar lo rdo rje 'tsho btsal du ma 'ong la/ 'khon lan slog pa sogs kyang byed ma byung / phal cher rdo rje 'tsho yi mdun nas slob gso tshan mo zhig 'thob pa 'dra/ kho ngo tshos sems bde bde ngang du dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu brkos/ brko kyin brgo kyin kho tshos rim gyis mang bo zhig brko thub byung la/lhag tu 'bu tshang la thug tshe grangs ka dga' 'os pa zhig rnyed pa red/ rdo rje 'cho'i pham la nye ba'i sems la slar yang spro snang dang yid ches kyis brtas/brko mtshams 'jog la nye dus kho mos khog rtsis shig brgyab pa na/ sa rin sob pa ma zad/ rang la gser gyi rna tog cig kyang rdung thub pa rtogs/ pha yul gcig nas 'ong ba'i kho tshos sa rin 'jal rjes phyir khul srid gzhung chags sa'i grong brdal de ru log da lta tshang ma'i lag na sgor mo yod pas grong brdal 153

dadrul gyi rna mong /myug ste rang la mkho ba'i nyo cha rgyag gin 'dug rdo rje 'tsho dang gsang bdagaphag sgron gsum po yang da ci ri nas yong khar bshad thog gcig la bzhag pa nang bzhin mgar ba ming grags can de'i sar gser gyi rna tog rdung du song /'on kyang mgar ba'i sar thon pa na rdo rje 'tsho tshig 'gyur te gser ma nyos/grogs mo gnyis 'dang ma phog par‘‘khyod kyis da reg bar du gser gyi da tog ces gleng bzhin yod pa min nam/ da sgor mo yod dus mi rdung ba ci yin zhes dris par/ mos‘ gser gong mtho 'dug ces dzun bshad/ mgar ba bsam shes des mgo yar la 'gyog bzhin‘ zhi mo/ kha sang de ring gser gong dma' dus red/ nye na sto ran red ces bshad mod/ rdo rje 'tshos ma go ba ltar‘‘nga la dngul gyi rna long zhig rdung na chog ces bshad byung / rdo rje 'tsho yang gsang bdag dang pag sgron gnyis ltar gser gyi rna tog 'dogs par ring nas smon pa smos ma dgos mod/ 'on te da thengs gser gyi rna tog nyos na 'phro mar sgor mo cang mi 'u sa pa kho mos gsal bor sheg mal sar lhung ba'i pha la sman dang bcud rdzas nyo bar sgor mo mkho la/ mam la yang gon pa zhig ma nyos na ga la 'grig yoms da reg bar du sdug mthong yang gon pa mdza' mo zhig rgyab tu ma blangs ma myong / mi mang chogs sa zhig la gon rgyu dga' zhig med mi rung / mos da thengs rang gi yomar yin gcig min gnyis kyis phrug lu zhig nyo dgos snyam/bod zla drug pa'i nang sde ba 'di'i phyi phyogs su song ba'i zhor las pa 154

dacal gyi rna tshang /rnams snga gzhug byed de rang rang gi yul du log drug pa'i bco lnga'i nyin ni sa 'di'i gzhi bdag po gsum gyi lab tse gzhi gcig tu bstod pa'i nyin mo yin pas/ nyin 'dir lung ba'i nyin srib gnyis na chags pa'i sde ba so so'i pho mo rgan gzhon ma lus lus la shom lu gon te lab tse bstod sar 'gro ba yin pas/ mi tshogs rgyas shing ltad mo che/ gsar bu 'ga' re ma'o tho 'khor lor zhon te yar rgyugs mar rgyugs byed cing / 'ga' res sdong ra'i bsil grib 'og na dbu chang 'thung bzhin rang gi blor 'bab pa'i bu mo re yod med la mig gis rig rig blta/ sman shar tshos gos sram kha ma gyon/ mgo la li mo mnabs/ ske rgyan dang rna rgyan btags te skor dang skor byas te 'gro/ rig rtsal 'khrab ston byed sa de ni mi mang 'du sa dang ltad mo ches che sa red/ ltad mo ba'i nang na gser gyi rna long dang rna tog btags pa'i bu mo gang mang mang 'dug de lta na yang mi mang gi gras nas yag mo sgo lhang la 'bud zer ba dzun ga la yin/ bu mo brgya 'dus stong 'dus yin yang dngul gyi rna long btags pa'i rdo rje 'tsho lhang nger gsal/ mo'i skyes gzugs mda' las drang la sha rtsa dkar/ lan bu ring zhing sbom/ dngul gyi rna long zung kho mor ha cang 'phrod la rgyan char mjos/ mo'i mtha' 'khor gyi gser gyi rna long dag kyang bkrag mdangs yal/ nyin der bu mo gsang bdag dang phag sgron gnyis kyi mig lam na kho tsho sde ba'i rdo rje 'tsho ni bya brgya'i khrod kyi mi bya bzhin mdzes shing sgeg pas kho mo gnyis nga'o snyam zhing dbang med du yin smon skyeg ngo ma mardzas ma 155

dacal gyi rna 'ong /'dra red ces dris byung / gong de dma' song ba min nam/ kha che tshong ba'i g.yo sgyu'i 'dzum mdangs des kho la 'tshug pa za ru bcug mod/ kho gnyis kyi tshong 'di gzhan gyis tshor mi nyan pa'i tshong rgyag stangs khyad par ba zhig yin sta bas khos mdzo de gong sla mor btsong dgos byung / za khang gi bdag po de mur khang phug tu song ste sgor mo 'khyer yong / sgor mo stong dang lnga brgya shag shag brtsis te rta lo la byin/ da ni sgor mo spam mthug po cig yod gyur pas bang khug speg speg dang za rkyang dang 'thung rkyang yin/ rta lo thog mar mgron khang dga' zhig tu song ste tho 'god byas rjes za khang du za ma bza' ru phyin/za khang nas rgyas za rgyas 'thung byed tshar ba dang sgregs sgyugs byed bzhin srang du 'khor/ kho tshong khang dang the'u chu'u spo lo khang nyul/ de nas sho rgyag sar phyin/rta lo sho rgyag rgyur dga' mod ma rtsa mang bo zhig med na sho ya tsho'i 'gran yar mi 'ong bas kho de ru yud tsam shāshu bsdad rjes phyir 'khor tewang du song / lag mgo'i dus tshod la bltas pa na da dung snga bas 'di 'dra'i snga mor nyal na gnyid ga la khugs/ nyal rogs shig btsal na 'grig 'dug snyam/ rta lo chang khang du 'dzul/ kha sang de ring sras mo dag gi gong yang dus tshigs rang bzhin gyi tshong rdzas ltar bstod 'dug mod rta los blor babs pa'i bu mo zhig bsal te khrid/ phyi nyin nyin gung la nye ba dang kho da gzod mal las langs/ sgor khug nang la bltas pa na phyed ka tshar yag byas zin/ 'on kyang nyin gcig gi za 'thung gi phyogs la sems khur byed mi dgos pa red/ khos nangs ja 'thung 159

byamasasnyeb/dgos snyam ste mgron khang nas bud pa na ru zhol ma'i ma sru zhig srang na yar rgyugs mar rgyugs byed bzhin sha 'tshong rgyag pa'i tshong pa dang za khang gi bdag po rnams la mdzo ser ser zhig khrid 'ong ba tsherig ces rtsad gcod kyin 'dug ma sru de'i skad cha'i gdangs la ngu ngag 'dres shing mdzo ma rnyed par smyo la khad du gyur 'dug rta los de mthong ba na rtab rtab por gyur la snying nyig lteg tu lding byung bas 'phral mar tshong khang du 'dzul te bzha'/ sketsi mdang dgong khrid 'ong ba'i mdzo rgan de ma sru gan tshang gi yin nam/ khos banus pa ni skyes pa med rma 'i ma sru khyim tshang gi red/ khos da dgong ded yong skabs su tshang gi yin par 'dang ma brgyab/ mdzo de 'byor ba bzang ba'i khyim tshang zhig gi yin na cis ma chog ma b.ri sum sa nas med po tshang zhig gi yin song / rta los ru zhol ma'i bud med nyam thag de mthong ba dang 'gyod pa phran tsam skyes byung / 'phro ma na da dung sgor mo bdun brgya lhag yod/ de bas sgor mo 'di dag dgong mor su la yang tshor du ma bcug par kha rog ger mo tshang gi lhas dkyil du 'phangs na mdzo bor song ba'i gyong gun cung tsam gsab thub la sems sdug je chung du 'gro bar phan na snyam/ rta los bkod pa 'di lag len du 'debs rtsis byas/ 'on kyang sgor mo 'di dag byin btang na khyod kyis ci zhig 'khol/ gsus pa stogs su 'jug rgyu yin nam/ yang gcig bshad na sngon chad lag bsrings bsrings thams cad khyim tshang phyug po tag tag gi ga la yin/khyim tshang med po rnams sems khur byed na khyim tshang rgyug po dag sems 'khur 160

dngul gyi rna long /mi byed pa'i nges pa ci/ khyod kyis gzhan la snying rje na sus khyod la snying rje/skabs der rta lo mi lus gcig can mi gnyis su gyur te gcig gis sgor mo de phyir slog bsam skabs cig shos des lag pa phyir bskums su 'jug yun ring zhig la 'gran rtsod byed mthar mi sngon ma des mi gzhug ma de ma thub par pham song / red ya/ rang gi kha las sngar nas dge med na da ni don dag bzang po zhig bsgrubs kyang gzhan pa ji ltar yid ches/ nga'i 'di glen 'dang min nam/khyod cag 'khor ba'i nang la lhung ste sdug gsog mug gsog dang ser snas bkol ma thub na ngas khyod tshor bkol rogs byed chog rta lo sems lhod la babs shing gdong nas khrel 'dzum zhig mngon/ kho nyin gang bor za khang dang tshong khang myug pa na 'phro ma'i sgo ra mo dag kyang gshog pa thogs pa bzhin kho'i lag nas yal/ rgyu mi rtag rtswa mapo/'i zil ba zer ba cis ma bden/ da yod na da med/ rta los rgyu yod pa'i skyid skad cig la myong zhing rgyu med pa'i sdug kyang de bzhin myong dgos byung / kho'i lag par za 'phrug che ru langs/ mun rub pa dang kho slar yang rku la chas/ khos re ba chen po zhig bzung ste zhing bar myul yang zhing nang na nyin dkar btang ba'i nor gyi snyi rlom dang / rta sbangs/ ril ma ma gtogs ci yang mthong rgyu mi 'dug sa re thag chad de phyir khyim du log dgos byung / phyi nas za ma zhim po bza' rgyur lobs song bas kho khyim gyi go re za 'dod med la mid par 'gro dka' bas/ yul nas 'dug mi tshugs par gyur/ phyi nyin yang rku la song mod/ kha sang bzhin lag stong la yong dgos byung /161

dadul gyirna mong /khug ma'i kha dam por bsdams pa dang phyi na grags 'gul med pa shes rjes gyang khar gla lding lding byas te skad cig la dgon pa nas yal bar byas/ a khu rnams tshogs grol te phyir log pa na grwa shag tu rkun ma 'dzul ba mthong bas dgon pa'i nang de ma thag zing zing long long du gyur/ rkun ma de ji 'dra'i 'dang rgyag med pa cig red ang / phyag bskor ba byed sa'i dgon pa'i nang la'ang lag bsrings phod/ rku la shor ba'i a khu tsho zhe sdang gis ma bzod pa ra‘‘a shi re kho/ rkun phrug de nga'i lag tu shor che/ nga la bkod pa zhig yod ces la ga mthil la mchil ma 'debs bzhin kha shom 'then/ go thos su rku la shorab de dag ches myug po'i gras ma red zer/ dgon pa 'di na da dung rgyu 'byor ba che ba'i rgyug po ming can skor zhig yod/ gang ltar brkus gyod byung ba'i nyin de nas yokhu tshos dogasazon gyi rig pa rno skud sgrin sgrin byas shing rin po che ma lus mis mi rig sa zhig tu bskung ci thub byas/ lhag par du a khu chos 'phel sems mi bde bar gyur/ kho tshogs su zhugs na yang sems su 'khor ba ni rang gi grwa shag dang rgyu nom pa dag red/ kho tshogs grol thengs rer thad kur grwa shag gtad de rgyugs ma lding gis yong zhing sbas pa'i rin po che dag 'tsham po bde mor bsdad yod pa mthong ba dang da gzod sems lhod la 'bab thub par gyur/ 'on kyang khu chos 'phel gyis sems lhod yag byed ga la thub/ rkun ma des brkus rdzas tshang ma longs su spyad tshar rjes phyir dgon par 'khor 'ong rgyu ni khos blos dpog thub/ ci la zhe na/ rku ma 'di kha za la 14

byams ba/dga' zhing lag na yod yod tshang ma bkol rgyu 'dang rgyag med pa'i mi ngan rengs shig yin pa de'i rku byed stangs las shes thub/ dngos gnas khu chos 'phel gyis tshod dpag byed pa bzhin rku ma rta los dgon pa nas banus pa de dag 'dod dgu longs spyod du bag med du bkol tshar rjes phyir dgon pa'i nang 'gro bar gra sgrig byas/ nyin zhig tshogs la nye skabs mkhu chos 'phel chab gsang du dgon 'dabs su song ba na/ sdong ra'i 'og gi de'u 'bur de'i phar nang nas mi zhig gi grib gzugs nag yor rer 'gul byung a khu chos 'phel gyis ci yang mi rig khul du 'don pa dbyangs la bkyags shing yar la langs te gzan thu sprugs sprugs byed bzhin tshogs chen 'du khang gi phyogs su phyin/ kho 'du khang nang 'dzul ba dang dbu mdzad kyi rna bar gtad de shab shub 'ga' bshad rjes phyir 'du khang nas bud cing gnya' ltem stem dang rkang 'jab lag 'jab ngang rang gi grwa shag tu 'dzul ba dang / nang sgo'i phag tu yib ste bsdad/rta lo'i sems la de ring yang rang gi 'dod thog tu 'ong bar the mi tshom zhing yokhu tshang ma tshogs la song yod shas snyam/ kho lding thengs shig gis sa gyang dma' mo de ru 'gos shing yar mar la mig nyul tsam byas rjes sems bde bde ngang nang du lding / 'on kyang kho las blo rig rno zhing spyad po yin pa'i yokhu zhig gis kho la sgrug yod pa klad pa'i dgu yul du'ang dran nam/ khu chos 'phel gyis rkun ma nang la 'dzul yag byed pa mthong pa dang‘‘ha ha/ rkun rgan khyod/ de ring lag tu shor ba min nam ci zhes ngar skad sgrogs bzhin 'phral mar sgo ru 164

dacal gyi rna tshang /phyin te phyi zwa sra mor brgyab jes‘‘rkun ma bzung btang zhes lhas dkyil nas gnam la lding bzhin skad brgyab pa na/ snga mo nas gra sgrig byas pa'i grwa ba rgod hrag 'gas shing dum re bzung ste nang du mchongs 'ong / grwa gzhon 'di dag dkor zas dkor bcud zos te sha rgyags rus rgyags kyi sgang yin pas rta lo ni rtsam pa brdzis brdzis byag kho tshos rku ma thag pas bkyigs te khang ba'i gnam du dpyangs/ de nas grwa gzhon dag gis kha 'gul ba'i zhor la lag 'gul/gcar rdung gi rtsal yid tshims pa zhig ngoms pa na tshogs kyang grol song bas a khu tshang ma rku ma 'dzin sa der slebs/ rku la shor ba'i a khu dag gis rang gis grong mtha' nyul nyul ba'i yong sgo dag rku phrug 'dis bag med du spyad de phyir yong med pa shes pa na phangs sems la zhe ldang 'dres/ sdig dmod la ngu skad bsres te 'dri rtsad byas/ res bskor te gcar rdung rgyad par rkun ma rta los zhu ba yang yang 'then yang a khu tshos mgo rnga med par rdung pas rta los kha nas smre sngags bton zhing gcin skyag rkang snam du shor/ dge bshes byams pa yong ste bshol 'debs dang kha ta mi byed rgyu na grwa gzhon de tshos gcar rdung gi mtshams 'jog mi 'dod pa red/ khong khro ma zhi ba'i a khu 'gas rta lo la gtad de‘‘phyin chad khyod 'di ru gom gang sbo sa ye yod blta zhes kha shom 'then bzhin lag gi shing dum bskyur te 'gro/ grwa gzhon gcig gnyis shig gis dge bshes kyi kha la nyan te rta lo gnam la dpyangs pa las grol pa dang g.yas g.yon nas bzung ste drud cing dgon 'dabs su g.yug ste bzhag gcar rdung 165

dadul gyi rna tshang /phyin te phyi zwa sra mor brgyab rjes‘ rkun ma bzung btang zhes lhas dkyil nas gnam la lding bzhin skad brgyab pa na/ snga mo nas gra sgrig byas pa'i grwa ba rgod hrag 'gas shing dum re bzung ste nang du mchongs 'ong / grwa gzhon 'di dag dkor zas dkor bcud zos te sha rgyags rus rgyags kyi sgang yin pas rta lo ni rtsam pa brdzis brdzis byag kho tshos rku ma thag pas bkyigs te khang ba'i gnam du dpyangs/ de nas grwa gzhon dag gis kha 'gul ba'i zhor la lag 'gul/gcar rdung gi rtsal yid tshims pa zhig ngoms pa na tshogs kyang grol song bas a khu tshang ma rku ma 'dzin sa der slebs/ rku la shor ba'i a khu dag gis rang gis grong mtha' nyul nyul ba'i yong sgo dag rku phrug 'dis bag med du spyad de phyir yong med pa shes pa na phangs sems la zhe sdang 'dres/ sdig dmod la ngu skad bsres te 'dri rtsad byas/ res bskor te gcar rdung rgyad par rkun ma rta los zhu ba yang yang 'then yang a khu tshos mgo rnga med par rdung pas rta los kha nas smre sngags bton zhing gcin skyag rkang snam du shor/ dge bshes byams pa yong ste bshol 'debs dang kha ta mi byed rgyu na grwa gzhon de tshos gcar rdung gi mtshams 'jog mi 'dod pa red/ khong khro ma zhi ba'i a khu 'gas rta lo la gtad de‘ phyin chad khyod 'di ru gom gang spo sa ye yod blta zhes kha shom 'then bzhin lag gi shing dum bskyur te 'gro/ grwa gzhon gcig gnyis shig gis dge bshes kyi kha la nyan te rta lo gnam la dpyangs pa las grol pa dang g.yas g.yon nas bzung ste drud cing dgon 'dabs su g.yug ste bzhag gcar rdung 165

byams pa/tshad med byas stabs rta lo ni phyi'i 'ba' 'bur thams cad nang la ded/ nang gi gsha' gzhong thams cad khrag gis bkang ba'i tshad la lhung / dran pa nyams med na yang na zug gis yar la langs mi thub pas gog ma nur gyis 'gro dgos byung / dge bshes byams pas tshul de mthong bas sems kyis ma bzod/khos yokhu rnams kyis mnyam mi 'jog pa'i skabs su rang gi shag tu 'khur yong nas rku ma'i kha ru rtsam ldud lud cing rma kha bkrus/ nyin 'ga' la bdag byed pa na rta lo'i na zug cung tsam 'jog thub byung / rkang ba 'theng na yang phar tshur ga meng 'gro thub/ dge bshes byams pas rta lo'i nazug bzhag ste rma kha yang sos la nye ba de mthong pa dang kho la phyin chad rku byed mi rung ba'i bslab bya gnang rjes lam la bcugagacar rdung mi 'dra ba zhig byas pas da ni rkun mas bsam shes yod la phyin chad rku rgyu sems la yang dran mi thub/ gcar rdungabyed mkhan gyi mkhu tshos gdeng tshod thug po'i ngang de ltar gleng / khu phyug po rnams de bas kyang sems bde bar gyur la tshogs la 'gro rkyang byed kyin 'dug rku ma la khrims lcag tsha mo gzhus pas dgon pa'i nang sngon ltar 'tshe med zhod 'jags su gyur/yin na yang phaṭakhu tsho'i rtsib nas ya rabs slob gso myangs pa des rta lo la go ma chod pa 'dra ste/ dus yun ring po zhig 'gor ba na kho'i lag par slar yang za 'phrug langs shing rang dgar 'dug mi bzod par gyur/ sngon chad kyi gcar rdung byed tshul de dran na ma khu tsho la skrag rgyu dang 'jigs rgyu zhig yong 166

dngul gyi rna mong /mod/ da lta dgon pa ma gtogs lag bsrings sa dga' zhig med pas/ kho slar yang nyen kha la ma 'dzems par dgon par song / 'on kyang a khu phyug po tshos sngon chad rku la shor ba'i bslab bya nan bsdoms byed par brten rgyu nom pa zhig mig brgyar sprul te btsal yang mthong sa na mi 'dug pas kho thengs re rer lag stong la yi mug ste yong dgos byung / da ni ci ltar bya dgos/ thabs ci zhig 'then na legs sam/ dkor gzan 'di tsho rig pa rgod pa la/ sgyu ma mkhan ji bzhin yod tshad gang zhig la bskungs te rig sa mthong sa na bzhag mi 'dug kho dgon pa 'di'i grwa shag yod yod po'i nang du 'dzul zin mod/ ma 'dzul pa gcig ni dge bshes byams pa tshang yin/ da ni 'dzul sa gzhan med pas dge bshes tshang gi bzhugs shag tu 'dzul ba las 'os ci/ dge bshes byams pa srog skyob kyi drin chen yin mod/ da lta rta lo 'u thug pas khrel med mi bya ka med red/ gal te stabs ma legs par dge bshes kyi lag tu tshud pa'i dbang du btang rung / dge bshes tshang a khu gzhan ltar rgyud gyong gshis rtsub cig yin mi srid/ kho gyang khar 'gos te nang du bltas pa na khang pa'i phyi nang gnyis ka lhing 'jags ser gnas/ dge bshes tshang gang zhig la phebs song ba yin nam/ rta lo gyang kha nas shud bzhin thang du babs/ kho 'jab kyin khang ba'i nang 'dzul ba na dge bshes tshang tsha thab na skyil mo krung dang bcas te dpe char gzigs 'dug rta los da ma bzang snyam ste phyir 'bro grabs byed med/ rjes su ded 'ong ba ma mthong bas 'di ci yin nam zhes phyir nang la 167

zams ba/'dzul te bltas pa na dge bshes byams pas sngar bzhin dpe char gzigs 'dug thab kar bskyon pa'i sla nga nas rlangs pa thu lu lu 'byur zhing de las mngar dri zhig kyang ldang 'ong / phar bltas na dge bshes khong nyid rig pa gcig tu sgrim ste dpe cha'i thog la 'khor 'dug pa 'dra/ rta lo sgo 'gram du song zhing mgo bo phyir bsrings te khang ba'i nang gi bkod par zhib tu bltas/a khu 'di la a khu gzhan dag lta bu'i thog la ri mo phab pa'i 'cha' sgam dang /shing sgam che chung brtsigs rgyu dang bshams rgyu med par thab ka'i thog na ca ne gcig gnyis re ma gtogs mthong rgyu med pa red/ khang phug tu dpe cha sna ring sna thung dang deng sang lcags par du btab pa'i dpe cha sna tshogs brtsigs yod pa de phal cher dge bshes khong gi rgyu nor yod tshad yin 'dug rta lo'i sems la dge bshes khong yang nga'i yan gyi phyug po ma red snyam/ skabs shig la dge bshes tsha thab las babs te thab rtsar 'ong zhing sla nga'i kha phyes pa dang rlangs pa thu li li byed pa'i tshod ma 'ga' sder ma'i nang la btus/ sder ma'i nang la btus rjes phu zhig 'debs bzhin lag tu blangs te za grabs byed pa na yang ci zhig dran pa ltar tshod ma de phyir sder mar bzhag la 'tshab be 'tshub ber tsha thab thog la bud de dpe cha'i blta 'phror der bltas byung / rta lo yun ring la skug kyang dge bshes tshang yang bskyar tsha thab las ma babs/ sha tshod bza' rgyu phal cher brjed song ba 'dra/ skabs 'dir rta lo la bza' 'dod kyi yi ga che cher 'byed byung bas mchil ma sgog ser mid dgos byung / kho rkang 'jab lag 168

dngul gyi rna long /'jab ngang thab rtsar bcar zhing / dge bshes kyi phyogs su skog mig gis blta bzhin sha tshod de dag spyang ltogs kyi bza' bza' byed pas dar tsam gyi ring la sder ma stong bar btang / de lta na yang dge bshes kyis rang gi nye 'khor na ci yang ma byung ba ltar sngar bzhin mgo bo smad de dpe char phur tshugs su blta/rta lo sngar bas kyang ya mtshan par gyur/ sngon chad khos rgan rabs tsho'i kha nas dge bshes 'ga' re rtsod rgyugs sul te phyir grwa shag tu log skabs lam bar kun du rgyugs gzhi la bsam gzhigs btang bas/ lag pa zwa khung nang btang yang de ltar nam gsal ba yod ces thos myong / de risbru mngon sum du mjal byung ba na kho rang gi mig la yid mi ches pa byung / yin na yang rta lo kho 'di ru rku byed du yong ba yin/ dge bshes la brku rgyu gzhan med na thab mgo'i sla nga brkus pa las 'os ci/ khos sla nga las chu tshang ma 'pho rjes dge bshes kyis ngo mi zin pa'i ched sla nga mgo la bskon(bca' srol 'di dge bshes la bsnyad bsko ba 'dra〉te sgo ru chas/ khos sgo lam nas sla nga cung tsam yar la btegs te bltas pa na dge bshes byams pa stan thog na tsam yang mi 'gul bar mig gis hrig ger dpe char gzigs 'dug 'jig rten yongs su brjed pa'i snang tshul 'di 'dra rta los sngon chad mthong ma myong bas kho la ngo mtshar dang dad pa cig car du 'phel/ kye ma rang gi bya spyod la stos dang / mi rung ba'i nag nyes lhur len byas/ rang gis dge bshes kyis thugs mnyam mi 'jog pa'i skabs su khong gi zas thun gcig po de yang 'jab bus banus te zos/169

dngul gyi rna long /'jab ngang thab rtsar bcar zhing / dge bshes kyi phyogs su lkog mig gis blta bzhin sha tshod de dag spyang ltogs kyi bza' bza' byed pas dar tsam gyi ring la sder ma stong bar btang / de lta na yang dge bshes kyis rang gi nye 'khor na ci yang ma byung ba ltar sngar bzhin mgo bo smad de dpe char phur tshugs su blta/rta lo sngar bas kyang ya mtshan par gyur/ sngon chad khos rgan rabs tsho'i kha nas dge bshes 'ga' re rtsod rgyugs gul te phyir grwa shag tu log skabs lam bar kun du rgyugs gzhi la bsam gzhigs btang bas/ lag pa zwa khung nang btang yang de ltar nam gsal ba yod ces thos myong / de ring mngon sum du mjal byung ba na kho rang gi mig la yid mi ches pa byung / yin na yang rta lo kho 'di ru rku byed du yong ba yin/ dge bshes la brku rgyu gzhan med na thab mgo'i sla nga brkus pa las 'os ci/ khos sla nga las chu tshang ma 'pho rjes dge bshes kyis ngo mi zin pa'i ched sla nga mgo la bskon(bca' srol 'di dge bshes la bsnyad brko ba 'dra〉te sgo ru chas/ khos sgo lam nas sla nga cung tsam yar la btegs te bltas pa na dge bshes byams pa stan thog na en tsam yang mi 'gul bar mig gis hrig ger dpe char gzigs 'dug 'jig rten yongs su brjed pa'i snang tshul 'di 'dra rta los sngon chad mthong ma myong bas kho la ngo mtshar dang dad pa cig car du 'phel/ kye ma rang gi bya spyod la stos dang / mi rung ba'i nag nyes lhur len byas/ rang gis dge bshes kyis thugs mnyam mi 'jog pa'i skabs su khong gi zas thun gcig po de yang 'jab bus brkus te zos/169

byams ba/'di ni mi bzad pa'i nyes pa min nam/ rkun ma rta lo sngar byas la 'gyod pa cher skyes shing / dge bshes la dad pa dang snying rje 'gog med du skyes/ de mur phyir song ste sla nga thab kar srud rjes/ dge bshes mdun du yan lag lnga po sa la btud de phyag byas/ mgo bo sa la gtug pa'i nyig sgra des dge bshes la yang grags 'gul bzos byung / khos ci yin nam snyam ste dpe cha phar bzhag ste bltas pa na mig mdun gyi yod tshad kyis kho rangahad de btang zhing ya mtshar bar byas/ gsar bu zhig kho'i lus mdun na pus mo lha nga sa la reg ste mgo bo dud 'dug 'di ci yin nam/ dge bshes thang la babs shing yar la bskyor ba na gsar bu des rgyu mtshan tshang ma kho la zhus la/ gdong nas mchi ma bzhur bzhin 'gyod gshags byas/ dge bshes kyang thugs dbang med du mnyes byung bas lag pa bsrings thengs gcig gis bsnyes 'bol gyi 'og gi sgor mo de dag spar bas bcings te rta lo'i lag la bzhag pa dang / deng phyin mi dge ba'i rku sogs mi byed par drang bo'i lam du 'gro bar slob gso dang gdangs ngag gnang / rta los thugs dgongs dkyel yangs kyi dge bshes kyi drung du rang ngo zin byung bas dge bshes la rku sogs mi byed pa'i dam bcas/lo bdun 'gor song / nyin zhig dge bshes byams pa'i grwa shag tu pha bu gnyis bslebs byung / dge bshes kyis thog mar ngo ma zin na yang gsar bu de'i ngo tshugs las su yin pa rim gyis shes/ khos mgron po rtsa zhig bslebs pa ltar mi de gnyis la bsu ba byas/ mi 'di gnyis gzhan min te rta 170

dacal gyi rna mong /lo pha bu gnyis red/ rta los dge bshes byams pa lo gang mang ring la ma rig pas de ring 'o ma 'gyig snod gang bzung ste blta ru 'ong ba red/ khos lo 'di dag gi ring la sa gzhan du song ste zhor las gnyer ba dang / tshong brgyab tshul/chung ma blangs te khyim skyong tshul sogs re re bzhin dge bshes la gleng / khos rtsib kyi bu chung de bstan te‘‘nga la bu zhig skyes pa ni gnam rgan mas nga la gnang ba'i bsod nams yin/ ming 'dogs skabs dge bshes khyod kyi mtshan dran pas de 'phral byams pa zhes btags pa yin zer ba na/ dge bshes thugs dgyes te bu byams pa'i mgo la byil byil byed bzhin‘‘khyod la bu yag cig skyes 'dug stos dang chos mgo can zhig red ces smras/ rta los de mur‘‘dge ba'i bshes gnyen lags/ nga la bu gcig ma gtogs med kyang bu gcig po 'di khyod kyi mdun nas rab tu byung na nga'i bsam don 'grub song /bu kho yang grwa ba byed 'dod che/ ngas rang gi bu 'di pha lta bu'i rmongs rtul zhig tu gtong mi 'dod/ 'on kyang grong chog kho na bda' ba'i ban de mgo stong zhig kyang ngas mi 'dod ces smras par/ dge bshes kyis kyang‘‘khyod la dngos gnas de 'dra'i bsam pa yod na/ khyod brel mi dgos/ bu kho lo dgu la son tshe nga'i jib la skyol dang / kho dpe cha ba zhig tu 'gyur bar ngas 'gan khur zer/dge bshes kyi skad cha des rta lo'i yid sems rab tu 'gul bar byas pas kho'i skad cha je mang du gyur zhing kha brda mang po byas/ dge bshes dang kho tsho shag por gyur la/ lo tsho'i gad mo 'i dgod sgra de dgon pa'i bar snang du lhang nger grags/171

dadul gyi rna long /lo pha bu gnyis red/ rta los dge bshes byams pa lo gang mang ring la ma rig pas de ring 'o ma 'gyig snod gang bzung ste blta ru 'ong ba red/ khos lo 'di dag gi ring la sa gzhan du song ste zhor las gnyer ba dang / tshong brgyab tshul/chung ma blangs te khyim skyong tshul sogs re re bzhin dge bshes la gleng / khos rtsib kyi bu chung de bstan te ‘nga la bu zhig skyes pa ni gnam rgan mas nga la gnang ba'i bsod nams yin/ ming 'dogs skabs dge bshes khyod kyi mtshan dran pas de 'phral byams pa zhes btags pa yin’zer ba na/ dge bshes thugs dgyes te bu byams pa'i mgo la byil byil byed bzhin‘‘khyod la bu yag cig skyes 'dug ltos dang chos mgo can zhig red ces smras/ rta los de mur‘‘dge ba'i bshes gnyen lags/ nga la bu gcig ma gtogs med kyang bu gcig po 'di khyod kyi mdun nas rab tu byung na nga'i bsam don 'grub song /bu kho yang grwa ba byed 'dod che/ ngas rang gi bu 'di pha lta bu'i rmongs rtul zhig tu gtong mi 'dod/ 'on kyang grong chog kho na bda' ba'i ban de mgo stong zhig kyang ngas mi 'dod ces smras par/ dge bshes kyis kyang‘ khyod la dngos gnas de 'dra'i bsam pa yod na/ khyod brel mi dgos/ bu kho lo dgu la son tshe nga'i rtsib la skyol dang / kho dpe cha ba zhig tu 'gyur bar ngas 'gan khur zer/dge bshes kyi skad cha des rta lo'i yid sems rab tu 'gul bar byas pas kho'i skad cha je mang du gyur zhing kha brda mang po byas/ dge bshes dang kho tsho shag por gyur la/ lo tsho'i gad mo 'i dgod sgra de dgon pa'i bar snang du lhang nger grags/171

ru nang gi 'brog pa/mun yongs su rub/ spra nang du lu gu skyid gcig pu go 'dabs su bsdad de sgrol bstod tshar 'don byed kyin 'dug 'ur 'ur du ldang ba'i lhags rlung dang mnyam du kha ba leb mo bya'i sgro spu 'thor ba bzhin thang la 'bab/ rlung gi g.yug shugs che bas spra nag yom yom sgrul la/ chod thag bcad de rdzogs 'gro ba'i 'jigs snang ster/ khangs kyi 'bab shugs kyang de bzhin du che bas mgo spra 'di mi 'gyang bar bcag bcag nyil nyil du gtong mi 'gro'am zhes sems khur zhig dbang med du 'khor bar byas/ yin na yang thab ka'i nang spong me lam lam du 'bar bas sbra nang hril bor drol 'khol zhig 'khyil 'dug slog pa g.yogs pa'i mal sa na byis pa gnyis po lhags rlung gi ngar sgra dang bskun sngur ba yang mor 'then bzhin gnyid du yur/ lu gu skyid kyi khyo ga ldom zog gnyis kyi rjes su song ste da dung phyir ma baspebs/ khangs 'bab cing btsag che ba'i 'di 'dra'i yul ngan zhig la kho mo 'dug mi bzod par gyur bas sgo ru yang yang blta ru 'gro dgos byung la/ khyo ga'i mgo la 'jigs pa ci yang 172

ru nang gi 'brog pa/mun yongs su rub/ spra nang du lu gu skyid gcig pu go 'dabs su bsdad de sgrol bstod tshar 'don byed kyin 'dug 'ur 'ur du ldang ba'i lhags rlung dang mnyam du kha ba leb mo bya'i sgro spu 'thor ba bzhin thang la 'bab/ rlung gi g.yug shugs che bas sbra nag yom yom sgul la/ chod thag bcad de rdzogs 'gro ba'i 'jigs snang ster/ khangs kyi 'bab shugs kyang de bzhin du che bas mgo spra 'di mi 'gyang bar bcag bcag nyil nyil du gtong mi 'gro'am zhes sems khur zhig dbang med du 'khor bar byas/ yin na yang thab na'i nang spong me lam lam du 'bar bas sbra nang hril bor drol 'khol zhig 'khyil 'dug slog pa g.yogs pa'i mal sa na byis pa gnyis po lhags rlung gi ngar sgra dang bstun sdur ba yang mor 'then bzhin gnyid du yur/ lu gu skyid kyi khyo ga ldom zog gnyis kyi rjes su song ste da dung phyir ma bslebs/ khangs chen 'bab cing btsag che ba'i 'di 'dra'i yul ngan zhig la kho mo 'dug mi bzod par gyur bas sgo ru yang yang blta ru 'gro dgos byung la/ khyo ga'i mgo la 'jigs pa ci yang 172

dngul gyi rna long /mi yong ba'i skyabs 'jug snying nas zhus/'on kyang sgo kha nas phyi ru bltas na ci yang mi mthong bas lu gu skyid slar yang sems 'tshab dang bcas go 'dabs su bsdad/ skabs shig la khyi rgan nag ldang gis ci zhig tshor ba bzhin zug byung / mos da ni khyo ga 'ong ba min nam zhes sgo ru bud de mun nag la gtad de shugs kyis bos mod/ lhags rlung gi ngud mo tsam las yolan ster mkhan ma byung / kho mo phyir 'ong ste go 'dabs su bsdad de thab ma'i nang la yong ba kha snon byas/ khyi rgan mu mthud du zug kyin 'dug khyi rgan hon log zug par brtag rgyu med/ kho mos khyi'i zug 'bod la de 'dra'i snang dogs ma byas/ 'on kyang bsdad kyin bsdad kyin khyi rgan gyi zug 'then de sngar bas che ru gyur la sna bas nyan tshod kyis lcags thag sil di rer gcod rtsis byed pa 'dra/ khyi rgan gyi zug 'bod de rgyun ldan zhig ma red/de dang mnyam du rgyang mi ring ba'i sa nas rta yi 'tsher skad zhig kyang grags song / a tsi 'di ci yin nam/ khyo ga 'gro khar zhon pa ni med/ kho mo mtshar snang dang bcas lag sgron lag tu blangs te sbra sgor bud/sgo khyis bdag mo sgo ru bud pa mthong ba dang rnga ma g.yug g.yug byed rjes lcags thag shugs kyis 'then bzhin zug byung / khyi'i zug skad la brtag na bdag mor 'di'i sngon la don rkyen zhig byung song zhes nyen brda gtong ba 'dra/khyi rgan kha mar la 'khor te zug 'bod byed kyin yod pas/ lu gu skyid kyis gdon khyi 'dis ci zhig tshor ba yin nam zhes smad phyogs la gom pa 'ga' song 173

ru nang gi'athog pa/ba na kho mo tshang gi sbra phub sa'i zhol na 'then pa'i lam de'i phyogs nas rta zhig gis sna phu brgyab byung / kho mo thur la 'bab zhor du mdun thad du glog bkar ba na chu kha yi lam de'i steng na rta ra ra zhig langs 'dug la rgyab la da dung sga zhig bstad 'dug zhon pa 'di su zhig gi yin nam/ kho mo nye sar bcar te bltas pa na/ ma gzhi skya mi zhig rta thog nas lhung ba de red/ thur mda' skya mi de'i lag na dam por bzung 'dug la rtsib na chang dam zhig 'phred du log 'dug rtar lhung mi 'dis sngur ba 'then pa tsam ma gtogs lus yongs su khangs kyis g.yogs te shi ba'i bem po zhig dang kun nas mtshungs/ lu gu skyid kyis a rogs/ orogs zhes mi de'i lus po shed kyis skul mod/ de ni sngar bzhin sdur ba stug po 'then pa las 'phag rgyu ci yang med par ra ro 'dam bag gi mtshams su bslebs 'dug chang rkyal 'di tsho ngo ma srog mi dgog lu gu skyid kyis kher lab cig rgyag bzhin mi de'i lus steng gi khangs sprugs pa na/ glo bur du kho mo glog la phrad pa bzhin lag pa myur du tshur bskums/ cung min na ag skad kyang brgyab byung / yogi yogi gyod ya lam dog zer ba cis ma bden/ da lta thang na nyal yod pa 'di kho mo tshang gi gyod ya red/bsam nag rgyud 'khyog 'dis nged tshang la ngan ma bcas pa'i bsam pa med/de dus bden kho mo tshang la yod kyang 'dis gleng nag po btab ste mi kha kho mo tshang la bskor/ shing ngan pa'i du ba dang mi ngan pa'i grib ma zer ba ltar cung tsam min na khyim kha gnyis bar la sha 'khon byung / khrims 'dzin sde khag gis 174

ru nang ṣka'ablog pa/ba na kho mo tshang gi sgra phub sa'i zhol na 'then pa'i lam de'i phyogs nas rta zhig gis sna phu brgyab byung / kho mo thur la 'bab zhor du mdun thad du glog bkar ba na chu kha yi lam de'i steng na rta ra ra zhig langs 'dug la rgyab la da dung sga zhig bstad 'dug zhon pa 'di su zhig gi yin nam/ kho mo nye sar bcar te bltas pa na/ ma gzhi skya mi zhig rta thog nas lhung ba de red/ thur mda' skya mi de'i lag na dam por bzung 'dug la rtsib na chang dam zhig 'phred du log 'dug rtar lhung mi 'dis sngur ba 'then pa tsam ma gtogs lus yongs su khangs kyis g.yogs te shi ba'i them po zhig dang kun nas mtshungs/ lu gu skyid kyis‘‘a rogs/ oṃrogs zhes mi de'i lus po shed kyis skul mod/ de ni sngar bzhin snur ba snag po 'then pa las 'phag rgyu ci yang med par ra ro 'dam bag gi mtshams su bslebs 'dug ‘‘chang rkyal 'di tsho ngo ma srog mi dgog lu gu skyid kyis kher lab cig rgyag bzhin mi de'i lus steng gi khangs sprugs pa na/ glo bur du kho mo glog la phrad pa bzhin lag pa myur du tshur bskums/ cung min na ag skad kyang brgyab byung / oṃgi oṃgi gyod ya lam dog zer ba cis ma bden/ da lta thang na nyal yod pa 'di kho mo tshang gi gyod ya red/bsam nag rgyud 'khyog 'dis nged tshang la ngan ma bcas pa'i bsam pa med/de dus bden kho mo tshang la yod kyang 'dis gleng nag po btab ste mi kha kho mo tshang la bskor/ shing ngan pa'i du ba dang mi ngan pa'i grib ma zer ba ltar cung tsam min na khyim kha gnyis bar la sha 'khon byung / khrims 'dzin sde khag gis 174

dngul gyi rna tshang /bden rdzun gyi brdar sha bcad de dkar nag gi dbye ba mi phyes rgyu na don dag de ltar thag gcod ga la thub/ ngo ma de dus gnam rgan mar mig med ska zer ba yin/ las rgyu 'bras zer ba zhig 'khor rgyu med 'dod/ da 'dang brgyab na 'chug song / de ring gnam gyis rig song / las rgyu 'bras zer ba 'di 'dra zhig min nam/ mi ngan khyod do dgong khangs nang nas skyid por nyol la phyi ma'i yul du song / lu gu skyid kyis mi de'i gdong la blta gin blta gin gar 'ong mi shes pa'i zhe sdang zhig gis rgyud yongs su dkrigs pas da ci'i snying rje'i sems de rim gyis med par gyur/ mos‘ hun’ zhes kha gzir ser 'khor te sbra gur gyi phyogs su song / sbra khyim du 'ong ban khyo ga da dung log mi 'dug pas mo la kher treng gi snang ba zhig 'gog med du skyes shing dngangs 'tshab zhig kyang ngang gis langs/ byis pa gnyis po sngar bzhin skyid po'i mal na gnyid du yur/rang gi byis pa gnyis po mthong ba dang mo'i yid la glo bur du gyod ya tshang 'khor/ kho tshang la yang 'di lta bu'i lag chags med pa'i byis pa bsam med gnyis yod pa min nam/ gal te kho tsho'i yopha med par gyur tshe ci ltar bya/ da dung de'i chung ma nad pa zhig yin/ khyim tshang zhig la skyes pa med tshe khang ba'i ka ba 'chag pa bzhin min nam/ lu gu skyid kyis de ltar dran pa dang rang steng la dper blangs nas rang gis rang la gnas lugs gleng / red ya/ khyim tshang zhig la skyes pa med tshe/ shul gyi mi rnams su la bsten/ snying rje'i chu bo zhig lu gu skyid kyi sems khong nas 'phyur zhing zhe sdang gi me rtse bcil bar byas/ mi 175

ru nang gi 'ablog pa yin pa rgacig 'dra red/ nga 'di gdon gyis brlams sam/ lu gu skyid rang gi bya byed la slar yang spa ga snang dang yid chad skyes/ rta rgyugs zin/ rdul yal zin/ da gyod kyi rnga ma brtsad de phan pa ci/ skra ring ma dang blo thung ma zer ba cis ma bden/ da skyob du ma song na mi de 'khyag shi thebs srid/ lu gu skyid kyis de ltar dran pa dang tsham tshom med par phyi ru rgyugs/ mos shed shugs yod tshad kyis lus bongs chen po'i mi de thang nas 'khur rtsis byed skabs/ khyi'i zug skad dang mnyam du khyo ga'i 'bod skad kyang rna lam du rgyu byung / khyo gas‘‘lu gu skyid/ khyod gang na yod ces bos pa na/ ‘‘nga 'di na yod/ mos lan btab/ khyo bo mo'i mdun du thon te6‘khyod yul nas mi 'dug par 'di na ces ngag nas ma thon gong slar yang‘‘bsam nag kho 'di na yod dam/chung mas 'di la ci zhig byung song snyam ste yar mar la dris te smyo la khad du gyur 'dug ngas kyang sems kyis ma bzod par zog btsal rgyu bamyur te kha rog ger kho btsal ba yin/ zog las mi gal mi che'am zer ba dang /yang‘ mi ngan 'di la bzang gtan nas mi 'bab mod/ de ring nga tsho 'phrad pa las kyi bkod sgrig red/’ ga re/ ngas 'khur/ 'di'i ro che bas khyod kyis mi theg mi de khyo gas 'khur/ chung mas de'i zhon pa khrid de gzhug nas yong /bza' ba gnyis ka spra gur gyi phyogs su phyin/kha ba dkar po sngar bzhin lhab lhub tu 'bab/176

dgong mo der khos rmi lam 'khul 'khrul zhig ma rmis/dud sprin dang mtshungs pa'i smu ga pa de smad nas stod phyogs la lang 'o nga 'khrigs yong bas/ sgrug pas mthong lam sgrib pa na kho gang zhig na langs yod pa'ang mgo 'thoms te rmongs par gyur/ sprug pa sngar bzhin lang long du 'khrigs/ de ni gzugs med kyi byed po stobs chen zhig ltar kho rang da lta nyid du yongs su btum ste gnas nges med cig la 'khyer rtsis byas/ da lta kho'i mig lam du rgyu ba ni dkar mag mog gi sgrug sprin las ci yang med pas/ kho ni lkog gyur dang sgyu 'phrul gyis khengs pa'i 'jig rten zhig na gyar ba'i snang ba skyes/kho mu mthud du mdun du 'gro 'dod mod/ rdog lam smug pas bsgribs te gar 'gro mi shes/ kho had de bsdad yod pa'i skabs der lung mthil nas 'ba' sgra gsal la mi gsal ba zhig grags yong / 'ba' sgra de go ba dang kho la 'tshub cha zhig dbang med du skyes/ rang gis 'tsho bzhin pa'i lug khyu de gang du bzhud song ngam/ da ci sgang na rtswa la bkram mod/ da ni mi ma thong bar gyur/ kho lug khyu bor 'gro snyam ste sems ma bde zhing / yar mar la song ste btsal 'dod 177

dgong mo der khos mi lam 'khral 'khrul zhig ma mis/gcig 'phror gcig 'ong / rtsom 'bri bar bar chad bzos song bas tshe brtan grogs po'i steng la zhe sdang langs bzhin yod mod/ 'di ltar sgo khar thon na dga' bsu mi byed sa ma song bas/ khos khong khro mar mnan te mu tshugs kyi 'dzum dang bcas ja cog 'khris kyi 'bol khri de bstan bzhin‘‘khyod tsho de ru sdod ces bshad/ skal lo 'phral mar mi tsog par khang ba'i nang yar blta 'ga' byas rjes ha las mdog gis ‘ci red/ de ring nam rgyun dang mi 'dra bar ca dag yin pa/ zhi mo zhig bos yod pa min nam zhes ku re rtses pa dang g.yas la 'khor te yig cog gi ngos la cer byung / tshe brtan gyi 'bri 'phror lus pa de mthong pa dang yon tan can 'di dag kha kha red/ ha mi go ba zhig 'bri bzhin 'dug ces kher lab cig byed pa dang phyir 'khor te tshe brtan la bltas/ skabs 'dir tshe brtan gyis mgron po tshor ja sdug rtsisabyed kyin 'dug la/ da ci dang bsdur na kho'i ngo mdog dang rnam 'gyur yang je bzang du gyur 'dug skal los de'i mur grogs po'i khams dang bstun pa ltar‘‘nga tshos khyod la bar chad bzos song mod/ de ring gza' mjug yin pas 'u cag gis lhan du chang 'thung na ci 'dra zhes dris byung / gza' mjug yin min la khyad par ci zhig mchis/ nga tshos chang 'thung 'dod dus gza' skar la bltas pa yin nam/ grogs po'i skad cha de go rjes tshe brtan khong nas dgod rgyu zhig langs/ 'on kyang do dgong chang mi 'thung sa mi 'gro ba 'dra ste/ grogs pos re ba'i mig gis kho la cer bas ngo mi bzlog thabs mi 'dug yang gcig bshad 180

dpyal gyi rna long /na mi gsum po bslebs pa dang kho'i klong du brdol ba'i rig pa de yang gar song cha med du yal zin/ do dgong chang 'thung ba las 'os med snyam/ tshe brtan gyis grogs po la‘‘'thung na 'thung / mang po zhig mi 'thung / 'u cag gis shog sgam gcig 'thung zhes bshad pa na/ grogs po dga' ste‘ red/red/ shog sgam gcig ma gtogs mi 'thung zhes bshad pa dang gsar bu de gnyis kyi lag tu rlangs 'khor gyi lde mig dang sgor mo bzhag ste dbu chang nyo ru mngags/ gsar bu gnyis sgo ru song rjes grogs po skal los tshe brtan la skad cha drang mor smras byung / ma gzhi 'di'i sngon la kho tsho gsum po khyim tshang gzhan zhig la song ste chang 'thung bsam mod/ khyim tshang de'i sgo khar thon pa na tag tag bza' ba gnyis bza' 'khon drag po zhig byed kyin pa rna bas go la khang ba'i nang nas byis pa'i ngu skad dang ca lag gcog pa'i khrog sgra sogs bstud mar mched 'ong / kho tsho nang du 'gro ma phod par phyir yong / 6 dang thog khyod kyang phyi ru ldom ste khang ba'i nang na med snyam mod/ ma bsam sa nas khyod nang du bsdad 'dug grogs pos de ltar smras pa dang slar yang‘‘skyid po mi rkyang tsho red/ ci byed rang dbang na 'dug nga tsho bza' tshang yod pa rnams rgan mos(chung ma'i 'bod tshul zhig)srung srung la bsdad de chang kha la reg tu mi 'jug ngo ma las ngan red ya zhes bshad bzhin gdong nas sdug mdog cig bstan/ tshe brtan dgod tsam byas rjes che'o na do dgong khyod la rang dbang thob pa ci yin zhes dris pa na/ grogs pos‘‘do dgong 'dre mo ma mā cang rtse ru 181

dgong mo der khos mi lam 'khral 'khrul zhig ma zis/song bas/ nga gcig tu khyim du bsdad ma 'dod stabs phyi la yong ba yin zhes bshad/ kho gnyis kha brda byed de cang ma 'gor bar chang nyo ru song ba'i gsar bu gnyis phyir thon/ gsar bu gnyis kyis dbu chang shog sgam gcig nyos yod pa ma zad/ da dung phor ba can gyi stabs bde thug pa yang nyos 'dug de nas tshang ma rang rang gi gnas su 'khod/ de'i nang gi gsar bu gcig gis ma skul dang len ngang shog sgam gyi kha phyes byung / shog sgam nas dam bu gnyis blangs pa dang ha cang byang cha yod pa'i ngang dam bu'i mchu to gcig gis gcig la gtad de yar mar la 'degs gnon tsam byed pa na dam bu gcig gi kha tshur ser phyes/ pi tse bzhi yi nang la 'phyur la nye ba re blugs/ grogs po skal los chang dpon zhig gi tshul du pi tse lag tu blangs te tshang mar thod gtug brgyab rjes‘‘gtsang bzhes gyis’ zhes bskul ba na/ tshang mas mgo la g.yon te sgog ser 'thung / kho tshos chang 'thung zhor kha brda byas/ gsar bu tsho gral gcig tu 'dzoms tshe kha brda'i gtam ni shin tu mang / sman bu mo gleng gzhi gtso bo yin pa las gzhan da dung gzhan la rdung res dang rgyag res byas te dpa' rtags bzhag tshul sogs kyang kha brda'i nang don du 'jog grogs po skal lo 'di dus rgyun sab nyung mod/ chang 'thung ste kha ngar tshe kha brda'i skud sne je ring nas je ring du gtong / kho bu mo su zhig la 'grogs pa dang gsar bu su la 'dzing res byed pa de brgyud rim cha tshang dang gtam rgyud byung rim ldan pa zhig brjod rgyu yod mod/ kho gtam rgyud gcig de 'or bshad byed rgyur dga' bas 182

dgong mo der khos zi lam 'khral 'khrul zhig ma zis/song bas/ nga gcig tu khyim du bsdad ma 'dod stabs phyi la yong ba yin zhes bshad/ kho gnyis kha brda byed de cang ma 'gor bar chang nyo ru song ba'i gsar bu gnyis phyir thon/ gsar bu gnyis kyis dbu chang shog sgam gcig nyos yod pa ma zad/ da dung phor ba can gyi stabs bde bug pa yang nyos 'dug de nas tshang ma rang rang gi gnas su 'khod/ de'i nang gi gsar bu gcig gis ma skul dang len ngang shog sgam gyi kha phyes byung / shog sgam nas dam bu gnyis blangs pa dang ha cang byang cha yod pa'i ngang dam bu'i mchu to gcig gis gcig la gtad de yar mar la 'degs gnon tsam byed pa na dam bu gcig gi kha tshur ser phyes/ tha tse bzhi yi nang la 'argyur la nye ba re blugs/ grogs po skal los chang dpon zhig gi tshul du pi tse lag tu blangs te tshang mar thod gtug brgyab rjes‘‘gtsang bzhes gyis’ zhes bskul ba na/ tshang mas mgo la g.yon te sgog ser 'thung / kho tshos chang 'thung zhor kha brda byas/ gsar bu tsho gral gcig tu 'dzoms tshe kha brda'i gtam ni shin tu mang / sman bu mo gleng gzhi gtso bo yin pa las gzhan da dung gzhan la rdung res dang rgyag res byas te dpa' rtags bzhag tshul sogs kyang kha brda'i nang don du 'jog grogs po skal lo 'di dus rgyun sab nyung mod/ chang 'thung ste kha ngar tshe kha brda'i skud sne je ring nas je ring du gtong / kho bu mo su zhig la 'grogs pa dang gsar bu su la 'dzing res byed pa de brgyud rim cha tshang dang gtam rgyud byung rim ldan pa zhig brjod rgyu yod mod/ kho gtam rgyud gcig de 'or bshad byed rgyur dga' bas 182

dacal gyi rna long /nyan pa por sun snang zhig ster/ dang thog gsar bu gnyis kas kyang skal los‘‘rgya mo de'i skor gleng bar rna ba blags te nyan khul byed mod/ re zhig 'gor rjes kho gnyis kha phyogs gcig la 'khor te lab gleng byas/ de bas tshe brtan gcig pus skal los ci zhig gleng na rna ba gtad de nyan dgos byung /chang 'thung na gtam mang zhing / gtam mang na chang ji ltar 'thung tshar ba'ang mi tshor/ dbu chang shog sgam gang bo de kho tsho gsar bu bzhi yi gtam dang lab gleng gi khrod nas 'thung yag byas tshar/ tshe brtan la chang de 'dra mi 'gro bas dbu chang shel do gsum tsam 'thung ba na mgo la rgyugs te yam me yom me zhig tu gyur/ da ni kho gnyid kyis 'thibs 'ong bas mal khri'i thog log ste gnyid 'dod 'gog med cig skyes/ 'on kyang grogs po skal lo chang gis ma ngoms pa los yin/ ‘‘da shog sgam gcig 'thung zhes bshad byung / tshe brtan gnyid na 'dod pas ma rangs par‘‘da khrigs se red/ ngal yang gso ran red ces bshad mod/ skal los kha ma nyan par sgor mo bton te gsar bu gnyis kyi lag tu bzhag gsar bu gnyis kyis kyang rta lo'i mngags bkod dang du blangs te chang nyo ru bud song / shog sgam gzhug ma de 'thung skabs skal los mu mthud du chang 'thung bzhin kha brda byed mod/ nyan pa po tshe brtan ni ra bzi ste pi tse lag tu 'dzin bzhin gnyid du yur/ tshe brtan gnyid las sangs te bltas pa na kho tsho mi gsum pos chang 'thung tshar te rang rang sar song zin/ khos rkang mgo'i lham ma gtogs gon pa gzhan ma 'phud par mal du nyal 'dug phal 183

dajul gyi rna long /nyan pa por sun snang zhig ster/ dang thog gsar bu gnyis kus kyang skal los‘‘rgya mo de'i skor gleng bar rna ba blags te nyan khul byed mod/ re zhig 'gor rjes kho gnyis kha phyogs gcig la 'khor te lab gleng byas/ de bas tshe brtan gcig pus skal los ci zhig gleng na rna ba gtad de nyan dgos byung /chang 'thung na gtam mang zhing / gtam mang na chang ji ltar 'thung tshar ba'ang mi tshor/ dbu chang shog sgam gang bo de kho tsho gsar bu bzhi yi gtam dang lab gleng gi khrod nas 'thung yag byas tshar/ tshe brtan la chang de 'dra mi 'gro bas dbu chang shel do gsum tsam 'thung ba na mgo la rgyugs te yam me yom me zhig tu gyur/ da ni kho gnyid kyis 'thibs 'ong bas mal khri'i thog log ste gnyid 'dod 'gog med cig skyes/ 'on kyang grogs po skal lo chang gis ma ngoms pa los yin/ 6 da shog sgam gcig 'thung zhes bshad byung / tshe brtan gnyid na 'dod pas ma rangs par ‘da khrigs se red/ ngal yang gso ran red ces bshad mod/ skal los kha ma nyan par sgor mo bton te gsar bu gnyis kyi lag tu bzhag gsar bu gnyis kyis kyang rta lo'i mngags bkod dang du blangs te chang nyo ru bud song / shog sgam gzhug ma de 'thung skabs skal los mu mthud du chang 'thung bzhin kha brda byed mod/ nyan pa po tshe brtan ni ra bzi ste pi tse lag tu 'dzin bzhin gnyid du yur/ tshe brtan gnyid las sangs te bltas pa na kho tsho mi gsum pos chang 'thung tshar te rang rang sar song zin/ khos rkang mgo'i lham ma gtogs gon pa gzhan ma 'phud par mal du nyal 'dug phal 183

dgong mo der khos mi lam 'khral 'khrul zhig ma mis/cher grogs po rda lo sogs kyis khos chang 'thung thub zhin med pa mthong ba dang skyon 'ong ste mal khri'i thog nyal du bcug pa yin shas che/ ngo ma de reg bar du tshe brtan gyis mi rkyang gi sdod shag 'di nas grogs po skal lo gtsos rdzong mkhar gyi ngo shes mi shes pa'i gsar bu gang mang mang la 'grogs te chang 'thung ba grangs kyis mi zin/ khang ba chung chung zhig yin na yang stabs shin tu bde bas pha mas gar song mi shes pa dang chung mas khyim la 'gug mi thub pa'i gsar bu rkyal stong mang po 'du rub rgyag sa zhig tu gyur/ 'di nas chang 'thung mkhan tsho ma mthun par tshig rtsod byung la/ tha na lag 'gul te 'thab 'khrug rgyag pa'i skabs kyang yod/ tshe brtan la sha tsha zhing snying nye ba'i grogs po yod med mi shes mod/ rdzong mkhar 'di na kho la sha za rogs dang chang 'thung rogs kyi grogs po ni mi nyung ba zhig yod/ kho tshos tshe brtan btsal du 'ong ba mang la/skabs rer tshe brtan gyis kyang kho tsho btsal te chang 'thung ba dang / kho tshor 'grogs te gar khang dang chang khang sogs myug ste mun rub bar du phyir mi phog 'on kyang 'dang zhig brgyab na chang ma 'thung na ci zhig bya/ gzhung las khang du 'gro thabs 'dug thabs byed chog la/ snying bo ldan pa zhig bsgrub rgyu med/ nam rgyun du las grogs tsho gzhung sgrub khang gcig tu 'dus pa dang don med kyi lab gleng sna tshogs byed de dus 'da' bar byas/ dngos gnas snying bo med pa la/ tshe brtan gyi sems su kho dang las grogs tsho gzhung sgrub khang du 'gro ba ni lto rgyab 'tsho ba'i don la nyi ma re re mu tshugs mthar skyes byed bzhin 184

dbyal gyi rna mong /'dug snyam/ tshe brtan gzhung las khang du 'gro bar yi mug skyes mod/ ma song na ga la 'grig las khungs kyi 'go gtso de 'grig lam bca' rgyur shin tu dga'/ kho'i lag nas don dang ldan pa'i bya ba chen po zhig mi 'khyongs na yang las sgrub dang las grol 'grig lam ha cang nan tan yin pas thugs la ma babs tshe rnar gzan pa'i bka' bkyon gnang rgyur yang 'dang rgyag med/ 'go gtso 'di da dung khor yug gtsang dag byed rgyu dang bsam blo'i slob gso gtsigs su 'dzin rgyur dga' bas 'a sa rogs rnams sun snang skyes na yang bkod pa ci yod/ kha sang de ring las khungs kun na bya 'gul snatshogs shig dbyar gyi sprin nag 'khrigs 'khrigs dang dgun gyi sa rdul 'phyur 'phyur du spel te mi'i dbugs rgyun gcod la khad du gtong / 'grig la ma yang de bzhin du je btsan du btang yod/ tshe brtan gyis lta bas mi bzod pa'i mal khang nang gi shel dam stong ba sogs kyi phyags lud rnams gtsang spra byed 'dod mod/las sgrub la 'gro bar dus chod ring bo zhig mi 'dug khos khrus gzhong du chu 'khyag cig blugs/ kha lag rten 'brel tsam zhig bkrus pa dang me long lag tu blangs te skyalo shad/ tshe brtan gyis me long nang nas rang gi ngo gdong de mthong / sngon chad kyi ngo gdong gor gor de da lta dbyibs nar mo zhig tu gyur zhing / khra chen gyi mig zung la 'od mdangs med/ da dung kha spu dang ag tshom ni spang gi sngo skyes skyes ltar ngo gdong rub la nye/ tshe brtan gyis me long nang la blta gin blta gin rang gis rang la yid mi ches par gyur/ lo ngo bcu gnyis 185

dacal gyi rna tshang /'dug snyam/ tshe brtan gzhung las khang du 'gro bar yi mug skyes mod/ ma song na ga la 'grig las khungs kyi 'go gtso de 'grig lam bca' rgyur shin tu dga'/ kho'i lag nas don dang ldan pa'i bya ba po zhig mi 'khyodas na yang las sgrub dang las grol 'grig lam ha cang nan tan yin pas thugs la ma babs tshe rnar gzan pa'i bka' bkyon gnang rgyur yang 'dang rgyag med/ 'go gtso 'di da dung khor yug gtsang dag byed rgyu dang bsam blo'i slob gso gcigs su 'dzin rgyur dga' bas la sa rogs rnams sun snang skyes na yang bkod pa ci yod/ kha sang de ring las khungs kun na bya 'gul snatshogs shig dbyar gyi sprin nag 'khrigs 'khrigs dang dgun gyi sa rdul 'phyur 'phyur du spel te mi'i dbugs rgyun gcod la khad du gtong / 'grig la ma yang de bzhin du je btsan du btang yod/ tshe brtan gyis lta bas mi bzod pa'i mal khang nang gi shel dam stong ba sogs kyi phyags lud rnams gtsang spra byed 'dod mod/las sgrub la 'gro bar dus chod ring bo zhig mi 'dug khos khrus gzhong du chu 'khrug cig blugs/ kha lag rten 'brel tsam zhig bkrus pa dang me long lag tu blangs te skyalo shad/ tshe brtan gyis me long nang nas rang gi ngo gdong de mthong / sngon chad kyi ngo gdong gor gor de da lta dbyibs nar mo zhig tu gyur zhing / khra chen gyi mig zung la 'od mdangs med/ da dung kha spu dang ag tshom ni spang gi sngo skyes skyes ltar ngo gdong rub la nye/ tshe brtan gyis me long nang la blta gin blta gin rang gis rang la yid mi ches par gyur/ lo ngo bcu gnyis 185

dgong mo der khos mi lam 'khral 'khrul zhig ma mis/ni ji 'dra'i mgyogs pa la/ gnyid ma sad kyi ngang la pho lo sum cur yol/ kho rang gi lang tsho'i dpal yon de skad cig tu yal bar nges 'byung zhig skyes/ kha spu bzhar te ca dag byed 'dod mod/ gzhung las khang du 'gro ran 'dug nyi la 'gro skabs khos mig gis blta phyogs shig gis yig cog steng gi 'bri 'phror lus pa de mthong / de'i steng du sa rdul rim pa zhig chags 'dugalas khungs su thon pa na las grogs tshos zin bris 'bri deb bzung ste gros tshogs khang du 'gro bzhin mchis/ kho yang de mur gzhung sgrub khang du song nas rang gi 'bri deb blangs pa dang gros tshogs khang du phyin/ gros chogs khang du song ba na 'go gtso las gzhan tshang ma bslebs 'dug las grogs gcig gnyis shig gis ha cang rgyus yod pa ltar 'go gtso rdzong mu'i nang la gros tshogs su zhugs pas/ snga dro phal cher las khungs su yong thub rgyu ma red zer ba na/las grogs rnams kyis 'phrin bzang thos pa ltar gdong la spro snang dang lhod g.yeng gis khengs/ de lta na yang 'go ba gzhon pa yod pas slob sbyong rgyun 'khyongs byed dgos pa smos ci/ 'go ba gzhon pas yig cha brtsegs ma zhig yod pa de'i nang nas sub bu gnyi bsal rjes las grogs gzhan zhig gi lag tu bzhag ste sgrog 'don byed du bcug kho ni 'go gtso lta bu'i mi btsan po zhig min pas las grogs tsho'i nang na dril bsgrags kyi nang don rna ba gtad de nyan mkhan ma mchis/ 'ga' res phan tshun la gtam shab shub smra ba dang / skabs rer ci zhig la dgod rgyu 'ong ba bzhin kha shags shags dang skyipags gnyer 186

dargong mo der khos lam 'khral 'khrul zhig ma mis/ni ji 'dra'i mgyogs pa la/ gnyid ma sad kyi ngang la pho lo sum cur yol/ kho rang gi lang tsho'i dpal yon de skad cig tu yal bar nges 'byung zhig skyes/ kha spu bzhar te ca dag byed 'dod mod/ gzhung las khang du 'gro ran 'dug phyi la 'gro skabs khos mig gis blta phyogs shig gis yig cog steng gi 'bri 'phror lus pa de mthong / de'i steng du sa rdul rim pa zhig chags 'dugalas khungs su thon pa na las grogs tshos zin bris 'bri deb bzung ste gros tshogs khang du 'gro bzhin mchis/ kho yang de mur gzhung sgrub khang du song nas rang gi 'bri deb blangs pa dang gros tshogs khang du phyin/ gros chogs khang du song ba na 'go gtso las gzhan tshang ma bslebs 'dug las grogs gcig gnyis shig gis ha cang rgyus yod pa ltar 'go gtso rdzong u'i nang la gros tshogs su zhugs pas/ snga dro phal cher las khungs su yong thub rgyu ma red zer ba na/las grogs rnams kyis 'phrin bzang thos pa ltar gdong la spro snang dang lhod g.yeng gis khengs/ de lta na yang 'go ba gzhon pa yod pas slob sbyong rgyun 'khyongs byed dgos pa smos ci/ 'go ba gzhon pas yig cha brtsegs ma zhig yod pa de'i nang nas sub bu gnyisabasal rjes las grogs gzhan zhig gi lag tu bzhag ste sgrog 'don byed du bcug kho ni 'go gtso lta bu'i mi btsan po zhig min pas las grogs tsho'i nang na dril bsgrags kyi nang don rna ba gtad de nyan mkhan ma mchis/ 'ga' res phan tshun la gtam shab shub smra ba dang / skabs rer ci zhig la dgod rgyu 'ong ba bzhin kha shags shags dang rdzipags gnyer 186

dadul gyi rna mong /gnyer byed kyin mchis/ yang 'ga' res gcig gis gcig la gtad de kha dang lag pas rnam 'gyur mtshar bo zhig bstan te rtsed 'jo ston/ tshe brtan gyis las khungs nang gi thun mong gi slob sbyong byed tshul de mthong ba dang slob chung gi skabs su slob khrid la nyan pa'i rnam pa de mig lam du shar/ de'i dus kyang dge rgan btsan po la ma 'phrad tshe khrid stegs kyi gsham 'og na pra tshag yin pa'i slob grogs tshos phan tshun la bsnyad 'tshol ba dang brnyas bcos byed de dge rgan gyis khrid stegs steng na ci zhig 'chad bzhin pa rna ba'i bu gar mi 'gro/ tshe brtan gyis las grogs tshor blta bzhin rang gi chung dus kyi ma rabs pra tshag gi spyod stangs de dran pas kha rog ger kher dgod byas/ dus tshod phyed tsam las ma 'gor bar sgrog 'don mkhan gyis yig cha de gnyis shar mar bton tshar/ 'go ba gzhon pas‘‘de ring 'di tsam gyis chog par bya/ tshang ma rang rang gi gzhung sgrub khang du ci zhig las rgyu yod na bsgrub tu song zhes bshad pa na/ der 'dus kyi tshang ma dga' thag chod de gros tshogs khang gi phyi la bud/ las grogs rnams la las rgyu 'di dang gan zhes med pas kho tsho ma gros gcig mthun ngang thog khang zhol ma na yod pa'i las grogs ga ge mo'i gzhung las khang du 'dus/ gzhung las khang 'di thog khang zhol ma'i phug tu gnas shing khang ba gzhan las dro/ nyis thog na yod pa'i 'go gtso gzhon pa gnyis kyis mnyam 'jog de 'dra mi byed la/ 'di ru skor de 'dra mi rgyag 'go gtso las khungs su med pa'i skabs su sgowa mo brgyab ste shog phe 'phangs te 187

dargong mo der khos mi lam 'khral 'khrul zhig ma zis/rgyan skugs rkyang yin/ 'on kyang de ring mis mi 'dang stabs kho tshos sho rgyag thabs bral byung / de bas stong lab rgyag pa las 'os med/ zha'o zhi'i ni kha grags na skad mgo mtho zhing 'drags la/ pho mo'i dbye ba med par kha mtshar ku re rtsed rgyur 'dzem dogs med/ khos bde 'tsho la hur rer bltas pa dang /tu'u mthon po can gyi shel mig de yar la ded de‘‘bde 'tsho/ khyod la ngo ma sman shar zhig gi bro ba mi 'dug ang / ltos dang brang ga na myos bum mi 'dug pas khod snyoms shig red/ khyod ni dngos gnas 'bri skam zhig dang 'dra zhes bshad pa na/ der yod dag bsam thog la 'khel pa bzhin bzhad gad thag ger song / bde 'tshos tshig de go rjes mtshang la phog pa bzhin kha skyengs te ngo mdog dmar po gyur/ yin yang mos phyir btsan gyis 'dzum zhig phyungs bzhin‘‘de med kyang skyon ci/ lo sum cu'i rtsa stod la bud pas de dag gis ci zhig bya zhes ci mi snyam par byed mod/ mo zhig la 'dzoms 'os pa'i mchor sgeg yal ba gzhan gyis mthong bas/ kho mos mgo bo brang khar dud de ci yang mi lga yin na yang las grogaspotshos bde 'tsho la rtsed mo rtse rgyu mtshams ma bzhag zha'o spu'u yis bde 'tsho la zha'o mā bstan bzhin‘ khyod las zha'o mā'i brang gzhung rgyas 'dug gon rgyu gud de blta rgyu na zha'o mā'i brang de khyod las ldab 'gyur gyis che ba 'don mi za zhes 'aldam bag med par bshad pa na/zha'o mā dang bcas pa slar yang 'ur di re bgad byung / zha'o mā ni sha rgyags rus rgyags can gyi gsar bu lo nyung zhig ste dus rgyun par nang luwab bu zhig 188

dacal gyi rna mong /gyon te brang gzhung gi sha gnad de kun la ngoms/ khos rang gi lus gung gi lngid tshad la rgya ma brgya dang drug cu yod ces brjod pa na/ tshang mas kho la blta bzhin yid ches pa'i tshul du mgo lcog ldem ldem byas/ yin na yang kho las khungs nang gi tshon pa'i gras su mi the/ las khungs 'di ru gzugs ring thung med par tshon po pho ba 'bur ba skor zhig yod/ de las kyang zha'o tsha'o ni tshon po mig la rgyag pa zhig yin/ kho lo nyi shur son ma thag gi skyes bu gzugs thung can zhig yin na yang / za rgyu 'thung rgyu ma gtogs sems khur med pa'i byis pa bag yangs shig dang 'dra bar lus la tsho gsog ste 'gram pa dang pho ba lugs te las ka cung tsam zhig las na 'phral mar jul chu 'dzag 'ong / lha rgyal gyis zha'o tsha'o la blta bzhin‘‘khyod dngos gnas tsho ba la/ 'go khrid dang khyed gnyis bsha' nyan ni zhig yin tshe bshas btang na tshil tag tag yin pa thag gis chod zer ba na/ der 'dus tshang ma gad mo che cher bgad/ las grogs gcig gnyis shig bgad rgyu mang drags te mig chu 'chor la khad du gyur/zha'o tsha'o yis lha rgyal gyis snying 'phyas gtong bar ma bzod par phyir lha rgyal la‘ ngas zas na 'thung na ngo la shar 'dug 'on kyang khyod kyis shi reg bar du zos kyang sha mi rgyas/ 'di ni khyod kyis rgyal khab la bla btsag pa min nam zhes 'gram sha bslug bslug ngang dgod zhor du lan slog mod/ smra ba bo zha'o tsha'o rang nyid ma gtogs nyan mkhan tshor dgod rgyu de 'dra slong ma thub/ zha'o tsha'o yis de ltar bshad pa na/ lha rgyal yang yar la langs te‘‘khyod kyis nga mi skam 189
