dgong mo der khos mi lam 'khral 'khrul zhig ma mis/po zhig red 'dod dam/ nga'i ngo la sha med pa ma gtogs mi tsho rgyu med/ rgya ma brgya dang lnga bcu(lus po'i lngid tshad〉yod/ 'o los zhes lag pas pho ba phur bzhin lab pa na/ der yod kyi tshang mas dogs pa za ba'i mig gis lha rgyal gyi pho ba'i steng la cer byung / las grogs tshos yid nas mi rloms par khag med de/ lha rgyal gyi gzugs cung ring ba'i khar/ sngon chad mi skam rid can zhig yin/ 'on kyang kho gnyen sgrig pa nas lus la rim gyis tsho bud de pho ba cung tsam phyir 'bur de‘‘sku bsod can gyitags te 'dzoms la nye mod/ de 'dra mngon gsal min pas mig la mi rgyag tshon po gzhan dang bsdur na 'brong gi rtsib na g.yag tsam mo/ de'i rkyen gyis zha'o tsha'o ni lha rgyal gyis rgya ma brgya dang lnga bcu yod ces par yid ma ches/ khos lha rgyal la ‘skyag lab ma rgyag khyod kyi tshugs nar bltas na lngid tshad de 'dra zhig yod srid dam zhes mig gis zur gyis blta bzhin smras/ lha rgyal la rgyal kha ma byin na kha mi nyan zhing rang dgang la rgya 'chor du 'jug mi srid/ de'i mur zha'o tsha'o yi phyogs su ske bsrings te ‘gal te nga la rgya ma brgya dang lnga bcu yod na ci bya/ khyod kyis skugs 'dzugs thub bam zhes dris/ zha'o tsha'o yis ‘rgyan ci la 'jog mi thub/ ci zhig skugs/ lha rgyal gyis 'dang cung tsam brgyab rjes‘tha mag ca'o tsisngon po(༅lo)sgam gnyis 'jog zer ba na/ der yod tshang mas‘‘bzang gi bzang gi su pham na pham/ nga tshos mnyam du bzhes zhes 'ur bslangs/ zha'o tsha'i yang rgyan de skugs par 'thad pa byung / rgyan 'jog mkhan gnyis 'bru 190

dargong mo der khos zi lam 'khral 'khrul zhig ma jis/po zhig red 'dod dam/ nga'i ngo la sha med pa ma gtogs mi tsho rgyu med/ rgya ma brgya dang lnga bcu(lus po'i smid tshad〉yod/ 'o los zhes lag pas pho ba phur bzhin lab pa na/ der yod kyi tshang mas dogs pa za ba'i mig gis lha rgyal gyi pho ba'i steng la cer byung / las grogs tshos yid nas mi rloms par khag med de/ lha rgyal gyi gzugs cung ring ba'i khar/ sngon chad mi skam rid can zhig yin/ 'on kyang kho gnyen sgrig pa nas lus la rim gyis tsho bud de pho ba cung tsam phyir 'bur de‘‘sku bsod can gyikaugs te 'dzoms la nye mod/ de 'dra mngon gsal min pas mig la mi rgyag tshon po gzhan dang bsdur na 'brong gi jib na g.yag tsam mo/ de'i rkyen gyis zha'o tsha'o ni lha rgyal gyis rgya ma brgya dang lnga bcu yod ces par yid ma ches/ khos lha rgyal la ‘skyag lab ma rgyag khyod kyi tshugs kar bltas na ljid tshad de 'dra zhig yod srid dam zhes mig gis zur gyis blta bzhin smras/ lha rgyal la rgyal kha ma byin na kha mi nyan zhing rang dgad la rgya 'chor du 'jug mi srid/ de'i mur zha'o tsha'o yi phyogs su ske bsrings te‘‘gal te nga la rgya ma brgya dang lnga bcu yod na ci bya/ khyod kyis skugs 'dzugs thub bam zhes dris/ zha'o tsha'i yis‘‘rgyan ci la 'jog mi thub/ ci zhig skugs/ lha rgyal gyis 'dang cung tsam brgyab rjes‘tha mag ca'o misngon po(༅ṭha)sgam gnyis 'jog zer ba na/ der yod tshang mas ‘bzang gi bzang gi su pham na pham/ nga tshos mnyam du bzhes zhes 'ur bslangs/ zha'o tsha'i yang rgyan de skugs par 'thad pa byung / rgyan 'jog mkhan gnyis 'bru 190

dadul gyi rna mong /mdzod sa tshigs su rgya mar tshad du 'gro rgyu byas rgyan 'jog dus bden dpang byed mkhan yod na rab red/ ‘‘'gro/ tshe brtan khyod 'gro/ khyed kyis nged gnyis la bden dpang mdzod/ lha rgyal gyis tshe brtan mthong ba dang de ltar zer/ zha'o zhi'i dang zha'o kru'u sogs kyis kyang rjes mthud de‘‘red/ red/ tshe brtan mi da ma zhig yin zhes bshad/ bden dpang mi snar bskos byung bas tshe brtan gyis ngo bzlog ma thub/ tshe brtan gyis bden dpang bya rgyu dang du blangs/ kho tsho gsum po 'bru rigs sa tshigs su phyin/ 'bru mjal byed kyi rgya ma rgya chen rtsib la thon ma thag lha rgyal gyis rkang pa yar bkyags thengs shig gis rgya ma'i thog la bud/ de nas kho tsho gsum pos mig gdangs te ljid tshad kyi sde tshan la bltas pa na/ lha rgyal gyi lngid tshad la spyi rgyalha5yan la son 'dug 'di ni zha'o tsha'o la mtshon na bsam yid las 'das pa zhig yin/ lha rgyal gyi gdong la rgyal kha'i 'dzum mdangs shig shar/ khos nga'o dang bcas‘‘zha'o tsha'o da khyod kyis khas len nam/ gsal bo rig no 'di red ces bshad/ skabs 'dir zha'o tsha'o yi ngo cung tsam nar yod na yang rgyan rgyal bo yin rung ster dgos pas/ khos lha rgyal la tha mag lan co(1sdusmocha)sgam gnyis nyo dgos byung / du ba nyos rjes kho tsho phyir 'du tshogs rgyag sa'i gzhung las khang du log lha rgyal la sger sems med par spyi sems che bas rgyan skugs te 'thob pa'i tha mag sgam gnyis po tshang ma'i longs spyod du phul/ las grogs tshos du brgyangs byed bzhin 'ur brgyab/ cang ma 'gor bar las grol gyi dus tshod la bslebs/ thog 191

dasgel gyi rna tshang /mdzod sa tshigs su rgya mar tshad du 'gro rgyu byag rgyan 'jog dus bden dpang byed mkhan yod na rab red/ ‘‘'gro/ tshe brtan khyod 'gro/ khyed kyis nged gnyis la bden dpang mdzod/ lha rgyal gyis tshe brtan mthong ba dang de ltar zer/ zha'o zhi'i dang zha'o spu'u sogs kyis kyang rjes mthud de‘‘red/ red/ tshe brtan mi da ma zhig yin zhes bshad/ bden dpang mi snar bskos byung bas tshe brtan gyis ngo bzlog ma thub/ tshe brtan gyis bden dpang bya rgyu dang du blangs/ kho tsho gsum po 'bru rigs sa tshigs su phyin/ 'bru mjal byed kyi rgya ma rgya rtsib la thon ma thag lha rgyal gyis rkang pa yar bkyags thengs shig gis rgya ma'i thog la bud/ de nas kho tsho gsum pos mig gdangs te ljid tshad kyi sde tshan la bltas pa na/ lha rgyal gyi ljid tshad la spyi rgyalha5yan la son 'dug 'di ni zha'o tsha'o la mtshon na bsam yid las 'das pa zhig yin/ lha rgyal gyi gdong la rgyal kha'i 'dzum mdangs shig shar/ khos nga'o dang bcas‘‘zha'o tsha'o da khyod kyis khas len nam/ gsal bo rig no 'di red ces bshad/ skabs 'dir zha'o tsha'o yi ngo cung tsam nar yod na yang rgyan rgyal bo yin rung ster dgos pas/ khos lha rgyal la tha mag lan co(1sdultaci)sgam gnyis nyo dgos byung / du ba nyos rjes kho tsho phyir 'du tshogs rgyag sa'i gzhung las khang du log lha rgyal la sger sems med par spyi sems che bas rgyan skugs te 'thob pa'i tha mag sgam gnyis po tshang ma'i longs spyod du phul/ las grogs tshos du brgyangs byed bzhin 'ur brgyab/ cang ma 'gor bar las grol gyi dus tshod la bslebs/ thog 191

dgong tha der khas zi lam 'khral 'khrul zhig ma mis/khang nang de mur 'ur sgra dang spu sgras khengs/ tshe brtan las grogs tsho dang mnyam du gzhung las khang gi phyi ru bud/tshe brtan gung tshigs bza' ru rgyun du 'gro bzhin pa'i za khang chung chung de ru phyin/ za khang nang thon pa dang sbyin bdag gis kho rang 'dzum gyis bsus/kho zas cog la gtad de tsog pa na sbyin bdag gis 'phral mar kho la ja ldug bzhin‘‘nye lam brel ba che'am zhes dris byung / ‘‘brel ba che'am zhes pa'i mtshams 'dri'i tshig 'di sems bsam pa'i gting gi skad cha zhig yin min mi shes mod/ deng sang su dang su thug na de ltar 'dri zhing kun gyi kha ru lobs song ba'i goms gshis rang bzhin gyi skad cha zhig tu gyur 'dug de ring nyan chod cig gis rna ru bde ba zhig ma red/ tshe brtan yid ma rangs paraphabrel ba shin tu che/ kha sang de ring brel ba dngos gnas che zhes skad mthon pos smras/tshe brtan gyis bsam par de ring sbyin bdag gis kho la bsam gzas te tshig gis rgyag gin 'dug snyam pas skad cha drang mo zhig bshad 'dod ma skyes/ sbyin bdag gis de skad go ba dang ye bden nam zhes mig gor gor gnyis phur tshugs su gdangs bzhin‘‘'o zhes zer ba dang cang mi sabar kha phar la 'khor te 'grul ba gzhan la ja sdug tu bud song / tshe brtan gyis za khang de nas brnyan 'phrin la blta bzhin za ma zos rjes/ ga ler par la langs pa dang gom pa dal gyis spo bzhin srad lam du song / khos mkhrig ma'i dus tshod 'khor lo bltas pa na/ phyi dro'i las 'go tshugs pa la dus chod gnyis tsam 'dug192

dgong mo der khas zi lam 'khral 'khrul zhig ma mis/khang nang de mur 'ur sgra dang gru sgras khengs/ tshe brtan las grogs tsho dang mnyam du gzhung las khang gi phyi ru bud/tshe brtan gung tshigs bza' ru rgyun du 'gro bzhin pa'i za khang chung chung de ru phyin/ za khang nang thon pa dang sbyin bdag gis kho rang 'dzum gyis bsus/kho zas cog la gtad de tsog pa na sbyin bdag gis 'phral mar kho la ja sdug bzhin‘‘nye lam brel ba che'am zhes dris byung / ra‘brel ba che'am zhes pa'i mtshams 'dri'i tshig 'di sems bsam pa'i gting gi skad cha zhig yin min mi shes mod/ deng sang su dang su thug na de ltar 'dri zhing kun gyi kha ru lobs song ba'i goms gshis rang bzhin gyi skad cha zhig tu gyur 'dug de ring nyan chod cig gis rna ru bde ba zhig ma red/ tshe brtan yid ma rangs par4grel ba shin tu che/ kha sang de ring brel ba dngos gnas che zhes skad mthon pos smras/tshe brtan gyis bsam par de ring sbyin bdag gis kho la bsam gzas te tshig gis rgyag gin 'dug snyam pas skad cha drang mo zhig bshad 'dod ma skyes/ sbyin bdag gis de skad go ba dang me bden nam zhes mig gor gor gnyis phur tshugs su gdangs bzhin‘ 'o zhes zer ba dang cang mi zabar kha phar la 'khor te 'grul ba gzhan la ja sdug tu bud song / tshe brtan gyis za khang de nas brnyan 'phrin la blta bzhin za ma zos rjes/ ga ler yang la langs pa dang gom pa dal gyis spo bzhin srad lam du song / khos mkhrig ma'i dus tshod 'khor lo bltas pa na/ phyi dro'i las 'go tshugs pa la dus chod gnyis tsam 'dug192

dngul gyi rna long /phyir sdod shag tu song na 'khyag sib ber snying bo med/ srang du 'khor na yang snying bo med/ khos dus tshod gnyis de ji ltar 'khyil par bsam blo gtong skabs 'bru rigs sa tshigs kyi sgo chen gyi logs zur na mi skor zhig gis 'ur rgyag bzhin mig mangs rtse bzhin pa mthong / mig mangs rtse ba mthong ba dang tshe brtan la dga' spro skyes byung / kho mig mangs rtse rgyur dga' ba ma zad/ gzhan gyis rtse ba la yang mtha' khar rub ste lta bar dga'/ de na mi drug bdun zhig mig mangs la rub ste 'dug spyir mig mangs 'ded na mi gnyis pha rol tshu rol byed de 'ded rgyu de yin mod/ rgya srang na 'ded pa ni de 'dra zhig tu ma nges/ mtha' kha na ltad mor blta ba'i mi rnams kyang ltad mor blta ba kho nas ma tshim par pha rol tshu rol gyi phyogs su langs te kha dang lag pa gnyis ka 'gul te 'ur rgyag pa dang bkod 'doms byas/ de ring yang rtse mkhan gnyis ma zad/ rtsib na ltad mo lta mkhan bzhi lhag 'dug mig mangs 'ded mkhan gnyis la bkod 'doms byed mkhan ha cang mang / mi gcig gis ltag ga nas‘‘de ltar song na ga la 'grig 'di ltar song na 'os zhes lag pa bsrings te dngos su bkod 'doms byed pa na/ rogs byed mkhan zhig gis de 'phral ‘de ltar song na gzhan gyis bza' mi 'gro'am/ glen pa zhes bshad bzhin 'jig de'u phyir len/ pha rol po tshang gis‘ khyed tshang 'gro rgyu med ni ci zhig red/ ngo ma sbrum mas bu phrug btsas pa ltar 'gor 'gyangs che zhes ma 'dod par brel ba bslangs/ mig mangs 'ded mkhan gyis 'jig sde'u shed 193

dacam gyi rna long /phyir sdod shag tu song na 'khyag sib bair snying bo med/ srang du 'khor na yang snying bo med/ khos dus tshod gnyis de ji ltar 'khyil par bsam blo gtong skabs 'bru rigs sa tshigs kyi sgo chen gyi logs zur na mi skor zhig gis 'ur rgyag bzhin mig mangs rtse bzhin pa mthong / mig mangs rtse ba mthong ba dang tshe brtan la dga' spro skyes byung / kho mig mangs rtse rgyur dga' ba ma zad/ gzhan gyis rtse ba la yang mtha' khar rub ste lta bar dga'/ de na mi drug bdun zhig mig mangs la rub ste 'dug spyir mig mangs 'ded na mi gnyis pha rol tshu rol byed de 'ded rgyu de yin mod/ rgya srang na 'ded pa ni de 'dra zhig tu ma nges/ mtha' kha na ltad mor blta ba'i mi rnams kyang ltad mor blta ba kho nas ma tshim par pha rol tshu rol gyi phyogs bu langs te kha dang lag pa gnyis ka 'gul te 'ur rgyag pa dang bkod 'doms byas/ de ring yang rtse mkhan gnyis ma zad/ rtsib na ltad mo lta mkhan bzhi lhag 'dug mig mangs 'ded mkhan gnyis la bkod 'doms byed mkhan ha cang mang / mi gcig gis ltag ga nas‘‘de ltar song na ga la 'grig 'di ltar song na 'os zhes lag pa bsrings te dngos su bkod 'doms byed pa na/ rogs byed mkhan zhig gis de 'phral‘‘de ltar song na gzhan gyis bza' mi 'gro'am/ glen pa zhes bshad bzhin 'jig de'u phyir len/ pha rol po tshang gis‘‘khyed tshang 'gro rgyu med ni ci zhig red/ ngo ma sbrum mas bu phrug btsas pa ltar 'gor 'gyangs che zhes ma 'dod par brel ba bslangs/ mig mangs 'ded mkhan gyis 'jig sde'u shed 193

dgong mo der khos mi lam 'khral 'khul zhig ma mis/kyis bdeg pa dang kha nang nas tshig rdzob bo dang rtsub po rang dgar smra zhing /gal te rgyal kha thob na pha rol por snying 'phyas btang ste 'dug mi bzod par byas/ pham kha nyo mkhan gyis kyang mgo mi skur bar khog dpung la rgya brtsad de yang dang yang du bskyar du rtses/ tshe brtan gyisamatha' kha na ltad mor lta gin lta gin rtse 'dod kyi lag par za 'phrug langs mod/ mi 'di dag gis rtses te mtshams mi 'jog kho tshos rgyal pham gyi rting thag ma chod par yun ring bo zhig la rtse mthar gzhi nas mtshams bzhag song / tshe brtan gyis da ni rang gis kyang 'ded chog snyam ste dga' spro'i ngang mig mangs rtse rogs btsal ba na/ mi de tsho thang nas yar langs shing glal bgyings dang rkang lag bya rnyang byas rjes 'phongs tshos thog gi rdul sprugs bzhin‘‘rtse khom med/ za ma za ru 'gro ran song zhes bshad de rang rang sar bud song / ma gzhi kho tshos mig mangs rtses te za ma za rgyu'ang brjed 'dug tshe brtan mig mangs rtse 'dod che mod/ 'ded grogs med pas sems pham song / khos mkhrig ma'i dus tshod la bltas pa na da so ma dus tshog3dang skar ma phyed kur bslebs pa tsam red/ mig mangs rtse thub ma byung stabs kho rang las khungs kyi gzhung las khang gi zur logs na yod pa'i dra khang(༅khrispu〉de'i nang song / dra khang nang na rdzong gi na gzhon las byed skor zhig dang bkag kyang mi khogs pa'i byis pa 'ga' 'dus/ na gzhon tsho shog phe'i rtsed 'jo la rol bzhin mchis/ byis pa rnams 'jigs rgol(yo0〉'phrul rtsed la rol bzhin mchis/ tshe brtan dra khang nang gi rtsed 'jo 194

dgong mo der khos mi lam 'khral 'khyul zhig ma jis/kyis bdeg pa dang kha nang nas tshig rdzob po dang tsub po rang dgar smra zhing /gal te rgyal kha thob na pha rol por snying 'phyas btang ste 'dug mi bzod par byas/ pham kha nyo mkhan gyis kyang mgo mi sur bar khog dpung la rgya brtsad de yang dang yang du bskyar du rtses/ tshe brtan gyisamatha' kha na ltad mor lta gin lta gin rtse 'dod kyi lag par za 'phrug langs mod/ mi 'di dag gis rtses te mtshams mi 'jog kho tshos rgyal pham gyi rteng thag ma chod par yun ring bo zhig la rtse mthar gzhi nas mtshams bzhag song / tshe brtan gyis da ni rang gis kyang 'ded chog snyam ste dga' spro'i ngang mig mangs rtse rogs btsal ba na/ mi de tsho thang nas yar langs shing glal bgyings dang rkang lag bya rnyang byas rjes 'phongs tshos thog gi rdul sprugs bzhin‘ rtse khom med/ za ma za ru 'gro ran song zhes bshad de rang rang sar bud song / ma gzhi kho tshos mig mangs rtses te za ma za rgyu'ang brjed 'dug tshe brtan mig mangs rtse 'dod che mod/ 'ded grogs med pas sems pham song / khos mkhrig ma'i dus tshod la bltas pa na da so ma dus tshog3dang skar ma phyed kur bslebs pa tsam red/ mig mangs rtse thub ma byung stabs kho rang las khungs kyi gzhung las khang gi zur logs na yod pa'i dra khang(༅baspu〉de'i nang song / dra khang nang na rdzong gi na gzhon las byed skor zhig dang bkag kyang mi khogs pa'i byis pa 'ga' 'dus/ na gzhon tsho shog phe'i rtsed 'jo la rol bzhin mchis/ byis pa rnams 'jigs rgol(krerṣa〉'phrul rtsed la rol bzhin mchis/ tshe brtan dra khang nang gi rtsed 'jo 194

dadul gyi rna long /gzhan la de 'dra mi dga'/ kho ci la dga' zhe na dra mthud kha brda(khu༅maza)byed rgyur mos/ khe nyin khos dra mthud kha brda byed pa brgyud ming la yongs 'dzin me tog zer ba'i na chung dra mthun ma(4༅cho〉zhig ngo shes/ kho brnyan ris kyi mdun du bsdad/ brnyan sgo'i kha phyes/ de nas0pa.ang rtags kyi kha phyes te‘ yongs 'dzin me tog la dngos su kha brda byed 'go brtsams/ kho mo spo langs bzhin pa 'dra ste‘‘ci red/ khyed la ci byung song / kha sang khyod nga la kha brda byed du mi 'ong don zhes dris byung / phar bltas tshod kyis‘‘yongs 'dzin me tog gis kho gnyis kha brda byed rgyu de sems la bzung ste nan tan byed bzhin yod pa ltar snang / 'on te dra rgya la mi kun gyis sgyu ma'i zhing khams su 'bod na/ yid rton rgyu ci yod/ khos kho mo ni dra mthun(༅4〉tsam du brtsis pa las re ba lhag ma bcangs med/ tshe brtan gyis‘‘don dag gi dbang gis khyod la gleng mol byed ma thub ces pa'i yig 'bru de dag bde myur 'khyug pos gtags/ don dam du kha sang khos ci zhig bsgrub pa dran rgyu mi 'dug de ni rang dgar bshad pa'i skad cha yin/ ‘‘yongs 'dzin me tog gis yang khyod brel ba che ba la/ ltos dang ngo gdong yongs su spus bkang ste rgas nyams shar 'dug ces bshad byung / tshe brtan gyis ‘brel ba che zhes pa'i yig 'bru de methong ma thag dgod rgyu zhig gting nas 'ong mod/ ru‘rgas 'dug zer ba'i skad cha des kho la skyo snang ban bun zhig skyes su bcug byung / dra rgya'i sgyu ma'i zhing khams nas mi la blo gtad dka' rung / da thengs khos mo la skad cha drang 195

dacal gyi rna 'ong /gzhan la de 'dra mi dga'/ kho ci la dga' zhe na dra mthud kha brda( 2 lko)byed rgyur mos/ khe nyin khos dra mthud kha brda byed pa brgyud ming la yongs 'dzin me tog zer ba'i na chung dra mthun ma(ṭwāṃ༅oṃ〉zhig ngo shes/ kho brnyan ris kyi mdun du bsdad/ brnyan sgo'i kha phyes/ de nas0pa.ang rtags kyi kha phyes te‘‘yongs 'dzin me tog la dngos su kha brda byed 'go brtsams/ kho mo spo langs bzhin pa 'dra ste‘‘ci red/ khyed la ci byung song / kha sang khyod nga la kha brda byed du mi 'ong don zhes dris byung / phar bltas tshod kyis‘‘yongs 'dzin me tog gis kho gnyis kha brda byed rgyu de sems la bzung ste nan tan byed bzhin yod pa ltar snang / 'on te dra rgya la mi kun gyis sgyu ma'i zhing khams su 'bod na/ yid rton rgyu ci yod/ khos kho mo ni dra mthun(༅oṃ〉tsam du brtsis pa las re ba lhag ma bcangs med/ tshe brtan gyis‘‘don dag gi dbang gis khyod la gleng mol byed ma blub ces pa'i yig 'bru de dag bde myur 'khyug pos gtags/ don dam du kha sang khos ci zhig bsgrub pa dran rgyu mi 'dug de ni rang dgar bshad pa'i skad cha yin/ ‘‘yongs 'dzin me tog gis yang‘‘khyod brel ba che ba la/ ltos dang ngo gdong yongs su spus bkang ste rgas nyams shar 'dug ces bshad byung / tshe brtan gyis‘‘brel ba che zhes pa'i yig 'bru de rmethong ma thag dgod rgyu zhig gting nas 'ong mod/ ‘‘rgas 'dug zer ba'i skad cha des kho la skyo snang ban bun zhig skyes su bcug byung / dra rgya'i sgyu ma'i zhing khams nas mi la blo gtad dka' rung / da bengs khos mo la skad cha drang 195

dgong mo der khos mi mam 'khral 'khrul zhig ma mis/mor bshad 'dod skyes/ 6 brel ba ci la tshergyu/ nyin rgyun mun 'thoms ngang du dus bda' rgyu de red’ces ji bzhin du bshad/ tshe brtan kho mo dang mu mthud du kha brda byed rtsis yod mod/ phyi dro'i las 'go rtsom la nye bas phan tshun la bde mo 'jog dgos byung /tshe brtan gzhung las khang gi thog khang gi sgo chen du 'dzul ba na/ thog khang zhol ma'i bar khyams nas 'ur rgyag pa'i sgra dang dgod sgra mched yong / de ni da nangs 'du tshogs rgyag sa'i gzhung las khang de red/ las grogs skor zhig gis lag 'khyer kha par rtses bzhin mchis/ zha'o tsha'o yis dga' bslug bslug ngang tshe brtan la shog la stos dang dngos gnas dgod rgyu 'ong zhes lag 'khyer kha par thog gi 'phrin thung zhig bstan byung / tshe brtan gyis bltas pa na de ni pho mo'i 'dod sred she sbyor dmar rjen du bris pa'i kha mtshar zhig red/ zha'o tsha'o de'i thog la cer bzhin‘‘sman chung bu mo'i brang skyes go re rlangs btsos gnyis dang mtshungs/ yojo yong nas zhim mngar zad med longs su spyod ces 'gram sha thad kyis brgyangs te bgad byung / tshe brtan la dgod kha slong ma thub na yang zha'o tsha'o yi ngo ma chod par dgod khul zhig byas/ tshe brtan gyis shes pa ni lag 'khyer kha par blangs te‘‘kha mtshar ser bor lta rgyu ni las grogs tsho'i dga' phyogs shig tu gyur pag da lta tshags par dang dus deb kyi rigs la lta 'dod kyi yi ga 'gag pa de red/ sa cha 'di dang las khungs 'di la mtshon na lag khyer kha par gyis nyi ma gtong byed kyi go ma 196

dargong mo der khos zi pham 'khral 'khrul zhig ma mis/mor bshad 'dod skyes/ ‘‘brel ba ci la tshergyu/ nyin rgyun mun 'thoms ngang du dus bda' rgyu de red ces ji bzhin du bshad/ tshe brtan kho mo dang mu mthud du kha brda byed jis yod mod/ phyi dro'i las 'go rtsom la nye bas phan tshun la bde mo 'jog dgos byung /tshe brtan gzhung las khang gi thog khang gi sgo du 'dzul ba na/ thog khang zhol ma'i bar khyams nas 'ur rgyag pa'i sgra dang dgod sgra mched yong / de ni da nangs 'du tshogs rgyag sa'i gzhung las khang de red/ las grogs skor zhig gis lag 'khyer kha par rtses bzhin mchis/ zha'o tsha'o yis dga' bslug baspug ngang tshe brtan la‘‘shog la stos dang dngos gnas dgod rgyu 'ong zhes ci lag 'khyer kha par thog gi 'phrin thung zhig bstan byung / tshe brtan gyis bltas pa na de ni pho mo'i 'dod sred she spyor dmar rjen du bris pa'i kha mtshar zhig red/ zha'o tsha'o de'i thog la cer bzhin‘ sgan chung bu mo'i brang skyes go re rlangs btsos gnyis dang mtshungs/ skejo yong nas zhim mngar zad med longs su spyod ces 'gram sha thad kyis brgyangs te bgad byung / tshe brtan la dgod kha slong ma thub na yang zha'o tsha'i yi ngo ma chod par dgod khul zhig byas/ tshe brtan gyis shes pa ni lag 'khyer kha par blangs te‘‘kha mtshar ser bor jilta rgyu ni las grogs tsho'i dga' phyogs shig tu gyur pag da lta tshags par dang dus deb kyi rigs la lta 'dod kyi yi ga 'gag pa de red/ sa cha 'di dang las khungs 'di la mtshon na lag khyer kha par gyis nyi ma gtong byed kyi go ma 196

dadul gyi rna long /gtogs chod rgyu med 'dra/ tshe brtan gyis las grogs tsho kha mtshar ser bo’ nang mgo 'khor ba de mthong ba dang sun snang dang yu mug pa cig skyes// tshe brtan/ 'go ba yis khyod kho'i gzhung las khang du shog zer/’ bde 'tshos de ltar 'bod bzhin nang du bslebs/ kho mos tshe brtan la‘ go thos la/ khyod gzhi rim du 'gro dgos zer bzhin 'dug phal cher don dag de'i skor yin rgyu red ces bshad byung / skad cha de go rjes tshe brtan glo bur ba zhig tu btang / ci'i phyir zhe na kho sngon chad thengs gcig ma gtogs gzhi rim la song ma myong / de yang zhang thog la skor ba zhig brgyab pa kho na yin/ de ring glo bur du gzhi rim du 'gro dgos pa go ma thag don dag gsar ba zhig mdun du lhags pa'i snang ba ster/ kho dang las grogs tshos 'brog khul du bya ba sgrub kyin yod na yang / 'brog pa'i ru nang du song ma myong ba ni gang mang mang yod/'di ni don dngos las 'das pa'i sgro 'dogs min/ gzhi rim gyi cha rkyen ha cang zhan te/ zhang la lar glog 'then med khar 'phrin gtong sgrig chas med/‘‘kha par mi 'gro/ brnyan 'phrin la yang lta mi thub/ rdzong thog gi las byed tsho gzhi rim du ye nas 'gro mi 'dod la/ gzhi rim du 'gro bar mgo na/ de bas kho tshos sa cha sdug po de lta bur mi 'gro ched snga mo nas smon lam 'debs/ 'gro dgos pa de tsho mi las ngan zhig tu brtsi ‘‘kha mtshar ser bor lta ba'i las grogs tshos tshe brtan la gzhi rim la 'gro dgos pa go ma thag 'gegs las thar ba ltar sems lhod la babs te‘ tshe brtan gzhi rim du skyid rgyag du 'gro rgyu 197

dgong mo der khos rmi lam 'khral 'khrul zhig ma mis/red’ ces 'phya rgod byas/ tshe brtan gyis las grogs tsho'i gdong gi rnam 'gyur dang skad cha bshad stangs la zhe sdang dang yi mug re chad cig byung mod/ phyir ci yang ma smras/ ngo ma kho tsho nyin rgyun gzhung las khang du 'dzul te don med du dus bda' ba las ci zhig bsgrub kyin yod/ kho tsho gcig las gcig nya be nyob be yin zhing / 'ga' zhig dgong mor gnyid kyis ma 'dang bar tshod tshod la glal basbyings byed/ ltos dang / las grogs shig da dung bung ba'i zur sgra'i khrod na gnyid lcog brgyab 'dug las khungs 'di ru las sgrub tu ma 'ong na mi nyan la/ yong na las rgyu snying bo dang ldan pa zhig med pas/ ro med bro rkyang gi bya ba sgrub stangs 'dis mi'i dbugs rgyun gcod la khad tu gtong / tshe brtan las khungs 'di dang 'bral 'dod skyes/ da reb gzhi rim du 'gro ba ni go skabs bzang bo zhig tshud pa min nam/ tshe brtan thar lam zhig rnyed pa ltar blo bde dga' spro zhig skyes la/ blo spobs shig ngang gis rgyas byung / kho thad kur du 'go khrid kyi gzhung las khang du song / lag 'khyer kha par rtses bzhin pa'i 'go khrid kyis kho mthong ba dang nam rgyun mthong dka' ba'i 'dzum mdangs shig ston bzhin nang du bsus la/ de mur nam rgyun thos dka' ba'i ngag 'jam pos‘‘rdzong gi na gzhon las byed skor zhig gzhi rim du las don bsgrub tu skong 'then byas 'dug khyod kyang de'i nang 'dus/ 'di ni rdzong gi bkod sgrig red/ngas khyod song zer ba min/ gzhi rim du song na za 'thung dang 'dug khang gang thad nas stabs bde min/ de'i khar da thengs zhang thog ma zad 'brog pa'i ru 198

mjug gtam/lta klog gi zhor du ci zhig 'bri rgyu ni nga'i chung dus nas ma dor ba'i dga' phyogs gtso bo yin la/ bya ba'i sgang du'ang btang lhod byas ma myong /'bri 'dod dus sems na dran dran po shog ngos su phab ste gsog nyar ram rang gi blo ru babs pa dag rtsom sgrig khang du bskur te par 'god byed par re bas sgug pa yin/ nga ni sgyug thogs pa gzhan ltar sna gcig kho nar 'jus pa tsam gyis yid tshim pa zhig min te/ snya na ngag dang lhug rtsom/ de min sgrung gtam la yang 'jug 'dod skyes/ ngas myong tshor zhig la rtsom 'bri ba la rtsom lus kyis tshad bzung na phan che ba ma mthong la/ rmongs blor shar ba ni rtsom lus phan tshun bar grogs dang mthun rkyen sgrub thub snyam/ yang na 'di ni phran gyi bsam blo smin thag ma chod pa'i rkyen te nar ma son pa'i skad cha ldab ldib cig yin yang srid/ ngo ma da rag bar du bris rtsom mang po zhig dus deb dang tshags par thog 'god thub byung mod/ dga' 'os pa'i 'bras bu da dung reg thub med la/ chud zos su btang ba'i lo zla dang bsdur na ngo gnong dgos te lag nas ci yang ma 'khyongs pa 'dra/ bsdus deb tu 'khod pa dag kyang gtam rgyud 201

martsag gtam/tsam du zad pas rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi srang la 'jal rgyu med/ ro myong byed rin med pas chen po dag gi mdun sar 'khyer srol ga nas yod de/ na ge nog ge 'ga' bris 'dug ces logs su baphyur mkhan yod na thang mod/ 'di dag rtsed spyad dgod spyad kyis bris pa min la/ gzhan la mgo bskor ba'ang min te dgod bro ba'i tshig gi shugs na dgod rgyu dang ngu rgyu zhig bltas tshar rjes bro ba ro ru myong rgyu zhig ster thub snyam/ bsdus deb 'di nga rtsom la phyogs pa'i lam bu'i ngos kyi rkang rjes te mgo rtsom pa'i rol dbyangs yin la/ dka' sdug gi lam thag ring por gom pa re re nan gyis bgrod pa'i spobs pa dang yid ches kyang yin/ deb 'di par du bsgrun pa la dus yun ring mo nas bdag la slob ston dang gzhen skul 'jungs pa med par byed mkhan〈〈mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉〉rtsom sgrig khang gi gtso sgrig pa gzhon pa dge rgan bka' ma mkha' 'bum dang /rtsom sgrig gi skabs su rogs gang mang byed mkhan〈〈sprang char〉zom sgrig khang gi chos skyong / 'gro song thad du dngos brgyud gang rung nas rogs byed mkhan gyi phu bo gnyis dang grogs stag lha rgyal/ 'phags pa tshe ring a sangs lha mgon/ mkha' mo tshe ring / skal bzang rdo rje bcas la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu ba yin la/ lhod g.yeng gi bar gseng du mig zung gi bung ba lan gcig g.yor zhing dgongs 'char lhug lhug 'jo bar klog pa po rnams la bka' drin che zhu ba lags/zhesartsom mkhan gyis2006lo'i gnam lo gsar tshesal pha yulu rdo srisanag202
